Kubanga ng’Abakristaayo bonna, nga bwe bali Abakristaayo, bwe baalekayo ensi eno, okwetegekera, olw’okwewaayo okwa buli lunaku n’obutukuvu mu byonna, embeera ey’emirembe gyonna ey’engeri endala ddala, bateekwa okutunuulira emirimu egy’ensi ng’ebyetaago eby’ensi, n’obunafu bw’omubiri; ebintu ebitalina kwegombebwa wabula okugumiikirizibwa n’okubonaabona nabyo, okutuusa okufa n’okuzuukira lwe birituttwala mu mbeera ey’emirembe gyonna ey’essanyu ery’amazima.

Kale oyo atatunuulira bintu by’obulamu buno mu ddaala lino ery’obutono, tayinza kugambibwa nti awulira oba akkiriza amazima agasinga obukulu ag’Obukristaayo. Kubanga bw’alowooza nti waliwo ekintu ekinene oba ekikulu mu mirimu gy’abantu, ayinza okugambibwa nti awulira oba akkiriza Ebyawandiikibwa ebyo, ebiraga obulamu buno, n’ebintu ebisinga obukulu eby’obulamu, ng’ebibumbe by’amazzi ebibutuka, olufu, ebirooto, n’ebisiikirize?

Bw’alowooza nti okweyoleka, n’okweraga, n’ekitiibwa eky’ensi, lye ssanyu erituufu ery’Omukristaayo, ayinza atya okugambibwa nti awulira oba akkiriza enjigiriza eno, "Mulina omukisa bwe babakyawa, ne babeewala, ne babavuma, ne basiiga erinnya lyammwe enziro, olw’Omwana w’Omuntu"? [Lukka 6:22] Kubanga mazima, singa waaliwo essanyu ery’amazima lyonna mu kweyoleka, n’okweraga, n’ekitiibwa eky’ensi; singa ebintu bino byasaanira ebirowoozo byaffe n’okufaayo kwaffe; tekyandibadde nsonga ya ssanyu lisingirayo ddala, bwe tubiggibwako olw’okuyigganyizibwa n’okubonaabona. N’olwekyo omuntu bw’anaabeera mu ngeri eraga nti awulira era akkiriza enjigiriza z’Obukristaayo ezisinga okuba ez’omusingi, ateekwa okubeera waggulu w’ensi; guno gwe mutima ogulina okumusobozesa okukola emirimu gy’obulamu, naye n’abeera mulamu eri Katonda yekka, n’okuyita mu mulimu ogumu ogw’ensi n’ebirowoozo eby’omu ggulu. Era kyetaagisa abantu okubeera mu mirimu gyabwe n’omutima guno, nga bwe kyetaagisa omulimu gwabwe gwennyini okuba ogukkirizibwa.

Omulimi alima ettaka akola omulimu ogw’obwesimbu, ogwetaagisa mu bulamu era ogusobola ennyo okufuulibwa obuweereza obusiimibwa Katonda. Naye bw’akola era n’afuba, si kutuukiriza bigendererwa bya magezi eby’obulamu, wabula alyoke abe n’enkumbi ey’effeeza, n’embalaasi ze zisibibwe n’ebyuma ebya zaabu, obwesimbu bw’omulimu gwe bubula gy’ali, era omulimu gwe gufuuka obusirusiru bwe.

Omusuubuzi ayinza mu bwenkanya okulowooza nti kituukagana n’okwagala kwa Katonda, okutunda ebintu ng’ebyo ebitaliiko kabi era eby’omugaso mu bulamu, ebiyamba ye yennyini n’abalala, okufuna eby’okwebeezaawo ebisaanidde, era ebibasobozesa okuyamba abo abeetaaga okuyambibwa. Naye singa, mu kifo ky’ekyo, asuubula ng’atunuulira ye yekka, awatali tteeka ddala okuggyako ery’omutima gwe; bw’eba nga ekigendererwa kye ekikulu mu kyo kwe kugaggawala, alyoke abeere mu kweyoleka n’okwekkusa, era asobole okuva mu mirimu okudda mu bugayaavu n’okwejalabya; obusuubuzi bwe, gy’ali, bubulwa obutaliiko musango bwabwo bwonna, era buli wala nnyo okuba obuweereza obusiimibwa Katonda, ne kiba nti bwe bubeera bubeezi omululu, okwerowoozaako, n’okwegomba obukulu okulabika obulungi okusingawo. Kubanga omuntu ng’oyo afuula ebyetaago by’omulimu okuba amalala n’omululu, nga omutamiivu n’omuluvu bwe bafuula ebyetaago by’okulya n’okunywa okuba obuluvu n’obutamiivu. Kale oyo agolokoka mu makya ennyo n’akola okutuusa ekiro, atuuyana era akola olw’ebigendererwa bino, alyoke lumu agaggawale, abeere mu masanyu n’okwekkusa, tabeera mulamu olw’ekitiibwa kya Katonda, okusinga oyo azannya era akuba zaala olw’ebigendererwa bye bimu. Kubanga wadde waliwo enjawulo nnene wakati w’obusuubuzi n’okukuba zaala, naye enjawulo eyo esinga obungi ebula, abantu bwe basuubula n’okwegomba kwe kumu n’emitima gye gimu, era olw’ebigendererwa bye bimu, abalala bye bakubira zaala. Okusaasira, n’okwambala obulungi ennyo, bintu bya njawulo nnyo; naye abantu bwe bagaba ebirabo eri abaavu olw’ensonga ze zimu abalala ze bambalira obulungi, balyoke balabibwe era beewuunyizibwe, olwo okusaasira kufaanana bufaananyi obutaliimu bw’engoye ennungi. Mu ngeri y’emu, ensonga ze zimu bwe zifuula abantu abamu abanyiikivu era abakozi mu busuubuzi bwabwe, ezifuula abalala abatakoowa mu kukuba zaala, okufuba ng’okwo kufaanana bufaananyi okufuba kw’okukuba zaala.

Calidus amaze emyaka egisukka amakumi asatu ng’asuubula mu kibuga ekisinga obunene mu bwakabaka; emyaka egyo gyonna abadde yeeyongera bulijjo mu busuubuzi bwe n’obugagga bwe. Buli ssaawa ey’emisana gy’ali ssaawa ya mirimu; era wadde alya era anywa nnyo n’omutima gwonna, naye buli kijjulo kirabika nga kya kwanguyirira, era yandyebazizza Katonda ku mmere singa yalina obudde. Calidus akomekkereza buli lunaku mu kifo awanywerwa omwenge, naye tafuna budde kubeerayo okutuusa nga ssaawa ssatu ez’ekiro ziri kumpi. Bulijjo awalirizibwa okunywa ekikompe ekinene, okugoba ebirowoozo by’emirimu mu mutwe gwe, n’okuleetera omwoyo gwe otulo okumala okwebaka. Akola emirimu ebbanga lyonna ng’agolokoka, era amala okutereeza ensonga eziwerako nga tannatuuka mu kisenge kye eky’okubaliramu ensimbi. Essaala ze kwe kwogera mu bwangu ekigambo kimu oba bibiri, by’atasubwa n’akatono mu mbeera y’obudde ey’embuyaga ne kibuyaga, kubanga bulijjo aba n’ekintu ekimu oba ekirala ku nnyanja. Calidus ajja kukugamba, n’essanyu lingi, nti amaze emyaka egyo gyonna mu kwanguyirira kuno, era nti kwandibadde kumusse edda, singa tekyali nti abadde n’etteeka ery’okuva mu kibuga buli Lwamukaaga, n’afuula Ssande olunaku olw’emirembe, n’okuwummula obulungi mu kyalo.

Kaakano mugagga nnyo, ne kiba nti yandirese emirimu gye, ne yeesanyusa mu bukadde bwe ng’azimba, era ng’ateeka ebintu mu nnyumba ennungi mu kyalo, wabula atya nti yandinakuwadde singa yandirese emirimu gye. Ajja kukugamba, n’obukakali bungi, nti kya kabi omuntu eyamanyiira okufuna ensimbi okulekera ddala okuzifuna. Ebirowoozo by’eddiini bwe bibaawo nga bimwesenseddemu mu mutwe mu kiseera kyonna, Calidus yeematiza n’okulowooza nti teyabangako mukwano gw’abakyamu mu kukkiriza, n’abatakkiriza, nti bulijjo abadde wa mpisa ennungi eri omusumba w’ekigo kye, era emirundi mingi awadde ekintu eri amasomero ag’okusaasira.

Kale engeri eno ey’obulamu eri wala nnyo n’enjigiriza zonna n’empisa z’Obukristaayo, ne kiba nti tewali ayinza kugibeeramu olw’obutamanya oba obunafu. Calidus tayinza kulowooza nti "yazaalibwa omulundi ogwokubiri olw’Omwoyo"; [Yokaana 3] nti "mu Kristo kitonde kiggya"; nti abeera wano ng’omugwira era omutambuze, [1 Peetero 2:11] ng’ateeka okwagala kwe ku bintu ebiri waggulu, era ng’atereka obugagga mu ggulu, [Abakkolosaayi 3:1] — tayinza kulowooza kino, okusinga bw’ayinza okulowooza nti obulamu bwe bwonna abadde Mutume akola ebyamagero, era abuulira Enjiri.

Era kiteekwa okukkirizibwa, nti abasuubuzi abasinga obungi, naddala mu bibuga ebinene, bafaanana nnyo Calidus. Obalaba wiiki yonna nga baziikiddwa mu mirimu, nga tebasobola kulowooza ku kintu kirala; olwo ne bamalira Ssande mu bugayaavu n’okuwummula, mu kutambulatambula mu byalo, mu kukyala ng’okwo ne mu nkuŋŋaana ez’ebinyumu, ebifuula olunaku olwo emirundi mingi okuba olusinga obubi mu wiiki.

Kale tebabeera bwe batyo kubanga tebasobola kwebeezaawo nga tebafaayo nnyo era nga tebeewaddeyo nnyo ku mirimu; wabula babeera bwe batyo kubanga baagala okugaggawala mu busuubuzi bwabwe, n’okulabirira amaka gaabwe mu kweyoleka ng’okwo n’eddaala ery’okwewunda, obulamu obw’Ekikristaayo obw’amagezi bwe butetaaga. Ggyawo bugyi omutima guno, olwo abantu ab’obusuubuzi obwa buli ngeri bajja kwesanga nga balina obudde okubeera buli lunaku ng’Abakristaayo, okwegendereza buli buvunaanyizibwa bw’Enjiri, okubeera mu ngeri ey’eddiini erabika, era buli lunaku okuba abakuumi abanyiikivu ab’okusaba okwa kyama n’okwa lwatu.

Kale engeri yokka ey’okukola kino, kwe kuba nti abantu batwala obusuubuzi bwabwe ng’ekintu kye bateekwa okuwaayo olw’ekitiibwa kya Katonda, ekintu kye balina okukola mu ngeri yokka eyinza okukifuula obuvunaanyizibwa gy’ali. Tewali kintu kiyinza kuba kituufu mu mirimu, ekitali wansi w’amateeka gano. — Omutume alagira abaddu okuwulira bakama baabwe "ng’omutima gwammwe mumalirivu, nga bwe mwamalirira mu Kristo. Ekyo temukikola lwa kulabibwa, abantu balyoke babasiime, wabula mukolenga ng’abaddu ba Kristo nga mukola n’omutima gwammwe gwonna, nga Katonda bw’ayagala. Muweerezenga n’omutima omulungi ng’abakolera Mukama waffe so si ng’abakolera abantu." [Abaefeso 6:5; Abakkolosaayi 3:22, 23]

Ekigambo kino kiraga ekimala, nti Abakristaayo bonna balina okubeera abalamu eri Katonda yekka mu buli mbeera n’embeera, nga bakola omulimu gw’okuyitibwa kwabwe okwa bulijjo mu ngeri eyo, era olw’ebigendererwa ebyo, ebigufuula ekitundu ky’okwewaayo kwabwe oba obuweereza eri Katonda. Kubanga mazima singa abaddu abaavu tebalina kukola mirimu gyabwe ng’abasanyusa abantu, bwe baba nga balina okutunuulira Katonda yekka mu bikolwa byabwe byonna, n’okuweereza n’omutima omumalirivu, ng’abaweereza Mukama, mazima abantu ab’emirimu emirala n’embeera endala bateekwa nabo okukola emirimu gyabwe n’omutima gwe gumu omumalirivu; si ng’abasanyusa obutaliimu bw’ebirowoozo byabwe, si ng’abamatiza okwegomba kwabwe okw’ensi okw’okwerowoozaako, wabula ng’abaweereza ba Katonda mu byonna bye balina okukola. Kubanga mazima tewali n’omu aligamba, nti omuddu alina okuwaayo embeera y’obulamu bwe eri Katonda, n’afuula okwagala kwa Katonda etteeka lyokka n’ekigendererwa ky’obuweereza bwe, naye nti omusuubuzi teyeetaaga kukola n’omwoyo gwe gumu ogw’okwewaayo mu mulimu gwe. Kubanga kino busirusiru, nga okufuula ekyetaagisa omuntu omu okuba omwenkanya oba omwesigwa okusinga omulala.

N’olwekyo kikakafu ddala nti tewali Mukristaayo alina kweyingiza mu mirimu okusukka, wadde olw’ebigendererwa ebirala byonna, okuggyako ebyo by’ayinza n’omutima omumalirivu okuwaayo eri Katonda, ng’obuweereza obw’amagezi. Kubanga Omwana wa Katonda yatununula olw’ekigendererwa kino kyokka, tulyoke, olw’obulamu obw’amagezi n’okutya Katonda, tubeere abalamu olw’ekitiibwa kya Katonda; lino lye tteeka lyokka n’ekipimo eri buli ddaala n’embeera ey’obulamu. Awatali tteeka lino, omulimu ogusinga okukkirizibwa gufuuka embeera y’obulamu ey’ekibi.

Ggyawo kino mu bulamu bw’omukulembeze w’eddiini, olwo omulimu gwe omutukuvu gumwanika bwanisi eri okusalirwa omusango okusingawo. Ggyawo kino mu basuubuzi, olwo amadduuka gaba bugaba ennyumba ez’omululu n’amagoba ag’obukyafu. Ggyawo kino mu bami ab’ekitiibwa, olwo engeri y’obulamu bwabwe efuuka ey’obuluvu, amalala, n’obukaba. Ggyawo etteeka lino ku mmeeza zaffe, olwo byonna bigwa mu buluvu n’obutamiivu. Ggyawo ekipimo kino ku by’okwambala byaffe n’engoye zaffe, olwo byonna bifuulibwa ebizigo, n’ebimasamasa, n’eby’okwewunda eby’ekisesa, ebiri ensonyi ddala eri ayambala. Ggyawo kino ku nkozesa y’obugagga bwaffe, olwo ojja kusanga abantu nga tebalina kye bakwatirako okuggyako okusaasira. Ggyawo kino ku kwesanyusa kwaffe, olwo tojja kusanga mizannyo gya busirusiru nnyo, wadde ebinyumu ebitaliimu nnyo era eby’obuvundu nnyo, okubeera essanyu ly’Abakristaayo. N’olwekyo bwe tuba nga twagala okubeera abalamu eri Katonda, kyetaagisa okuleeta obulamu bwaffe bwonna wansi w’etteeka lino, okufuula ekitiibwa Kye etteeka lyokka n’ekipimo ky’okukola kwaffe mu buli mulimu gw’obulamu. Kubanga tewali kwewaayo kulala kwa mazima, wabula kuno okw’okubeera abeewaddeyo eri Katonda mu mirimu egya bulijjo egy’obulamu bwaffe.

N’olwekyo abantu tebalina kwematiza na kuba nti emirimu gyabwe gikkirizibwa, wabula balina okulowooza oba bagikozesa nga bwe balina okukozesa buli kintu ng’abagwira era abatambuze, abaabatizibwa mu kuzuukira kwa Yesu Kristo, abalina okumugoberera mu ngeri y’obulamu ey’amagezi era ey’omu ggulu, mu kutta okwegomba kwonna okw’ensi, ne mu kulongoosa n’okutegeka emmeeme zaabwe olw’okwesiima okw’omukisa mu Katonda. [Abakkolosaayi 3:1; 1 Peetero 1:15, 16; Abaefeso 5:26, 27]

Kubanga okuba ab’obutaliimu, oba ab’amalala, oba ab’omululu, oba abeegomba obukulu, mu ngeri eya bulijjo ey’emirimu gyaffe, kikontana n’emitima gino emitukuvu egy’Obukristaayo, nga obukumpanya n’obutaba mwesigwa bwe bikontana nagyo.

Singa omuluvu yandigambye, ng’awolereza obuluvu bwe, nti alya bulya ebintu ebikkirizibwa okuliibwa, yandyewolerezza obulungi nga omusuubuzi ow’omululu, ayaayaana, eyeegomba obukulu, ayinza okugamba nti akola bukozi emirimu egikkirizibwa. Kubanga ng’Omukristaayo bw’atalagirwa kuba mwesigwa kyokka, wabula okuba n’omwoyo gw’Ekikristaayo, n’okufuula obulamu bwe okwegezaamu obwetoowaze, okwenenya, n’okwagala eby’omu ggulu, bwe kityo emitima gyonna egikontana na bino gikontana n’Obukristaayo, ng’obukumpanya bwe bukontana n’obwesigwa.

N’olwekyo ensonga mu lwatu ekoma wano; emitima gyonna egitali mitereevu mu busuubuzi ne mu mirimu gifaanana bufaananyi emitima egitali mitereevu mu kulya n’okunywa.

Endowooza ez’amalala, n’okwegomba okutaliimu, mu mirimu gyaffe egy’ensi, mazima bibi era buvundu, nga obunnanfuusi mu kusaba, oba obutaliimu mu kugaba ebirabo eri abaavu. Era tewali nsonga eyinza okuweebwa lwaki obutaliimu mu birabo byaffe eri abaavu butufuula ab’okwenyinyalwa eri Katonda, etalyoleka nti amalala ag’engeri endala yonna nago ga kwenyinyalwa mu ngeri y’emu. Oyo akola era afuba mu mulimu gwe, alyoke yeeyoleke mu nsi era asikirize amaaso g’abantu ku kumasamasa kw’embeera ye, ali wala n’obwetoowaze obw’okutya Katonda obw’Omukristaayo, nga oyo agaba ebirabo eri abaavu alyoke alabibwe abantu. Kubanga ensonga lwaki amalala n’obutaliimu mu ssaala zaffe ne mu birabo byaffe eri abaavu bibifuula obuweereza obutasiimibwa Katonda, si lwa kuba nti waliwo ekintu eky’enjawulo mu ssaala ne mu birabo eri abaavu, ekitayinza kukkiriza malala, wabula kubanga amalala tegaatonderwa muntu mu ngeri yonna, wadde mu kintu kyonna; gazikiriza okutya Katonda kw’essaala zaffe n’ebirabo byaffe eri abaavu, kubanga gazikiriza okutya Katonda kwa buli kintu kye gakwatako, era gafuula buli kikolwa kye gafuga obutasobola kuweebwayo eri Katonda.

N’olwekyo singa twali tusobola okwegabanyaamu bwe tutyo, okuba abeetoowaze mu bintu ebimu, n’ab’amalala mu birala, obwetoowaze obwo tebwandituyambye n’akatono, kubanga Katonda atwetaagako mazima okuba abeetoowaze mu bikolwa byaffe byonna n’ebigendererwa byaffe, nga bwe atwetaagako okuba ab’amazima era abeesigwa mu bikolwa byaffe byonna n’ebigendererwa byaffe.

Era ng’omuntu bw’ataba mwesigwa era wa mazima, kubanga ali bw’atyo eri abantu bangi, oba mu biseera ebiwerako, wabula kubanga amazima n’obwesigwa bye kipimo ky’enkolagana ze zonna ne buli muntu; bwe kiri bwe kityo mu bwetoowaze, oba mu mutima omulala gwonna; guteekwa okuba empisa ey’ebirowoozo byaffe ey’awamu era efuga, era nga yeetuuka ku bikolwa byaffe byonna n’ebigendererwa byaffe, nga tennabalirwa gye tuli.

Mazima ebiseera ebimu twogera, ng’abalowooza nti omuntu ayinza okuba omwetoowaze mu bintu ebimu, n’ow’amalala mu birala; omwetoowaze mu by’okwambala, naye ng’ayenyumiriza mu kuyiga kwe; omwetoowaze mu ndabika ye, naye ow’amalala mu ndowooza ze n’ebigendererwa bye. Naye wadde kino kiyinza okuyita mu mboozi eza bulijjo, ebintu bitono mwe byogerwa ng’amazima amakakali bwe gali, tekiyinza kukkirizibwa, bwe twekebejja obutonde bw’ebikolwa byaffe.

Kisoboka nnyo omuntu abeera mulamu olw’obukumpanya, okuba omwegendereza ennyo mu kusasula ebyo by’agula; naye kale buli muntu akakasa, nti takola bw’atyo olw’omusingi gwonna ogw’obwesigwa obw’amazima.

Mu ngeri y’emu kisoboka nnyo omuntu ayenyumiriza mu bugagga bwe, eyeegomba obukulu mu ndowooza ze, oba ayenyumiriza mu kuyiga kwe, obutafaayo ku by’okwambala n’endabika ye mu ngeri omuntu omwetoowaze ddala gy’ayinza okukola; naye okulowooza nti akola bw’atyo olw’omusingi ogw’amazima ogw’obwetoowaze obw’eddiini, busirusiru bwe bumu ng’okulowooza nti omukumpanya asasula by’agula olw’omusingi ogw’obwesigwa obw’eddiini.

N’olwekyo, ng’obutaba mwesigwa obwa buli ngeri bwe buzikiriza okwefuula kwaffe nti tulina omusingi gw’ebirowoozo ogw’obwesigwa, bwe gatyo amalala aga buli ngeri gazikiriza okwefuula kwaffe nti tulina omwoyo omwetoowaze.

Tewali yeewuunya nti essaala ezo n’ebirabo eri abaavu, ebiva mu malala n’okweraga, bya kwenyinyalwa eri Katonda; naye kyangu okulaga, nti amalala gasonyiyibwa eyo nga bwe gasonyiyibwa awalala wonna.

Singa twali tusobola okulowooza nti Katonda agaana amalala mu ssaala zaffe ne mu birabo byaffe eri abaavu, naye n’agumiikiriza amalala mu by’okwambala byaffe, mu ndabika yaffe, oba mu bugagga bwaffe, kyandibadde kye kimu n’okulowooza, nti Katonda avumirira obulimba mu bikolwa ebimu, naye n’abukkiriza mu birala. Kubanga amalala, mu kintu ekimu, gaawukana ku malala mu kintu ekirala, ng’okubba omuntu omu bwe kwawukana ku kubba omulala.

Era nate, amalala n’okweraga bwe biba eby’okwenyinyalwa bwe bityo ne kiba nti bizikiriza omugaso n’omuwendo gw’ebikolwa ebisinga okuba eby’amagezi, mazima biteekwa okuba eby’okwenyinyalwa mu ngeri y’emu mu bikolwa ebyo ebyesigamye bwesigamizi ku bunafu n’obukoowu bw’obutonde bwaffe. Bwe kiti, ebirabo eri abaavu Katonda abiragira, ng’ebirungi ennyo mu byo byokka, ng’eby’okulabirako eby’amazima eby’omutima ogw’obwakatonda, naye engoye zikkirizibwa bukkirizibwa okubikka ensonyi zaffe; mazima, n’olwekyo, kiteekwa okuba waakiri eddaala ly’amalala ery’okwenyinyalwa ng’eryo, okwenyumiriza mu ngoye zaffe, nga bwe kiri okwenyumiriza mu birabo byaffe eri abaavu.

Era nate, tulagirwa "okusabanga obutayosa," [1 Basessaloniika 5:17] ng’engeri ey’okufuula emmeeme zaffe okugulumizibwa ennyo n’okuba ez’omu ggulu, naye tugaanibwa okweterekera eby’obugagga ku nsi; [Matayo 6:19] era tuyinza okulowooza nti si kibi nga bwe kiri okwenyumiriza mu by’obugagga ebyo bye tugaanibwa okutereka, ng’okwenyumiriza mu ssaala ezo ze tulagirwa okusaba?

Abakazi balagirwa okubikka emitwe gyabwe, n’okwewunda n’okwegendereza: [1 Abakkolinso 11:13; 1 Timoseewo 2:9] n’olwekyo, bwe baba ab’obutaliimu mu bintu ebyo ebigaanibwa mu lwatu, bwe beesiiga ebizigo ku kitundu ekyo, ekiyinza okuwundibwa okwegendereza kwokka, mazima balina bingi bye beenenya olw’amalala ng’ago, ng’abo amalala gaabwe ge gabaleetera okusaba n’okusaasira. Kino kiteekwa okukkirizibwa; okuggyako nga tugamba nti kisonyiyibwa nnyo okwenyumiriza mu nsonyi zaffe, okusinga okwenyumiriza mu mpisa zaffe ennungi.

Eby’okulabirako bino byonna bigendereddwa bugenderezi okutulaga obwetaavu obunene obw’okutya Katonda okutegeke era okw’engeri emu ng’okwo, okwetuuka ku bikolwa byonna eby’obulamu bwaffe obwa bulijjo.

Nti tuteekwa okulya n’okunywa, n’okwambala n’okwogera, ng’okwefuga kw’omwoyo gw’Ekikristaayo bwe kuli, obuteeyingiza mu mirimu okuggyako egyo gye tusobola mu mazima okuwaayo eri Katonda, wadde okugigoberera okusukka ekyo ekiyamba ebigendererwa eby’amagezi eby’obulamu obutukuvu era obwewaddeyo eri Katonda. — Nti tuteekwa okuba abeesigwa, si mu biseera ebimu byokka, ne mu bintu ng’ebyo ebitenderezebwa mu nsi, ebyangu okukola, era ebitaliimu kabi, wadde okufiirwa, wabula olw’omusingi omulamu ogw’obwenkanya ng’ogwo, ogutuleetera okwagala amazima n’obwesimbu mu ngeri zaago zonna, okubigoberera mu kabi konna, ne mu kuwakanyizibwa kwonna; nga tumanyi nti gye tukoma okusasula ennyo olw’amazima gonna, n’endagaano yaffe gy’ekoma okuba ennungi, era nti obwesimbu bwaffe lwe bufuuka ejjinja ery’omuwendo, bwe tuba nga tuwaddeyo byonna okubukuuma. — Nti tuteekwa okuba abeetoowaze, si mu bintu ng’ebyo ebisuubirwa mu nsi, oba ebituukagana n’emitima gyaffe, oba ebikoma ku biseera ebimu; wabula mu bwetoowaze bw’omwoyo ng’obwo, obutufuula abawombeefu era abeetoowaze mu bulamu bwaffe bwonna, obweyoleka mu by’okwambala byaffe, mu ndabika yaffe, mu mboozi zaffe, mu kwesiima kwaffe mu nsi, mu mirembe gy’ebirowoozo byaffe, mu kugumiikiriza ebisobyo bye batukola, mu kugondera abatusinga, ne mu kukkakkanira abo abali wansi waffe, ne mu bikolwa byonna eby’okungulu eby’obulamu bwaffe. — Nti tuteekwa okuwaayo, si biseera na bifo byokka eri okusaba, wabula okubeera buli wamu mu mwoyo gw’okwewaayo eri Katonda; nga tulina emitima egitunuulidde bulijjo eggulu, nga tutunuulira Katonda waggulu mu bikolwa byaffe byonna, era nga tukola buli kintu ng’abaweereza Be; nga tubeera mu nsi nga mu yeekaalu ya Katonda entukuvu, era nga tumusinza bulijjo, wadde si na mimwa gyaffe, naye n’okwebaza kw’emitima gyaffe, obutukuvu bw’ebikolwa byaffe, n’okukozesa ebirabo Bye byonna mu kutya Katonda ne mu kusaasira. — Nti tuteekwa, si kutuma bwegayirizi n’ebirowoozo mu Ggulu byokka, wabula okuyita mu mirimu gyaffe gyonna egy’ensi n’omwoyo ogw’omu ggulu, ng’ebitundu by’omubiri gwa Kristo ogw’ekyama; tulyoke, n’emitima emiggya n’ebirowoozo ebiggya, tufuule obulamu obw’oku nsi okwetegekera obulamu obw’obukulu n’ekitiibwa mu bwakabaka obw’omu Ggulu. Kale engeri yokka ey’okutuuka ku kutya Katonda kuno okw’omwoyo, kwe kuleeta ebikolwa byo byonna wansi w’etteeka lye limu ng’okwewaayo kwo n’ebirabo byo eri abaavu. Omanyi bulungi nnyo ekifuula okutya Katonda okw’ebirabo byo eri abaavu oba okw’okwewaayo kwo; kale amateeka ge gamu, okutunuulira Katonda okwe kumu, biteekwa okufuula buli kintu ekirala ky’okola, obuweereza obusaanira era obusiimibwa eri Katonda.

Ebimala, nga bwe nsuubira, byogeddwa, okukulaga obwetaavu bw’okuyingiza bwe tutyo eddiini mu bikolwa byonna eby’obulamu bwo obwa bulijjo, n’okubeera omulamu n’okukola ng’otunuulira Katonda mu ngeri y’emu, mu byonna by’okola, nga mu ssaala zo ne mu birabo byo eri abaavu.

Okulya kye kimu ku bikolwa ebisinga obwangu eby’obulamu bwaffe; tukufaanaganya n’ebisolo byokka; naye tulaba nti okutya Katonda kw’emirembe gyonna egy’ensi kwafuula ekikolwa kino ekya bulijjo eky’obulamu obw’ensolo okuba okutya Katonda, nga buli kijjulo kitandika era kiggwa n’okwewaayo eri Katonda.

Tukyalaba ebisigaddewo ebimu eby’empisa eno mu maka g’Abakristaayo agasinga obungi, akakolwa akatono ng’ako akakulaga, nti abantu baakozesanga okukoowoola Katonda ku ntandikwa ne ku nkomerero y’ebijjulo byabwe. Naye, mazima, kaakano okutwalira awamu kukolebwa, ne kiba nti kulabika nga kusekerera okwewaayo eri Katonda, okusinga okwemalira ebirowoozo ku Katonda n’ekitiibwa. Mu nnyumba emu oboolyawo oyinza okulaba omukulu w’amaka ng’aggyako bugyi enkuufiira ye; mu ndala, ng’asituka ekitundu ku ntebe ye; omulala, oboolyawo, ajja kutuuka n’okufaanana ng’ayogedde ekintu; naye, wadde kiri kityo, okugezaako kuno okutono bye bisigaddewo eby’okwewaayo okumu okwakozesebwanga edda mu biseera ng’ebyo, era bukakafu nti eddiini edda yali ya kitundu kino eky’obulamu obwa bulijjo.

Naye tutuuse wano kaakano, ne kiba nti wadde empisa ekyakuumibwa, naye tetuyinza kugumiikiriza oyo alabika ng’agikola, n’obwegendereza bwonna, era tukitwala ng’akabonero ak’omwoyo ogw’obukambwe mu ddiini, omuntu bw’atamaliriza amangu ddala nga atandise.

Saagala kulowoozebwa nti mpolereza obwetaavu bw’essaala empanvu mu biseera bino; naye kino kyokka ndowooza kiyinza okwogerwa, nti okusaba bwe kuba nga kusaanira mu biseera bino, tusaanidde okwewaliriza okukozesa ebigambo ng’ebyo, ebiyinza okulaga nti tusaba Katonda n’ekitiibwa olw’ekisa n’emikisa ng’egyo egisaanira ensonga eyo mu kiseera ekyo. Bwe kitaba bwe kityo omukolo ogw’okusekerera, mu kifo ky’okusabira emmere yaffe omukisa, gutumanyiiza bumanyiiza okuzannyira mu kwewaayo eri Katonda, era gutuwa empisa ey’obutakwatibwako ssaala zaffe.

Singa buli mukulu w’amaka, buli kijjulo lwe kituuka, yandyewalirizza okusinza Katonda n’ekitiibwa, mu ngeri esaanidde ng’eyo esaanira ebirowoozo ebyewaddeyo eri Katonda, kyandimuyigirizza ddala nti okulayira, obuluvu, okulya ennyo, n’emboozi ez’obuvundu, tebisaanira n’akatono ku bijjulo ebyo, ebyalina okutandika n’okuggwa n’okwewaayo eri Katonda.

Era bwe kiba nti mu nnaku zino ez’obuvundu obubunye, ekitundu kino eky’okwewaayo kigudde mu mukolo ogw’okusekerera, kiteekwa okuteekebwa ku nsonga eno, nti obuluvu n’obutefuga bifunye obuyinza bungi nnyo ku ffe, okutukkiriza okugattako okwewaayo kwonna ku bijjulo byaffe. Naye kino kyokka kiteekwa okwogerwa, nti bwe tuliba nga tutya Katonda ng’Abayudaaya n’abakaafiiri ab’emirembe gyonna bwe baali, tulirowooza nti kisaanira okusaba ku ntandikwa ne ku nkomerero y’ebijjulo byaffe.

Nnesigamye ku mpisa eno ey’okutya Katonda ey’emirembe gyonna egy’ensi, ng’obukakafu bw’amagezi g’enjigiriza ey’essuula eno n’ezo ezigikulembeddemu; kwe kugamba, ng’obukakafu nti eddiini erina okuba etteeka n’ekipimo ky’ebikolwa byonna eby’obulamu obwa bulijjo. Kubanga mazima, bwe tuba nga tetulina kulya, okuggyako wansi w’amateeka ng’ago ag’okwewaayo eri Katonda, kiteekwa okulabika mu lwatu, nti kyonna ekirala kye tukola, kiteekwa, mu ngeri yaakyo esaanidde, okukolebwa nga tutunuulira ekitiibwa kya Katonda mu ngeri y’emu, era nga kituukagana n’emisingi gy’ebirowoozo ebyewaddeyo era ebitya Katonda.

fields.title: Abantu abatalina bwetaavu bwa kukola mirimu balina okwetunuulira ng’abeewaddeyo eri Katonda mu ddaala erisingawo
fields.body_html:
EKITUNDU ekinene eky’ensi tekiri mu bwetaavu bwa kukola mirimu na kwekozesa, era kirina obudde bwakyo n’obugagga bwakyo mu buyinza bwakyo kyokka.

Naye nga bwe watali muntu alina kubeera mu mulimu gwe nga bw’awulira, oba olw’ebigendererwa ebisanyusa endowooza ye, wabula alina okukola emirimu gye gyonna mu ngeri egifuula obuweereza eri Katonda; bwe batyo abo abatalina mulimu gwa njawulo bali wala nnyo okulekebwa mu ddembe eddene okubeera abalamu ku lwabwe, okugoberera endowooza zaabwe, n’okukozesa obudde bwabwe n’obugagga bwabwe nga bwe baagala, ne kiba nti bali wansi w’obuvunaanyizibwa obusingawo okubeera abalamu eri Katonda yekka mu bikolwa byabwe byonna.

Eddembe ly’embeera yaabwe libateeka wansi w’obwetaavu obusingawo obw’okulondanga bulijjo, n’okukolanga, ebintu ebisinga obulungi.

Be bano, abaliba basuubirwamu bingi, kubanga baweereddwa bingi.

Omuddu ayinza okubeera omulamu eri Katonda mu ngeri emu yokka ey’enjawulo, kwe kugamba, olw’okugumiikiriza n’okugondera okw’eddiini mu mbeera ye ey’obuddu.

Naye amakubo gonna ag’okubeera mu butukuvu, eby’okulabirako byonna, n’empisa ennungi eza buli ngeri, biggulwawo eri abo abeefuga bokka, obudde bwabwe, n’obugagga bwabwe.

N’olwekyo buvunaanyizibwa bw’abantu ng’abo, okukozesa n’amagezi eddembe lyabwe, okwewaayo eri empisa ennungi eza buli ngeri, okuyaayaanira buli kintu ekitukuvu era eky’okutya Katonda, okufuba okwatiikirira mu mirimu gyonna emirungi, n’okusanyusa Katonda mu ngeri esinga obugulumivu era esinga okutuukirira; buvunaanyizibwa bwabwe okuba ab’amagezi bwe batyo mu ngeri gye beeyisaamu, era okugaziya bwe batyo okufuba kwabwe okutuuka ku butukuvu, nga bwe buli obuvunaanyizibwa bw’omuddu okwewaayo eri Katonda mu mbeera ye ey’obuddu.

Toli mupakasi, oba musuubuzi omutono, toli mutunzi munene wadde mujaasi; n’olwekyo weetwale ng’ateekeddwa mu mbeera mu ngeri emu efaanana ey’Abamalayika abalungi abatumibwa mu nsi nga myoyo egiweereza, olw’obulungi bw’abantu bonna, okuyamba, okukuuma, n’okuweereza abo abagenda okusikira obulokozi.

Kubanga gy’okoma okuba ow’eddembe ku byetaago ebya bulijjo eby’abantu, gy’olina okukoma okugoberera okutuukirira okw’awaggulu okw’Abamalayika.

Singa ggwe, Serena, wawalirizibwa, olw’ebyetaago by’obulamu, okwoza engoye olw’okwebeezaawo, oba okuweereza nnyabo omu eyali akwetaagako emirimu gyo gyonna, olwo kyandibadde buvunaanyizibwa bwo okuweereza n’okugulumiza Katonda, olw’obwetoowaze, obuwulize, n’obwesigwa ng’obwo, obwandiwunze embeera y’obulamu eyo. Olwo kyandikukwasiddwa okufaayo, okukulaakulanya ettalanta eyo emu okutuuka ku ntikko yaayo. Nti ekiseera bwe kyandituuse, abantu lwe baali bagenda okusasulwa olw’emirimu gyabwe Omulamuzi omukulu ow’abalamu n’abafu, wandisembezeddwa n’ekigambo nti, "Weebale, oli muddu mulungi era mwesigwa: Yingira sanyukira wamu ne mukama wo." [Matayo 25:21]

Naye nga Katonda bwe yakuwa ttalanta ttaano, nga bwe yakuteeka waggulu w’ebyetaago by’obulamu, nga bwe yakulekera mu mikono gyo ggwe kennyini, mu ddembe ery’essanyu ery’okulonda amakubo ag’empisa ennungi agasinga obugulumivu; nga bwe yakugaggawaza n’ebirabo bingi eby’obugagga, n’atakulekera kya kukola, okuggyako okukozesa obulungi emikisa egy’engeri nnyingi, okufuna ekisinga mu bulamu obumpi, okunoonya okutuukirira kwo ggwe kennyini, ekitiibwa kya Katonda, n’obulungi bwa muliraanwa wo; bwe kityo kaakano buvunaanyizibwa bwo okugoberera abaweereza ba Katonda abasinga obukulu, okunoonyereza engeri abatukuvu abasinga okwatiikirira gye baabeeramu, okuyiga obukodyo bwonna n’engeri ez’okutuukirira, n’obutateeka nkomerero ku kwagala kwo n’okwebaza kwo eri Omutonzi omugabi ow’emikisa emingi bwe gityo.

Kaakano buvunaanyizibwa bwo okufuula ttalanta zo ettaano okuzaala endala ttaano, n’okulowooza engeri obudde bwo, n’eddembe lyo, n’obulamu bwo obulungi, n’obugagga bwo, gye biyinza okufuulibwa engeri ez’essanyu ez’okulongoosa emmeeme yo, ez’okuyamba bannaffe okukulaakulana mu makubo ag’empisa ennungi, n’ez’okukutwala ku nkomerero ku ntikko ezisinga obugulumivu ez’ekitiibwa ekitaggwaawo.

Nga bw’otolina nnyabo gw’oweereza, emmeeme yo k’ebe ekintu ky’ofaako era ky’olabirira buli lunaku. Nakuwala olw’obutali bulongoofu bwayo, amabala gaayo, n’obutatuukirira bwayo, era oyige obukodyo bwonna obutukuvu obw’okugizzaawo mu bulongoofu bwayo obw’obutonde era obw’olubereberye.

Sanyukira okugiweereza, era osabe Katonda agiwunde na buli kisa na buli kutuukirira.

Giriisa n’emirimu emirungi, giwe emirembe mu kwesudde, gifunire amaanyi mu kusaba, gifuule ey’amagezi n’okusoma, gimulise n’okufumiitiriza, gigonze n’okwagala, giwoomye n’obwetoowaze, gitoowaze n’okwenenya, gizzeemu amaanyi ne zabbuli n’ennyimba, era ogibudaabude n’okufumiitiriza emirundi mingi ku kitiibwa ekigenda okujja. Gikuume mu maaso ga Katonda, era ogiyigirize okugoberera Bamalayika abo abakuumi, abo, wadde nga bafaayo ku nsonga z’abantu, n’abasinga obwetoowaze mu bantu, naye "ennaku zonna babeera mu maaso ga Kitaffe ali mu ggulu." [Matayo 18:10]

Kino, Serena, gwe mulimu gwo. Kubanga nga bwe kiri ekikakafu nti Katonda ye Katonda omu, bwe kityo bwe kiri ekikakafu nti alina ekiragiro kimu kyokka eri abantu bonna, ka babe baddu oba ba ddembe, bagagga oba baavu; era kye kino, okukola ng’obulungi bw’obutonde obwo bwe yabawa bwe bwetaaga, okubeera abalamu mu magezi, okutambulira mu kitangaala ky’eddiini, okukozesa buli kintu ng’amagezi bwe galagira, okugulumiza Katonda mu birabo Bye byonna, n’okuwonga buli mbeera ey’obulamu eri obuweereza Bwe.

Kino kye kiragiro kimu ekya bulijjo ekya Katonda eri abantu bonna. Bw’oba n’omulimu, olina okuba ow’amagezi bw’otyo, atya Katonda, era omutukuvu, mu kugukola; bw’oba n’obudde n’obugagga mu buyinza bwo, oteekwa okuba ow’amagezi bw’otyo, omutukuvu, era atya Katonda, mu kukozesa obudde bwo bwonna, n’obugagga bwo bwonna.

Okukozesa buli kintu na buli ttalanta mu ngeri entuufu ey’eddiini, bwe buvunaanyizibwa obutayinza kwewalika obwa buli kitonde ekisobola okumanya ekituufu n’ekikyamu.

Kubanga ensonga lwaki tulina okukola ekintu kyonna nga tukikolera Katonda, era nga tutunuulira obuvunaanyizibwa bwaffe, n’akakwate kaffe naye, y’ensonga y’emu lwaki tulina okukola buli kintu nga tukikolera Katonda, era nga tutunuulira obuvunaanyizibwa bwaffe, n’akakwate kaffe naye.

Ekyo ekiri ensonga y’okuba ab’amagezi era abatukuvu mu kukola emirimu gyaffe gyonna, y’ensonga y’emu ey’okuba ab’amagezi era abatukuvu mu kukozesa ensimbi zaffe zonna.

Nga bwe tulina obutonde bwe bumu bulijjo, era nga tuli buli wamu abaweereza ba Katonda y’omu, nga buli kifo bwe kijjudde okubeerawo Kwe mu ngeri y’emu, era nga buli kintu kirabo Kye mu ngeri y’emu, bwe tutyo tuteekwa okukola bulijjo ng’amagezi g’obutonde bwaffe bwe gali; tuteekwa okukola buli kintu ng’abaweereza ba Katonda; tuteekwa okubeera mu buli kifo, nga mu maaso Ge; tuteekwa okukozesa buli kintu, ng’ekyo ekya Katonda bwe kisaanidde okukozesebwa.

Oba okutya Katonda kuno, n’amagezi, n’okwewaayo, kulina okuyita mu buli ngeri ey’obulamu, n’okutuuka ku nkozesa ya buli kintu, oba tekulina kuyita mu kitundu kyonna eky’obulamu.

Singa twali tuyinza okwerabira ffekka, oba okwerabira Katonda, singa twali tuyinza obutafaayo ku magezi gaffe, ne tubeera abalamu nga bwe tuwulira n’okwegomba, mu kintu kyonna, oba mu kiseera kyonna, oba mu kifo kyonna, kyandibadde kikkirizibwa okukola bwe tutyo mu buli kintu, nga bwe twegomba, mu buli kiseera, ne mu buli kifo.

N’olwekyo singa abantu abamu balowooza nti balina okuba abakakkamu era ab’ekitiibwa mu Kkanisa, naye bayinza okuba abasirusiru era abatabuddwa awaka; nti balina okubeera abalamu mu tteeka erimu ku Ssande, naye bayinza okumalira ennaku endala nga bwe kigwa; nti balina okuba n’ebiseera ebimu eby’okusaba, naye bayinza okwonoona obudde bwabwe obusigadde nga bwe baagala; nti balina okugaba ensimbi ezimu mu kusaasira, naye bayinza okusaasaanya ezisigadde nga bwe beegomba; abantu ng’abo tebalowoozezza kimala ku butonde bw’eddiini, wadde ku nsonga ez’amazima ez’okutya Katonda. Kubanga oyo ayinza, olw’emisingi gy’amagezi, okumanya lwaki kirungi okuba ow’amagezi era ow’ebirowoozo eby’omu ggulu mu Kkanisa, ayinza okumanya nti kyegombebwa bulijjo okuba n’emitima gye gimu mu bifo ebirala byonna. Oyo amanyi ddala lwaki asaanidde okukozesa obulungi obudde bwonna, amanyi nti tekikkirizibwa n’akatono okusuula obudde bwonna. Oyo ategeera obulungi amagezi n’obulungi bw’okusaasira, ajja kumanya nti tekiyinza kusonyiyibwa n’akatono okwonoona ezimu ku nsimbi zaffe mu malala n’obusirusiru, oba mu nsaasaanya yonna eteetaagisa.

Kubanga buli nsonga eraga amagezi n’obulungi bw’okusaasira, eraga amagezi ag’okukozesa obulungi obugagga bwaffe bwonna. Buli nsonga eraga amagezi n’obutuufu bw’okuba n’ebiseera eby’okusaba, eraga amagezi n’obutuufu bw’obutafiirwa ku budde bwaffe bwonna.

Singa omuntu yenna yali asobola okulaga nti tetwetaaga bulijjo kukola nga tuli mu maaso ga Katonda, nti tetwetaaga kulowooza na kukozesa buli kintu ng’ekirabo kya Katonda, nti tetwetaaga bulijjo kubeera balamu mu magezi, n’okufuula eddiini etteeka ly’ebikolwa byaffe byonna; ensonga ze zimu zandiraze nti tetwetaaga n’akatono kukola nga tuli mu maaso ga Katonda, wadde okufuula eddiini n’amagezi ekipimo ky’ekikolwa kyaffe kyonna. N’olwekyo, bwe tuba nga tulina okubeera abalamu eri Katonda mu kiseera kyonna, oba mu kifo kyonna, tulina okubeera abalamu eri Ye mu biseera byonna, ne mu bifo byonna. Bwe tuba nga tulina okukozesa ekintu kyonna ng’ekirabo kya Katonda, tulina okukozesa buli kintu ng’ekirabo Kye. Bwe tuba nga tulina okukola ekintu kyonna n’amateeka amakakali ag’amagezi n’okutya Katonda, tulina okukola buli kintu mu ngeri y’emu. Kubanga amagezi, n’obugezi, n’okutya Katonda, bye bintu ebisinga obulungi mu biseera byonna, ne mu bifo byonna, nga bwe biri ebintu ebisinga obulungi mu kiseera kyonna oba mu kifo kyonna.

Bwe kiba nga kye kitiibwa kyaffe era essanyu lyaffe okuba n’obutonde obw’amagezi, obuweereddwa obugezi n’amagezi, obusobola okugoberera obutonde bwa Katonda, olwo kiteekwa okuba ekitiibwa kyaffe n’essanyu lyaffe okukulaakulanya amagezi gaffe n’obugezi bwaffe, okukola ng’obulungi bw’obutonde bwaffe obw’amagezi bwe bwetaaga, n’okugoberera Katonda mu bikolwa byaffe byonna, nga bwe tusobola okukoma. N’olwekyo abo abakomya eddiini ku biseera n’ebifo, n’amateeka amatono ag’okwesudde, abalowooza nti kuba kukakanyala nnyo okuyingiza eddiini mu bulamu obwa bulijjo, n’okugireka okuteekawo amateeka eri ebikolwa byabwe byonna n’engeri zaabwe ez’obulamu, abo abalowooza bwe batyo, si kukyama kwokka, wabula bakyamye ku butonde bwonna obw’eddiini. Kubanga mazima bakyamye ku butonde bwonna obw’eddiini, abayinza okulowooza nti ekitundu kyonna eky’obulamu bwabwe kifuulibwa ekyangu, olw’okuba nga kiri wala n’eddiini. Bayinza bulungi okugambibwa nti bakyamye ku butonde bwonna obw’amagezi, abatalowooza nti kyegombebwa okuba ab’amagezi bulijjo. Tannayiga butonde bw’okutya Katonda, oyo alowooza nti kisukkiridde okutya Katonda mu bikolwa bye byonna. Tategeera kimala amagezi kye gali, oyo ateegomba nnyo okubeera omulamu mu buli kintu nga gwe bwe gali.

Singa twali n’eddiini erimu obulombolombo obw’obusirusiru, obutafaayo ku kutuukirira kw’obutonde bwaffe, abantu bandisanyuse okusonyiyibwa ekitundu ekimu eky’obulamu bwabwe okuva mu yo. Naye ng’eddiini y’Enjiri bw’eri obulongoosi n’okugulumiza bwokka obw’amagezi gaffe agasinga obulungi, nga bw’etwetaagako obulamu obw’amagezi agasingirayo ddala bwokka, nga bw’etwetaagako okukozesa ensi eno nga bw’esaanidde okukozesebwa mu magezi kwokka, okubeera mu mitima ng’egyo egiri ekitiibwa ky’ebitonde ebitegeera, okutambulira mu magezi ng’ago agagulumiza obutonde bwaffe, n’okukola okutya Katonda ng’okwo okulitusitula okututuusa eri Katonda; ani ayinza okulowooza nti kizibu okubeera bulijjo mu mwoyo gw’eddiini ng’eyo, okubeera n’ekitundu kyonna eky’obulamu bwe nga kigijjudde, okuggyako oyo yandirowoozezza nti kizibu nnyo okusingawo okuba nga Bamalayika ba Katonda mu Ggulu?

Ate era, nga Katonda bw’ali Omu era y’omu, bulijjo ng’akola nga Ye yennyini, era nga obutonde Bwe bwe buli, bwe kityo buvunaanyizibwa bwa buli kitonde kye yatonda, okubeera omulamu ng’obutonde bwe yakiwa bwe buli, n’okukola bulijjo nga kyo kyennyini.

N’olwekyo tteeka lya Katonda eritakyuka, nti ebitonde byonna eby’amagezi bikole mu magezi mu bikolwa byabyo byonna; si mu kiseera kino, oba mu kifo ekyo, oba ku nsonga eno, oba mu kukozesa ekintu ekimu eky’enjawulo, wabula mu biseera byonna, mu bifo byonna, ku nsonga zonna, ne mu kukozesa ebintu byonna. Lino tteeka eritakyuka nga Katonda, era teriyinza kulekera kubaawo, okusinga Katonda bw’ayinza okulekera okuba Katonda ow’amagezi n’entegeka.

N’olwekyo, ekitonde kyonna ekyaweebwa amagezi bwe kikola ekintu ekitali kya magezi mu kiseera kyonna, oba mu kifo kyonna, oba mu kukozesa ekintu kyonna, kisobya ku tteeka eddene ery’obutonde bwakyo, kyeyonoona, era kisobya eri Katonda, Omutonzi w’obutonde obwo.

N’olwekyo abo abawolereza okwekkusa n’ebitaliimu, emisono gyonna egy’obusirusiru, empisa, n’endowooza z’ensi, okukozesa obubi obudde bwaffe oba ensimbi zaffe, bawolereza obujeemu eri obutonde bwaffe, obujeemu eri Katonda, eyatuwa amagezi olw’ekigendererwa kimu kyokka, okugafuula etteeka n’ekipimo ky’engeri zaffe zonna ez’obulamu.

N’olwekyo, bw’oba n’omusango gw’obusirusiru bwonna, oba okusukkiriza, oba bwe weekkiriza omutima gwonna ogutaliimu, tokitwala ng’ensonga entono, kubanga kiyinza okulabika bwe kityo bwe kigeraageranyizibwa n’ebibi ebirala; wabula kitwale, nga bwe kiri okukola ekikontana n’obutonde bwo, olwo ojja kulaba nti tewali kintu kitono ekitali kya magezi; kubanga amakubo gonna agatali ga magezi gakontana n’obutonde bw’ebitonde byonna eby’amagezi, ka babe bantu oba Bamalayika: era tewali ku bo ayinza okusiimibwa Katonda, okusinga nga bwe bakola ng’amagezi n’obulungi bw’obutonde bwabwe bwe biri.

Obunafu bw’obulamu bw’omuntu bufuula emmere n’engoye ng’ebyo okwetaagisa gye tuli, Bamalayika bye batetaaga; naye kale tekikkirizibwa gye tuli okufuula ebyetaago bino obusirusiru, ne tweyagaza mu kwejalabya mu mmere, oba mu butaliimu bw’okwambala, okusinga bwe kikkirizibwa Bamalayika okukola wansi w’ekitiibwa ky’embeera yaabwe esaanidde. Kubanga obulamu obw’amagezi, n’okukozesa n’amagezi embeera yaffe esaanidde, bwe buvunaanyizibwa bw’abantu bonna, nga bwe buli obuvunaanyizibwa bwa Bamalayika bonna n’ebitonde byonna ebitegeera. Bino si birowoozo bya kuloota, oba ndowooza za kirooto, wabula mateeka geeyoleka era agatayinza kuwakanyizibwa, agasimbiddwa mu butonde bw’ebitonde eby’amagezi, ebiteekwa, nga bwe biri bwe bityo, okubeera ebiramu mu magezi, n’okugulumiza Katonda olw’okukozesa obulungi okutakoma ttalanta zaabyo ez’enjawulo n’obusobozi bwabyo. N’olwekyo wadde abantu si Bamalayika, naye bayinza okumanya olw’ebigendererwa ki, era mu mateeka ki, abantu gye balina okubeera n’okukola, nga balowooza ku mbeera n’okutuukirira kwa Bamalayika. Omulokozi waffe omutendereze yakyusa mu lwatu ebirowoozo byaffe mu ngeri eno, ng’afuula okwegayirira kuno ekitundu ekitakyuka eky’essaala zaffe zonna, "By’oyagala bikolebwe mu nsi, nga bwe bikolebwa mu ggulu." Obukakafu obweyoleka, nti obuwulize bw’abantu bulina okugoberera obuwulize bwa Bamalayika, era nti ebitonde eby’amagezi ku nsi birina okubeera ebiramu eri Katonda, ng’ebitonde eby’amagezi mu Ggulu bwe bibeera ebiramu eri Ye.

N’olwekyo, bw’oyagala okulaga ebirowoozo byo, Abakristaayo bwe basaanidde okubeera abalamu eri Katonda, n’amadaala ag’amagezi n’obutukuvu ge basaanidde okukozesaamu ebintu eby’obulamu buno, tolina kutunuulira nsi, wabula olina okutunula waggulu eri Katonda, n’ekibiina kya Bamalayika, n’olowooza ku magezi n’obutukuvu ebisaanira okukutegekera embeera ey’ekitiibwa ng’eyo. Olina okutunuulira ebiragiro byonna eby’Enjiri ebisinga obugulumivu, olina okwekebera n’omwoyo gwa Kristo, olina okulowooza engeri abantu abasinga amagezi mu nsi gye baabeeramu, olina okulowooza engeri emmeeme ezaafa gye zandibaddemu singa zaddamu okukola ekitundu ekimpi eky’obulamu bw’omuntu; olina okulowooza ku madaala ag’amagezi n’obutukuvu ge olyegomba, bw’oliba ng’ova mu nsi.

Kale kuno si kusukkiriza nsonga, oba okwetegekera okutuukirira kwonna okuteetaagisa. Kuba bugonderi okubuulirira kw’Omutume, w’agamba nti, "Eky’enkomerero, abooluganda, mulowoozenga ku buli kya mazima, na buli ekisiimibwa na buli kya butuukirivu, na buli kirongoofu, na buli kyagalibwa, na buli kyogerwako obulungi, era bwe wabangawo ekirungi oba bwe wabangawo ettendo, ebyo mubirowoozengako." [Abafiripi 4:8] Kubanga tewali ayinza kusemberera njigiriza ya kigambo kino, okuggyako oyo eyeeteerawo okukola buli kintu mu bulamu buno ng’omuweereza wa Katonda, okubeera omulamu mu magezi mu buli ky’akola, n’okufuula amagezi n’obutukuvu bw’Enjiri etteeka n’ekipimo ky’okwegomba kwe n’okukozesa kwe buli kirabo kya Katonda.

fields.title: Obuvunaanyizibwa obunene n’emigaso eminene egy’okukozesa obugagga bwaffe n’ebintu byaffe mu ngeri ey’amagezi era ey’eddiini
fields.body_html:
NGA obutukuvu bw’Obukristaayo bwe buwonga embeera zonna n’emirimu gyonna egy’obulamu eri Katonda, nga bwe butwetaagako okuyaayaanira obuwulize mu byonna, nga tukola era nga tukozesa buli kintu ng’abaweereza ba Katonda, bwe tutyo tuteekwa mu ngeri ey’enjawulo okukuuma obwegendereza buno obw’eddiini mu kukozesa obugagga bwaffe n’ebintu byaffe.

Ensonga y’ekyo yandirabise mu lwatu nnyo, singa twandirowoozezza bulowooza, nti obugagga bwaffe kirabo kya Katonda nga amaaso gaffe oba emikono gyaffe bwe biri, era tebulina kuziikibwa oba kusuulibwa nga bwe twagala, okusinga bwe tulina okwejjamu amaaso gaffe, oba okusuula ebitundu by’omubiri gwaffe nga bwe twagala.

Naye, ng’oggyeeko ensonga eno, waliwo ensonga endala nnyingi enkulu era ez’omugaso lwaki tusaanidde okwegendereza mu ngeri ey’eddiini mu kukozesa obugagga bwaffe.

Esooka, Kubanga engeri gye tukozesaamu ensimbi zaffe oba gye tusaasaanyaamu obugagga bwaffe eyingira nnyo mu mirimu gya buli lunaku, era efuula ekitundu ekinene bwe kityo eky’obulamu bwaffe obwa bulijjo, ne kiba nti obulamu bwaffe obwa bulijjo buteekwa okuba nga bwa ngeri y’emu nnyo n’engeri yaffe eya bulijjo ey’okusaasaanya obugagga bwaffe. Amagezi n’eddiini bwe bitufuga mu kino, olwo amagezi n’eddiini biba bitukutte nnyo; naye endowooza, amalala, n’okwegomba bwe biba nga bye bipimo by’okusaasaanya obugagga bwaffe, olwo endowooza, amalala, n’okwegomba biriba n’obulagirizi bw’ekitundu ekisinga obunene eky’obulamu bwaffe.

Ey’okubiri, Ensonga endala enkulu ey’okuwaayo obugagga bwaffe bwonna mu nkozesa entuufu, y’eno: kubanga busobola okukozesebwa olw’ebigendererwa ebisinga obulungi, era kye kintu ekinene bwe kityo eky’okukola ebirungi. Bwe tubwonoona tetwonoona kintu kitono, ekitalina makulu, wabula twonoona ekyo ekyandifuuliddwa amaaso eri bamuzibe, ng’omwami eri nnamwandu, nga kitaawe eri mulekwa; twonoona ekyo ekitatusobozesa kyokka okuweereza ebibudaabuda eby’ensi abo abali mu nnaku, wabula ekyo ekyanditugulidde eby’obugagga ebitaggwaawo mu Ggulu. N’olwekyo bwe tuwaayo ensimbi zaffe mu ngeri ez’obusirusiru, tuwaayo obuyinza obunene obw’okubudaabuda bannaffe, n’obw’okwefuula ab’omukisa emirembe gyonna.

Bwe wataba kintu kya kitiibwa nga okukola ebirungi, bwe wataba kintu kitufuula kufaanana Katonda bwe kityo, olwo tewali kiyinza kuba kya kitiibwa mu kukozesa ensimbi zaffe, nga okuzikozesa zonna mu mirimu egy’okwagala n’obulungi, nga twefuula mikwano, ne bakitaabwe, n’abayambi, eri bannaffe bonna, nga tugoberera okwagala kwa Katonda, era nga tufuula obuyinza bwaffe bwonna ebikolwa eby’obugabi, okufaayo, n’ekisa eri abo ababyetaaga.

Singa omuntu yalina amaaso, n’emikono, n’ebigere, by’ayinza okuwa abo ababyetaaga; singa abisiba mu ssanduuko, oba ne yeesanyusa n’okubikozesa mu ngeri eteetaagisa oba ey’ekisesa, mu kifo ky’okubiwa baganda be abaali bamuzibe era abalema, tetwandimubaze mu bwenkanya ng’omunafu atalina kisa? Singa yandisinze okulonda okwesanyusa n’okuteeka ebintu ebyo mu nnyumba ye, okusinga okwefunira empeera etaggwaawo, ng’abiwa abo abaali beetaaga amaaso n’emikono, tetwandimubaze mu bwenkanya ng’omulalu?

Kale ensimbi zirina nnyo obutonde bw’amaaso n’ebigere; bwe tuzisiba mu ssanduuko, oba ne tuziyonoona mu nsaasaanya eteetaagisa era ey’ekisesa ku ffe ffekka, ng’abaavu n’abali mu nnaku bazeetaaga olw’ebyetaago byabwe; bwe tuzimalawo mu by’okwewunda eby’ekisesa eby’okwambala, ng’abalala bafa enjala nga bali bwereere; tetuli wala n’obukambwe bw’oyo, alonda okuwunda ennyumba ye n’emikono n’amaaso okusinga okubiwa abo ababyetaaga. Bwe tulonda okwekkusa mu bisanyusa eby’ensimbi ennyingi ng’ebyo ebitaliimu mugaso gwa mazima, ebitamatiza bwetaavu bwa mazima, okusinga okwefunira empeera etaggwaawo, nga tukozesa obulungi ensimbi zaffe, tulina omusango gw’obulalu bwe, oyo alonda okusiba amaaso n’emikono, okusinga okwefuula ow’omukisa emirembe gyonna, ng’abiwa abo ababyetaaga. Kubanga bwe tumala okumatiza ebyetaago byaffe eby’okwefuga era eby’amagezi, ensimbi zaffe zonna ezisigadde zifaanana bufaananyi amaaso oba emikono egisukkiridde; kye kintu kye tutayinza kwekuumira ffekka nga tetuli basirusiru mu kukikozesa, kye kintu ekiyinza okukozesebwa obulungi kyokka, nga tukiwa abo abakyetaaga.

Ey’okusatu, Bwe twonoona ensimbi zaffe, tetuba na musango gwa kwonoona ttalanta Katonda gye yatuwa kyokka, tetuba na musango gwa kufuula ekitaliimu mugaso, ekyo ekiri engeri ey’amaanyi bwe gatyo ey’okukola ebirungi kyokka, wabula twekola ne kabi kano akalala, nti tufuula ttalanta eno ey’omugaso okuba engeri ey’amaanyi ey’okwonoona ffekka; kubanga nga bwe zisaasaanyizibwa obubi, bwe zityo bwe zisaasaanyizibwa okuwanirira omutima omubi ogumu, okumatiza okwegomba okumu okutaliimu era okutali kwa magezi, okugoberera emisono egyo, n’amalala g’ensi, bye tuteekwa, ng’Abakristaayo n’abantu ab’amagezi, okulekayo.

Ng’amagezi amangi n’ebirabo ebirungi bwe bitayinza kuzannyirwamu, ne bibula bubuzi, wabula biriwalira abo ababirina mu busirusiru obusingawo, bwe bitawongebwa ddala eri okutya Katonda; bwe zityo ensimbi, bwe zitakozesebwa ddala ng’amagezi n’eddiini bwe biri, teziyinza kuzannyirwamu kyokka, wabula zirireetera abantu okugwa mu busirusiru obusingawo, ne zibafuula okubeera mu bulamu obw’obusirusiru era obw’okusukkiriza okusinga bwe bandibadde awatali zo. N’olwekyo, bw’otosaasaanya nsimbi zo mu kukolera abalala ebirungi, oteekwa okuzisaasaanya mu kwerumya. Ojja kukola ng’omuntu eyandigaanye okuwa ekyo ng’eddagala erigumya eri mukwano gwe omulwadde, wadde nga ye yennyini teyandisobodde kukinywa awatali kwokya musaayi gwe. Kubanga eno y’embeera y’ensimbi ezisukkiridde; bw’oziwa abo abazeetaaga, ddagala erigumya; bw’oziyonoona ku ggwe kennyini mu kintu ky’otetaaga, zookya bwokya era zitabula ebirowoozo byo, ne zikufuula omubi okusinga bwe wandibadde awatali zo.

Lowooza nate ku kugeraageranya okwogeddwako emabega; singa omuntu ataakozesa bulungi maaso n’emikono ebisukkiridde, yandyonoonye amaaso ge n’emikono gye ye, olw’okugezaako bulijjo okubikozesa ye yennyini, twandimuvunaanye mu bwenkanya olw’obulalu obusingawo.

Kale eno ddala y’embeera y’obugagga obusaasaanyizibwa ku ffe ffekka mu nsaasaanya etaliimu era eteetaagisa; mu kugezaako okubukozesa we butalina mugaso gwa mazima, era nga ffe tetulina bwetaavu bwa mazima, tubukozesa bukozesi okwerumya ennyo, mu kuzaala okwegomba okutali kwa magezi, mu kuliisa emitima emibi, mu kwekkiriza okwegomba kwaffe, ne mu kuwanirira ebirowoozo eby’ensi era ebitaliimu. Kubanga okulya n’okunywa ebinyumu, engoye ennungi, n’ennyumba ennungi, ekitiibwa n’amagaali, amasanyu ag’ebinyumu, n’okwesanyusa, byonna mu butonde bwabyo birumya era bitabula emitima gyaffe; bye mmere era by’okuliisa obusirusiru bwonna n’obunafu bw’obutonde bwaffe, era ngeri nkakafu ez’okutufuula ab’obutaliimu era ab’ensi mu mitima gyaffe. Byonna biwanirira ekintu ekitasaanidde kuwanirirwa; bikontana n’okwefuga okwo n’okutya Katonda okw’omutima okuwoomerwa ebintu bya Katonda; bifaanana emigugu mingi ku birowoozo byaffe, egitufuula abatasobola nnyo, era abateegomba nnyo, okusitula ebirowoozo byaffe n’okwagala kwaffe eri ebintu ebiri waggulu.

N’olwekyo ensimbi ezisaasaanyizibwa bwe zityo tezonoonebwa bwonoonebwa oba okubula, wabula zisaasaanyizibwa olw’ebigendererwa ebibi, n’ebibivaamu eby’ennaku, okwonoona n’okutabula emitima gyaffe, n’okutufuula abatasobola nnyo okubeera mu njigiriza ez’awaggulu ez’Enjiri. Kifaanana bufaananyi okuziyiza abaavu ensimbi, okwegulira obutwa.

Kubanga ezo zonna ezisaasaanyizibwa mu butaliimu bw’okwambala, ziyinza okubalibwa nga ze zonna ezisaasaanyizibwa okunyweza obutaliimu mu birowoozo byaffe. Ezo zonna ezisaasaanyizibwa ku bugayaavu n’okwekkusa, ziyinza okubalibwa nga ze zonna eziweereddwayo okufuula emitima gyaffe egizitowa era egy’obuluvu. Ezo zonna ezisaasaanyizibwa ku kitiibwa n’amagaali, ziyinza okubalibwa nga ze zonna ezisaasaanyizibwa okuziba amaaso go, n’okukufuula ekifaananyi ky’osinza eky’endowooza yo. Era bwe kityo mu buli kintu, bw’ova ku byetaago eby’amagezi, owanirira bwanirizi omutima omumu ogutali gwa magezi, endowooza emu, buli Mukristaayo omulungi gy’ayitibwa okulekayo.

N’olwekyo mu nsonga zonna, ka tulowooze ku bugagga bwaffe nga ttalanta, era ekintu kye twateresebwa Katonda, oba obulungi obunene bwe butusobozesa okukola, oba akabi akanene ke butuleetera, bwe busaasaanyizibwa mu butaliimu; mu nsonga zino zonna enkulu kirabika, nti kyetaagisa ddala okufuula amagezi n’eddiini etteeka ekkakali ery’okukozesa obugagga bwaffe bwonna.

Buli kukubiriza mu Byawandiikibwa okuba ab’amagezi era abategeevu, nga tumatiza ebyetaago ebyo byokka Katonda bye yandyagadde bimatizibwe; buli kukubiriza okuba ab’omwoyo era ab’omu ggulu, nga tufuba okutuuka ku nkyukakyuka ey’ekitiibwa ey’obutonde bwaffe; buli kukubiriza okwagala muliraanwa waffe nga bwe twagala ffekka, okwagala abantu bonna nga Katonda bwe yabaagala, kiragiro kya kuba ab’eddiini ddala mu kukozesa ensimbi zaffe. Kubanga tewali ku mitima gino eyinza okutuukirizibwa, okuggyako nga tuli ba magezi era ba nsonga, ba mwoyo era ba mu ggulu, nga tukola okwagala okw’ab’oluganda, okusaasira okufaanana okwa Katonda, mu kukozesa obugagga bwaffe bwonna. Emitima gino, n’enkozesa eno ey’ebintu byaffe eby’ensi, bye njigiriza y’Endagaano Empya yonna, ne kiba nti toyinza kusoma ssuula nga toyigiriziddwa kintu ku byo. Nja kuleeta ekigambo kimu kyokka eky’ekyewuunyo okuva mu Byawandiikibwa, ekimala okukakasa byonna bye njogedde ku nkozesa eno ey’eddiini ey’obugagga bwaffe bwonna.

"Omwana w’Omuntu bw’alijja mu kitiibwa kye ne bamalayika bonna nga bali naye, alituula ku ntebe ey’ekitiibwa kye. Awo amawanga gonna galikuŋŋaanyizibwa mu maaso ge era aligaawulamu ng’omusumba bw’ayawulamu endiga n’embuzi. Endiga aliziteeka ku mukono gwe ogwa ddyo n’embuzi ku gwa kkono. Awo Kabaka n’alyoka agamba abali ku mukono gwe ogwa ddyo nti, Mujje mmwe Kitange be yawa omukisa, musikire obwakabaka obwabateekerwateekerwa okuva ku kutondebwa kw’ensi. Kubanga nnali muyala ne mundiisa, nnali muyonta ne mumpa ekyokunywa, nnali mugenyi ne munnyaniriza, nnali bwereere ne munnyambaza, nnali mulwadde ne munnambula, nnali mu kkomera ne mujja okundaba . . . Bw’atyo aligamba abo abali ku mukono gwe ogwa kkono nti, Muveewo, mmwe abakolimire, mulage mu muliro ogutazikira ogwateekerwateekerwa Setaani ne bamalayika be. Kubanga nnali muyala ne mutampa kyakulya, nnali muyonta ne mutampa kyakunywa, nnali mugenyi ne mutannyaniriza, nnali bwereere ne mutannyambaza, nnali mulwadde ne mu kkomera ne mutajja kunnambula. Abo baligenda ku kibonerezo eky’emirembe n’emirembe, naye abatuukirivu baliyingira mu bulamu obutaggwaawo." [Matayo 25:31-46]

Nzizeeyo ekigambo kino kyonna, kubanga omuntu bw’atunuulira engeri y’ensi, tayinza kulowooza nti Abakristaayo baali basomyeko ekitundu kino eky’Ebyawandiikibwa. Kubanga kiki ekiri mu bulamu bw’Abakristaayo, ekirabika ng’obulokozi bwabwe bwesigamye ku mirimu gino emirungi? Naye obwetaavu bwagyo bukakasibwa wano mu ngeri esingirayo ddala, era bututeekebwako n’ennyinyonnyola ennamu ey’ekitiibwa n’entiisa y’olunaku olw’omusango.

Abantu abamu, ne mu abo abayinza okubalibwa ng’Abakristaayo ab’empisa ennungi, batwala ekigambo kino ng’okukubiriza okwa bulijjo kwokka okw’emirimu egy’okusaasira egy’ebiseera ebimu; so nga kiraga obwetaavu, si bw’okusaasira okw’ebiseera ebimu kyokka, wabula obwetaavu bw’obulamu obw’okusaasira obujjuvu ng’obwo, obuli okukola okutakoma emirimu gyonna egy’okusaasira ng’egyo, gye tusobola okukola.

Okkiriza nti tolina ddembe ku bulokozi, bw’oba nga walagajjalira emirimu gino emirungi; kubanga abantu ng’abo abaagirekayo, ku lunaku olw’enkomerero, baliteekebwa ku mukono ogwa kkono, ne bagobebwa n’ekigambo nti "Muveewo, mmwe abakolimire." N’olwekyo tewali bulokozi wabula mu kukola emirimu gino emirungi. Kale ani ayinza okugambibwa nti yakola emirimu gino emirungi? Ye oyo eyayamba omusibe omulundi gumu, oba eyayamba omwavu oba omulwadde? Kino kyandibadde busirusiru nga okugamba nti yatuukiriza emirimu egy’okwewaayo eri Katonda, oyo eyasaba essaala ze omulundi gumu. Kale ye oyo eyakola emirimu gino egy’okusaasira emirundi egiwerako? Kino tekiyinza kwogerwa, okusinga bwe kiyinza okwogerwa nti ye musajja omwenkanya ddala, oyo eyakola ebikolwa eby’obwenkanya emirundi egiwerako. Kale etteeka, oba ekipimo ky’okukola emirimu gino emirungi kye kiruwa? Omuntu ayinza atya okwesiga nti agikola nga bw’asaanidde?

Kale etteeka lyeyoleka nnyo era lyangu, era lye limu eri buli mpisa ennungi endala, oba omutima omulungi, nga bwe liri eri okusaasira. Ani omwetoowaze, oba omuwombeefu, oba eyeewaddeyo eri Katonda, oba omwenkanya, oba omwesigwa? Ye oyo eyakola ebikolwa eby’obwetoowaze, obuwombeefu, okwewaayo, obwenkanya, oba obwesigwa emirundi egiwerako? Nedda; wabula ye oyo abeera mu kukola empisa zino ennungi buli kiseera. Mu ngeri y’emu, oyo yekka y’ayinza okugambibwa nti yakola emirimu gino egy’okusaasira, abeera mu kugikola buli kiseera nga bw’asobola okukoma. Oyo yekka y’atuukirizza obuvunaanyizibwa bw’okwagala Katonda, ayagala Katonda n’omutima gwe gwonna, n’amagezi ge gonna, n’amaanyi ge gonna. Era oyo yekka y’atuukirizza obuvunaanyizibwa bw’emirimu gino emirungi, agikoze n’omutima gwe gwonna, n’amagezi ge gonna, n’amaanyi ge gonna. Kubanga tewali kipimo kirala eky’okukola kwaffe ebirungi, okuggyako obuyinza bwaffe obw’okubikola.

Omutume Peetero yabuuza Omulokozi waffe omutendereze ekibuuzo kino: "Mukama wange, muganda wange bw’ansobyanga musonyiwanga emirundi emeka? Emirundi musanvu? Yesu n’amuddamu nti, Sikugamba nti emirundi musanvu naye emirundi nsanvu emirundi musanvu." [Matayo 18:21, 22] Si nti oluvannyuma lw’omuwendo guno ogw’ebisobyo omuntu ayinza olwo okulekera awo okusonyiwa; wabula ekigambo eky’emirundi nsanvu emirundi musanvu, kwe kutulaga, nti tetulina kukomya kusonyiwa kwaffe ku muwendo gwonna ogw’ebisobyo, wabula tulina okweyongera okusonyiwa ebisobyo ebisinga okuddiŋŋanwa bye batukola. Bw’atyo Omulokozi waffe agamba mu kifo ekirala nti, "Ne bw’akusobyanga emirundi omusanvu mu lunaku olumu, naye buli mulundi n’ajja gy’oli n’akwenenyeza, musonyiwenga." [Lukka 17:4] N’olwekyo, omuntu bw’alekera awo okusonyiwa muganda we, kubanga amaze okumusonyiwa emirundi mingi; bw’eyewolereza obutasonyiwa muntu ono, kubanga yasonyiwa abalala abawerako; omuntu ng’oyo amenya etteeka lino erya Kristo, ery’okusonyiwa muganda we.

Kale etteeka ly’okusonyiwa lye tteeka ery’okugaba; tolina kugaba, oba kukolera birungi musanvu, wabula emirundi nsanvu emirundi musanvu. Tolina kulekera awo kugaba, kubanga ogabidde emirundi mingi omuntu y’omu, oba abantu abalala; wabula olina okwetwala nti oteekwa okweyongera okuyamba abo abeeyongera okuba mu bwetaavu, nga bwe wateekwa okubayamba omulundi gumu oba ebiri. Singa tekyali mu buyinza bwo, wandisonyiyiddwa obutayamba muntu yenna omulundi gumu; naye bwe kiba mu buyinza bwo okuyamba abantu emirundi mingi, buvunaanyizibwa bwo okukikola emirundi mingi, nga bwe buli obuvunaanyizibwa bw’abalala okukikola omulundi gumu gumu, kubanga basobola omulundi gumu gumu. Oyo atali mwetegefu kusonyiwa buli muganda we, emirundi gyonna gy’ayagala okusonyiyibwa, tasonyiwa ng’omuyigirizwa wa Kristo. Era oyo atali mwetegefu kuwa buli muganda we ayagala okuweebwa ekintu, tagaba ng’omuyigirizwa wa Kristo. Kubanga kyetaagisa okugaba okutuuka emirundi nsanvu emirundi musanvu, okubeera mu kukola okutakoma emirimu gyonna emirungi nga bwe tusobola okukoma, nga bwe kyetaagisa okusonyiwa okutuuka emirundi nsanvu emirundi musanvu, n’okubeera buli kiseera n’omutima guno ogusonyiwa, eri bonna abagwetaaga.

Era ensonga y’ebyo byonna yeeyoleka nnyo, kubanga waliwo obulungi bwe bumu, obukulu bwe bumu, n’obwetaavu bwe bumu, obw’okusaasira bwe tutyo mu kiseera ekimu nga mu kirala. Ye nkozesa esinga obulungi ey’ensimbi zaffe, okuzikozesa bulijjo okukola ebirungi, nga bw’eri enkozesa yaazo esinga obulungi mu kiseera kyonna eky’enjawulo; n’olwekyo ekyo ekiri ensonga ey’ekikolwa eky’okusaasira, ye nsonga ennungi y’emu ey’obulamu obw’okusaasira. Ekyo ekiri ensonga ey’okusonyiwa ekisobyo kimu, ye nsonga y’emu ey’okusonyiwa ebisobyo byonna. Kubanga okusaasira ng’okwo tekulina kye kwesigamako leero, ekitali kye kimu ekirikwesigamako enkya; era toyinza kukulekayo mu kiseera ekimu, nga tolina musango gwa kibi kye kimu, nga bw’oba ng’okulekayo mu kiseera ekirala.

N’olwekyo, nga bwe kiri ekikakafu nti emirimu gino egy’okusaasira gyetaagisa olw’obulokozi, bwe kityo bwe kiri ekikakafu nti tulina okugikola nga bwe tusobola okukoma; si leero, oba enkya, wabula mu bulamu bwaffe bwonna. N’olwekyo, bwe kiba buvunaanyizibwa bwaffe mu kiseera kyonna okwefiiriza ensaasaanya yonna eteetaagisa, okuba abeegendereza era abatasaasaanya, tulyoke tube n’eby’okuwa abo ababyetaaga, buvunaanyizibwa bwaffe okukola bwe tutyo mu biseera byonna, tulyoke tusobole nate okukola ebirungi ebisingawo. Kubanga bwe kiba nga kibi mu kiseera kyonna okusinza ensaasaanya etaliimu era eteetaagisa okusinga emirimu egy’okusaasira, kiba bwe kityo mu biseera byonna; kubanga okusaasira kusinga ensaasaanya yonna eteetaagisa era etaliimu mu kiseera ekimu nga mu kirala. N’olwekyo bwe kiba nga kyetaagisa olw’obulokozi bwaffe, okufaayo ku mirimu gino egy’okusaasira, n’okulaba nti twefuula mu ngeri emu abasobola okugikola, kyetaagisa olw’obulokozi bwaffe, okufaayo okwefuula abasobola nga bwe tusobola okukoma, okugikola mu bitundu byonna eby’obulamu bwaffe.

N’olwekyo, oba olina okulekayo Obukristaayo bwo okutuuka okugamba nti teweetaaga n’akatono kukola ku mirimu gino emirungi; oba olina okukkiriza nti olina okugikola obulamu bwo bwonna mu ddaala erisinga obugulumivu nga bw’osobola. Tewali kkubo lya wakati, okusinga bwe wali ekkubo erya wakati wakati w’amalala n’obwetoowaze, oba okwefuga n’obutefuga. Bw’otofuba kutuukiriza mirimu gyonna egy’okusaasira, bw’olagajjalira egimu ku gyo egiri mu buyinza bwo, n’ogaana okuyamba abo abeetaaga ky’oyinza okugaba, ka kibe ddi, oba wa, weebala mu abo ababulwa okusaasira okw’Ekikristaayo. Kubanga buvunaanyizibwa bwo okukola ebirungi ne byonna by’olina, n’okubeera mu kukola okutakoma emirimu emirungi, nga bwe buli obuvunaanyizibwa bwo okwefuga mu byonna by’olya ne by’onywa.

Wano era we walabikira obwetaavu bw’okulekayo ensaasaanya zonna ez’obusirusiru era ezitali za magezi, amalala n’obusirusiru bw’abantu bye bifudde ebya bulijjo era eby’omusono mu nsi. Kubanga bwe kiba nga kyetaagisa okukola emirimu emirungi, nga bw’osobola okukoma, kiteekwa okwetaagisa mu ngeri y’emu okulekayo engeri ezo eziteetaagisa ez’okusaasaanya ensimbi ezikufuula obutasobola kukola mirimu gya kusaasira.

N’olwekyo tolina kugoberera ngeri zino ez’ensi, okusinga bw’olina okugoberera ebibi by’ensi; tolina kusaasaanya wamu n’abo abonoona ensimbi zaabwe mu butaliimu nga endowooza zaabwe bwe zibatwala, okusinga bw’olina okunywa n’abatamiivu, oba okwekkusa wamu n’omuluvu: kubanga ensaasaanya ng’eyo tetuukagana na bulamu bwa kusaasira, okusinga okunywa okusukkiridde bwe kutuukagana n’obulamu obw’okwefuga. N’olwekyo, omuntu yenna bw’akugamba ku kukkirizibwa kw’engoye ez’omuwendo omungi, oba obutaba na musango obw’okwesanyusa n’ebimatiza eby’ensimbi ennyingi, lowooza bulowooza nti omuntu y’omu yali akugamba, nti teweetaaga kukola mirimu gya kusaasira; nti Kristo takwetaagako kukolera birungi baganda bo abaavu, nga bw’omukolera Ye; olwo ojja kulaba obubi bw’okubuulirira ng’okwo. Kubanga okukugamba nti oyinza okubeera mu nsaasaanya ng’eyo, efuula obutasoboka okubeera mu kukola emirimu emirungi, kye kimu n’okukugamba nti teweetaaga kufaayo n’akatono ku mirimu ng’egyo emirungi gyennyini.

fields.title: Okukozesa obugagga mu ngeri etali ya magezi bwe kwonoona empisa zonna ez’omutima, ne kujjuza omutima okwegomba okwavu era okw’okusekererwa, mu bulamu bwonna; kino kiragibwa mu kifaananyi kya Flavia
fields.body_html:
KYALABIDDWA dda, nti okwegendereza okw’amagezi era okw’eddiini kulina okukozesebwa mu ngeri gye tusaasaanyaamu ensimbi zaffe oba obugagga bwaffe, kubanga engeri gye tusaasaanyaamu obugagga bwaffe efuula ekitundu ekinene bwe kityo eky’obulamu bwaffe obwa bulijjo, era gwe mulimu gwa buli lunaku nnyo, ne kiba nti nga bwe tuli ab’amagezi, oba abatali ba magezi, mu nsonga eno, obulamu bwaffe bwonna bujja kufuulibwa oba obw’amagezi ennyo oba obujjudde obusirusiru bungi.

Abantu abaagala eddiini, abakkiriza okuyigirizibwa okw’okutya Katonda n’essanyu n’okumatira, emirundi mingi beewuunya ensonga lwaki tebakulaakulana nnyo mu ddiini eyo gye beewuunya ennyo bwe batyo.

Kale ensonga y’ekyo y’eno: kubanga eddiini ebeera mu mutwe gwabwe gwokka, naye ekintu ekirala kye kiri mu mitima gyabwe; n’olwekyo beeyongera okuva ku mwaka okudda ku mulala nga beewuunya bwewuunya era nga batendereza bwatenderezi okutya Katonda, nga tebatuuka n’akatono ku mazima n’okutuukirira kw’ebiragiro byakwo.

Singa kibuuzibwa lwaki eddiini tefuna mitima gyabwe, ensonga y’eno; si lwa kuba nti babeera mu bibi ebinene, oba mu bukaba, kubanga okussa ekitiibwa kwabwe mu ddiini kubakuuma obutagwa mu butategeka ng’obwo; wabula kubanga emitima gyabwe bulijjo gyemalidde ku bintu, gikyamiziddwa, era gikuumibwa mu mbeera enkyamu olw’okukozesa awatali magezi ebintu ng’ebyo ebikkirizibwa okukozesebwa.

Okukozesa n’okwesiima mu bugagga bwabwe kikkirizibwa, n’olwekyo tekibayingira mu mitwe gyabwe okulowooza nti waliyo akabi konna akanene okuva ku ludda olwo. Tebalowooza n’akatono, nti waliwo enkozesa y’obugagga bwabwe etaliimu era etali ya magezi, wadde nga tezikiriza ng’ebibi ebinene, naye etabula bw’etyo omutima, era n’eguwanirira mu buluvu n’obuzitowa ng’obwo, mu malala n’obutaliimu ng’obwo, ne kigufuula obutasobola kufuna bulamu n’omwoyo gw’okutya Katonda.

Kubanga emmeeme zaffe ziyinza okufuna akabi akatakoma, ne zifuulibwa obutasobola mpisa nnungi yonna, olw’okukozesa obukozesa ebintu ebitaliiko musango era ebikkirizibwa.

Kiki ekitaliiko musango okusinga okuwummula n’okwesudde? Naye kiki ekisinga akabi okusinga obugayaavu n’obusirise? Kiki ekikkirizibwa okusinga okulya n’okunywa? Naye kiki ekisinga okuzikiriza empisa ennungi zonna, ekisinga okuzaala ebibi byonna, okusinga obuluvu n’okwekkusa?

Okulabirira amaka nga kukkirizibwa era nga kusaanira ettendo! Naye nga bwe kiri ekikakafu nti abantu bangi bafuulibwa obutasobola mpisa nnungi yonna, olw’omutima ogw’ensi era ogweraliikirira!

Kale olw’obutaba na bwegendereza bwa ddiini mu kukozesa ebintu bino ebitaliiko musango era ebikkirizibwa, eddiini kye kiva tefuna mitima gyaffe. Era mu kwefuga obulungi era n’amagezi, ku bintu bino, mwe musinga okubeera obukodyo bwonna obw’okubeera mu butukuvu.

Ebibi ebinene birabibwa mu lwatu era byewalibwa mangu abantu abeeyatula eddiini. Naye okukozesa awatali magezi era mu ngeri ey’akabi ebintu ebitaliiko musango era ebikkirizibwa, nga bwe kutakankanya era tekunyiiza myoyo gyaffe, bwe kityo kizibu okufuula abantu okutegeera n’akatono akabi kaakyo.

Omwami asaasaanya obugagga bwe bwonna ku mizannyo, n’omukazi akozesa obugagga bwe bwonna ku ye yekka, kizibu okubakkirizisa nti omwoyo gw’eddiini teguyinza kubeerawo mu ngeri y’obulamu ng’eyo.

Abantu bano, nga bwe kyalabiddwa, bayinza okubeera awatali bukaba, bayinza okuba mikwano gy’eddiini, okutuuka n’okugitendereza n’okugyogerako obulungi, n’okugyewuunya mu ndowooza zaabwe; naye teyinza kufuga mitima gyabwe, n’okuba omwoyo gw’ebikolwa byabwe, okutuusa nga bakyusizza engeri yaabwe ey’obulamu, ne bakkiriza eddiini okuteekawo amateeka ku nkozesa n’ensaasaanya y’obugagga bwabwe.

Kubanga omukazi ayagala okwambala, atalowooza nti waliwo ensaasaanya esukkiridde okuweebwayo olw’okwewunda, tayinza kukoma awo. Kubanga omutima ogwo guwalula obusirusiru obulala lukumi wamu nagwo, era gujja kufuula obulamu bwe bwonna, emirimu gye, emboozi ze, essuubi lye, ebimutiisa, by’ayagala, amasanyu ge, n’okwesanyusa kwe, byonna okutuukagana nagwo.

Flavia ne Miranda baganda babiri abawala abatali bafumbo, buli omu ku bo alina pawundi bibiri buli mwaka. Baaziika bazadde baabwe emyaka abiri egiyise, era okuva olwo babadde basaasaanya obugagga bwabwe nga bwe baagala.

Flavia abadde kyewuunyo eri mikwano gye gyonna, olw’okutegeka kwe okulungi ennyo, mu kweyoleka mu ngeri ey’ekyewuunyo bw’etyo ku bugagga obutono bwe butyo. Bannyabo abawerako abalina obugagga obukubisaamu emirundi ebiri obubwe tebasobola kuba bulijjo ba kitiibwa bwe batyo, era abatakoowa mu bifo byonna eby’amasanyu n’ensaasaanya. Alina buli kintu ekiri mu misono, era abeera mu buli kifo awali okwesanyusa kwonna. Flavia mugoberezi nnyo w’enjigiriza entuufu, ayogera n’ebbugumu ku bakyamu mu kukkiriza n’abeeyawula, okutwalira awamu abeera mu Kkanisa, era emirundi mingi ku Ssakramentu. Omulundi gumu yatendereza okubuulira okwali kuwakanya amalala n’obutaliimu bw’okwambala, era n’alowooza nti kwali kutuufu nnyo ku Lucinda, gw’alowooza nti ayambala obulungi nnyo okusinga bw’asaanidde. Singa omuntu yenna asaba Flavia okukola ekintu mu kusaasira, bw’aba ayagala omuntu aleese ekirowoozo, oba bw’aba ali mu mbeera ennungi, ajja kumukasukira ekitundu kya kulaawuni, oba kulaawuni, n’amugamba nti singa yali amanyi ebbanja eddene ery’omukozi w’enkuufiira ly’abadde yaakafuna, yandirowoozezza nti kintu kinene gy’ali okugaba. Oluvannyuma lw’ekitundu ky’omwaka, awulira okubuulira ku bwetaavu bw’okusaasira; alowooza nti omusajja abuulira bulungi, nti nsonga esaanidde nnyo, nti abantu beetaaga nnyo okukijjukizibwa; naye takitwala ku ye yennyini n’akatono, kubanga ajjukira nti yagaba kulaawuni emabega, bwe yali nga tasobola kugiwaayo.

Ku bikwata ku baavu bennyini, tajja kukkiriza kwemulugunya kwabwe kwonna; akakasa nnyo nti bonna bakumpanya era balimba, era bajja kwogera kyonna okufuna obuyambi; n’olwekyo kiteekwa okuba ekibi okubazzaamu amaanyi mu makubo gaabwe amabi.

Wandirowoozezza nti Flavia alina omwoyo ogusinga obwegendereza mu nsi, singa wandirabye nga bw’afaayo ennyo era nga bw’atya omusango n’akabi k’okugaba mu ngeri enkyamu.

Agula ebitabo byonna eby’amagezi n’ebisesa, era yakuŋŋaanya n’ensimbi nnyingi ebitabo byonna eby’abawandiisi b’ebitontome baffe Abangereza. Kubanga agamba nti, omuntu tayinza kuwoomerwa ddala ku omu ku bo nga tamanyidde nnyo bonna.

Ebiseera ebimu ajja kusoma ekitabo eky’okutya Katonda, bwe kiba kimpi, bwe kiba kitenderezebwa nnyo olw’engeri gye kiwandiikiddwamu n’olulimi, era ng’amanyi w’ayinza okukyeyazika.

Flavia mugayaavu nnyo, naye ayagala nnyo emirimu egy’okutunga ennungi; kino kimuleetera emirundi mingi okutuula ng’akola ku kitanda okutuusa ttuntu, n’okubuulirwa emboozi nnyingi empanvu nga tannagolokoka; n’olwekyo seetaaga kukugamba, nti okwewaayo kwe okw’oku makya tekukolebwa bulungi bulijjo.

Flavia yandibadde kyamagero eky’okutya Katonda, singa yalina ekitundu kyokka eky’okufaayo ku mmeeme ye nga bw’afaayo ku mubiri gwe. Okuzimba kw’akabalabala mu maaso ge, okubojja kw’ensiri, bijja kumuleetera okusigala mu kisenge kye ennaku bbiri oba ssatu, era alowooza nti bantu ba bwangu nnyo abatafaayo ku bintu mu budde. Kino kimufuula okufaayo ennyo okusukkiridde ku bulamu bwe, ne kiba nti talowooza n’akatono nti ali bulungi ekimala; era okwekkusa ennyo okusukkiridde, ne kiba nti tayinza kuba bulungi ddala. N’olwekyo kimusaasaanyiza bingi mu ddagala ery’okwebaka n’ery’okuzuukuka, mu by’omutwe, mu matondo ag’obusimu, mu ddagala erigumya olubuto, ne mu zaafulaani ey’omu caayi we.

Bw’okyalira Flavia ku Ssande, bulijjo ojja kusanga abantu abalungi, ojja kumanya ebigenda mu maaso mu nsi, ojja kuwulira oluyimba olusembyeyo olw’okunyooma abantu, okubuulirwa ani yaluwandiika, n’ani ategeezebwa buli linnya eriri mu lwo. Ojja kuwulira emizannyo egyazannyibwa wiiki eyo, oluyimba olusinga obulungi mu opera, ani eyali tagumiikirizika ku nkuŋŋaana esembyeyo, n’emizannyo ki egisinga okuba mu misono. Flavia alowooza nti abo abazannya kaadi ku Ssande tebakkiriza Katonda, naye ajja kukubuulira obukodyo bwonna obw’emizannyo, kaadi ki z’abadde akutte, nga bwe yazizannya, n’ebyafaayo byonna ebyabaawo mu muzannyo, amangu ddala nga avudde mu Kkanisa. Bw’oba oyagala okumanya ani muwagatanyi era atalina kisa, ani wa butaliimu era ayagala okwewunda, ani abeera mu bulamu obusukkiridde, n’ani ali mu bbanja; bw’oba oyagala okumanya oluyombo oluli mu nnyumba emu, oba ani mu kwagalana; bw’oba oyagala okumanya Belinda bw’akeerewa okudda awaka ekiro, ngoye ki z’aguze, nga bw’ayagala okutenderezebwa, n’emboozi empanvu gye yabuulira mu kifo ekimu; bw’oba oyagala okumanya Lucius bw’akambuwalira mukyala we, ebigambo ebitalina kisa by’amugamba nga tewali abawulira; bw’oba oyagala okumanya nga bwe bakyawagana mu mitima gyabwe, wadde balabika ng’abalina ekisa mu lwatu; olina okukyalira Flavia ku Ssande. Naye ate assaamu nnyo ekitiibwa obutukuvu bwa Ssande, ne kiba nti yagoba mu nnyumba ye nnamwandu omukadde omwavu, ng’omuvvoozi, olw’okusangibwa omulundi gumu ng’atunga engoye ze ku Ssande ekiro.

Bw’atyo Flavia bw’abeera; era bw’anaawangaala emyaka kkumi emirala, ajja kuba amaze okumalira Ssande nga lukumi mu bitaano mu nkaaga mu ngeri eno. Ajja kuba ayambadde engoye ez’enjawulo nga bibiri. Ku myaka gino amakumi asatu egy’obulamu bwe, kkumi n’etaano giriba gimaliddwa ku kitanda; era, ku kkumi n’etaano egisigadde, nga kkumi n’ena giriba gimaliddwa mu kulya, okunywa, okwambala, okukyala, emboozi, okusoma n’okuwulira emizannyo n’engero ez’omukwano, mu opera, mu nkuŋŋaana, embaga ez’amazina n’okwesanyusa. Kubanga oyinza okubala obudde bwonna bw’abeera nga agolokose, nga bumalibwa bwe butyo, okuggyako essaawa nga emu n’ekitundu, ezimalibwa mu Kkanisa, ku Ssande ezisinga obungi mu mwaka. Olw’okutegeka okunene, era wansi w’amateeka ag’amaanyi ag’okukekkereza, ajja kuba asaasaanyizza pawundi kakaaga ku ye yekka, okuggyako ssiringi ntono, kulaawuni, oba ebitundu bya kulaawuni, ebyamuvaako mu kusaasira okwa kibwatukira.

Sijja kwetwalira kugamba nti tekisoboka Flavia okulokolebwa; naye kino kyokka kiteekwa okwogerwa, nti talina nsonga okuva mu Byawandiikibwa okulowooza nti ali mu kkubo ery’obulokozi. Kubanga obulamu bwe bwonna bukontanira ddala n’emitima gyonna n’ebikolwa ebyo Enjiri bye yafuula ebyetaagisa olw’obulokozi.

Singa wandimuwulidde ng’agamba nti abadde mulamu obulamu bwe bwonna nga Anna nnabbi, "eyali tavanga mu Yeekaalu ng’asiiba n’okwegayiriranga Katonda emisana n’ekiro," [Lukka 2:36, 37] wandimutwala ng’asukkiriza nnyo; naye kino tekyandibadde kusukkiriza kusingawo, okusinga ye okugamba nti abadde "afuba okuyingira mu mulyango omufunda," [Lukka 13:24] oba ng’afudde enjigiriza yonna ey’Enjiri etteeka ly’obulamu bwe.

Ayinza okugamba bulungi, nti yabeeranga ne Mulokozi waffe bwe yali ku nsi, nga bw’ayinza okugamba nti abadde mulamu ng’amugoberera, oba nti yafuula ekitundu kyonna eky’okufaayo kwe okubeera mu mitima ng’egyo gye yeetaagako abo bonna abandyagadde okuba abayigirizwa Be. Ayinza okugamba mu mazima ge gamu, nti buli lunaku abadde anaaza abatukuvu ebigere, nga bw’ayinza okugamba nti abadde mulamu mu bwetoowaze obw’Ekikristaayo n’obwavu mu mwoyo; era ayinza okulowooza mu magezi ge gamu, nti abadde ayigiriza mu ssomero ery’okusaasira, nga bw’abadde mulamu mu mirimu egy’okusaasira. Alina ensonga y’emu okulowooza nti abadde mukuumi mu ggye, nga bw’abadde mulamu mu kutunula n’okwefiiriza. Era kiyinza okwogerwa mu bwenkanya bwe bumu, nti abadde mulamu olw’emirimu gy’emikono gye, nga bwe yafuba ennyo okunyweza okuyitibwa kwe n’okulondebwa kwe.

Era wano kiteekwa okulabibwa obulungi, nti endowooza enfu era etaliimu, obutatya Katonda, obusirusiru, n’obutaliimu obw’obulamu buno bwonna obwa Flavia, byonna biva ku ngeri gye yakozesaamu obugagga bwe. Kino kye kyakola omwoyo gwe, ekyawa obulamu buli mutima ogw’obugayaavu, ekyawanirira buli kwegomba okutaliimu, era ne kimuziyiza ebirowoozo byonna eby’obulamu obw’amagezi, obw’omugaso, era obwewaddeyo eri Katonda.

Bazadde be bwe baafa, teyalina kirowoozo ku pawundi ze ebibiri buli mwaka, wabula nti yalina ensimbi nnyingi bwe zityo okukola kye yagala, okuzisaasaanya ku ye yekka, n’okugula amasanyu n’ebimatiza okwegomba kwe kwonna.

Era kuno kwe kutandika, kuno kwe kusala okukyamu n’enkozesa etali ya magezi ey’obugagga bwe, ebijjuzizza obulamu bwe bwonna obutaba na magezi kwe kumu, era ne bimuziyiza okulowooza ku kituufu, eky’amagezi, era eky’okutya Katonda, mu buli kintu ekirala.

Bw’obadde omulabye ng’asanyukira emizannyo n’engero ez’omukwano, mu lugambo n’okwogera abalala emabega waabwe, ng’asendebwa mangu, era ng’anyiiga mangu; bw’obadde omulabye nga yeewaddeyo eri amasanyu n’okwesanyusa, ng’omuddu w’okwegomba kwonna nga bwe kuddiriŋŋana, ng’afaayo ennyo ku buli kintu ekikwata ku mubiri gwe oba ku by’okwambala, nga tafaayo ku buli kintu ekyandigasizza emmeeme ye, ng’ayagala bulijjo ekinyumu ekiggya, era nga mwetegefu olwa buli kiyiiye eky’essanyu mu kweraga oba mu by’okwambala, kyali kubanga yali amaze okugula emitima gino gyonna n’ensimbi ezaamuyingiranga buli mwaka okuva mu bugagga bwe.

Yandibadde mwetoowaze, mukakkamu, eyeewaddeyo eri Katonda, ayagala ebitabo ebirungi, eyeewuunya okusaba n’okwesudde, eyeegendereza obudde bwe, omunyiikivu mu mirimu emirungi, ajjudde okusaasira n’okwagala Katonda, singa enkozesa etali ya magezi ey’obugagga bwe teyamuwaliriza mitima gyonna egikontana n’egyo.

Era tekyali kya kwewuunya nti yakyusa obudde bwe, ebirowoozo bye, obulamu bwe, n’amaanyi ge, mu nkozesa y’emu gye yakyusizaamu obugagga bwe. Kuva ku kuba nti yakyama mu nsonga enkulu bw’etyo ey’obulamu, toyinza kulaba kintu kya magezi, oba kya nsonga, oba kya kutya Katonda, mu kitundu kyabwo ekirala kyonna.

Kale, wadde omwoyo ogutali mutereevu era ogw’ebitaliimu ogw’empisa eno, nga bwe nsuubira, gukwata ku bantu batono, naye bangi bayinza okuyigira wano okuyigirizibwa okumu, era oboolyawo okulaba ekimu ku mwoyo gwabwe mu gwo.

Kubanga nga Flavia bw’alabika ng’eyazikirizibwa olw’enkozesa etali ya magezi ey’obugagga bwe, bwe kityo obunafu bw’empisa ennungi z’abantu abasinga obungi, obutatuukirira bw’okutya Katonda kwabwe, n’obutategeka bw’okwegomba kwabwe, okutwalira awamu biva ku nkozesa yaabwe etali ya magezi n’okwesiima mu bintu ebikkirizibwa era ebitaliiko musango.

Abantu bangi baziyizibwa okutegeera n’okuwoomerwa eddiini mu mazima, olw’obuluvu n’okwekkusa okw’engeri eya bulijjo, okusinga olw’obutamiivu obunene. Abantu bangi babeera nga tebafaayo ku buvunaanyizibwa obukulu obw’okutya Katonda, olw’okufaayo ennyo okusukkiridde ku bintu eby’ensi, okusinga olw’obutali bwenkanya obweyoleka.

Omusajja ono oboolyawo yandibadde yeewaddeyo eri Katonda, singa teyali mwagazi nnyo bwe atyo ow’ebintu eby’ekyewuunyo n’eby’emikono. Omulala aziba amatu eri ensonga zonna ez’okutya Katonda, olw’okwekkiriza omutima ogw’obugayaavu era ogw’obusirise. Singa wandisobodde okuwonya omusajja ono okwegomba kwe okunene okw’okumanya n’okubuuzabuuza, oba oli okumatira kwe okw’obulimba n’ennyonta ey’okuyiga, teweetaaga kukola kirala kyonna okubafuula bombi abantu abatya Katonda ennyo.

Singa omukazi ono yandikendeezezza ku kukyala, oba oli obutayogeranga bulijjo, tewali ku bo yandizibuwaliddwa wadde ekitundu okukwatibwako eddiini.

Kubanga ebintu bino byonna bitono bitono, bwe bigeraageranyizibwa n’ebibi ebinene; era wadde bitono mu ngeri eyo, naye binene, nga bwe biri ebiziyiza n’ebiremesa omwoyo ogutya Katonda.

Kubanga ng’okulowooza bwe kuli eriiso lyokka ery’emmeeme, nga amazima g’eddiini bwe gatayinza kulabibwa na kirala kyonna, bwe kityo buli kireeta obutaba na bukakkamu mu birowoozo, omwoyo ogw’ebitaliimu, kifuula emmeeme obutasobola kulaba, kutegeera, n’okuwoomerwa enjigiriza ez’okutya Katonda.

N’olwekyo bwe twandyagadde okukulaakulana mu mazima mu ddiini, tetulina kukyawa bibi binene era ebyatiikirira kyokka, wabula tuteekwa okutereeza ebitundu ebitaliiko musango era ebikkirizibwa eby’enneeyisa yaffe, n’okuteeka ebikolwa eby’obulamu ebisinga okuba ebya bulijjo era ebikkirizibwa wansi w’amateeka ag’amagezi n’okutya Katonda.

fields.title: Okukozesa obugagga mu ngeri ey’amagezi era ey’okutya Katonda bwe kututwala mu butonde eri obutuukirivu obunene mu mpisa zonna ennungi ez’obulamu obw’Ekikristaayo; kino kiragibwa mu kifaananyi kya Miranda
fields.body_html:
BULI ntegeka emu ey’okutya Katonda mu kitundu kyonna eky’obulamu bwaffe, egasa nnyo, si ku lwayo yokka, wabula kubanga etumanyiiza okubeera mu tteeka, n’okulowooza ku kwefuga.

Omusuubuzi, aleese ekitundu ekimu eky’ensonga ze wansi w’amateeka agamu, ali mu kkubo eddungi okufaayo mu ngeri y’emu ku bisigadde.

Bw’atyo oyo aleese ekitundu ekimu kyonna eky’obulamu bwe wansi w’amateeka g’eddiini, ayinza okuyiga okuva wano okugaziya entegeka y’emu n’obutereevu mu bitundu ebirala eby’obulamu bwe.

Singa omuntu yenna aba wa magezi okulowooza nti obudde bwe bwa muwendo nnyo okukozesebwa nga bwe kigwa, n’okulekebwa okulyibwa buli kintu ekijja mu kkubo lye; singa yeeteeka wansi w’obwetaavu obw’okulaba engeri buli lunaku gye luyitamu mu mikono gye, era ne yeewaliriza okugoberera entegeka emu ey’obudde mu mirimu gye, mu kwesudde kwe, ne mu kwewaayo kwe eri Katonda; tekiyinza kulowoozebwa nga enneeyisa ng’eyo bw’eyandizzeemu amangu, n’ekulaakulanya, n’etuukiriza obulamu bwe bwonna.

Oyo amaze okumanya bw’atyo omuwendo, n’okukungula ebirungi eby’obudde obutegekeddwa obulungi, tajja kuba mugwira ebbanga ddene eri omuwendo gw’ekintu ekirala kyonna ekimukwatako mu mazima.

Etteeka erikwata ne ku kitundu ekisinga obutono eky’obulamu bwaffe, litugasa nnyo, olw’okuba obubeezi nti tteeka.

Kubanga, ng’olugero bwe lugamba nti, "Atandika obulungi, aba amazeeko ekitundu": bw’atyo oyo atandise okubeera omulamu mu tteeka, aba atambudde ekkubo ddene okutuuka ku kutuukirira kw’obulamu bwe.

Etteeka, wano bulijjo kirina okutegeerwa nti litegeeza etteeka ery’eddiini erikuumibwa olw’omusingi gw’obuvunaanyizibwa eri Katonda.

Kubanga singa omuntu yeewaliriza okwefuga mu bijjulo bye, ng’atunuulira olubuto lwe lwokka; oba okwewala okunywa, okwewala obwewala omutwe okumuluma; oba okwefuga mu kwebaka, olw’okutya obuzitowa obw’endwadde; ayinza okuba omukakali mu mateeka gano, naye n’atafuuka muntu mulungi n’akatono olw’ago.

Naye bw’aba ng’eyeefuga era omutegeke mu kimu ku bintu bino, olw’okutegeera okwefuga n’okwefiiriza okw’Ekikristaayo, alyoke awe Katonda obulamu obw’amagezi era obutukuvu okusingawo, olwo etteeka erisinga obutono ery’engeri eno lifuuka, mu butonde bwalyo, entandikwa y’okutya Katonda okunene.

Kubanga etteeka erisinga obutono mu nsonga zino ligasa nnyo, kubanga lituyigiriza ekitundu ekimu eky’okwefuga, kubanga likuuma omwoyo nga mugonvu, kubanga liteeka Katonda emirundi mingi mu birowoozo byaffe, era kuleeta okutegeera eddiini mu bikolwa ebya bulijjo eby’obulamu bwaffe obwa bulijjo.
