Singa omuntu, buli lwe yabanga mu bantu, omuntu yenna mwe yalayira, n’ayogera eby’obukaba, oba n’ayogera obubi ku muliraanwa we, yandyekoledde etteeka, oba okumunenya mpola, oba, bwe kitandibadde kisaanidde, olwo okuva mu bantu abo mu ngeri esaanidde nga bwe yandisobodde, yandisanze nti etteeka lino ettono, ng’ekizimbulukusa ekitono ekikwekeddwa mu buwunga bungi, lyandibunye ne lyetuuka mu ngeri y’obulamu bwe bwonna.

Singa omulala yandyewalirizza okwewala ku lunaku lwa Mukama ebintu byonna ebitaliiko musango era ebikkirizibwa, ng’okutambula, okukyala, emboozi eza bulijjo, n’okwogera ku nsonga ez’ensi, ng’obusuubuzi, amawulire, n’ebiringa ebyo; singa yandiwonze olunaku, ng’oggyeeko okusinza okwa lwatu, eri okwesudde okusingawo, okusoma, okwewaayo eri Katonda, okuyigiriza, n’emirimu egy’okusaasira; wadde kiyinza okulabika ng’ekintu ekitono butono oba obwegendereza obuteetaagisa, okwetaagako omuntu okwewala ebintu ng’ebyo ebiyinza okukolebwa awatali kibi, naye buli eyandigezezza omugaso gw’etteeka ettono bwe lityo, oboolyawo yandisanze nga lireese enkyukakyuka mu mwoyo gwe, n’okuwoomerwa okutya Katonda okw’engeri eyo mu birowoozo bye, gye yali omugwira ddala emabega.

Kyandibadde kyangu okulaga, mu by’okulabirako ebirala bingi, nga ensonga ennyimpi era entono bwe ziri amadaala agasooka n’entandikwa ez’obutonde ez’okutuukirira okunene.

Naye ebintu ebibiri ebisinga byonna okwetaaga okubeera wansi w’etteeka ekkakali, era ebiri emikisa egisinga obunene eri ffe n’eri abalala, bwe bikozesebwa obulungi, bye budde bwaffe n’ensimbi zaffe. Ttalanta zino ngeri ezitakoma n’emikisa egy’okukola ebirungi.

Oyo akakanyala mu kutya Katonda, era omwegendereza mu kukozesa n’amagezi ekimu ku bino, tayinza kubeera ebbanga ddene nga tamanyi nkozesa ntuufu ey’ekirala. Era oyo ow’essanyu mu kubirabirira n’okubikozesa mu ngeri ey’eddiini byombi, aba alinnye dda amadaala agawerako ku ssiteezi y’okutuukirira okw’Ekikristaayo.

Miranda (muganda wa Flavia) Mukristaayo eyeefuga, ow’amagezi: amangu ddala nga afuuse nnannyini budde bwe n’obugagga bwe, ekirowoozo kye ekyasooka kyali nga bw’ayinza okutuukiriza obulungi buli kintu Katonda kye yamwetaagako mu kubikozesa, n’engeri gy’ayinza okukozesaamu obulungi era mu ssanyu obulamu buno obumpi. Yeesigama ku mazima g’ekyo Mukama waffe omutendereze kye yayogera, nti waliwo "ekintu kimu kyokka ekyetaagibwa," [Lukka 10:42] n’olwekyo afuula obulamu bwe bwonna okufuba kumu okutakoma okukituukako. Alina ensonga emu yokka ey’okukola oba obutakola, ey’okwagala oba obutayagala ekintu kyonna, era kwe kwagala kwa Katonda. Si munafu nnyo okwefuula nti agattako ekyo ekiyitibwa nnyabo ow’ekitiibwa ku Mukristaayo ow’amazima; Miranda alowooza bulungi nnyo obutasendebwa ddoboozi ly’ebigambo ebyo eby’obusirusiru; yalekayo ensi okugoberera Kristo mu kukola obwetoowaze, okusaasira, okwewaayo eri Katonda, okwefuga, n’okwagala eby’omu ggulu; era ezo ze mpisa za Miranda ez’ekitiibwa.

Bwe yali akyali wansi wa nnyina, yawalirizibwa okuba ow’ekitiibwa, okubeera mu mikolo, okutuula okutuusa ekiro ennyo, okubeera mu busirusiru bwa buli musono, n’okukyalanga bulijjo ku Ssande; okugenda ng’ayeesiize ebizigo, era ng’azitoowereddwa omugugu gw’eby’okwewunda, ku Ssakramentu Entukuvu; okubeera mu buli mboozi ey’abeesimbu b’ensi; okuwulira obuvvoozi mu kifo awazannyirwa emizannyo, n’ennyimba ez’obukaba n’enkwe ez’omukwano mu opera; okuzina mu bifo ebya lwatu, abasajja abeewunda n’abakaba balyoke beewuunye obulungi bw’omubiri gwe, n’obulungi bw’entambula ye. Okujjukira engeri eno ey’obulamu kumufuula omwegendereza ennyo okugitangirira n’enneeyisa ekontana nayo.

Miranda tagabanya buvunaanyizibwa bwe wakati wa Katonda, muliraanwa we, ne ye yennyini; wabula atwala byonna nga bya Katonda, n’olwekyo akola buli kintu mu Linnya Lye, era ku lwa Ye. Kino kimuleetera okutwala obugagga bwe ng’ekirabo kya Katonda, ekirina okukozesebwa, nga buli kintu ekya Katonda bwe kiri, olw’ebigendererwa eby’amagezi era eby’ensonga eby’obulamu obw’Ekikristaayo era obutukuvu. N’olwekyo obugagga bwe bugabanyizibwa wakati we n’abantu abalala abaavu abawerako, era ye afunamu ekitundu kye kyokka eky’obuyambi. Alowooza nti busirusiru bwe bumu okwekkusa mu nsaasaanya eteetaagisa, etaliimu, nga okuwa abantu abalala okusaasaanya mu ngeri y’emu. N’olwekyo nga bw’atajja kuwa mwavu nsimbi kugenda kulaba muzannyo gwa bipupe, bw’atyo tajja kwekkiriza ze yandisaasaanyizza mu ngeri y’emu; ng’alowooza nti kisaanira nnyo okuba ow’amagezi ye yennyini nga bw’asuubira abaavu okuba. Kubanga busirusiru era musango eri omwavu, Miranda bw’agamba, okwonoona ky’aweereddwa mu bintu ebitaliimu eby’obusirusiru, ng’abulwa emmere, ekyokunywa, n’engoye. Era kye busirusiru obutono, oba musango mutono gye ndi, okusaasaanya ensimbi ezo mu kwesanyusa okw’obusirusiru, ezandisaasaanyiziddwa obulungi ennyo mu kugoberera obulungi bwa Katonda, mu mirimu egy’ekisa n’okusaasira eri bannange n’Abakristaayo bannange? Singa ebyetaago by’omwavu bennyini nsonga lwaki tasaanidde kwonoona ku nsimbi ze mu butaliimu, mazima ebyetaago by’abaavu, obulungi bw’okusaasira, okutwalibwa ng’okukoleddwa Kristo Yennyini, nsonga nnene nnyo okusingawo lwaki tewali n’omu asaanidde kwonoona ku nsimbi ze. Kubanga bw’akola bw’atyo, takola ng’omwavu kyokka, okwonoona obwonoonyi ekyo ky’ayetaaga ye yennyini, wabula ayonoona ekyo ekyetaagibwa olw’enkozesa esinga ekitiibwa, era Kristo Yennyini kye mwetegefu okukkiriza okuva mu mikono gye. Era bwe tusunguwalira omwavu, ne tumutwala ng’omunafu ow’ennaku, bw’asuula ekyo ekyandimuguliddemu emmere ye; tulirabika tutya mu maaso ga Katonda, bwe tukozesa mu bukaba n’obugayaavu ekyo ekyandiguliddemu emmere n’engoye baganda baffe abalumwa enjala era abali obwereere, abali okumpi era abaagalwa Katonda nga ffe bwe tuli, era abasika bannaffe ab’embeera y’emu ey’ekitiibwa ekigenda okujja? Guno gwe mwoyo gwa Miranda, era bw’atyo bw’akozesa ebirabo bya Katonda; ye omu bumu ku muwendo gw’abaavu abamu, abayambibwa okuva mu bugagga bwe, era ayawukana ku bo mu mukisa gw’okugaba gwokka.

Ng’oggyeeko emmere ye, tasaasaanyangako kumpi pawundi kkumi buli mwaka ku ye yekka. Singa wandimulabye, wandyewuunyizza muntu ki omwavu oyo, eyali omuyonjo era omulongoofu mu ngeri ey’ekyewuunyo bw’etyo. Alina etteeka limu lyokka ly’akuuma mu by’okwambala, okuba bulijjo omuyonjo era mu bintu ebisinga obuseere. Buli kintu ekimwetoolodde kifaanana obulongoofu bw’emmeeme ye, era bulijjo aba muyonjo ebweru, kubanga bulijjo aba mulongoofu munda.

Buli makya gamulaba ng’azuukuse mangu ng’ali mu ssaala ze; asanyukira entandikwa ya buli lunaku, kubanga lutandika amateeka ge gonna ag’okutya Katonda ag’obulamu obutukuvu, era luleeta essanyu eriggya ery’okugaddiŋŋana. Alabika nga malayika omukuumi eri abo ababeera okumwetooloola, n’okutunula kwe n’essaala ze, ng’asabira omukisa ekifo w’abeera, era ng’abeegayiririra eri Katonda abo abeebase.

Okwewaayo kwe kubaddemu ebiseera ebimu eby’okuwummula, era Katonda awulidde essaala ze ez’ekyama eziwerako, ng’ekitangaala tekinnakkirizibwa kuyingira mu kisenge kya muganda we. Miranda tamanyi kye kitegeeza okubeera n’ekitundu ky’olunaku ekizitowa ekisiriikirivu; okuddayo kw’essaawa ze ez’okusaba, n’okwegezaamu kwe okw’eddiini, bijja emirundi mingi nnyo obutaleka kitundu kyonna ekinene ekya lwo okumuzitoowerera mu mikono.

Bw’omulaba ng’akola omulimu gw’emikono, olaba amagezi ge gamu agafuga ebikolwa bye ebirala byonna; oba akola ekintu ekyetaagisa gy’ali, oba ekyetaagisa eri abalala, abeetaaga okuyambibwa. Kumpi tewali maka maavu mu kitundu, agatayambala kintu kimu oba ekirala ekyakolebwako emikono gye. Ebirowoozo bye eby’amagezi era ebitya Katonda tebyetaaga kwesanyusa, era tebiyinza kugumiikiriza busirusiru, obw’omulimu ogw’obugayaavu era ogutaliimu nsa. Tayinza kukkiriza busirusiru ng’obwo emisana kubanga alina okuwoza ku bikolwa bye byonna ekiro. Bwe wataba magezi gakuumibwa mu mulimu gw’emikono gye, bwe wataba mulimu gwa mugaso oba ogw’okusaasira ogw’okukolebwa, Miranda tajja kweyongera kukola. Ku mmeeza ye abeera mu ngeri enkakali ng’etteeka lino ery’Ebyawandiikibwa ebitukuvu bwe liri, "buli kye mukola, oba kulya oba kunywa, mukikole nga mugenderera kugulumiza Katonda." [1 Abakkolinso 10:31] Kino kimuleetera okutandika n’okumaliriza buli kijjulo, nga bw’atandika era bw’amaliriza buli lunaku, n’ebikolwa eby’okwewaayo eri Katonda: alya era anywa olw’okubeera omulamu kwokka, era n’okwefuga okutegeke bwe kutyo, ne kiba nti buli kijjulo kwe kwegezaamu okwefiiriza, era yeetoowaza omubiri gwe buli lw’awalirizibwa okuguliisa. Singa Miranda yalina okudduka embiro olw’obulamu bwe, yandikkirizza emmere esaanira ekyo. Naye ng’embiro ezimuteekeddwa mu maaso bwe ziri embiro ez’obutukuvu, obulongoofu, n’okwagala eby’omu ggulu, z’alina okumaliriza mu mubiri omuvundu, omutabuddwa olw’okwegomba okw’oku nsi, bw’etyo emmere ye eya buli lunaku erina ekigendererwa kimu kyokka, okufuula omubiri gwe okusaanira ennyo embiro zino ez’omwoyo. Tapima mmere ye ku minzaani, naye agipima ku minzaani esinga obulungi ennyo; ekyenkana ekiwa omubiri gwe amaanyi agasaanidde, ne kigufuula ogusobola era ogwagala okugondera emmeeme, okwegatta mu zabbuli n’essaala, n’okusitula amaaso n’emikono eri eggulu n’obwetegefu obusingawo: ekyenkana ekyo kye kijjulo kya Miranda. N’olwekyo Miranda talibaako maaso gazimbagatana olw’obugevvu, oba okuwejjawejja wansi w’omugugu omuzito ogw’ennyama, okutuusa ng’akyusizza eddiini ye.

Ebyawandiikibwa ebitukuvu, naddala eby’Endagaano Empya, bye by’asoma n’okuyiga buli lunaku; abisoma n’okussaayo omwoyo okw’obwegendereza, ng’atunuulira bulijjo ye yennyini, era nga yeekebera na buli njigiriza eriwo. Bw’aba n’Endagaano Empya mu ngalo ze, alowooza nti ali ku bigere by’Omulokozi waffe n’Abatume Be, era afuula buli ky’abayigirako okuba amateeka g’obulamu bwe. Akkiriza ebigambo byabwe ebitukuvu n’okussaayo omwoyo n’okussa ekitiibwa nga bw’aba ng’abalaba bennyini, era ng’amanyi nti bakava mu Ggulu, nga bagenderedde okumuyigiriza ekkubo erigendayo.

Alowooza nti okwekebera buli lunaku n’enjigiriza z’Ebyawandiikibwa, ye ngeri yokka esoboka ey’okuba omwetegefu olw’okusalirwa omusango ku lunaku olw’enkomerero. Ebiseera ebimu atya nti asaasaanya ensimbi nnyingi nnyo ku bitabo, kubanga tayinza kwewala kugula bitabo byonna eby’okukozesa ebimanyiddwa, naddala ebyo ebiyingira mu mutima gw’eddiini, era ebinnyonnyola obutukuvu obw’omunda obw’obulamu obw’Ekikristaayo. Naye ku biwandiiko byonna eby’abantu, ebyafaayo by’abantu abatya Katonda n’abatukuvu abaatiikirira bye bimusanyusa okusinga. Mu bino anoonyeza ng’anoonya eky’obugagga ekyakwekebwa, ng’asuubira okusanga ekyama ekimu eky’obulamu obutukuvu, eddaala erimu ery’okutya Katonda eritali lya bulijjo, ly’ayinza okufuula erirye. Mu ngeri eno Miranda ajjuzizza bw’atyo omutwe gwe n’omutima gwe emisingi gyonna egy’amagezi n’obutukuvu, ajjudde nnyo omulimu ogumu omukulu ogw’obulamu, ne kiba nti kimuzibuwalira okwogera ku nsonga endala yonna; era bw’oba naye, bw’alowooza nti kisaanira okwogera, oteekwa okufuulibwa ow’amagezi era omulungi okusingawo, oyagale oba toyagala.

Okunnyonnyola okusaasira kwe, kwandibadde kunnyonnyola ebyafaayo bya buli lunaku okumala emyaka amakumi abiri; kubanga ebbanga eryo lyonna obugagga bwe bwonna bubadde busaasaanyizibwa mu ngeri eyo. Azzizzaawo abasuubuzi abaavu nga amakumi abiri abaali bagudde mu bisuubuzi byabwe, era n’awonya omuwendo gwe gumu obutagwa. Asomesezza abaana abaavu abawerako, abaalondebwa mu nguudo, n’abateeka mu kkubo ery’omulimu ogw’obwesimbu. Amangu ddala nga omupakasi yenna asibiddwa awaka olw’obulwadde, amuweereza, okutuusa lw’awona, omuwendo ogukubisaamu emirundi ebiri ogw’empeera ye, alyoke abe n’ekitundu ekimu eky’okuwa amaka ge nga bulijjo, n’ekirala eky’okugula ebintu ebisaanira obulwadde bwe.

Amaka bwe galabika nga manene nnyo okuwanirirwa n’emirimu gy’abo abasobola okukola mu go, abasasulira omusolo gw’ennyumba, era abawa ekintu buli mwaka okuyamba ku by’okwambala byabwe. Mu ngeri eno, waliwo amaka amaavu agawerako agabeera mu ngeri ey’emirembe, era agamusabira omukisa mu ssaala zaago okuva ku mwaka okudda ku mulala.

Bwe wabaawo omusajja omwavu oba omukazi omubi okusinga ku bulijjo era ow’ekyejo, Miranda amussaako eriiso; atunuulira ekiseera kye eky’obwetaavu n’ebizibu; era bw’asobola okuzuula nti bali mu buzibu bwonna obunene, oba mu nnaku, abawa obuyambi amangu. Alina okufaayo kuno eri abantu ab’engeri eno, kubanga omulundi gumu yawonya omuntu omukozi w’ebibi ennyo okutwalibwa mu kkomera, amangu ddala n’afuuka omwenenya ow’amazima.

Tewali kintu mu mpisa za Miranda ekisinga okwewuunyisa okusinga omutima guno. Kubanga ekisa kino eky’okwagala eri aboonoonyi abasinga okwerekerera kye kyokulabirako ekisinga obugulumivu eky’emmeeme ey’obwakatonda era efaanana Katonda.

Omulundi gumu Miranda yayita ku nnyumba, omusajja ne mukyala we mwe baali bakolimiragana era nga balayiragana mu ngeri esinga obubi, n’abaana basatu nga bakaaba okubeetooloola: okulaba kuno kwakwata nnyo ku birowoozo bye eby’ekisa, n’agenda ku lunaku olwaddirira, n’agula abaana abasatu, baleme kwonoonebwa nga babeera ne bazadde ababi ng’abo; kaakano babeera ne Miranda, baweebwa omukisa olw’okufaayo kwe n’essaala ze, n’emirimu gyonna emirungi gy’asobola okubakolera. Bawulira nga bw’ayogera, balaba nga bw’abeera, beegatta naye mu zabbuli n’essaala. Omukulu mu bo amaze okukyusa bazadde be okuva mu bulamu bwabwe obubi, era alaga ebirowoozo ebitya Katonda mu ngeri ey’ekyewuunyo bw’etyo, ne kiba nti Miranda amugenderera okuba omuweereza w’Ekkanisa; alyoke, ng’awonyezeddwa bw’atyo ye yennyini, abe omunyiikivu mu bulokozi bw’emmeeme, era akole eri abalala ab’ennaku nga ye bw’amukoledde.

Miranda buyambi obutakoma eri abaavu mu bizibu byabwe n’obubenje bwabwe: ebiseera ebimu wabaawo obuzibu obutono obubatuukako, bwe batandisobodde kuwangula bokka. Okufa kw’ente oba embalaasi, oba obubbi obutono, byandibakuumye mu nnaku obulamu bwabwe bwonna. Tabaleka kunakuwala wansi w’obubenje ng’obwo. Amangu ddala abawa omuwendo gwonna ogw’ekyo kye bafiiriddwa, era akikozesa ng’engeri ey’okusitula ebirowoozo byabwe eri Katonda.

Alina ekisa kinene eri abakadde abataddayo kusobola kukola. Ensako ekigo ky’ewa abantu ng’abo tetera kuba ya kubeezaawo bulungi: olw’ensonga eno bulijjo be bantu b’afaako: ayongera ku nsako yaabwe ekyenkana, ne kisukka katono empeera gye baafunanga nga bakyali bavubuka. Kino akikola okubudaabuda obunafu bw’obukadde bwabwe, balyoke, nga tebali mu buzibu na nnaku, baweereze Katonda mu mirembe n’obuteefu bw’ebirowoozo. Okutwalira awamu alina omuwendo munene ogw’engeri eno, abo, olw’okusaasira kwe n’okukubiriza kwe eri obutukuvu, bamalira ennaku zaabwe ez’enkomerero mu kutya Katonda okunene n’okwewaayo.

Miranda tabulwa kusaasira, ne eri abasabiriza aba bulijjo; naddala eri abo abakadde oba abalwadde, oba abajjudde amabwa, ababulwa amaaso oba ebitundu by’omubiri. Awulira okwemulugunya kwabwe n’ekisa, abawa obukakafu obumu obw’ekisa kye, era tabagaana n’ebigambo ebikakanyavu oba eby’okuvuma, olw’okutya okwongera ennaku ku bannaffe.

Singa omutambuze omukadde omwavu amugamba nti talina maanyi, wadde emmere, wadde ensimbi ezisigaddeyo, tamugamba kuddayo gye yava, wadde okumugamba nti tayinza kumuyamba, kubanga ayinza okuba omukumpanya, oba kubanga tamumanyi; wabula amuyamba olw’ensonga eyo, kubanga mugwira era tamumanyi. Kubanga kye kitundu ekisinga ekitiibwa eky’okusaasira okuba n’ekisa era okugonda eri abo be tutalabangako, era oboolyawo be tutaliddayo kulaba mu bulamu buno. "Nnali mugenyi ne munnyaniriza," [Matayo 25:35] Omulokozi waffe omutendereze bw’agamba: naye ani ayinza okutuukiriza obuvunaanyizibwa buno, atajja kuyamba bantu b’atamanyi?

Miranda alowooza nti Lazaalo yali musabiriza wa bulijjo, nti bamalayika baamulabirira, era ne bamutwala mu kifuba kya Ibulayimu. Alowooza nti Omulokozi waffe omutendereze n’Abatume Be baali n’ekisa eri abasabiriza; nti baayogeranga nabo mu ngeri ebabudaabuda, ne bawonya endwadde zaabwe, ne bazzaawo amaaso n’ebitundu by’omubiri eri abalema ne bamuzibe; nti Peetero yagamba omusabiriza eyali ayagala ekirabo okuva gy’ali nti, "Effeeza ne zaabu sibirina, naye ka nkuwe ekyo kye nnina. Mu linnya lya Yesu Omunnazaaleesi Golokoka, otambule!" [Ebikolwa by’Abatume 3:6] N’olwekyo Miranda tayisa basabiriza mu butafaayo n’okukyawa; wabula agoberera ekisa ky’Omulokozi waffe n’Abatume Be gye bali; era wadde tayinza, nga bo, okukola ebyamagero olw’okubayamba, naye abayamba n’obuyinza obwo bw’alina; era ayinza okugamba, ng’Omutume, nti "ka nkuwe ekyo kye nnina, mu linnya lya Yesu Kristo."

Oboolyawo, Miranda bw’agamba, emirundi mingi nnyinza okuwa abo abatasaanira, oba abaliyonoona ekirabo kyange. Naye kale ki? Eno si y’engeri yennyini ey’obulungi bwa Katonda? Katonda tafuula "omusana gwe agwakiza abalungi n’ababi"? [Matayo 5:45] Buno si bwe bulungi bwennyini obutukubirizibwa mu Byawandiikibwa, tulyoke, nga tubugoberera, tubeere abaana ba Kitaffe ali mu Ggulu, "atonnyeza enkuba ab’amazima n’abatali ba mazima"? Era nnaaziyiza ensimbi ntono, oba emmere, munnange, olw’okutya nti oboolyawo si mulungi ekimala okubifuna okuva gye ndi? Nsaba Katonda ankole, si ng’empeera yange bw’eri, wabula ng’obulungi Bwe obunene bwe buli; era nnaaba musirusiru bwe ntyo okuziyiza okusaasira kwange eri muganda wange omwavu, kubanga oboolyawo tasaanira? Nnaakozesa ekipimo gy’ali, kye nsaba Katonda aleme kukozesa gye ndi?

Ate era, Ebyawandiikibwa byafuula wa obusaanyizo okuba etteeka oba ekipimo ky’okusaasira? Ku ludda olulala, Ebyawandiikibwa bigamba nti, "omulabe wo bw’alumwanga enjala, muliisenga; bw’alumwanga ennyonta muwenga ekyokunywa." [Abaruumi 12:20]

Kale kino kituyigiriza mu lwatu, nti obusaanyizo bw’abantu tebulina kuba tteeka lya kusaasira kwaffe; wabula nti tulina okukola ebikolwa eby’ekisa eri abo abasinga byonna obutasaanira. Kubanga bwe mba nga ndina okwagala n’okukolera ebirungi abalabe bange abasinga obubi: bwe mba nga ndina okubasaasira, wadde balina ettima lyonna n’obukyayi; mazima obusaanyizo si kipimo kya kusaasira. Bwe mba nga sirina kuziyiza kusaasira kwange eri abantu ababi ng’abo, era abali abalabe bange mu kiseera kye kimu, mazima sirina kugaana birabo eri abasabiriza abaavu, be simanyi nti bantu babi, wadde abalabe bange mu ngeri yonna.

Oboolyawo ojja kugamba, nti mu ngeri eno nzizaamu abantu amaanyi okuba abasabiriza. Naye okuwakanya kwe kumu okutalowoozeddwako kuyinza okukolebwa ku kusaasira okwa buli ngeri, kubanga kuyinza okuzzaamu abantu amaanyi okwesigama ku kwo. Kye kimu kiyinza okwogerwa ku kusonyiwa abalabe baffe, kubanga kiyinza okuzzaamu abantu amaanyi okutukola obubi. Kye kimu kiyinza okwogerwa ne ku bulungi bwa Katonda, nti olw’okufuka emikisa Gye ku babi ne ku balungi, ku b’amazima ne ku batali ba mazima, abantu ababi era abatali ba mazima bazzibwamu amaanyi mu makubo gaabwe amabi. Kye kimu kiyinza okwogerwa ku kwambaza abali obwereere, oba okuwa abalwadde eddagala; kubanga ekyo kiyinza okuzzaamu abantu amaanyi okwerekerera, n’obutafaayo ku bulamu bwabwe. Naye okwagala kwa Katonda bwe kubeera mu ggwe, bwe kumala okugaziya omutima gwo, ne kukujjuza okusaasira n’ekisa okw’omunda, tojja kuddamu kuwakanya bwe kuti.

Buli lw’oba ng’ogoba omwavu, omukadde, omulwadde, n’omutambuze atalina buyambi, omulema, oba muzibe, weebuuze ekibuuzo kino, Njagala mu mazima ebitonde bino ebyavu okuba eby’essanyu nga Lazaalo, eyatwalibwa bamalayika mu kifuba kya Ibulayimu? Njagala mu mazima Katonda abafuule abasika bannange mu kitiibwa ekitaggwaawo? Kale bw’onoonoonyereza mu mmeeme yo, ojja kusanga nti tewali kweyongera kwa ngeri eyo mu yo; nti toli mu kwagala kintu kyonna ku bino. Kubanga tekisoboka omuntu yenna okwagala n’omutima gwonna ekitonde ekyavu essanyu eddene bwe lityo, naye n’atabaako mutima gwa kukiwa kirabo kitono. Olw’ensonga eno, Miranda bw’agamba, nga bwe nsobola, mpa bonna, kubanga nsaba Katonda asonyiwe bonna; era siyinza kugaana kirabo eri abo be nsabira Katonda abawe omukisa, be njagala okugabana ku kitiibwa ekitaggwaawo, wabula nsanyuka okulaga eddaala erimu ery’okwagala eri abo, nga bwe nsuubira, abaliba abaagalwa okwagala kwa Katonda okutakoma. Era bwe kiba nti, nga Omulokozi waffe bwe yatukakasa, okugaba kwa mukisa okusinga okuweebwa, tusaanidde okutunuulira abo abatusaba ebirabo, nga mikwano mingi n’abayambi, abajja okutukolera ekirungi ekisinga kye bayinza okufuna, abajja okugulumiza empisa zaffe ennungi, okuba abajulirwa b’okusaasira kwaffe, okuba ebijjukizo by’okwagala kwaffe, okuba abatwogerera eri Katonda, okuba gye tuli mu kifo kya Kristo, okulabika ku lwaffe ku lunaku olw’omusango, n’okutuyamba okufuna omukisa omunene okusinga ebirabo byaffe bye biyinza okubawa.

Guno gwe mwoyo, era buno bwe bulamu, bwa Miranda eyeewaddeyo eri Katonda; era bw’anaawangaala emyaka kkumi emirala, ajja kuba asaasaanyizza pawundi kakaaga mu kusaasira; kubanga ekyo ky’ayekkiriza, kiyinza okubalirwa mu bwenkanya mu birabo bye.

Bw’alifa, ateekwa okwakaayakana mu Batume, n’abatukuvu, n’abajulizi; ateekwa okuyimirira mu baweereza ba Katonda abasooka, era okuba ow’ekitiibwa mu abo abaalwana okulwana okulungi, ne bamaliriza olugendo lwabwe n’essanyu.

fields.title: Ebirowoozo ebimu ku bulamu bwa Miranda, n’okulaga nga bwe buyinza era nga bwe busaanidde okugobererwa abakazi bonna
fields.body_html:
KALE obulamu buno obwa Miranda, bwe nkubiriza n’omutima gwonna abakazi bannaabwe okugoberera, wadde nga buyinza okulabika nga bukontana nnyo n’engeri n’emisono gy’ensi, naye butuukagana n’omwoyo ogw’amazima, era bwazimbibwa ku njigiriza ezisinga okweyoleka ez’Obukristaayo.

Okubeera nga ye bw’abeera, kituukagana ddala n’Enjiri ya Kristo, nga okubatizibwa, oba okufuna Ssakramentu.

Omwoyo gwe gwe gwe gumu ogwawa abatukuvu ab’emirembe egyayita amaanyi; era olw’okuba baabeeranga nga ye bw’abeera, kyetuva kaakano tujaguza okujjukira kwabwe, era tutendereza Katonda olw’eby’okulabirako byabwe.

Tewali kintu kya kyekango, ekitaliimu nsa, oba ekitali kya magezi mu mpisa ze, wabula buli kintu ekinnyonnyoddwayo kyokulabirako ekituufu era ekisaanidde eky’okutya Katonda okunywevu era okw’amazima.

Kyangu okulaga nti kya kyekango okugenda mu Kkanisa, oba okusaba essaala, nga bwe kiri okulaga nti kya kyekango okukuuma ekimu ku mateeka gano ag’obulamu. Kubanga amateeka gonna aga Miranda ag’okubeera omulamu eri Katonda, ag’okumalira obudde bwe n’obugagga bwe, ag’okulya, okukola, okwambala, n’okwogera, bitundu bikulu by’obulamu obw’amagezi era obutukuvu, ng’okwewaayo n’okusaba bwe biri.

Kubanga tewali kiyinza kwogerwa ku magezi g’okwefuga, amagezi g’okwewaayo, amagezi g’okusaasira, oba amagezi g’obwetoowaze, ekitali nsonga nnungi mu ngeri y’emu ey’okukozesa n’amagezi era mu nsonga eby’okwambala.

Era tewali kiyinza kwogerwa ku busirusiru bw’okwejalabya, obusirusiru bw’obuluvu, obusirusiru bw’okusukkiriza, obusirusiru bw’okusaasaanya, obusirusiru bw’okwegomba obukulu, obw’obugayaavu, oba obw’okwekkusa, ekitateekwa kwogerwa ku busirusiru bw’okwambala. Kubanga eddiini ekwatibwako nnyo ku kimu nga ku kirala.

Bw’oba oyinza okuba ow’obutaliimu mu kintu kimu, oyinza okuba ow’obutaliimu mu buli kintu; kubanga engeri emu ey’obutaliimu eyawukana ku ndala nga engeri emu ey’obutefuga bw’eyawukana ku ndala.

Bw’osaasaanya obugagga bwo mu by’okwewunda eby’okwambala ebiteetaagisa era ebitaliimu, toyinza kuvumirira kusaasaanya, oba okusukkiriza, oba okwejalabya, nga teweevumiridde.

Bw’olowooza nti obwo bwe busirusiru bwo bwokka, era n’olwekyo tewayinza kubaamu nsonga nnene mu bwo, ofaanana abo abalowooza nti balina omusango gw’obusirusiru bw’omululu gwokka, oba obusirusiru bw’okwegomba obukulu. Kale wadde abantu abamu bayinza okubeera mu bulamu obulabika obulungi bwe butyo, ne balabika nga tebalina nsobi ndala okuggyako ey’omululu oba ey’okwegomba obukulu; naye ensonga teri nga bw’erabika, kubanga omululu oba okwegomba obukulu tebiyinza kubeera mu mutima, ogwewaddeyo obulungi eri Katonda mu nsonga endala.

Mu ngeri y’emu, wadde abantu abamu bayinza okusaasaanya ebisinga ku bye balina mu by’okwewunda eby’okwambala ebiteetaagisa era eby’ensimbi ennyingi, naye ne balabika nga batya Katonda ddala mu buli nsonga endala, naye mazima bulimba; kubanga tekisoboka birowoozo ebiri mu mbeera ey’amazima ey’eddiini, okuba eby’obutaliimu mu kukozesa engoye, nga bwe kitasoboka okuba eby’obutaliimu mu kukozesa ebirabo eri abaavu oba okwewaayo. Kale okukukakasa kino okuva mu kufumiitiriza kwo ggwe kennyini, ka tulowooze nti omutukuvu omu eyatiikirira, ng’ekyokulabirako, nti Maliyamu Embeerera omutukuvu yatumibwa mu nsi, okuddamu okubeera mu mbeera ey’okugezesebwa okumala emyaka mitono, era nti wali ogenda gy’ali, okuzimbibwa olw’okutya Katonda kwe okunene; wandisuubidde okumusanga ng’ayambadde era ng’ayeewunze n’engoye ennungi era ez’omuwendo omungi? Nedda. Wandimanyi, mu birowoozo byo, nti tekisoboka, nga bwe kitandisobose okumusanga ng’ayiga okuzina. Gattako bugasi omutukuvu, oba ow’obutukuvu, ku muntu yenna, oba musajja oba mukazi, ebirowoozo byo bijja kukugamba amangu ddala, nti empisa ng’eyo teyinza kukkiriza butaliimu bw’engoye ennungi. Omutukuvu ayambadde mu kitiibwa eky’ensi, busirusiru bunene nga Omutume ayambadde ekyambalo ekiwundiddwa obulungi; okutegeera kwa buli muntu okw’obuzaaliranwa kumukakasa obutatuukagana bw’ebintu bino.

Kale nsonga ki, nti bw’olowooza ku mutukuvu, oba omuweereza wa Katonda eyatiikirira, toyinza kukkiriza butaliimu bw’engoye? Si lwa kuba nti tebutuukagana na mbeera ya mutima entuufu ng’eyo, okutya Katonda okw’amazima era okw’awaggulu ng’okwo? Era kale kino si bukakafu, nti obutaliimu ng’obwo we bukkirizibwa, eyo embeera y’omutima entuufu, okutya Katonda okw’amazima era okw’awaggulu, biteekwa okuba nga tebiriiyo? Kubanga nga bwe kiri ekikakafu nti Maliyamu Embeerera omutukuvu teyandyekkirizza, oba okugoberera obutaliimu bw’ensi mu by’okwambala n’okweyoleka, bwe kityo bwe kiri ekikakafu, nti tewali ayinza kwekkiriza butaliimu buno, okuggyako abo ababulwa okutya Katonda kwe okw’omutima; era n’olwekyo kiteekwa okukkirizibwa, nti eby’okwewunda byonna eby’okwambala ebiteetaagisa era eby’ensimbi ennyingi biva mu mutima ogutabuddwa, ogutafugibwa mwoyo gwa ddiini ogw’amazima.

Omululu si musango kubanga waliwo akabi konna mu zaabu oba mu ffeeza, wabula kubanga gulaga embeera y’ebirowoozo ey’obusirusiru era etali ya magezi, eyagwa okuva ku bulungi bwayo obw’amazima, n’ennyika mu kumatira okwavu era okw’ennaku bwe kutyo.

Mu ngeri y’emu, eby’okwewunda eby’okwambala eby’ensimbi ennyingi si musango kubanga waliwo ekintu ekirungi oba ekibi mu ngoye, wabula kubanga eby’okwewunda eby’engoye eby’ensimbi ennyingi biraga embeera y’omutima ey’obusirusiru era etali ya magezi, eyagwa okuva ku ndowooza entuufu ez’obutonde bw’omuntu, ekozesa obubi ekigendererwa ky’engoye, era efuula ebyetaago by’obulamu okuba eby’okulabirako bingi eby’amalala n’obusirusiru.

Ensi yonna ekkiriza okuvumirira abasajja abeewunda ennyo mu ngeri eyeeyoleka. Kale ensonga ya kino ye ki? Kubanga waliwo ekintu eky’ekibi mu by’okwambala byabwe eby’enjawulo, oba mu mpisa zaabwe ez’okwefuula? Nedda: wabula kubanga abantu bonna bamanyi nti biraga embeera y’ebirowoozo by’omuntu, era nti tekisoboka endabika ey’ekisesa bw’etyo ey’ebweru okubaako ekintu eky’amagezi, oba eky’ensonga, oba ekirungi munda. Era, mazima, okulowooza ku musajja eyeewunda ennyo atya Katonda ennyo, busirusiru bwe bumu nga okulowooza ku mutiitiizi alina obuzira bungi. N’olwekyo ensi yonna ekkiriza, nti enkozesa n’engeri y’engoye kabonero ak’embeera y’ebirowoozo by’omuntu, era, n’olwekyo, nti kintu kikulu nnyo mu ddiini. Naye kale kisaanidde okulowoozebwako obulungi, nti nga bwe kitali mutamiivu yekka alina omusango gw’obutefuga, wabula buli asukka ebipimo ebituufu era eby’eddiini eby’okulya n’okunywa; bwe kityo kisaanidde okulowoozebwako, nti si musajja eyeewunda ennyo yekka alina omusango gw’obutaliimu n’okukozesa obubi eby’okwambala, wabula buli ava ku bigendererwa eby’amagezi era eby’eddiini eby’engoye.

N’olwekyo, nga buli nsonga ewakanya obutamiivu bw’eri ensonga ennungi y’emu ewakanya obutefuga obwa buli ngeri; bwe kityo buli nsonga ewakanya obutaliimu bw’abasajja abeewunda ennyo, nsonga nnungi y’emu ewakanya obutaliimu bwonna n’okukozesa obubi eby’okwambala. Kubanga byonna bya ngeri y’emu, era byawukana bwawukanyi ng’eddaala erimu ery’obutefuga bwe liyinza okwawukana ku ddala. Oyo eyeesiiga ebizigo katono, ayinza mu bwenkanya bwe bumu okuvunaana omulala kubanga yeesiiga bingi, nga oyo akozesa eby’okwewunda eby’okwambala ebya bulijjo bw’ayinza okuvunaana omulala asukkiriza mu by’okwewunda bye.

Kubanga nga, mu nsonga y’okwefuga, bwe watali tteeka okuggyako okwefuga okutuukagana n’enjigiriza n’omwoyo gw’eddiini yaffe; bwe kityo, mu nsonga y’engoye, tewali tteeka lya kukuuma, okuggyako enkozesa entuufu ey’engoye ng’eyo etuukagana ddala n’enjigiriza n’omwoyo gw’eddiini yaffe. Okwefuula nti tufuula engeri y’ensi ekipimo kyaffe mu bintu bino, bunafu era busirusiru nga okufuula engeri y’ensi ekipimo ky’okwefuga kwaffe, okwewala kwaffe, oba obwetoowaze bwaffe. Kwefuula kwa busirusiru nnyo mu kamwa k’Abakristaayo, abalina okuba ewala nnyo n’okugoberera emisono gy’obulamu buno, ne kiba nti okuwangula ensi kufuuliddwa akabonero akakulu ak’Obukristaayo.

N’olwekyo eno y’engeri gy’olina okusaliramu omusango gw’engoye ez’obutaliimu: olina okugitwala ng’ekisobyo eri enkozesa esaanidde ey’engoye, ng’omululu bwe guli ekisobyo eri enkozesa esaanidde ey’ensimbi; olina okugitwala ng’okwekkiriza emitima egy’amalala era egitali gya magezi, ng’ekisobyo eri obwetoowaze n’okwefuga kw’omwoyo gw’Ekikristaayo; olina okugitwala ng’ekisobyo eri enjigiriza zonna ezo ezikwetaagako okukola byonna olw’ekitiibwa kya Katonda, ezikwetaagako okukozesa obulungi ttalanta zo; olina okugitwala ng’ekisobyo eri ebigambo byonna eby’Ebyawandiikibwa ebikulagira okwagala muliraanwa wo nga bwe weeyagala, okuliisa abayala, okwambaza abali obwereere, n’okukola emirimu gyonna egy’okusaasira gy’osobola: n’olwekyo tolina kwerimbalimba ng’ogamba nti, Akabi ki akayinza okuba mu ngoye? Kubanga omuntu ow’omululu yandigambye bulungi nti, Akabi ki akayinza okuba mu zaabu oba mu ffeeza? Wabula olina okulowooza, nti kabi kanene nnyo okubulwa embeera y’omutima ey’amagezi, ey’ensonga, era ey’obwetoowaze, etuukagana n’omwoyo gw’eddiini, era etayinza kubeera na muntu yenna mu ngeri gy’asaanidde okugibeeramu, eyeekkiriza oba obutaliimu bw’okwambala, oba okwegomba obugagga.

N’olwekyo tewali kituufu mu nkozesa y’engoye, oba mu nkozesa y’ekintu ekirala kyonna mu nsi, okuggyako obwangu n’obutalimu kwewunda obw’Enjiri. Buli nkozesa endala ey’ebintu (ne bw’eba ey’ekitiibwa era ey’emisono mu nsi) etaataaganya era etabula omutima, era tetuukagana na mbeera ey’omunda ey’okutya Katonda, obulongoofu bw’omutima, amagezi g’ebirowoozo, n’obutereevu bw’okwagala, Obukristaayo bye bwetaaga.

Bw’oyagala okuba Omukristaayo omulungi, waliwo engeri emu yokka: olina okubeera omulamu eri Katonda yekka: era bw’oyagala okubeera omulamu eri Katonda yekka, olina okubeera omulamu ng’amagezi agava eri Katonda bwe gali; olina okukola ng’okusala okutuufu okw’obutonde n’omuwendo gw’ebintu bwe kuli; olina okubeera mu kukola okwagala okutukuvu era okw’omu ggulu, n’okukozesa ebirabo byonna ebya Katonda olw’ettendo n’ekitiibwa Kye.

Abantu abamu, oboolyawo, abeewuunya obulongoofu n’okutuukirira kw’obulamu buno obwa Miranda, bayinza okugamba nti, Buyinza butya okuteekebwawo ng’ekyokulabirako ekya bulijjo? Ffe abali mu bufumbo, oba ffe abali wansi w’obulagirizi bwa bazadde baffe, tuyinza tutya okugoberera obulamu ng’obwo?

Kiddibwamu nti, Nga bw’oyinza okugoberera obulamu bw’Omulokozi waffe omutendereze n’Abatume Be. Embeera z’obulamu bw’Omulokozi waffe, n’embeera n’obulamu bw’Abatume Be, byali bya njawulo nnyo ku bibyo, okusinga ebya Miranda bwe biri; naye obulamu bwabwe, obulongoofu n’okutuukirira kw’enneeyisa yaabwe, kye kyokulabirako ekya bulijjo ekiteekebwa mu maaso g’Abakristaayo bonna.

N’olwekyo omwoyo gwabwe, okutya Katonda kwabwe, okwagala kwabwe eri Katonda, bye by’olina okugoberera, so si ngeri y’obulamu bwabwe ey’enjawulo.

Kola wansi wa Katonda nga bo bwe baakola, lungamya ebikolwa byo ebya bulijjo eri ekigendererwa ekyo bo kye baagenderera, gulumiza embeera yo esaanidde n’okwagala Katonda ng’okwo, okusaasira eri muliraanwa wo ng’okwo, obwetoowaze n’okwefiiriza ng’okwo, nga bo bwe baakola; olwo, wadde nga oyigiriza bwigiriza abaana bo, ate nga Pawulo omutukuvu akyusa amawanga gonna, naye ogoberera ebigere bye, era okola ng’ekyokulabirako kye bwe kiri.

N’olwekyo tolowooza, nti toyinza, oba nti teweetaaga, kufaanana Miranda, kubanga toli mu mbeera ye ey’obulamu; kubanga ng’omwoyo gwe gumu n’omutima gwe gumu bwe gwandifudde Miranda omutukuvu, wadde yandibadde awalirizibwa okukola olw’okwebeezaawo, bwe kityo bw’onooyaayaanira bubeezi omwoyo gwe n’omutima gwe, buli ngeri n’embeera ey’obulamu ejja kukuwa engeri ezimala ez’okubikozesa.

Miranda ali bw’ali, kubanga akola buli kintu mu Linnya lya Katonda, era ng’atunuulira obuvunaanyizibwa bwe gy’ali; era bw’onookola bw’otyo, ojja kumufaanana ddala, wadde ng’oyawukana nnyo ku ye mu mbeera ey’ebweru ey’obulamu bwo.

Ogamba nti oli mufumbo; n’olwekyo tolina budde bwo n’obugagga bwo mu buyinza bwo nga ye bw’abirina.

Kya mazima nnyo; n’olwekyo toyinza kumalira budde bungi bwe butyo, wadde ensimbi nnyingi bwe zityo, mu ngeri gy’akolamu.

Naye kaakano okutuukirira kwa Miranda tekuli mu kino, nti amalira obudde bungi bwe butyo, oba ensimbi nnyingi bwe zityo mu ngeri ng’eyo, wabula nti yeegendereza okukozesa obulungi ennyo obudde obwo bwonna, n’obugagga obwo bwonna, Katonda bwe yateeka mu mikono gye. N’olwekyo, ggwe kozesa obulungi ennyo obudde obwo bwonna n’ensimbi ezo zonna eziri mu buyinza bwo, olwo ofaanana Miranda.

Bw’aba alina pawundi bibiri buli mwaka, ate ggwe ng’olina kodulante bbiri zokka, tolina nsonga esingawo okwegendereza ennyo mu kuzikozesa n’amagezi agasingirayo ddala? Bw’aba alina obudde bungi, ate ggwe ng’olina butono, tosaanidde kutunula nnyo n’okwegendereza okusingawo, akatono ako kaleme okubula?

Ogamba nti, singa wandigoberedde obuyonjo, obwangu n’obuseere bw’engoye ze, wandinyiizizza abaami bammwe.

Ekisooka, Kakasa ddala nti kino kya mazima, nga tonnakifuula kwewolereza.

Eky’okubiri, Abaami bammwe bwe baba ddala nga babeetaagako okwesiiga ebizigo mu maaso, okwanika amabeere gammwe, n’okwambala obulungi ennyo era mu nsimbi nnyingi mu ngoye zammwe zonna, olwo musalewo ebintu bino ebibiri:

Ekisooka, Okwewala bino byonna, amangu ddala nga abaami bammwe babakkirizza.

Eky’okubiri, Okufuba n’amaanyi gammwe gonna okweyagaliza okwagala kwabwe olw’empisa ennungi ennywevu ng’ezo, eziyinza okutereeza obutaliimu bw’ebirowoozo byabwe, n’okubayigiriza okubaagala olw’empisa ng’ezo ezinaabafuula abaagalibwa mu maaso ga Katonda ne Bamalayika Be abatukuvu.

Ku bikwata ku njigiriza eno ekwata ku bwangu n’okwegendereza mu by’okwambala, abamu oboolyawo bayinza okulowooza nti ewakanyizibwa ekimala nga babuuza, oba abantu bonna balina okwambala mu ngeri y’emu?

Ebibuuzo bino okutwalira awamu bibuuzibwa abo abandisinze okutabulatabula amazima agasinga okweyoleka, okusinga okuwalirizibwa okugagoberera.

Ka kibe nti nnali nkubirizza obwangu mu mmere eri abantu bonna. Si kintu kya magezi ekimala okukubirizibwa eri bonna? Naye kyandiddiridde, nti omwami ow’ekitiibwa n’omupakasi balina okulya emmere y’emu?

Ka kibe nti nnali nkubirizza okwefuga eri bonna, eddiini tekakasa kimala enjigiriza ng’eyo? Naye kyandiddiridde, nti abantu bonna balina okunywa ebyokunywa bye bimu, era mu bungi bwe bumu?

Mu ngeri y’emu, wadde obwangu n’okwefuga mu by’okwambala bikubirizibwa eri bonna, naye tekiddirira n’akatono, nti bonna balina okwambala mu ngeri y’emu.

Kale etteeka ery’enjawulo ku bikwata ku kwefuga lye liruwa? Abantu ab’enjawulo abakozesa ebyokunywa eby’enjawulo, era mu bungi obw’enjawulo, bakuuma batya okwefuga kwabwe?

Lino si lye tteeka? Tebalina kwekuuma obutekkusa, okufuula enkozesa yaabwe ey’ebyokunywa ensonga ey’omwoyo, n’obutakkiriza kweddiza amaanyi kwonna, okuggyako okutuukagana n’amateeka amakakali ennyo ag’okwefuga okw’Ekikristaayo?

Kale kyusa etteeka lino olitwale mu nsonga y’engoye, olwo ebibuuzo byonna ebigikwatako biba biddiddwamu.

Buli muntu yeekuume bwekuumi obutaliimu bw’okwambala, bafuule bufuuzi enkozesa yaabwe ey’engoye ensonga ey’omwoyo, beegombe bwegomba okukozesa obulungi ennyo ensimbi zaabwe; olwo buli muntu aba n’etteeka, erimala okumulungamya mu buli mbeera ey’obulamu. Etteeka lino teririkkiriza bakulu kuba ba butaliimu mu by’okwambala byabwe, okusinga obutefuga mu byokunywa byabwe; naye lirireka nga kikkirizibwa okubaamu enjawulo ezimu mu ngoye zaabwe, nga bwe kikkirizibwa okubaamu enjawulo ezimu mu byokunywa byabwe.

Naye kaakano ojja kugamba, nti oyinza okukozesa wayini asinga obulungi era asinga omuwendo, ddi, era nga bw’oyagala; nti oyinza okusaasaanya ensimbi nnyingi ku ye nga bw’oyagala, kubanga ebyokunywa eby’enjawulo bikkirizibwa? Bwe kitaba bwe kityo, kiyinza kitya okwogerwa, nti oyinza okukozesa engoye nga bw’oyagala, n’okwambala ebintu ebisinga omuwendo by’osobola okufuna, kubanga enjawulo yokka ey’engoye ekkirizibwa?

Kubanga ng’okukkirizibwa kw’ebyokunywa eby’enjawulo bwe kutaleka kifo, wadde okwewolereza kwonna, eri eddaala erisinga obutono ery’obutefuga mu kunywa, bwe kityo okukkirizibwa kw’engoye ez’enjawulo tekuleka kifo, wadde okwewolereza kwonna, eri amadaala agasinga obutono ag’obutaliimu mu by’okwambala.

Okubuuza obutaliimu mu by’okwambala kye ki, si kibuuzo kizibu okusinga okubuuza, obutefuga mu kunywa kye ki. Era wadde eddiini wano teteekawo kipimo kya njawulo eri buli muntu, naye etuwa amateeka ag’awamu ng’ago agali obulagirizi obumala mu buli mbeera ey’obulamu.

Oyo akkiriza eddiini okumuyigiriza nti ekigendererwa ky’okunywa kwe kuzzaamu bubeezi emyoyo gyaffe amaanyi, okutukuuma nga tuli balamu bulungi, n’okufuula emmeeme n’omubiri okusaanira ennyo emirimu gyonna egy’obulamu obutukuvu era obutya Katonda, era nti alina okwegomba okugulumiza Katonda olw’okukozesa obulungi eddembe lino, ajja kumanya bulijjo obutefuga kye buli, mu mbeera ye ey’enjawulo.

Bw’atyo oyo akkiriza eddiini okumuyigiriza nti ekigendererwa ky’engoye kwe kukweka bukweka ensonyi zaffe n’obwereere bwaffe, n’okukuuma emibiri gyaffe obutalumibwa mbeera ya budde, era nti alina okwegomba okugulumiza Katonda olw’okukozesa obwetaavu buno mu kwefuga era mu magezi, ajja kumanya bulijjo obutaliimu bw’okwambala kye buli, mu mbeera ye ey’enjawulo.

Era oyo alowooza nti bwegendereza obuteetaagisa okwogera ku nkozesa ey’eddiini ey’engoye, alina ensonga y’emu okulowooza nti bwegendereza obuteetaagisa okwogera ku nkozesa ey’eddiini ey’ebyokunywa. Kubanga okwejalabya n’okwekkusa mu by’okwambala kukozesa bubi kunene, ng’okwejalabya n’okwekkusa mu kulya n’okunywa. Era tewali ngeri ya kwewala kimu ku byo, okuggyako okufuula eddiini ekipimo ekkakali eky’ebyo bye twekkiriza mu nsonga zombi. Era tewali kintu mu ddiini ekiyinza okukubiriza omuntu eri obwegendereza buno obw’okutya Katonda mu nsonga emu, ekitali nsonga nnungi y’emu eri obwegendereza obwo mu ndala.

Ate era, nga byonna ebikkirizibwa bwe bitali bya mugaso olw’ekyo, bwe kityo waliwo ebintu ebimu ebikkirizibwa mu nkozesa y’ebyokunywa n’engoye, ebiyinza, nga tubyewala olw’ebigendererwa eby’okutya Katonda, okufuulibwa engeri ez’okutuukirira okunene.

Bwe kityo, ng’ekyokulabirako, singa omuntu yandyefiirizza enkozesa y’ebyokunywa ekkirizibwa; singa yandyewaze okusaasaanya ku byokunywa bye ekyandikkiriziddwa awatali kibi; singa yandikoze kino, si lwa kwefiiriza okusingawo okutya Katonda kwokka, wabula alyoke asobole okuyamba n’okuzzaamu amaanyi abatalina buyambi, abaavu, n’abalwadde: singa omulala yandyewaze enkozesa y’ekyo ekikkirizibwa mu by’okwambala, singa yandibadde omukekkereza era owa wansi mu ngoye ze okusinga ebyetaago by’eddiini bwe byetaaga ddala; singa yandikoze kino si ng’engeri ey’obwetoowaze obusingawo bwokka, wabula alyoke asobole okwambaza abantu abalala; abantu bano bandigambiddwa nti bakoze ekyo ekituukagana ennyo n’omwoyo ogw’amazima, wadde nga tekyetaagibwa ddala nnukuta, ey’etteeka lya Kristo.

Kubanga abo abawa egiraasi y’amazzi agannyogoga omuyigirizwa wa Kristo bwe batalirema kuweebwa mpeera yaabwe, [Matayo 10:42] nga bateekwa okuba abaagalwa ennyo Kristo, abo abeewa amazzi emirundi mingi, balyoke basobole okuwa wayini abalwadde n’abanafu abali ebitundu by’omubiri gwa Kristo!

Naye ka tudde ku nsonga. Byonna ebyogeddwa wano eri abakazi abafumbo, biyinza okuba okuyigirizibwa kwe kumu eri abo abakyali wansi w’obulagirizi bwa bazadde baabwe.

Kale wadde obuwulizi obusaanira bazadde tebubawaliriza butatwala mpisa zaabwe nnungi waggulu okusinga bazadde baabwe bwe babetaagako; naye obuwulizi bwabwe bubetaagako okugondera obulagirizi bwabwe mu bintu byonna ebitakontana na mateeka ga Katonda.

N’olwekyo, bazadde bo bwe bakwetaagako okubeera ennyo mu misono n’emboozi z’ensi, oba okusaasaanya ennyo ku by’okwambala byo n’endabika yo, oba okukozesa obudde bwo mu ngeri endala etatuukagana na kwegomba kwo okw’okutuukirira okusingawo, oteekwa okugonda, n’okukigumiikiriza ng’omusaalaba gwo, okutuusa lw’oliba ow’eddembe okugoberera okubuulirira kwa Kristo okw’awaggulu, n’okuba n’obuyinza okulonda amakubo agasinga obulungi ag’okusitula empisa zo ennungi okutuuka ku ntikko yaazo esinga obugulumivu.

Kale wadde, ng’okyali mu mbeera eno, oyinza okuwalirizibwa okulekayo engeri ezimu ez’okukulaakulanya empisa zo ennungi, naye waliwo endala ezisangibwa mu yo, ezitayinza kufunibwa mu bulamu obulimu eddembe erisingawo.

Kubanga bw’oba mu mbeera eno, obuwulizi mwe buli empisa ennungi ennene bwe butyo, n’ogonda mu bintu byonna ebikkirizibwa, olw’okutegeera obuvunaanyizibwa okw’okutya Katonda era okw’ekisa, olwo ebintu ebyo by’okola bw’otyo, mu kifo ky’okuba ebiziyiza empisa zo ennungi, bifuulibwa engeri ez’okuzikulaakulanya.

Ky’ofiirwa olw’okuziyizibwa ebintu ng’ebyo bye wandyagadde okukuuma, okifuna olw’empisa ennungi ennyo ey’obuwulizi, mu kugonda n’obwetoowaze ng’okontana n’omutima gwo.

Kale ekikkiriziddwa wano, kiri mu bintu ebikkirizibwa byokka, n’olwekyo okwesanyusa kw’emizannyo gyaffe egy’Abangereza kuggyibwako wano; nga kwalagibwa awalala, nga bwe ndowooza, nti tekukkirizibwa n’akatono.

Ebyo bimala okulaga engeri abantu abali wansi w’obulagirizi bw’abalala gye bayinza okugoberera obulamu obw’amagezi era obutya Katonda obwa Miranda.

Naye ku bikwata ku abo abali mu mikono gyabwe bokka ddala, singa eddembe ly’embeera yaabwe libaleetera okwegomba ebirabo ebisinga obulungi, singa libatwala okulonda amakubo agasinga obulungi, singa bo, nga balina byonna mu buyinza bwabwe, bandifudde engeri y’obulamu bwabwe yonna okuba okukola okutegeke okw’empisa ennungi ezisinga obugulumivu, balina omukisa abo abaayiga Kristo bwe batyo!

Abantu bonna tebayinza kukkiriza kigambo kino. Abo abasobola okukikkiriza, bakikkirize, era beebaze Omwoyo oyo owa Katonda, eyateeka okwegomba okulungi bwe kutyo mu mitima gyabwe.

Katonda ayinza okuweerezebwa n’okugulumizibwa mu buli mbeera ey’obulamu. Naye nga bwe waliwo embeera ez’obulamu ezimu ezegombebwa okusinga endala, ezisinga okulongoosa obutonde bwaffe, ezisinga okukulaakulanya empisa zaffe ennungi, n’okutuwonga eri Katonda mu ngeri esingako obugulumivu, bwe batyo abo abali mu ddembe okwerondera balabika nga bayitibwa Katonda okwewaayo eri obuweereza Bwe mu ngeri esingawo okwatiikirira.

Okuva ku ntandikwa y’Obukristaayo wabaddewo ebibiina bibiri, oba amadaala abiri ag’abantu, mu Bakristaayo abalungi.

Ekimu ekyatyanga Katonda era ne kimuweereza mu mirimu egya bulijjo n’emirimu egy’obulamu obw’ensi.

Ekirala, nga kirekayo emirimu egya bulijjo, n’ebisanyusa ebya bulijjo eby’obulamu, ng’obugagga, obufumbo, ekitiibwa, n’amasanyu, ne kyewaayo eri obwavu obw’okweyagalira, obuwala obutali bufumbo, okwewaayo eri Katonda, n’okwesudde, kiryoke mu ngeri eno kibeere ekiramu eri Katonda yekka, mu kukola buli lunaku obulamu obw’obwakatonda era obw’omu ggulu.

Obujulirwa buno mbuggya ku muwandiisi w’ebyafaayo by’Ekkanisa eyatiikirira Eusebius, eyaliwo mu kiseera ky’Olukiiko olukulu olwasooka, okukkiriza kwa Nicene Creed yaffe lwe kwanywezebwa, Ekkanisa lwe yali mu kitiibwa kyayo n’obulongoofu bwayo obusingirayo ddala, Abalabirizi baayo lwe baali bakitaffe batukuvu era abatukuvu abaatiikirira.

"N’olwekyo," bw’atyo bwe yagamba, "mu Kkanisa ya Kristo mwateekebwawo amakubo abiri, oba engeri bbiri, ez’okubeera. Engeri emu, esituliddwa waggulu w’embeera eya bulijjo ey’obutonde, n’engeri eza bulijjo ez’okubeera, egaana obufumbo, ebintu, n’ebirungi eby’ensi, era, ng’eyawuliddwa ddala era ng’eggiddwa mu mboozi eza bulijjo ez’obulamu obwa bulijjo, ewongebwa era yeewaayo eri okusinza n’okuweereza Katonda yekka, olw’eddaala erisukkiridde ery’okwagala okw’omu ggulu.

"Abo abali mu kibiina kino eky’abantu balabika ng’abaafa eri obulamu bw’ensi eno, era, nga balina emibiri gyabwe gyokka ku nsi, mu birowoozo byabwe, ne mu kufumiitiriza kwabwe babeera mu ggulu. Okuva eyo, ng’abatuuze bangi ab’omu ggulu, batunuulira wansi obulamu bw’abantu, nga beegayiririra era nga bawaayo ebiweebwayo eri Katonda Omuyinza w’Ebintu Byonna ku lw’olulyo lwonna olw’abantu. Era kino si na musaayi gwa nsolo, wadde amasavu, oba omukka, n’okwokya emibiri, wabula n’okukola okusingirayo ddala okw’okutya Katonda okw’amazima, n’emitima egyatukuzibwa era egyalongoosebwa, era n’engeri y’obulamu yonna eyeewaddeyo ddala eri empisa ennungi. Ezo ze ssaddaaka zaabwe, ze bawaayo bulijjo eri Katonda, nga beegayirira okusaasira Kwe n’okuganja okuva gy’ali ku lwabwe ne ku lwa bannaabwe.

"Obukristaayo bukkiriza kino ng’engeri y’obulamu etuukiridde.

"Engeri endala ya ddaala lya wansi, era, ng’etuukagana nnyo n’embeera y’obutonde bw’omuntu, ekkiriza obufumbo obulongoofu, okulabirira abaana n’amaka, obusuubuzi n’emirimu, era eyita mu mirimu gyonna egy’obulamu ng’erina okutegeera okutya Katonda, n’okumutya.

"Kale abo abaalonda engeri eno ey’obulamu, balina ebiseera byabwe ebyateekebwawo eby’okwesudde n’okwegezaamu okw’omwoyo, era ennaku ez’enjawulo ziteekebwa ku bbali olw’okuwulira kwabwe n’okuyiga ekigambo kya Katonda. Era ekibiina kino eky’abantu kitwalibwa ng’ekiri mu mbeera ey’okubiri ey’okutya Katonda." [Eusebius, Dem. Evan. ekitabo 1, essuula 8]

Bw’atyo omuwandiisi w’ebyafaayo ono omuyivu bw’agamba.

N’olwekyo, singa abantu ab’ekikula kyonna, nga bakwatiddwako obulamu bwa Miranda, era nga beegomba okutuukirira, bandyegasse mu bibiina ebitono, nga beeyatula obwavu obw’okweyagalira, obuwala obutali bufumbo, okwesudde, n’okwewaayo eri Katonda, nga babeerawo ku byetaago byokka, abamu balyoke bayambibwe olw’okusaasira kwabwe, era bonna baweebwe omukisa olw’essaala zaabwe, era bagasibwe olw’ekyokulabirako kyabwe; oba singa, olw’obutaba na kino, bandikoze engeri y’obulamu y’emu, mu ddaala erisinga obugulumivu nga bwe bandisobodde bokka; abantu ng’abo bandibadde wala nnyo okuvunaanibwa obulombolombo bwonna, oba okwewaayo okw’obuzibe, ne kiba nti bandigambiddwa mu bwenkanya nti bazzaawo okutya Katonda okwo, okwali okwenyumiriza n’ekitiibwa ky’Ekkanisa, abatukuvu baayo abasinga obukulu bwe baali bakyali balamu.

Kale ng’omuwandiisi w’ebyafaayo ono omuyivu bw’alaba; nti lyali ddaala erisukkiridde ery’okwagala okw’omu ggulu, eryatwala abantu bano waggulu nnyo w’amakubo aga bulijjo ag’obulamu okutuuka ku mbeera ey’obutukuvu eyatiikirira bw’etyo; bwe kityo tekirina kwewuunyisa, nti eddiini ya Yesu Kristo ejjuza emitima gy’Abakristaayo bangi eddaala lino ery’awaggulu ery’okwagala.

Kubanga eddiini eggulawo ekifo eky’ekitiibwa bwe kityo, ebikkula ebintu ebiri waggulu ennyo bwe bityo okusinga ensi yonna, ewangula bw’etyo okufa, etukakasa ebifo eby’essanyu bwe bityo, gye tulibeera amangu ddala nga Bamalayika ba Katonda mu Ggulu; kyewuunyo ki, singa eddiini ng’eyo, amazima n’essuubi ng’ebyo, bizikiriza, mu mmeeme ezimu entukuvu, okwegomba kwonna okw’oku nsi, ne bifuula okwagala okubuubuuka okw’ebintu eby’omu ggulu okuba okwegomba okumu okutakoma okw’emitima gyabwe?

Singa eddiini y’Abakristaayo yazimbibwa ku kwetoowaza okutakoma, okusekererwa n’okukubibwa embooko okw’obukambwe, okubonaabona okw’ekitalo, obulamu obwavu, obuyigganyizibwa, n’okufa okw’obulumi, okw’Omwana wa Katonda eyakomererwa; kyewuunyo ki, singa abasinza bangi abeetoowaze ab’ekyama kino eky’omunda ennyo, abaagazi bangi ab’omutima aba Mukama eyakomererwa, balekayo omugabo gwabwe ogw’amasanyu ag’ensi, ne beewaayo eri okwefuga n’okwefiiriza okutakoma, balyoke, nga babonaabona bwe batyo ne Kristo wano, bafugire wamu naye oluvannyuma?

Singa amazima gennyini gatukakasizza nti waliwo ekintu kimu kyokka ekyetaagibwa, kyewuunyo ki nti wabaawo abamu mu Bakristaayo abajjudde okukkiriza bwe batyo, okukikkiriza mu makulu agasinga obugulumivu ag’ebigambo, n’okwegomba okwawukana bwe batyo n’ensi, okufaayo kwabwe n’okussaayo omwoyo kwabwe ku kintu ekyo kimu ekyetaagibwa kuleme okutaataaganyizibwa?

Singa Mukama waffe omutendereze yagamba nti, "Obanga oyagala okuba omutuukirivu genda otunde ebibyo, ensimbi ozigabire abaavu, kale oliba n’obugagga mu ggulu, olyoke ojje ongoberere"; [Matayo 19:21] kyewuunyo ki, nti wabaawo mu Bakristaayo abagoberezi ba Kristo abanyiikivu bwe batyo, abeemalidde bwe batyo ku by’obugagga eby’omu ggulu, abeegomba okutuukirira bwe batyo, ne balekayo okwesiima mu bugagga bwabwe, ne balonda obwavu obw’okweyagalira, ne bayamba abaavu bonna be basobola?

Singa ekibya ekyalondebwa, Pawulo omutukuvu, yagamba nti, "Omusajja atali mufumbo yeemalira ku bya Mukama, engeri gy’asanyusa Mukama": era nti "waliwo n’enjawulo eno wakati w’omukazi omufumbo n’embeerera; omukazi atali mufumbo afaayo ku bintu bya Mukama, abeerenga mutukuvu mu mubiri ne mu mwoyo"; [1 Abakkolinso 7:32-34] kyewuunyo ki, singa obulongoofu n’okutuukirira kw’embeera y’obuwala obutali bufumbo bubadde ettendo n’ekitiibwa ky’Ekkanisa mu mirembe gyayo egyasooka era egisinga obulongoofu? nti bulijjo wabaddewo abamu abeegomba bwe batyo okusanyusa Katonda, abanyiikivu bwe batyo okutuuka ku buli ddaala ery’obulongoofu n’okutuukirira, abasanyukira bwe batyo buli ngeri ey’okukulaakulanya empisa zaabwe ennungi, ne balekayo ebibudaabuda n’ebisanyusa eby’obufumbo, okuseesa ettaala zaabwe, okulongoosa emmeeme zaabwe, n’okulindirira Katonda mu mbeera ey’obuwala obutali bufumbo obw’olubeerera?

Era singa mu nnaku zaffe zino tubulwa eby’okulabirako eby’amadaala gano ag’enjawulo ag’okutuukirira, singa abakulembeze b’eddiini wadde abakkiriza abalala tebalina mwoyo guno ogumala; singa twavaako ewala nnyo, ne kiba nti omuntu alabika, nga Pawulo omutukuvu mu Asene, ng’omubuulizi w’enjigiriza ennyimpya, [Ebikolwa by’Abatume 17:18] bw’akubiriza okwefiiriza, okulekayo ensi, okwewaayo okutegeke eri Katonda, okwesudde, obuwala obutali bufumbo, n’obwavu obw’okweyagalira, kubanga tugudde mu mulembe, okwagala okw’abangi kwokka, wabula okw’abasinga obungi, mwe kuwoledde.

Nkoze okwesigama kuno okutono ku b’edda, ne njogera ebigambo bino ebitono eby’Ebyawandiikibwa, okuwanirira ebikolwa ebimu ebitali bya bulijjo mu bulamu bwa Miranda; n’okulaga nti amateeka ge agasinga obugulumivu ag’obulamu obutukuvu, okwewaayo kwe eri Katonda, okwefiiriza, okulekayo ensi, okusaasira kwe, obuwala bwe obutali bufumbo, obwavu obw’okweyagalira, byazimbibwa ku kubuulirira okusingirayo ddala obugulumivu okwa Kristo n’Abatume Be, bituukagana n’essuubi ery’awaggulu ery’obulamu obulala, bya kulabirako ebisaanidde eby’okwagala okw’omu ggulu, era byonna byagobererwa abatukuvu abasinga obukulu ab’emirembe gy’Ekkanisa egisinga obulungi era egisinga obulongoofu.

"Alina amatu agawulira, awulire." [Matayo 11:15]

fields.title: Okulaga emitendera gyonna n’amadaala gonna ag’abasajja n’abakazi, ab’emyaka gyonna, nga bwe balina okwewaayo eri Katonda
fields.body_html:
MU SSUULA ezikulembeddemu, nnyiseemu eby’okulabirako ebinene ebiwerako eby’okwewaayo okw’Ekikristaayo eri Katonda, ne ndaga nti ebitundu byonna eby’obulamu bwaffe obwa bulijjo, emirimu gyaffe, ttalanta zaffe, n’ebirabo by’obugagga, byonna birina okufuulibwa ebitukuvu era ebisiimibwa Katonda olw’okukozesa buli kintu n’amagezi era mu ngeri ey’eddiini, n’olw’okulungamya ebikolwa byaffe n’ebigendererwa byaffe eri ebigendererwa ng’ebyo ebisaanira ekitiibwa n’ettendo lya Katonda.

Kaakano nja kulaga nti obutereevu buno obw’okwewaayo eri Katonda, obutukuvu buno obw’obulamu obwa bulijjo, enkozesa eno ey’eddiini eya buli kintu kye tulina, kwe kwewaayo okuli obuvunaanyizibwa bw’amadaala gonna ag’abantu Abakristaayo.

Fulvius yasomera ddala, era yafuna amadaala ge mu ttendekero eddene; yavaayo alyoke abeere ow’eddembe ku mateeka gonna ag’obulamu. Tatwala mulimu gwonna, wadde okweyingiza mu nsonga yonna, kubanga alowooza nti buli mulimu oba ensonga eyita abantu okukola n’obwegendereza era n’obwenkanya emirimu gyagwo egy’enjawulo. Bw’aba ng’alina obukakkamu, ajja kukugamba nti teyayingira mu buweereza obutukuvu, kubanga agutwala okuba embeera eyeetaaga obutukuvu bungi mu bulamu, era nti tekituukagana na mutima gwe okuba omulungi bw’atyo. Ajja kukugamba nti tagenderera kuwasa n’akatono, kubanga tayinza kwewaliriza butereevu bw’obulamu n’enneeyisa ennungi, by’alowooza nti buvunaanyizibwa bw’abo abali ku mutwe gw’amaka. Yagaana okuba kitaawe w’omu kubatiza ow’omwana wa muganda we, kubanga tayagala kuteresebwa kintu kya ngeri yonna kye yandivunaanyizibwa.

Fulvius alowooza nti alina omwoyo omulungi mu nneeyisa eno, n’olwekyo amatidde n’obulamu obusinga obugayaavu, obutaliimu nsa, era obutafaayo.

Talina ddiini, talina kwewaayo eri Katonda, teyeefuula kutya Katonda. Tabeera mu mateeka gonna, era alowooza nti byonna biri bulungi nnyo, kubanga si kabona, wadde kitaawe, wadde omukuumi w’abaana, wadde alina omulimu gwonna, oba amaka, ge yandirabiridde.

Naye Fulvius, oli kitonde kya magezi, era, nga bw’oli bw’otyo, oteekwa okubeera omulamu ng’amagezi n’entegeka bwe biri, nga kabona bw’ateekwa okuweereza ku kyoto, oba omukuumi okuba omwesigwa mu ky’ateresebwa: bw’obeera omulamu mu ngeri ekontana n’amagezi, tokola musango mutono, tomenya bwesige butono; wabula omenya etteeka ly’obutonde bwo, ojeemera Katonda eyakuwa obutonde obwo, era weeteeka mu abo Katonda ow’amagezi n’entegeka b’aliboneereza ng’abaava ku kukkiriza era abaadduka.

Wadde nga tolina mulimu, naye, nga bwe wabatizibwa mu kwatula eddiini ya Kristo, oteekwa okubeera omulamu ng’obutukuvu bw’omwoyo gw’Ekikristaayo bwe buli, n’okutuukiriza ebisuubizo byonna bye wakola ku Kubatizibwa kwo, nga omuntu yenna bw’ateekwa okuba omwesigwa era omwetegefu mu mulimu gwe. Bw’okozesa obubi okuyitibwa kuno okunene, toba mulimba mu nsonga ntono, wabula okozesa bubi omusaayi gwa Kristo ogw’omuwendo; okomerera Omwana wa Katonda omulundi ogwokubiri; olagajjalira eby’okulabirako ebisinga obugulumivu eby’obulungi bwa Katonda; oswaza Ekkanisa ya Katonda; oteeka ebbala ku mubiri gwa Kristo; okozesa bubi engeri ez’ekisa, n’ebisuubizo eby’ekitiibwa; era Ttuulo ne Sidoni birisaasirwa okusinga ggwe ku lunaku olw’omusango.

N’olwekyo busirusiru bunene omuntu yenna okulowooza nti ali mu ddembe okubeera omulamu nga bw’ayagala, kubanga tali mu mbeera ya bulamu ng’abalala abamu bwe bali: kubanga bwe wabaawo ekintu eky’entiisa mu kukozesa obubi ekintu kyonna eky’okwesigwa; bwe wabaawo eky’okutya olw’okulagajjalira okuyitibwa kwonna; tewali kisinga kutiisa okusinga okukozesa obubi amagezi gaffe, wadde ekisinga okutiibwa okusinga okulagajjalira okuyitibwa kwaffe okw’Ekikristaayo, okutali kwa kuweereza bigendererwa bitono eby’obulamu obumpi, wabula okununulira Katonda emmeeme, okujjuza Eggulu abatukuvu, n’okumaliriza obwakabaka obw’ekitiibwa ekitaggwaawo eri Katonda.

N’olwekyo tewali muntu alina kwerowooza nti asonyiyiddwa obwegendereza bw’okutya Katonda n’empisa ennungi, kubanga yalonda okuba omugayaavu era atalina amufuga mu nsi; kubanga obwetaavu bw’obulamu obw’amagezi era obutukuvu tebwazimbibwa ku mbeera ez’enjawulo n’emirimu egy’obulamu buno, wabula ku butonde bwa Katonda obutakyuka, ne ku butonde bw’omuntu. Omuntu talina kuba wa magezi era mutukuvu, kubanga kabona, oba kitaawe w’amaka; wabula alina okuba kabona atya Katonda, era kitaawe omulungi, kubanga okutya Katonda n’obulungi ge mateeka g’obutonde bw’omuntu. Singa omuntu yenna yali asobola okusanyusa Katonda, nga tabeera mulamu ng’amagezi n’entegeka bwe biri, tewandibadde kintu kinyiiza Katonda mu kabona omugayaavu, oba mu kitaawe ow’ekyejo. N’olwekyo, oyo akozesa obubi amagezi ge, afaanana oyo akozesa obubi obwakabona; era oyo alagajjalira obutukuvu bw’obulamu obw’Ekikristaayo, afaanana omuntu atafaayo ku kintu ekisinga obukulu kye yateresebwa.

Singa omuntu yandironze okwejjamu amaaso, okusinga okwesiima mu kitangaala, n’okulaba emirimu gya Katonda; singa yandyetuse ku bubwe ng’agaana okulya n’okunywa; buli muntu yandikkirizza nti omuntu ng’oyo yali mujeemu eri Katonda, eyasaanira mu bwenkanya obusungu Bwe obusingirayo ddala. Towandigambye nti kino kyali kibi mu kabona yekka, oba mu mukulu w’amaka, wabula mu buli muntu nga bw’ali omuntu.

Kale obubi bw’enneeyisa eno buli mu ki? Tebuli mu kino, nti akozesa bubi obutonde bwe, era agaana okukola ekitundu ekyo Katonda kye yamutondera? Naye kino bwe kiba eky’amazima, olwo abantu bonna abakozesa obubi amagezi gaabwe, abakola ekitundu eky’enjawulo ku ekyo Katonda kye yabatondera, bafaanana omuntu ono, bajeemu eri Katonda, era olw’ensonga y’emu bali wansi w’obusungu Bwe.

Ka tulowooze nti omuntu ono, mu kifo ky’okwejjamu amaaso, yali agakozesezza bukozesi okutunuulira ebintu eby’ekisesa, oba okugaziba mu tulo; nti mu kifo ky’okwetta enjala, olw’obutalya n’akatono, yandifudde buli kijjulo ekinyumu, n’alya era n’anywa ng’omuluvu; yandigambiddwa nti yabeera mulamu nnyo okusingawo olw’Ekitiibwa kya Katonda? Yandigambiddwa nti yakola ekitundu Katonda kye yamutondera, okusinga singa yali yejjeemu amaaso, ne yetta enjala?

Kale lowooza bulowooza ku muntu akola mu ngeri etali ya magezi; lowooza bulowooza ng’azikiza amagezi ge, mu kifo ky’okwejjamu amaaso, era ng’abeera mu busirusiru n’ebitaliimu nsa, mu kifo ky’okwetta enjala; olwo oba ozudde omujeemu omunene bw’atyo eri Katonda.

Kubanga oyo eyeejjamu amaaso, oba eyeetta, alina omusango guno gwokka, nti akozesa bubi obuyinza Katonda bwe yamuwa; nti agaana okukola ekitundu ekyo kye yatonderwa, era yeeteeka mu mbeera ekontana n’okwagala kwa Katonda. Era mazima guno gwe musango gwa buli abeera mu bulamu obutali bwa magezi, obutali butukuvu, era obw’obusirusiru.

N’olwekyo, nga bwe watali mbeera ya njawulo, oba obulamu obw’ekyama, obuli okwewolereza olw’okukozesa obubi emibiri gyaffe, oba okwetta, bwe kityo tewali mbeera ya njawulo, oba obulamu obw’ekyama, obuli okwewolereza olw’okukozesa obubi amagezi gaffe, oba olw’okulagajjalira obutukuvu bw’eddiini y’Ekikristaayo. Kubanga mazima kwe kwagala kwa Katonda nti tukozese obulungi ennyo obusobozi bwaffe obw’amagezi, nti tugoberere obulongoofu n’obutukuvu bw’Obukristaayo, nga bwe kuli okwagala kwa Katonda nti tukozese amaaso gaffe, era tulye era tunywe olw’okukuuma obulamu bwaffe.

N’olwekyo, okutuusa omuntu lw’ayinza okulaga nti afuba mu mazima okubeera omulamu nga Katonda bw’ayagala, okuba ekyo Katonda ky’amwetaagako okuba; okutuusa lw’ayinza okulaga nti afuba okubeera omulamu ng’obutukuvu bw’eddiini y’Ekikristaayo bwe buli; ka abe ani, oba abe wa, alina okuwoza ku ebyo byonna, abo bye balina okuwozaako, abagaana okubeera abalamu, abakozesa obubi eby’okwesigwa ebisinga obunene, era abalagajjalira okuyitibwa okusinga obugulumivu mu nsi.

Buli muntu akkiriza nti amadaala gonna ag’abantu galina okuba ag’obwesigwa n’obwesimbu obwenkanankana era obukakali; tewali kuggyibwako kwonna mu mirimu gino, olw’embeera yonna ey’ekyama oba ey’enjawulo ey’obulamu. Kale, singa twandissaayo bussaayo omwoyo ku magezi n’obutonde bw’ebintu, singa twandirowoozezza bulowooza ku butonde bwa Katonda, n’obutonde bw’omuntu, twandisanze obwetaavu bwe bumu eri buli nkozesa endala entuufu ey’amagezi gaffe, eri buli kisa, oba omutima ogw’eddiini ogw’obulamu obw’Ekikristaayo; twandisanze nga busirusiru okulowooza nti omuntu omu ateekwa okuba omukakali mu kutya Katonda, n’omulala teyeetaaga, nga bwe kiri okulowooza nti omuntu omu ateekwa okuba omukakali mu bwesimbu, naye omulala teyeetaaga; kubanga obwetoowaze obw’Ekikristaayo, okwefuga, okwewaayo, n’okutya Katonda, bitundu binene era ebyetaagisa eby’obulamu obw’amagezi, ng’obwenkanya n’obwesimbu bwe biri. Ate ku ludda olulala, amalala, obuluvu, n’omululu, butabanguko bunene obw’emmeeme, kukozesa bubi kunene okw’amagezi gaffe, era bikontana ne Katonda, ng’obukumpanya n’obutaba mwesigwa bwe biri. Obubbi n’obutaba mwesigwa birabika, mazima, eri amaaso ga bannabulijjo, okuba ebibi ebinene okusingawo, kubanga birumya nnyo ekibiina ky’abantu, era bibonerezebwa nnyo amateeka g’abantu. Naye bwe tunaatunuulira abantu mu ndowooza ey’awaggulu, ng’ekibiina kya Katonda eky’ebitonde eby’amagezi, ebirina okumugulumiza olw’okukozesa obulungi amagezi gaabyo, n’olw’okukola nga bituukagana n’entegeka y’obutonde bwabyo, tujja kusanga nti buli mutima ogukontana mu ngeri y’emu n’amagezi n’entegeka, oguwakanya ebigendererwa bya Katonda n’entegeka Ze, era ogutabula obulungi n’ekitiibwa ky’ensi ey’amagezi, kibi mu ngeri y’emu mu muntu, era kya kwenyinyalwa mu ngeri y’emu eri Katonda.

Kino kyanditulaze nti ekibi ky’obuluvu kifaanana ekibi ky’obutaba mwesigwa, era kitufuula ab’okunyiigirwa ennyo Katonda mu ngeri y’emu.

Era nate: bwe tunaatunuulira abantu mu ndowooza endala esingawo, ng’ekibiina ekyanunulibwa eky’emyoyo egyagwa, egyabatizibwa mu kussa ekimu n’Omwana wa Katonda; okuba yeekaalu z’Omwoyo Omutukuvu; okubeera abalamu ng’okuluŋŋamya Kwe okutukuvu bwe kuli; okuwaayo eri Katonda ssaddaaka ey’amagezi ey’obulamu obwetoowaze, obutya Katonda, era obwebaza; okwerongoosa okuva mu butabanguko bw’okugwa kwabwe; okukozesa obulungi engeri ez’ekisa, balyoke babe abaana ab’ekitiibwa ekitaggwaawo; bwe tunaatunuulira abantu mu kitangaala kino eky’amazima, olwo tujja kusanga nti emitima gyonna egikontana n’ekibiina kino ekitukuvu, egiri okukozesa obubi okusaasira kuno okutakoma, ebikolwa byonna ebitufuula obutafaanana Kristo, ebiswaza omubiri Gwe, ebikozesa obubi engeri ez’ekisa, era ebiwakanya essuubi lyaffe ery’ekitiibwa, birina buli kintu ekiyinza okutufuula ab’okwenyinyalwa eri Katonda emirembe gyonna. N’olwekyo wadde amalala n’obuluvu, n’ebibi ebirala eby’engeri eyo, tebirumya kibiina kya bantu ng’obukumpanya n’obutaba mwesigwa bwe bikola; naye birumya ekibiina ekyo, era biwakanya ebigendererwa ebyo, ebisinga obukulu n’ekitiibwa mu maaso ga Katonda okusinga ebibiina byonna ebikwata ku nsi eno.

N’olwekyo tewali kiyinza kuba kya bulimba okusinga okulowooza, nti olw’okuba tuli bantu ab’ekyama, abateetikkanga buvunaanyizibwa wadde omulimu gwonna ogw’obulamu, n’olwekyo tuyinza okubeera mu ddembe eddene, okwekkusa mu kwegomba kwaffe, n’obutafaayo nnyo ku mirimu egy’okutya Katonda n’obutukuvu; kubanga kwe kwewolereza okulungi okwe kumu eri obukumpanya n’obutaba mwesigwa. Kubanga oyo akozesa obubi amagezi ge, eyeekkiriza okwegomba okubi n’obuluvu, era n’alagajjalira okukola ekitundu eky’amagezi era eky’ensonga eky’Omukristaayo ow’amazima, alina buli kintu mu bulamu bwe ekimufuula ow’okukyayibwa Katonda, ekisangibwa mu bukumpanya n’obutaba mwesigwa.

N’olwekyo, bw’olonda okuba omuluvu omugayaavu okusinga okuba atali mwesigwa; bw’olonda okubeera mu kwegomba okubi n’obuluvu, okusinga okulumya muliraanwa wo mu bintu bye; tewetegekedde bulungi kuganja mu maaso ga Katonda okusinga oyo alonda okubba ennyumba okusinga okubba ekkanisa.

Kubanga okukozesa obubi obutonde bwaffe bujeemu bunene eri Katonda, ng’okulumya muliraanwa waffe; era oyo abulwa okutya Katonda, akoze ebingi okwezikiriza, nga oyo abulwa obwesimbu eri abantu. N’olwekyo buli nsonga eraga nti kyetaagisa abantu bonna mu mbeera zonna ez’obulamu okuba abeesimbu ddala, eraga nti kyetaagisa mu ngeri y’emu abantu bonna mu mbeera zonna ez’obulamu okuba abatukuvu ddala era abatya Katonda, n’okukola ebintu byonna mu ngeri esaanira ekitiibwa kya Katonda.

Era nate: ensonga endala ey’okulaga nti amadaala gonna ag’abantu gateekwa okuba amatukuvu bwe gatyo era agewaddeyo eri Katonda mu bulamu bwabwe obwa bulijjo, mu kukozesa buli kintu kye beesiimamu, eyinza okuggyibwa mu buvunaanyizibwa bwaffe obw’okusaba.

Kikkirizibwa nti okusaba buvunaanyizibwa obukwata ku mbeera zonna n’embeera z’abantu: kale bwe tunoonyereza ensonga y’ekyo, lwaki tewali mbeera ya bulamu esonyiyibwa okusaba, tujja kusanga nga ye nsonga ennungi y’emu lwaki buli mbeera ey’obulamu erina okufuulibwa embeera ey’okutya Katonda n’obutukuvu mu bitundu byayo byonna.

Kubanga ensonga lwaki tulina okusaba Katonda, n’okumugulumiza n’ennyimba, ne zabbuli ez’okwebaza, y’eno, kubanga tulina okubeera abalamu eri Katonda yekka, n’okumugulumiza mu ngeri zonna ezisoboka. Si lwa kuba nti ettendo ly’ebigambo, oba ebigambo by’okwebaza, bisingako okuba ebitundu by’okutya Katonda, oba bisingako okuba okusinza Katonda okusinga ebintu ebirala; wabula kubanga ngeri ezisoboka ez’okulaga okwesigama kwaffe ku Katonda, obuwulize bwaffe n’okwewaayo kwaffe gy’ali. Kale bwe kiba nga eno y’ensonga y’ettendo n’okwebaza okw’ebigambo eri Katonda, kubanga tulina okubeera abalamu eri Katonda mu ngeri zonna ezisoboka, olwo kiddirira mu lwatu, nti tuteekwa mu ngeri y’emu okusinza n’okugulumiza Katonda mu bikolwa ebirala byonna ebiyinza okufuulibwa ebikolwa eby’okutya Katonda n’obuwulize gy’ali. Era, ng’ebikolwa bwe bisinga ennyo amakulu okusinga ebigambo, kiteekwa okuba okusinza Katonda okusiimibwa ennyo okusingawo, okumugulumiza mu bikolwa byonna eby’obulamu bwaffe obwa bulijjo, okusinga n’ebigambo ebitono byonna mu biseera ebimu.

Bwe kityo, singa Katonda alina okusinzibwa n’ebigambo by’okwebaza, oyo eyeekolera etteeka ery’okumatira n’okwebaza mu buli kitundu n’ekibaawo mu bulamu bwe, kubanga kiva eri Katonda, atendereza Katonda mu ngeri esinga ennyo obugulumivu okusinga oyo alina ekiseera ekimu ekyateekebwawo eky’okuyimba zabbuli. Oyo atayaŋŋanga kwogera kigambo kitali kya kisa, oba okukola ekintu ekitali kya magezi, kubanga alowooza nti Katonda ali buli wamu, akola okwewaayo okusinga obulungi okusinga oyo atayaŋŋanga kusubwa Kkanisa. Okubeera mu nsi ng’omugwira era omutambuze, ng’okozesa ebisanyusa byayo byonna ng’atabikozesa, ng’ofuula ebikolwa byaffe byonna amadaala mangi agatutwala eri obulamu obusingako obulungi, kwe kuwaayo eri Katonda ssaddaaka esinga obulungi okusinga ebigambo byonna eby’essaala entukuvu era ez’omu ggulu.

Okuba abeetoowaze mu bikolwa byaffe byonna, okwewala buli ngeri ya malala n’obutaliimu, okuba abawombeefu era abeetoowaze mu bigambo byaffe, ebikolwa, eby’okwambala, enneeyisa, n’ebigendererwa, nga tugoberera Omulokozi waffe omutendereze, kwe kusinza Katonda mu ngeri esinga obugulumivu okusinga abo abalina ebiseera byokka eby’okufukamira wansi mu kwewaayo. Oyo amatira n’ebyetaago, alyoke awe ebisigadde abo ababyetaaga; atayaŋŋanga kusaasaanya nsimbi zonna mu busirusiru, kubanga azitwala nga ttalanta okuva eri Katonda erina okukozesebwa nga Ye bw’ayagala, atendereza Katonda n’ekintu ekisinga ekitiibwa okusinga ennyimba ez’ettendo.

Oyo alina ebiseera ebyateekebwawo eby’okukozesa essaala ez’amagezi era ez’okutya Katonda, akola ekyokulabirako ekisaanidde eky’okwewaayo; naye oyo ateekkiriza biseera, wadde ebifo, wadde ebikolwa, okuggyako ebyo ebituukagana ddala n’amagezi n’obutukuvu, asinza obutonde bwa Katonda n’okwewaayo okusinga okuba okw’amazima era okunywevu. Kubanga ani atamanyi, nti kisinga okuba omulongoofu era omutukuvu, okusinga okwogera ku bulongoofu n’obutukuvu? Weewaawo, ani atamanyi, nti omuntu talina kubalibwa nga mulongoofu, oba mutukuvu, oba mutuukirivu, okusukka nga bw’ali omulongoofu, era omutukuvu, era omutuukirivu mu bulamu bwe obwa bulijjo? Naye kino bwe kiba kyeyoleka, olwo era kyeyoleka, nti kisinga okuba omutukuvu, okusinga okuba n’essaala entukuvu.

N’olwekyo essaala ziri wala nnyo okuba okwewaayo okumala, ne kiba nti bye bitundu byakwo ebisinga obutono. Tulina okutendereza Katonda n’ebigambo n’essaala, kubanga ngeri esoboka ey’okugulumiza Katonda, eyatuwa obusobozi ng’obwo, obuyinza okukozesebwa bwe butyo. Naye kale ng’ebigambo bwe biri ebintu ebitono mu byo byokka, ng’ebiseera eby’okusaba bwe biri ebitono, bwe bigeraageranyizibwa n’obulamu bwaffe obusigadde; bwe kityo okwewaayo okuli mu biseera n’ebigambo by’okusaba kintu kitono nnyo, bwe kugeraageranyizibwa n’okwewaayo okwo okulina okulabikira mu buli kitundu ekirala n’embeera ey’obulamu bwaffe.

Era nate: nga bwe kiri ekyangu okusinza Katonda n’ebigambo ebyateekebwawo, n’okukuuma ebiseera eby’okubimuwa, bwe kityo kwe kutya Katonda okw’engeri esinga obutono. Ate ku ludda olulala, nga bwe kisinga obuzibu okusinza Katonda n’ebintu byaffe, okumuwa ekitiibwa n’okukozesa obulungi obudde bwaffe, okumuwa ssaddaaka etakoma ey’okwefiiriza n’okwefuga; nga bwe kyetaaga okutya Katonda okusingawo okulya n’okunywa olw’ebigendererwa byokka ebiyinza okugulumiza Katonda, obuteetikka mulimu gwonna, wadde okukkiriza okwesanyusa kwonna, okuggyako we tuyinza okukola mu Linnya lya Katonda; nga bwe kisinga obuzibu okuwaayo ssaddaaka emitima gyaffe gyonna emivundu, okutereeza okwegomba kwaffe kwonna, n’okufuula okutya Katonda etteeka n’ekipimo ky’ebikolwa byonna eby’obulamu bwaffe obwa bulijjo; bwe kityo okwewaayo okw’engeri eno buweereza obusiimibwa ennyo Katonda okusingawo, okusinga ebigambo ebyo eby’okwewaayo bye tumuwa oba mu Kkanisa oba mu kisenge kyaffe eky’ekyama.

Buli musomi ow’amagezi ajja kutegeera mangu nti sigenderera kukendeeza ku muwendo omutuufu era omunene ogw’essaala, oba za lwatu oba za kyama; wabula okumulaga bulazi nti mazima kitundu kitono nnyo eky’okwewaayo, bwe zigeraageranyizibwa n’obulamu obwewaddeyo eri Katonda.

Okulaba kino mu kitangaala ekisingawo okutangaala, ka tulowooze nti omuntu alina ebiseera ebyateekebwawo eby’okutendereza Katonda ne zabbuli n’ennyimba, era nga mukakali mu kubikuuma; ka tulowooze era, nti mu bulamu bwe obwa bulijjo talina mirembe era teyeesiima, ajjudde okwemulugunya n’okwekubira enduulu ku buli kintu, tasanyuka okuggyako nga bwe kigwa, ng’omutima gwe bwe gumutwala, wabula nga yeemulugunya era nga yeerasaasa ne ku biseera by’omwaka byennyini, era ng’alina ekintu ky’atayagala mu buli kimutuukako.

Kale, oyinza okulowooza ku kintu kyonna ekisinga obusirusiru n’obutaba na magezi okusinga empisa ng’eno? Omuntu ng’oyo alina kubalibwa ng’eyeebaza Katonda, kubanga alina ebigambo by’ettendo by’amuwa? Weewaawo, tekikakafu nti ebigambo by’ettendo ng’ebyo biteekwa okuba ewala nnyo okuba okwewaayo okusiimibwa Katonda, ne kiba nti biteekwa okukyayibwa ng’eky’omuzizo? Kale obusirusiru bw’olaba mu kyokulabirako kino, bwe bumu mu kitundu ekirala kyonna eky’obulamu bwaffe; obulamu bwaffe obwa bulijjo bwe buba nga bukontana n’essaala zaffe, gwe muzizo gwe gumu ng’ennyimba ez’okwebaza mu kamwa k’abeemulugunya.

Amaviivi agafukamidde, ng’oyambadde amalala; okwegayirira okw’omu ggulu, ng’otereka eby’obugagga ku nsi; okwewaayo okutukuvu, ng’obeera mu busirusiru bw’ensi; essaala ez’obuwombeefu n’okusaasira, ng’omutima gwo gwe gutuula amalala n’obusungu; essaawa ez’okusaba, ng’owaayo ennaku n’emyaka eri okwesanyusa okw’obwereere, okukyala okutaliimu nsa, n’amasanyu ag’obusirusiru; buweereza bwa busirusiru era obutasiimibwa Katonda, ng’ebigambo by’okwebaza okuva eri omuntu abeera mu kwerasaasa n’obutamatira.

N’olwekyo, okuggyako ng’engeri y’obulamu bwaffe eya bulijjo etuukagana n’omwoyo ogwa bulijjo ogw’essaala zaffe, essaala zaffe ziri wala nnyo okuba eddaala ery’amazima oba erimala ery’okwewaayo, ne kiba nti zifuuka omulimu gw’emimwa ogutaliimu, oba, ekisingawo obubi, obunnanfuusi obweyoleka.

N’olwekyo, nga bwe tulina okufuula omwoyo n’omutima gw’essaala zaffe okuba omwoyo n’omutima ogwa bulijjo ogw’obulamu bwaffe, kino kiyinza okutukakasa nti amadaala gonna ag’abantu galina okufuba n’okuyaayaanira okutuukirira okwe kumu okusingirayo ddala okw’obulamu obw’Ekikristaayo. Kubanga ng’Abakristaayo bonna bwe balina okukozesa okwewaayo okutukuvu era okw’omu ggulu okwe kumu, nga bonna bwe balina okusaba n’obunyiikivu bwe bumu olw’Omwoyo wa Katonda, bwe kityo bukakafu obumala nti amadaala gonna ag’abantu galina, nga bwe gasobola okukoma, okufuula obulamu bwago okutuukagana n’Omwoyo oyo omu, gwe bonna balina okusaba.

N’olwekyo, nga bwe kiri ekikakafu nti obutukuvu bwe bumu obw’essaala bwetaaga obutukuvu bwe bumu obw’obulamu, bwe kityo bwe kiri ekikakafu, nti Abakristaayo bonna bayitibwa eri obutukuvu bwe bumu obw’obulamu.

Omujaasi, oba omusuubuzi, tayitibwa kuweereza ku kyoto, oba kubuulira Njiri; naye buli mujaasi oba musuubuzi ateekwa okuba eyeewaddeyo eri Katonda, omwetoowaze, omutukuvu, era ow’ebirowoozo eby’omu ggulu, mu bitundu byonna eby’obulamu bwe obwa bulijjo, nga omukulembeze w’eddiini bw’ateekwa okuba omunyiikivu, omwesigwa, era omukozi ennyo, mu bitundu byonna eby’omulimu gwe.

Era bino byonna olw’ensonga eno emu eyeeyoleka, kubanga abantu bonna balina okusaba olw’obutukuvu bwe bumu, amagezi, n’emitima egy’obwakatonda, n’okwefuula abasaanira nga bwe basobola Eggulu lye limu.

N’olwekyo abantu bonna, nga bantu, balina omulimu gumu era gwe gumu omukulu, okukola ng’obulungi bw’obutonde bwabwe obw’amagezi bwe bwetaaga, n’okufuula amagezi n’entegeka etteeka ly’ebigendererwa byabwe byonna n’ebikolwa. Abakristaayo bonna, nga Bakristaayo, balina okuyitibwa kumu era kwe kumu, okubeera abalamu ng’obulungi bw’omwoyo gw’Ekikristaayo bwe buli, n’okufuula ebiragiro eby’awaggulu eby’Enjiri etteeka n’ekipimo ky’emitima gyabwe gyonna mu bulamu obwa bulijjo. Ekintu ekimu ekyetaagibwa eri omu, kye kintu ekimu ekyetaagibwa eri bonna.

Omusuubuzi takyalina kutereka by’obugagga ku nsi; omujaasi takyalina kulwanira kitiibwa; omuyivu omukulu takyalina kwenyumiriza mu buziba bw’amagezi; wabula bonna bateekwa n’omwoyo gumu "okubala byonna ng’okufiirwa, olw’obulungi bw’okutegeera Kristo Yesu." [Abafiripi 3:8]

Nnyabo ow’ekitiibwa ateekwa okuyigiriza amaaso ge okukaaba, n’okwambala obwetoowaze. Omwami ow’empisa ennungi ateekwa okuwaanyisa ebirowoozo ebisanyufu eby’amagezi amangi n’okwegomba, olw’omutima ogumenyese era oguboneredde. Omuntu ow’ekitiibwa ateekwa okulekayo ekitiibwa ky’obuzaale bwe, okutuuka n’okwetwala ng’ow’ennaku okutuusa lw’alizaalibwa omulundi ogwokubiri. Abaweereza bateekwa okutwala obuweereza bwabwe ng’obukoleddwa Katonda. Bakama bateekwa okutwala abaweereza baabwe nga baganda baabwe mu Kristo, abalina okuyisibwa ng’ebitundu bannaabwe eby’omubiri gwa Kristo ogw’ekyama.

Abawala abato bateekwa oba okwewaayo eri okutya Katonda, okusaba, okwefiiriza, n’emirimu gyonna emirungi, mu mbeera y’obulamu obw’obuwala obutali bufumbo; oba okufumbirwa, babeere abatukuvu, abeefuga, era ab’amagezi mu kulabirira amaka, nga bakuza abaana baabwe mu kutya Katonda, obwetoowaze, n’okwewaayo, era nga bayitirira mu mirimu gyonna emirala emirungi, nga embeera yaabwe n’obusobozi bwabwe bwe bikoma. Tebalina kulonda kintu kirala, wabula bateekwa okwewaayo eri Katonda mu emu ku mbeera zino. Bayinza okulonda obulamu obw’obufumbo, oba obutali bufumbo; naye tekirekeddwa ku kulonda kwabwe, oba balifuula embeera emu oba endala okuba embeera ey’obutukuvu, obwetoowaze, okwewaayo, n’emirimu emirala gyonna egy’obulamu obw’Ekikristaayo. Tekirekeddwa mu buyinza bwabwe, kubanga balina obugagga, oba baazaalibwa bazadde bagagga, okwegabanya wakati wa Katonda n’ensi, oba okwetwalira amasanyu ng’ago obugagga bwabwe bwe busobola okubawa, okusinga bwe kikkirizibwa gye bali okuba abalongoofu era abeegendereza ebiseera ebimu, n’ebiseera ebirala obutaba bwe batyo.

Tebalina kulowooza nti eddiini eyinza kubakuumira mpisa nnungi zenkana wa mu maaso g’abantu, oba engeri gye bayinza okugattako okwewaayo ku bulamu obutaliimu nsa, obutaliimu, era obw’obulalu; wabula bateekwa okutunuulira mu mwoyo n’omutima gw’essaala zaabwe, mu butonde n’ekigendererwa ky’Obukristaayo; olwo bajja kusanga nti, ka babe bafumbo oba si bafumbo, balina omulimu gumu gwokka mu mikono gyabwe; okuba ab’amagezi, n’abatya Katonda, n’abatukuvu, si mu ngeri ntono n’ebigambo by’okusinza, wabula mu ndowooza yonna ey’ebirowoozo byabwe, mu ngeri yonna ey’enneeyisa yaabwe yonna, ne mu ngeri ya buli lunaku ey’obulamu obwa bulijjo.

Abavubuka ab’ekitiibwa bateekwa okulowooza ku ekyo Omulokozi waffe omutendereze kye yagamba omuvubuka ow’ekitiibwa mu Njiri; yamugamba okutunda byonna bye yalina, n’okubiwa abaavu. Kale wadde ekigambo kino tekiwaliriza bantu bonna kutunda byonna, naye mazima kiwaliriza abantu aba buli ngeri okukozesa obugagga bwabwe bwonna mu ngeri ez’amagezi, ez’ensonga, era ez’okusaasira, eziyinza okulaga ekimala nti byonna bye balina biwongeddwa eri Katonda, era nti tewali kitundu kyabyo kiziyizibwa baavu okusaasaanyizibwa mu nsaasaanya eteetaagisa, etaliimu, era ey’obusirusiru.

N’olwekyo, abavubuka ab’ekitiibwa bwe beeteerawo obulamu obw’amasanyu n’okwekkusa, bwe basaasaanya obugagga bwabwe mu bulamu obw’ebinyumu, mu kwejalabya n’obutefuga, mu kitiibwa n’amagaali, mu masanyu n’okwesanyusa, mu mizannyo n’okukuba zaala, n’ebimatiza ebirala eby’obukaba eby’okwegomba kwabwe okw’obusirusiru, balina ensonga y’emu okwetwala nga Bamalayika, nga bwe balina okwetwala ng’abayigirizwa ba Kristo.

Bakakase nti gwe mulimu gumu gwokka ogw’omwami ow’ekitiibwa Omukristaayo, okweyawula olw’emirimu emirungi, okwatiikirira mu mpisa ennungi ezisinga obugulumivu ez’Enjiri, okugumiikiriza obutamanya n’obunafu bwa bannabulijjo, okuba mukwano era omuyambi eri bonna ababeera okumwetooloola, okubeera ku ntikko ezisingirayo ddala ez’amagezi n’obutukuvu, n’okulaga mu bulamu bwe bwonna obukulu bw’ebirowoozo obw’amazima obw’eddiini. Bateekwa okuyaayaanira ekitiibwa ng’ekyo, kye bandiyize nga balaba Yesu omutendereze, era obutalaga mwoyo mulala gwa mwami wa kitiibwa, okuggyako ogwo gwe bandifunye nga babeera n’Abatume abatukuvu. Bateekwa okuyiga okwagala Katonda n’omutima gwabwe gwonna, n’emmeeme yaabwe yonna, n’amaanyi gaabwe gonna, ne muliraanwa waabwe nga bwe beeyagala; olwo baba n’obukulu bwonna n’okweyawula kwonna kwe bayinza okuba nakwo wano, era basaanira essanyu eritaggwaawo mu Ggulu oluvannyuma.

Bwe kityo mu madaala gonna n’embeera zonna, oba ez’abasajja oba ez’abakazi, buno bwe butukuvu obumu obwa bulijjo, obulina okuba obulamu obwa bulijjo obw’Abakristaayo bonna.

Omusuubuzi talina kulekera mukulembeze wa ddiini kwewaayo, wadde omukulembeze w’eddiini okulekera omupakasi obwetoowaze; abakazi ab’obugagga tebalina kulekera bakazi baavu bannaabwe kuba ba magezi, abalongoofu, abakola emirimu mu maka, okwewunda n’engoye ezisaanidde, n’okwegendereza, n’okwefuga; wadde abakazi abaavu okulekera abagagga okugenda mu kusinza n’okuweereza Katonda. Abantu abakulu bateekwa okwatiikirira olw’obwavu obw’amazima mu mwoyo; n’abantu ab’embeera eya wansi era ey’ennaku bateekwa okusanyuka ennyo mu Katonda.

Omuntu ow’amaanyi n’obuyinza alina okusonyiwa n’okusabira abalabe be, n’omuntu atalina musango abonaabona, asibiddwa mu njegere mu kkomera, ateekwa, nga Pawulo ne Siira, mu ttumbi okuyimba ennyimba ez’okutendereza Katonda. Kubanga Katonda alina okugulumizibwa, obutukuvu bulina okukolebwa, n’omwoyo gw’eddiini gulina okuba omwoyo ogwa bulijjo ogwa buli Mukristaayo, mu buli mbeera n’embeera ey’obulamu.

Kubanga Omwana wa Katonda teyava waggulu okugattako engeri ey’okungulu ey’okusinza ku ngeri ez’enjawulo ez’obulamu eziri mu nsi, n’alyoka aleka abantu okubeera nga bwe baali emabega, mu mitima n’ebisanyusa ng’ebyo emisono n’omwoyo gw’ensi bye bikkiriza; wabula nga bwe yakka okuva mu Ggulu nga wa bwakatonda ddala era ow’omu ggulu mu butonde Bwe, bwe kityo kyali kuyita bantu eri obulamu obw’obwakatonda era obw’omu ggulu; eri enkyukakyuka esinga obugulumivu ey’obutonde bwabwe n’emitima gyabwe; okuzaalibwa omulundi ogwokubiri olw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu; okutambulira mu magezi n’ekitangaala n’okwagala kwa Katonda, n’okumufaanana nga bwe basobola okukoma; okulekayo amakubo gonna ag’ensi agasinga okulabika obulungi, oba ag’obukulu, emirimu, oba amasanyu; eri okutta okwegomba kwabwe kwonna okusinga okubanyumira; n’okubeera mu magezi, n’obulongoofu, n’obutukuvu ng’ebyo, ebiyinza okubafuula abasaanira okuba ab’ekitiibwa mu kwesiima mu Katonda emirembe gyonna.
