N’olwekyo, buli kintu eky’obusirusiru, eky’ekisesa, ekitaliimu, oba eky’oku nsi, oba eky’obuluvu, mu bulamu bw’Omukristaayo, kye kintu ekitasaanidde kubaawo; libala era bucaafu obulina okunaazibwawo n’amaziga ag’okwenenya. Naye ekintu kyonna eky’engeri eno bwe kiyita mu bulamu bwaffe bwonna, bwe tweekkiriza mu bintu ebitaliimu, eby’obusirusiru, oba eby’obuluvu, tulekayo okwatula kwaffe.

Kubanga nga bwe kiri ekikakafu nti Yesu Kristo yali magezi n’obutukuvu, nga bwe kiri ekikakafu nti yajja okutufuula okumufaanana, n’okubatizibwa mu Mwoyo We, bwe kityo bwe kiri ekikakafu, nti tewali ayinza kugambibwa nti akuuma okwatula kwe okw’Ekikristaayo, okuggyako abo, nga bwe basobola okukoma, ababeera mu bulamu obw’amagezi era obutukuvu era obw’omu ggulu. Kino, era kino kyokka, bwe Bukristaayo; obutukuvu mu buli kitundu ky’obulamu, amagezi ag’omu ggulu mu bikolwa byaffe byonna, nga tetugoberera mwoyo na mutima gw’ensi, wabula nga tufuula ebisanyusa byonna eby’ensi engeri ez’okutya Katonda n’okwewaayo eri Katonda.

Naye kaakano, embeera eno ey’omutima ogwewaddeyo eri Katonda bw’eba, empisa zino ez’obutukuvu obw’omunda bwe ziba, eddiini ey’amazima, olwo eddiini ey’amazima buvunaanyizibwa era ssanyu mu ngeri y’emu eri amadaala gonna ag’abantu; kubanga tewali kigiwolereza eri omu, ekitali kiwolereza kye kimu eri embeera zonna ez’abantu.

Bwe kiba nga ssanyu era kitiibwa eri omulabirizi okubeera mu mwoyo guno ogwewaddeyo eri Katonda, ng’ajjudde emitima gino emitukuvu, ng’akola buli kintu ng’akikolera Katonda, kitiibwa era ssanyu mu ngeri y’emu eri abasajja n’abakazi bonna, ka babe bavubuka oba bakadde, okubeera mu mwoyo gwe gumu. Era buli asobola okuzuula ensonga zonna lwaki omulabirizi ow’edda yandyemalidde ku bintu bya Katonda, ng’afuula obulamu bwe bwonna okukola okusingirayo ddala okw’okutya Katonda, amagezi, n’okwewaayo, ajja kuzisanga nga nsonga nnyingi lwaki naye, nga bw’asobola okukoma, asaanidde okukola bw’atyo.

Bw’ogamba nti omulabirizi ateekwa okuba ekyokulabirako ekyatiikirira eky’obutukuvu obw’Ekikristaayo, olw’okuyitibwa kwe okw’awaggulu era okutukuvu, ogamba bulungi. Naye bw’ogamba nti kimugasa nnyo okuba ekyokulabirako okusinga bwe kikugasa, okyamye nnyo: kubanga tewali kifuula madaala agasingirayo ddala ag’obutukuvu okwegombebwa omulabirizi, ekitagafuula okwegombebwa mu ngeri y’emu buli muvubuka wa buli maka.

Kubanga okutya Katonda okw’awaggulu, okwewaayo okungi, n’okukozesa buli kintu mu ngeri ey’eddiini, kitiibwa era ssanyu ery’embeera emu ey’obulamu, nga bwe kiri ery’endala.

Lowooza bulowooza mu birowoozo byo omwoyo gw’okutya Katonda gw’owandyagadde omulabirizi asinga obulungi mu nsi abe nagwo, nga bw’owandyagadde ayagale Katonda, nga bw’owandyagadde agoberere obulamu bw’Omulokozi waffe n’Abatume Be, nga bw’owandyagadde abeere waggulu w’ensi, ng’ayakaayakana mu by’okulabirako byonna eby’obulamu obw’omu ggulu, olwo oba ozudde omwoyo ogwo gw’osaanidde okufuula omwoyo gw’obulamu bwo ggwe kennyini.

Nsaba buli musomi asigale akaseera ku kufumiitiriza kuno, era oboolyawo ajja kufunamu okukakasibwa okusinga bw’alowooza. Buli muntu ayinza okugamba nga bw’ayagala abantu abamu okuba abalungi era abatya Katonda; buli muntu amanyi nga bwe kiri ekya magezi era eky’ensonga omulabirizi okuba waggulu ddala w’ensi, n’okuba ekyokulabirako ekyatiikirira eky’okutuukirira okw’Ekikristaayo; amangu ddala nga olowoozezza ku mulabirizi ow’amagezi era ow’edda, olowooza ku ddaala erimu ery’awaggulu ery’okutya Katonda, ekyokulabirako ekiramu eky’emitima gyonna emitukuvu gy’osanga nga ginnyonnyoddwa mu Njiri.

Kale, bwe weebuuza nti, Kintu ki ekisinga essanyu omukulembeze w’eddiini omuvubuka ky’ayinza okukola? Ojja kuwalirizibwa okuddamu, nti tewali kiyinza kumuleetera ssanyu n’ekitiibwa bwe kityo, nga okufaanana omulabirizi oyo omutukuvu ennyo.

Bw’oneeyongera n’obuuza nti, Kintu ki ekisinga essanyu omuvubuka yenna ow’ekitiibwa oba bannyina kye bayinza okukola? Okuddamu kuteekwa okuba kwe kumu; nti tewali kiyinza kubaleetera ssanyu oba kitiibwa bwe kityo nga okubeera mu mpisa ng’ezo ez’okutya Katonda, mu kukola ng’okwo obulamu obw’obwakatonda, nga omulabirizi ono omulungi omukadde bw’akola. Kubanga buli kintu ekinene era eky’ekitiibwa mu ddiini, kye kitiibwa eky’amazima ekya buli musajja oba mukazi, nga bwe kiri ekitiibwa ky’omulabirizi yenna. Bwe kiba nga amadaala ag’awaggulu ag’okwagala Katonda, okusaasira okubuubuuka, obulongoofu obutaliiko bbala, okwagala eby’omu ggulu, okwefuga okutakoma, okwewaayo okw’emirundi emingi, ye ngeri y’obulamu esinga obulungi n’essanyu eri Omukristaayo yenna, bwe kiri bwe kityo eri buli Mukristaayo.

Lowooza nate: singa wandirabye omulabirizi mu bulamu bwe bwonna ng’abeera wansi w’empisa ze, ng’agoberera emitima gyonna egy’obusirusiru egy’ensi, era ng’afugibwa ebimweraliikiriza n’ebimutiisa bye bimu ebifuga abantu abataliimu era ab’ensi, wandimulowoozezza otya? Wandirowoozezza nti alina omusango gw’ensobi ntono yokka? Nedda, wandimuvumiridde ng’akyamye mu ekyo ekitali kisinga bukulu kyokka, wabula ensonga yokka enkulu emukwatako. Sigala akaseera mu kufumiitiriza kuno, okutuusa ebirowoozo byo lwe binaakakasa ddala nga bwe kiri ensobi ey’ennaku omulabirizi okubeera mu bulamu obutafaayo era obw’ensi.

Ng’okyalowooza mu ngeri eno, kyusa ebirowoozo byo eri abamu ku b’omanyi, muganda wo oba mwannyoko, oba omuvubuka yenna. Kale, bw’olaba nti engeri y’obulamu bwabwe eya bulijjo tetuukagana na njigiriza za Njiri, bw’olaba nti engeri yaabwe ey’obulamu teyinza kugambibwa nti kwe kufuba okw’amazima okuyingira mu mulyango omufunda, olaba ekintu ky’olina okuvumirira, mu ddaala lye limu, era olw’ensonga ze zimu. Tebakola nsobi ntono, wabula bakyamye mu ekyo kye kyabwe kyonna, era bakyamye ku ssanyu lyabwe ery’amazima, nga omulabirizi oyo bw’akyama, alagajjalira emirimu egy’awaggulu egy’okuyitibwa kwe. Kozesa okulowooza kuno ku ggwe kennyini; bwe weesanga ng’obeera mu bulamu obw’obugayaavu, obw’okwekkusa, obutaliimu, ng’olonda okusinga okumatiza okwegomba kwo okusinga okubeera ng’enjigiriza z’Obukristaayo bwe ziri, n’okukola ebiragiro ebyeyoleka ebya Mukama waffe omutendereze, olina obuzibe bwonna obwo n’obutaba na magezi okweteekako, bw’oyinza okuteeka ku mulabirizi yenna atali mutereevu.

Kubanga empisa zonna ennungi ez’obulamu obw’Ekikristaayo, obulongoofu bwabwo obutuukiridde, emitima gyabwo egy’omu ggulu, lye tteeka lyokka ery’obulamu bwo, nga bwe liri etteeka lyokka ery’obulamu bw’omulabirizi. Bw’olagajjalira emitima gino emitukuvu, bw’otogiyaayaanira n’obunyiikivu, bw’oteweeraga ng’ekyokulabirako ekirabika ekya gyo, oba ogudde okuva ku ssanyu lyo ery’amazima, oba mulabe munene eri ggwe kennyini era olonze bubi, nga omulabirizi oyo, alonda okusinga okugaggawaza amaka ge okusinga okufaanana Omutume. Kubanga tewali nsonga lwaki osaanidde okulowooza nti obutukuvu obusingirayo ddala, emitima egisinga okuba egy’omu ggulu, bwe buvunaanyizibwa n’essanyu ly’omulabirizi, etali nsonga nnungi y’emu lwaki osaanidde okulowooza nti emitima gye gimu bwe buvunaanyizibwa n’essanyu ly’Abakristaayo bonna. Era nga omulabirizi asinga amagezi mu nsi bw’ali oyo abeera ku ntikko ezisingirayo ddala ez’obutukuvu, asinga okuba ekyokulabirako mu kukola kwonna okw’obulamu obw’obwakatonda, bwe kityo omuvubuka asinga amagezi, omukazi asinga amagezi, ka abe mufumbo oba si mufumbo, ye oyo abeera mu madaala agasingirayo ddala ag’obutukuvu obw’Ekikristaayo, ne mu kukola kwonna okw’obulamu obw’obwakatonda era obw’omu ggulu.

fields.title: Okulaga okwewaayo okunene eri Katonda bwe kujjuza obulamu bwaffe emirembe n’essanyu ebisinga ebiyinza okufunibwa mu nsi muno
fields.body_html:
ABANTU ABAMU oboolyawo bajja kuwakanya, nti amateeka gano gonna ag’okubeera mu butukuvu eri Katonda mu byonna bye tukola, gaziyiza nnyo obulamu bw’omuntu; nti bujja kufuulibwa embeera ey’okweraliikirira ennyo, olw’okuyingiza bwe tutyo okutunuulira Katonda mu bikolwa byaffe byonna; era nti olw’okwefiiriza amasanyu amangi bwe gatyo agalabika ng’agataliiko musango, tujja kufuula obulamu bwaffe obuzitowa, obutaliimu mirembe, era obw’ennaku.

Kino kiyinza okuddibwamu nti,

Ekisooka, Nti amateeka gano gaalagirwa, era mazima galireeta, ekigendererwa ekikontana ddala n’ekyo. Nti mu kifo ky’okufuula obulamu bwaffe obuzitowa era obw’ennaku, galibufuula obujjudde okumatira n’essanyu ery’amaanyi. Nti olw’amateeka gano, tuwaanyisa buwaanyisa essanyu ery’obwana ery’okwegomba kwaffe okutaliimu era okulwadde, olw’ebisanyusa ebinywevu n’essanyu ery’amazima ery’ebirowoozo ebiramu.

Eky’okubiri, Nti nga bwe watali musingi gwa kubudaabudibwa mu bisanyusa eby’obulamu buno, okuggyako mu kukakasa nti Katonda ow’amagezi era omulungi y’afuga ensi, bwe kityo gye tukoma okuzuula Katonda mu buli kintu, gye tukoma okumunoonya mu buli kifo, gye tukoma okumutunuulira waggulu mu bikolwa byaffe byonna, gye tukoma okugoberera okwagala Kwe, gye tukoma okukola ng’amagezi Ge bwe gali, n’okugoberera obulungi Bwe, n’okwesiima kwaffe mu Katonda gye kukoma okweyongera, okugabana ku butonde bwa Katonda, n’okugulumiza era n’okwongera byonna eby’essanyu era ebibudaabuda mu bulamu bw’omuntu.

Eky’okusatu, Oyo afuba okuwangula, n’okusiguukulula mu birowoozo bye, okwegomba okwo kwonna okw’amalala, obuggya, n’okwegomba obukulu, eddiini kw’ewakanya, akola bingi okwefuula ow’essanyu, ne mu bulamu buno, okusinga oyo ategeka engeri ez’okukwekkusaamu. Kubanga okwegomba kuno kwe kuleeta obutabanguko bwonna n’okunyiiga okw’obulamu bw’omuntu: bwe bulwadde bw’okuzimba n’omusujja ogw’ebirowoozo byaffe, nga bibitawaanya n’okwegomba okw’obulimba, n’okuyaayaana okutaliimu mirembe ku bintu bye tutetaaga, era nga byonoona okuwoomerwa kwaffe eri ebintu ebyo ebiri obulungi bwaffe obusaanidde.

Lowooza bulowooza nti walaba awamu oba awalala omuntu eyeeteerawo amagezi ng’etteeka ly’ebikolwa bye byonna; ataalina kwegomba okuggyako ku bintu ng’ebyo obutonde bye bwetaaga, era eddiini bye ekkiriza; eyali omulongoofu ku kweyongera kwonna okw’amalala, obuggya, n’omululu, nga bw’ali ku birowoozo by’okutta; nti, mu ddembe lino okuva mu kwegomba okw’ensi, yalina emmeeme ejjudde okwagala kwa Katonda, ng’ayagala era ng’asaba nti abantu bonna bafune bye beetaaga mu bintu eby’ensi, era bagabane ku kitiibwa ekitaggwaawo mu bulamu obugenda okujja. Lowooza bulowooza ku muntu abeera mu ngeri eno, era omwoyo gwo gwennyini gujja kukugamba amangu ddala, nti ye muntu asinga essanyu mu nsi, era nti tekiri mu buyinza bw’endowooza esinga obugagga okuyiiya essanyu lyonna erisingawo obugulumivu mu mbeera y’obulamu eya kaakano.

Ate ku ludda olulala, bw’olowooza nti tatuukiridde mu ddaala lyonna; bw’olowooza nti ali wansi bubeezi w’okwagala okumu okw’obusirusiru oba okwegomba okumu okutaliimu, omwoyo gwo gwennyini gujja kukugamba nate nti bw’atyo akendeeza ku ssanyu lye, era yeenyaga okwesiima okw’amazima mu mpisa ze endala ennungi. Bwe kiri eky’amazima bwe kityo, nti gye tukoma okubeera abalamu mu mateeka g’eddiini, gye tukoma okufuula obulamu bwaffe obw’emirembe era obw’essanyu.

Era nate; nga bwe kirabika bwe kityo nti essanyu ery’amazima liyinza kufunibwa bufunibwa okuva mu madaala agasingirayo ddala ag’okutya Katonda, okwefiiriza okusingirayo ddala okw’okwegomba kwaffe, n’amateeka g’eddiini agasinga obukakali; bwe kityo amazima ge gamu galirabika nga tulowooza ku nnaku y’omuntu. Bwe tunaatunuulira mu nsi, ne tulaba obutabanguko n’ebizibu by’obulamu bw’omuntu, tujja kusanga nti byonna biva ku kwegomba kwaffe okw’amaanyi era okutali kwa ddiini.

Kale ebizibu byonna n’obutaba na mirembe byesigamye ku kubulwa ekintu ekimu oba ekirala: n’olwekyo bwe twandyagadde okumanya ensonga ey’amazima ey’ebizibu byaffe n’obutabanguko, tuteekwa okuzuula ensonga y’ebyetaago byaffe; kubanga ekyo ekizaala era ekyongera ebyetaago byaffe, kizaala era kyongera, mu ddaala lye limu, ebizibu byaffe n’obutabanguko.

Katonda Omuyinza w’Ebintu Byonna yatusindika mu nsi nga tulina ebyetaago bitono nnyo; emmere, n’ekyokunywa, n’engoye, bye bintu byokka ebyetaagisa mu bulamu; era nga bino bwe biri ebyetaago byaffe ebya kaakano byokka, bwe kityo ensi eya kaakano erimu ebimala okutuukiriza ebyetaago bino.

Singa omuntu yalina ekitundu ky’ensi mu buyinza bwe, tayinza kukifunamu okusinga kino; nga bw’akyetaaga bwetaazi okuwanirira obulamu obw’omubiri, bwe kityo tekisobola kumukolera kirala kyonna, wadde okumuwa essanyu eddala lyonna.

Eno y’embeera y’omuntu, — eyazaalibwa ng’alina ebyetaago bitono, era mu nsi ennene esobola ennyo okubituukiriza. N’olwekyo omuntu yandirowoozezza mu magezi nti abantu bandimaze obulamu bwabwe mu kumatira n’okwebaza Katonda; waakiri, nti bandibadde ba ddembe okuva mu butabanguko obw’amaanyi n’okunyiiga, nga bwe bateekeddwa mu nsi erimu ebisukka ku bimala okuyamba ebyetaago byabwe byonna.

Naye bwe tugattako ku bino byonna, nti obulamu buno obumpi, obuweereddwa bwe butyo byonna bye twetaaga mu bwo, buba kuyita kumpi bwokka okugenda mu kitiibwa ekitaggwaawo, gye tulyambazibwa okumasamasa kwa Bamalayika, ne tuyingira mu ssanyu lya Katonda, twandisuubidde n’amagezi agasingawo nti obulamu bw’omuntu bwandibadde mbeera ya mirembe, n’essanyu, n’okusanyukira mu Katonda. Bwe kityo mazima bwe kyandibadde, singa amagezi gaalina obuyinza bwago bwonna ku ffe.

Naye, zisanze! wadde Katonda, n’obutonde, n’amagezi, bifuula obulamu bw’omuntu bwe butyo obutaliimu byetaago bingi era obujjudde essanyu bwe butyo; naye okwegomba kwaffe, mu kujeemera Katonda, obutonde n’amagezi, kutonda ensi empya ey’ebibi, ne kujjuza obulamu bw’omuntu ebyetaago eby’ekirooto, n’obutabanguko obutaliimu.

Omuntu ow’amalala alina ebyetaago lukumi, amalala ge gokka bye gaatonda; era bino bimufuula ajjudde ebizibu nga Katonda bwe yandibadde amutonze n’okwegomba lukumi, nga tatonze kintu kyonna ekisaanira okukumatiza. Obuggya n’okwegomba obukulu nabyo birina ebyetaago byabyo ebitakoma, ebitabula emmeeme z’abantu, era olw’okukontana kw’entambula zaabyo, bibafuula ab’ennaku mu ngeri ey’obusirusiru, nga abo abaagala okubuuka n’okuseyeeya mu kiseera kye kimu.

Omuntu yenna eyeemulugunya, atalina mirembe, k’akugambe bugambi ensibuko y’obutaba na mirembe bwe, era ojja kulaba mu lwatu nti ye nsibuko y’okubonaabona kwe; nti yeetawaanya olw’ekibi ekimu eky’ekirooto, ekirirekera awo okumubonyaabonya amangu ddala nga amatidde okuba ekyo Katonda, n’obutonde, n’amagezi bye bimwetaagako okuba.

Singa wandirabye omuntu ng’amalira ennaku ze mu butabanguko, kubanga teyasobola kutambulira ku mazzi, oba okukwata ebinyonyi nga bimuyitako nga bibuuka, wandikkirizza mangu nti omuntu ng’oyo yandyeyebazizza yekka olw’obutaba na mirembe ng’obwo. Naye kaakano bw’otunuulira obutabanguko bwonna obusinga okubonyaabonya mu bulamu, ojja kubusanga bwonna nga bwa busirusiru bwe butyo: abantu we babonyaabonyezebwa obusirusiru bwabwe bwokka, era nga beetawaanya olw’ebintu ng’ebyo ebitabakwatako, era ebitali bulungi bwabwe obusaanidde, okusinga okutambulira ku mazzi, oba okukwata ebinyonyi.

Kiki ky’oyinza okulowooza ekisinga obusirusiru n’okusukkiriza, okusinga okulowooza ku muntu ng’akaluubiriza obwongo bwe, era ng’ayiga emisana n’ekiro engeri y’okubuuka? — ng’ava mu nnyumba ye n’awaka we, ng’akoowa olw’okulinnya buli kifo ekiwanvu, ng’akuba amavi era ng’asaba buli gw’asanga amusitule okuva ku ttaka, nga yeenuubula olw’okugwa okutakoma, era ku nkomerero ng’amenya ensingo ye? — era bino byonna olw’endowooza nti kyandibadde kya kitiibwa amaaso g’abantu okumutunuulira waggulu, era kya ssanyu lingi okulya, n’okunywa, n’okwebaka, ku ntikko z’emiti egisinga obuwanvu mu bwakabaka: towandikkirizza mangu nti omuntu ng’oyo yali atabulwa busirusiru bwe bwokka?

Bw’obuuza, makulu ki agali mu kulowooza ku bitonde eby’obusirusiru ng’ebyo, ebitasangibwa wonna mu bulamu bw’abantu?

Kiyinza okuddibwamu, nti buli w’olaba omuntu eyeegomba obukulu, eyo w’olabira omubuusi ono ataliimu era atalina magezi.

Era nate: singa wandirabye omuntu eyalina ekidiba ekinene eky’amazzi, naye ng’abeera mu nnyonta etakoma, nga teyekkiriza kunywa wadde ekitundu ky’ekikopo, olw’okutya okukendeeza ku kidiba kye; singa wandimulabye ng’amalawo obudde bwe n’amaanyi ge, mu kuleeta amazzi amalala mu kidiba kye; bulijjo ng’alumwa ennyonta, naye bulijjo ng’akutte ekidomola ky’amazzi mu ngalo ze, ng’atunula mu makya ne mu kiro okukwata amatondo g’enkuba, ng’ayasamira buli kire, era ng’adduka n’omululu mu buli bitosi n’ettosi, ng’asuubira amazzi, era bulijjo ng’ayiga engeri y’okufuula buli mufulejje okwefukira mu kidiba kye: singa wandimulabye ng’amera envi era ng’akaddiwa mu mirimu gino egy’okweraliikirira, era ku nkomerero ng’amaliriza obulamu obw’okweraliikirira, obw’ennyonta, ng’agwa mu kidiba kye; towandigambye nti omuntu ng’oyo teyali nsibuko ya butabanguko bwe bwonna kyokka, wabula yali musirusiru ekimala okubalibwa mu basiru n’abalalu? Naye ne bwe kiri ekisirusiru era eky’obusirusiru bwe kityo, empisa eno teraga wadde ekitundu ky’obusirusiru, n’obutabanguko obw’obusirusiru, obw’omuntu ow’omululu.

Kaakano nnandisobodde mangu okweyongera okulaga ebiva mu kwegomba kwaffe okulala kwonna bye bimu, n’okulaga mu lwatu nti ennaku zaffe zonna, okunyiiga, n’okwemulugunya, byonna tubyekolera ffekka, era nti, mu ngeri y’emu ey’obusirusiru, nga mu by’okulabirako bino eby’omuntu ow’omululu n’eyeegomba obukulu. Tunula w’oyagala, ojja kulaba okunyiiga kwonna okw’ensi, nga kufaanana bufaananyi okunyiiga kw’oyo eyali bulijjo mu bitosi n’ettosi ng’anoonya amazzi ag’okunywa, so nga yalina awaka agasukka ku gamala embalaasi kikumi.

Celia bulijjo akubuulira nga bw’asunguwazibwa, ebintu ebitagumiikirizika, eby’entiisa ebimutuukako, enneeyisa ey’ekyewuunyo gy’ayisibwamu, n’okunyiiga kw’asanga buli wamu. Akugamba nti obugumiikiriza bwe buweddewo ddala, era tewali kugumiikiriza nneeyisa y’abantu. Buli lukuŋŋaana gy’abeera, lumuzza awaka ng’asunguwadde; ekintu ekimu oba ekirala kyogeddwa, oba kikoleddwa, omuntu yenna ow’amagezi era ow’empisa ennungi ky’atasaanidde kugumiikiriza. Abantu abaavu abeetaaga okusaasira kwe basindikibwa n’okuddibwamu okw’amangu, si lwa kuba nti talina mutima gwa kuwaayo nsimbi zonna, wabula kubanga ajjudde nnyo obuzibu obumu obubwe obutasobola kussaayo mwoyo ku kwemulugunya kw’abalala. Celia talina mulimu mu mikono gye okuggyako okufuna ensimbi eziva mu bugagga obungi; naye, olw’endowooza ye ey’ennaku, wandiyinzizza okulowooza nti talina mmere wadde we yeebaka. Bw’omulaba ng’asiiwuuse okusinga bulijjo, emimwa gye bwe gikankana ng’ayogera naawe, kubanga yaakava mu kukyala, Lupus gye yali tamufuddeeko n’akatono, wabula n’ayogera ekiseera kyonna ne Lucinda, atalina wadde ekitundu ky’obugagga bwe. Obubenje obunyiiza bwe bumala okutabula bw’atyo omwoyo gwe, ne kiba nti awalirizibwa okuyita omusawo, okumusobozesa okulya, amugamba n’obusungu bungi eri Katonda alabirira, nti teyabangako bulungi okuva lwe yazaalibwa, era nti akwatirwa obuggya buli musabiriza gw’alaba ng’ali mulamu bulungi.

Buno bwe bulamu obutaliimu mirembe obwa Celia, atalina kimubonyaabonya okuggyako omwoyo gwe yennyini.

Singa wali osobola okumussaamu obwetoowaze obw’Ekikristaayo, teweetaaga kukola kirala kyonna okumufuula ow’essanyu ng’omuntu yenna mu nsi. Empisa eno ennungi yandimufudde eyeebaza Katonda olw’ekitundu kyokka eky’obulamu obulungi bw’abadde nabwo, era n’emuyamba okwesiima mu bingi okusingawo mu biseera ebigenda okujja. Empisa eno ennungi yandigobye okukankana kw’omwoyo, n’okubulwa okwagala emmere, era omusaayi gwe tegwandyetaaze kirala kyonna kuguwoomya.

Nkutteko bukutteko ku mpisa zino ez’obusirusiru, olw’ekigendererwa kimu kyokka, okukukakasa, mu ngeri esinga okweyoleka, nti amateeka g’eddiini agasinga obukakali gali wala nnyo okufuula obulamu obuzitowa, obweraliikirivu, era obutaliimu kubudaabudibwa (nga bwe kyawakanyiziddwa waggulu), ne kiba nti, ku ludda olulala, ennaku zonna, okunyiiga, n’okwemulugunya, ebiri mu nsi, biva ku kubulwa eddiini; nga bireetebwa butereevu okwegomba okwo okw’obusirusiru eddiini kw’etuyigiriza okwegaana.

Kubanga ebyetaago byonna ebitabula obulamu bw’omuntu, ebituleetera obutaba na mirembe mu ffe, okuyomba n’abalala, n’obuteebaza Katonda; ebitukooya mu mirimu egitaliimu n’okweraliikirira okw’obusirusiru; ebitutwala okuva ku nteekateeka emu okudda ku ndala, okuva mu kifo ekimu okudda mu kirala, mu kunoonya okwavu kw’ekyo kye tutamanyi, bye byetaago Katonda, wadde obutonde, wadde amagezi bye bitaatuteeka wansi waabyo, wabula bitussibwamu bussibwa amalala, obuggya, okwegomba obukulu, n’omululu.

N’olwekyo, nga bw’okendeeza okwegomba kwo okutuuka ku bintu ng’ebyo obutonde n’amagezi bye byetaaga; nga bw’otereeza entambula zonna ez’omutima gwo n’amateeka amakakali ag’eddiini, bw’otyo bwe weeggya mu bwetaavu obutakoma n’okunyiiga okwo, okubonyaabonya buli mutima ogulekeddwa ku bwagwo.

Abantu abasinga obungi, mazima, bakkiriza nti eddiini etukuuma ku bibi bingi nnyo, era etuyamba mu ngeri nnyingi okwesiima okusingawo essanyu; naye kale balowooza nti kino kya mazima ku mugabo gwa ddiini ogw’ekigero gwokka, oguziyiza bubeezi mpola okusukkiriza kw’okwegomba kwaffe. Balowooza nti amateeka amakakali n’ebiziyiza eby’okutya Katonda okw’awaggulu bikontana nnyo n’obutonde bwaffe, ne kiba nti biteekwa okufuula obulamu bwaffe obuzitowa era obutaliimu kubudaabudibwa.

Wadde obunafu bw’okuwakanya kuno bulabika ekimala okuva mu ebyo ebimaze okwogerwa, naye nja kukwongerako ekigambo kimu.

Okuwakanya kuno kulowooza nti eddiini, ekolebwa mu kigero, eyongera nnyo ku ssanyu ly’obulamu; naye nti entikko ng’ezo ez’okutya Katonda nga okutuukirira kw’eddiini bwe kwetaaga, zireeta ekikontana nakyo.

N’olwekyo kulowooza nti kya ssanyu okukuumibwa ku kusukkiriza kw’obuggya, naye kya nnaku okukuumibwa ku madaala amalala ag’obuggya. Nti kya ssanyu okununulibwa mu kwegomba obukulu okutakoma, naye kya nnaku okubulwa okwegomba obukulu okw’ekigero. Kulowooza, era, nti essanyu ly’obulamu liri mu kutabula empisa ennungi n’ekibi, okutabula okwegomba obukulu n’obwetoowaze, okusaasira n’obuggya, okwagala eby’omu ggulu n’omululu. Ebyo byonna bya busirusiru nga okulowooza nti kya ssanyu okuba ow’eddembe okuva mu bulumi obusukkiridde, naye kya nnaku okubulwa obulumi obw’ekigero: oba nti essanyu ly’obulamu obulungi liri mu kuba omulwadde ekitundu era omulamu ekitundu.

Kubanga obwetoowaze bwe buba emirembe n’okuwummula kw’emmeeme, olwo tewali alina ssanyu lingi bwe lityo okuva mu bwetoowaze, nga oyo asinga okwetoowaza. Obuggya obusukkiridde bwe buba okubonyaabonya kw’emmeeme, oyo yeenunula mu ngeri esinga okutuukirira okuva mu kubonyaabonyezebwa, asinga okuzikiza mu ngeri etuukiridde buli kasasi k’obuggya. Bwe wabaawo emirembe n’essanyu lyonna mu kukola ekikolwa kyonna nga Katonda bw’ayagala, oyo aleeta ebikolwa bye ebisinga obungi wansi w’etteeka lino, y’asinga byonna okwongera emirembe n’essanyu ly’obulamu bwe.

Era bwe kiri bwe kityo mu buli mpisa ennungi; bw’ogikola okutuuka ku buli ddaala lyayo, n’essanyu ly’ofunamu gye likoma okweyongera. Era bwe kityo bwe kiri ku buli kibi; bw’okendeeza bukendeeza ku kusukkiriza kwakyo, weekolera bitono; naye bw’okigaana mu madaala gonna, olwo owulira emirembe egy’amazima n’essanyu ly’ebirowoozo ebyatereezebwa.

Ng’ekyokulabirako: Eddiini bw’eziyiza obuziyiza okusukkiriza kw’okwesasuza, naye n’ereka omwoyo ogwo nga gukyali mulamu munda mu ggwe mu bintu ebitono, eddiini yo eyinza okuba nga efudde obulamu bwo okulabika obulungi akatono ku ngulu, naye tekufudde ow’essanyu n’akatono, oba atalina buzibu munda mu ggwe. Naye bw’oba omaze okuwaayo ssaddaaka ebirowoozo byonna eby’okwesasuza, mu kugondera Katonda, era nga omaliridde okusasula ekirungi olw’ekibi mu biseera byonna, olyoke weefuule okufaanana ennyo Katonda, era okusaanira ennyo okusaasira Kwe mu bwakabaka obw’okwagala n’ekitiibwa; eno ntikko ya mpisa nnungi ejja kukuleetera okuwulira essanyu lyayo.

Eky’okubiri, Ku bikwata ku bimatiza n’ebisanyusa ebyo, okutya Katonda okw’awaggulu bye kutwetaagako okwefiiriza, kino tekitwaka kubudaabudibwa kwonna okw’amazima okw’obulamu.

Kubanga, ekisooka, Okutya Katonda tekutwetaagako kulekayo ngeri yonna ey’obulamu, mwe tuyinza okukolera mu magezi, n’okuwaayo bye tukola olw’ekitiibwa kya Katonda. Engeri zonna ez’obulamu, ebimatiza n’ebisanyusa byonna, ebiri munda mu nsalo zino, tebigaanibwa n’akatono amateeka g’okutya Katonda agasinga obukakali. Kyonna ky’oyinza okukola, oba okwesiimamu, nga oli mu maaso ga Katonda, ng’omuweereza We, ng’ekitonde Kye eky’amagezi ekyafuna amagezi n’okumanya okuva gy’ali; byonna by’oyinza okukola nga bituukagana n’obutonde obw’amagezi, n’okwagala kwa Katonda, byonna bino bikkirizibwa amateeka g’okutya Katonda. Era olirowooza nti obulamu bwo bujja kuba obutaliimu kubudaabudibwa okuggyako nga oyinza okunyiiza Katonda, okuba omusirusiru, n’omulalu, n’okukola ebikontana n’amagezi n’obugezi ebyo bye yasimba mu ggwe?

Era ku bikwata ku bimatiza ebyo bye tutayaŋŋanga kuwaayo eri Katonda omutukuvu, ebiyiiyizibwa busirusiru n’obuvundu bw’ensi bwokka, ebyokya okwegomba kwaffe, ne binnyika emmeeme zaffe mu bukaba n’obuluvu, ne bitufuula obutasobola kuganja mu maaso ga Katonda, oba wano oba oluvannyuma; mazima teyinza kuba mbeera ya bulamu etaliimu kubudaabudibwa okununulibwa eddiini okuva mu kwetta okw’engeri eyo, n’okufuulibwa abasobola essanyu eritaggwaawo.

Ka tulowooze ku muntu atalina kumanya okwo kwe tufuna okuva mu busimu bwaffe, ateekeddwa awamu yekka, wakati mu bintu eby’engeri nnyingi bye yali tamanyi kukozesa; nti alina okumpi naye emmere, wayini, amazzi, enfuufu ya zaabu, enjegere ez’ekyuma, omusenyu, engoye, omuliro, n’ebirala. Ka tulowooze nti talina kumanya kwonna ku nkozesa entuufu ey’ebintu bino, wadde obulagirizi bwonna okuva mu busimu bwe ku ngeri y’okumalawo ennyonta ye, oba okumatiza enjala ye, oba okukozesa ekintu kyonna ku ebyo ebimwetoolodde. Ka tulowooze, nti mu nnyonta ye ateeka enfuufu ya zaabu mu maaso ge; amaaso ge bwe gamwokya, ateeka wayini mu matu ge; nti mu njala ye, ateeka omusenyu mu kamwa ke; nti mu bulumi, yeetikka enjegere ez’ekyuma; nti bw’awulira obunnyogovu, ateeka ebigere bye mu mazzi; nti bw’atiisibwa omuliro, agudduka; nti bw’akoowa, emmere ye agifuula ekituulo. Ka tulowooze, nti olw’obutamanya bwe ku nkozesa entuufu ey’ebintu ebimwetoolodde, alyebonyaabonya mu butaliimu ng’akyali mulamu, era ku nkomerero n’afa, ng’aziba amaaso olw’enfuufu, ng’ayingiddwa omusenyu mu mumiro, era ng’azitoowereddwa ebyuma. Ka tulowooze nti ekitonde ekimu ekirungi kyajja gy’ali, ne kimulaga obutonde n’enkozesa y’ebintu byonna ebyali bimwetoolodde, ne kimuwa amateeka amakakali ag’okubikozesa ng’ago, agandimufudde mazima, bwe gandikuumiddwa, ow’essanyu okusingawo olw’ebyo byonna bye yalina, era agandimununudde mu bulumi bw’enjala, n’ennyonta, n’obunnyogovu.

Kale wandisobodde n’amagezi gonna okukakasa, nti amateeka ago amakakali ag’okukozesa ebintu ebyo ebyali bimwetoolodde, gaafuula obulamu bw’omuntu oyo omwavu obuzitowa era obutaliimu kubudaabudibwa?

Kale kino mu ngeri emu kye kifaananyi ky’amateeka amakakali ag’eddiini; gaggyawo bugyi obutamanya bwaffe, gatuwonya okwebonyaabonya, era gatuyigiriza okukozesa buli kintu ekitwetoolodde olw’okutugasa okusaanidde.

Omuntu ateekeddwa mu nsi ejjudde ebintu eby’engeri nnyingi; obutamanya bwe bumuleetera okukozesa bingi ku byo mu busirusiru nga omuntu eyateeka enfuufu mu maaso ge okumalawo ennyonta ye, oba eyeesiba enjegere okuggyawo obulumi.

N’olwekyo eddiini wano ejja okumuyamba, n’emuwa amateeka amakakali ag’okukozesa buli kintu ekimwetoolodde; alyoke, ng’abikozesa bwe atyo nga bituukagana n’obutonde bwe, n’obutonde bw’ebintu, abeere bulijjo n’essanyu ery’okufuna okuva mu byo omugaso omutuufu. Emulaga ekituufu ddala mu mmere, n’ekyokunywa, n’engoye; era nti talina kirala kya kusuubira okuva mu bintu by’ensi eno, okuggyako okumatiza ebyetaago bye ng’ebyo; olwo n’agaziya obuyambi bwe eri baganda be bonna, alyoke, nga bw’asobola, ayambe bannaabwe bonna okufuna okuva mu nsi omugaso gwe gumu gw’alina.

Emugamba nti ensi eno tesobola kumuwa ssanyu ddala lyonna; era nti okufuba kwonna okuba ow’essanyu mu bifunvu by’ensimbi, oba mu yiika z’ettaka, mu ngoye ennungi, ebitanda eby’omuwendo, amagaali ag’ekitiibwa, n’okweraga n’okumasamasa, kufuba bufuba okutaliimu, kugezaako okw’obutamanya okutuuka ku bitasoboka, kubanga ebintu bino tebisobola kuwa wadde eddaala erisinga obutono ery’essanyu, okusinga enfuufu mu maaso bw’eyinza okuwonya ennyonta, oba omusenyu mu kamwa okumatiza enjala; wabula, ng’enfuufu n’omusenyu ebikozeseddwa obubi, bijja kumufuula bufuuzi ow’ennaku okusingawo olw’okubikozesa obubi mu butamanya bwe butyo.

Emugamba nti wadde ensi eno teyinza kumukolera kisingawo ku kumatiza ebyetaago bino eby’omubiri, naye waliwo ekirungi ekisinga ennyo obunene ekyategekerwa omuntu okusinga okulya, okunywa, n’okwambala; nti kikyali kitalabika eri amaaso ge, kubanga kya kitiibwa nnyo okutegeerwa omubiri n’omusaayi; naye kimuterekeddwa okukiyingiramu, amangu ddala nga obulamu buno obumpi buwedde; gy’alibeera, mu mubiri omuggya ogwakolebwa mu kifaananyi ky’abamalayika, mu kitangaala n’ekitiibwa kya Katonda emirembe gyonna.

Emugamba nti embeera eno ey’ekitiibwa eriweebwa abo bonna abakozesa obulungi ebintu eby’ensi eno eya kaakano, abateeziba maaso na nfuufu ya zaabu, oba okulya omusenyu, oba okusinda wansi w’emigugu gy’ebyuma gye beetikkira bokka; wabula abakozesa emmere, amazzi, wayini, n’engoye, olw’ebigendererwa ebituukagana n’obutonde n’amagezi; era abo, n’okukkiriza n’okwebaza, abasinza Omugabi ow’ekisa ow’ebyo byonna bye beesiimamu wano, era bye basuubira oluvannyuma.

Kale waliwo ayinza okugamba nti amateeka agasinga obukakali ag’eddiini ng’eno gatuziyiza ekimu ku bibudaabuda eby’obulamu? Tekyandyogeddwa mu bwenkanya bwe bumu ku mateeka ago agaziyiza bugaziyiza omuntu okwesiba omumiro n’omusenyu? Kubanga obukakali bw’amateeka gano buli mu butuufu bwago obukakali bwokka.

Ani yandyemulugunyizza ku bukakali obw’amaanyi obw’etteeka, awatali kuggyako kwonna, eryagaana okuteeka enfuufu mu maaso gaffe? Ani yandirowoozezza nti likakanyavu nnyo, kubanga teryalina kukendeeza? Kale buno bwe bukakali bw’eddiini; tetwetaagako kintu kyonna mu bukakali, oba awatali kukendeeza, okuggyako we wali buli ddaala ly’ekintu nga kikyamu, we wali buli kwekkusa nga kutukolako akabi.

Eddiini bw’egaana ebikolwa byonna eby’okwesasuza, awatali kuggyako kwonna, kubanga okwesasuza kwonna kwa butonde bwa butwa; era wadde tetunywa ebimala okukomya obulamu, naye bwe tunywako n’akatono, bwonoona omusaayi gwonna, ne kifuula kizibu okuzzibwawo mu bulamu bwaffe obulungi obwasooka.

Eddiini bw’eragira okusaasira eri bonna, okwagala muliraanwa waffe nga bwe twagala ffekka, okusonyiwa n’okusabira abalabe baffe bonna awatali kwekuumira kwonna; kubanga amadaala gonna ag’okwagala madaala ga ssanyu, agagumya era agawanirira obulamu obw’obwakatonda obw’emmeeme, era geetaagisa olw’obulamu bwayo obulungi n’essanyu lyayo, ng’emmere esaanidde bw’eyetaagisa olw’obulamu obulungi n’essanyu ly’omubiri.

Eddiini bw’eba n’amateeka agawakanya okweterekera eby’obugagga ku nsi, era n’etulagira okumatira n’emmere n’engoye, kubanga buli nkozesa endala ey’ensi kwe kugikozesa obubi olw’okunyiiga kwaffe, n’okufuula ebyangu byayo byonna emitego n’obukodyo obw’okutuzikiriza. Kubanga obwangu buno n’obutalimu kwewunda mu bulamu bitukuuma ku bitweraliikiriza n’obulumi bw’amalala n’obuggya obutaliimu mirembe, era bifuula kyangu okukuuma ekkubo eryo eggolokofu eririttwala mu bulamu obutaggwaawo.

Eddiini bw’egamba nti, "Genda otunde ebibyo, ensimbi ozigabire abaavu," kubanga tewali nkozesa ndala ya butonde oba ya magezi ey’obugagga bwaffe, tewali ngeri ndala ey’okwefuula ab’essanyu okusingawo olw’abwo; kubanga kituufu ddala okuwa abalala ekyo kye tutetaaga ffekka, nga bwe kiri ekituufu okukozesa ekyenkana ebyetaago byaffe bye byetaaga. Kubanga omuntu bw’aba n’emmere esukka ku obutonde bwe bwe bwetaaga, nga kya buwansi era kitali kya magezi okuyiiya engeri ez’obusirusiru ez’okugyonoona, n’okugifuula ekinyumu eri olubuto lwe olujjudde, okusinga okuleka bannaabwe okufuna okubudaabudibwa kwe kumu okuva mu mmere kwe yafuna. N’olwekyo kiri wala nnyo okuba etteeka ekkakanyavu ery’eddiini, okukozesa bwe tutyo obugagga bwaffe, ne kiba nti omuntu ow’amagezi yandisanyukidde eddiini eyo emuyigiriza okuba ow’essanyu okusingawo mu ekyo ky’agaba, okusinga mu ekyo ky’ayekuumira; emuyigiriza okufuula emmere n’engoye ezisukkiridde okuba emikisa eminene gy’ali, okusinga ekyo ekiriisa era ekyambaza omubiri gwe ye.

Eddiini bw’etwetaagako ebiseera ebimu okusiiba, n’okwegaana okwegomba kwaffe okw’obutonde, kwe kukendeeza ku lutalo n’olutabaalo oluli mu butonde bwaffe, kwe kufuula emibiri gyaffe ebikozesebwa ebisaanira ennyo obulongoofu, era ebiwulira ennyo entambula ennungi ez’ekisa kya Katonda; kwe kukaza ensulo z’okwegomba kwaffe okulwanagana n’emmeeme, okuwoza ennimi z’omuliro ez’omusaayi gwaffe, n’okufuula ebirowoozo okusobola ennyo okufumiitiriza ku bya Katonda. N’olwekyo wadde okwewala kuno kuleeta obulumi obumu eri omubiri, naye kukendeeza nnyo ku buyinza bw’okwegomba okw’omubiri, era kwongera nnyo okuwoomerwa kwaffe essanyu ery’omwoyo, ne kiba nti n’obukakali buno obw’eddiini, bwe bukolebwa n’amagezi, bwongera nnyo ku kwesiima okubudaabuda mu bulamu bwaffe.

Eddiini bw’etuyita eri obulamu obw’okutunula n’okusaba kubanga tubeera wakati mu kibiina ky’abalabe, era bulijjo twetaaga obuyambi bwa Katonda. Bwe tuba nga tulina okwatula n’okukaabira ebibi byaffe, kubanga okwatula ng’okwo kuwummuza ebirowoozo, ne kubizzaamu emirembe; ng’emigugu n’ebizito ebiggyibwa ku bibegabega, bwe biwummuza omubiri, ne bigufuula omwangu. Bwe tuba nga tulina okuba abanyiikivu era abakwatirivu mu kwegayirira okutukuvu, kwe kutukuuma nga tunywevu mu maaso ga Katonda waffe ow’amazima, tuleme okubulwa essanyu ery’okukkiriza okulamu, essuubi ery’essanyu, n’okwesiga Katonda okw’omusingi omunywevu. Bwe tuba nga tulina okusabanga emirundi mingi, kwe kuba nti tubeere ab’essanyu emirundi mingi mu ssanyu ery’ekyama ng’eryo okusaba kwokka lye kuyinza okuwa; mu kukwatagana ng’okwo n’Okubeerawo kwa Katonda, okulijjuza ebirowoozo byaffe essanyu lyonna ebitonde ebitali mu Ggulu lye bisobola okufuna.

Singa waaliwo ekintu kyonna mu nsi ekisinga okusaanira okufaayo kwaffe, singa waaliwo okwegezaamu kwonna okw’ebirowoozo, oba emboozi yonna n’abantu, ebisinga okutugasa okusinga okukwatagana kuno ne Katonda, tetwandiyitiddwa kunyiikira bwe tutyo mu kusaba. Naye omuntu bw’alowooza ky’alekayo bw’agenda mu kwewaayo eri Katonda, ajja kusanga nga si ssanyu ttono okuwummuzibwa emirundi mingi bwe gityo okuva mu kukola obutakola kintu, oba okukola ebitaliimu nsa; okuva mu bugayaavu obuzitowa, emirimu egitaliimu mugaso, oba emboozi ezitaliimu. Bw’alowooza nti byonna ebiri mu nsi, ne byonna ebikolebwa mu yo, by’amubiri gwokka, n’ebisanyusa eby’omubiri, ajja kuba n’ensonga okusanyukira essaawa ezo ez’okusaba, ezimutwala eri okubudaabudibwa okw’awaggulu, ezimusitula waggulu w’ensonga zino enfu, ezibikkulira ebirowoozo bye ekifo eky’ebintu ebinene okusingawo, era ezimanyiiza emmeeme ye essuubi n’okubirindirira.

Eddiini bw’etulagira okubeera abalamu eri Katonda yekka, n’okukola byonna olw’ekitiibwa Kye, kubanga buli ngeri endala kwe kubeera abalamu nga twekontana ffekka, era eriggwera mu nsonyi zaffe n’okuswala mu maaso.

Nga buli kintu bwe kiri ekizikiza, Katonda ky’atamulisa; nga buli kintu bwe kiri ekitategeera, ekitafuna mugabo gwakyo ogw’okumanya okuva gy’ali; nga tewali kiramu, okuggyako olw’okugabana obulamu okuva gy’ali; nga tewali kibaawo, okuggyako kubanga Ye akiragira okubaawo; bwe kityo tewali kitiibwa wadde obukulu, okuggyako ebiva mu kitiibwa n’obukulu bwa Katonda.

Mazima tuyinza okwogera ku kitiibwa ky’abantu nga bwe tuyinza okwogera ku bulamu bw’abantu, oba okumanya kw’abantu: naye nga bwe tukakasa nti obulamu bw’abantu tebutegeeza kintu kyaffe ffekka wabula okubeera abalamu nga twesigama ku Katonda, oba okwesiima mu bulamu obwenkana awo mu Katonda; bwe kityo ekitiibwa ky’abantu, buli lwe tukisanga, kiteekwa okuba ekitiibwa ekyenkana ekyo kye twesiimamu mu kitiibwa kya Katonda.

Eno y’embeera y’ebitonde byonna, ka babe bantu oba Bamalayika; nga bwe bateetonda bokka, bwe batyo tebalina kye beesiimamu okuva mu bo bokka: bwe baba abakulu, kiteekwa okuba nga bakulu ng’abafuna ebirabo bya Katonda kyokka; obuyinza bwabwe busobola okuba obuyinza bwa Katonda obwenkana awo obukolera mu bo; amagezi gaabwe gasobola okuba amagezi ga Katonda agenkana awo agaakaayakana munda mu bo; n’ekitangaala kyabwe n’ekitiibwa, ekitangaala n’ekitiibwa kya Katonda ekyenkana awo ekibaakira.

Nga bwe batali bantu oba Bamalayika, kubanga baayagala bo bokka okuba bwe batyo, wabula kubanga okwagala kwa Katonda kwabakola okuba bye bali; bwe batyo tebayinza kwesiima mu ssanyu lino oba eryo ery’abantu oba erya Bamalayika, kubanga baliyagala, wabula kubanga kwe kwagala kwa Katonda ebintu ng’ebyo okuba essanyu ly’abantu, n’ebintu ng’ebyo okuba essanyu lya Bamalayika. Naye kaakano Katonda bw’aba bw’atyo byonna mu byonna; okwagala Kwe bwe kuba bwe kutyo ekipimo ky’ebintu byonna, n’obutonde bwonna; bwe wataba kiyinza kukolebwa, okuggyako olw’obuyinza Bwe; bwe wataba kiyinza kulabibwa, okuggyako olw’ekitangaala okuva gy’ali; bwe tutaba na kya kutya, okuggyako okuva mu bwenkanya Bwe; bwe tutaba na kya kusuubira, okuggyako okuva mu bulungi Bwe; bwe buba nga buno bwe butonde bw’omuntu, atalina buyambi bwe butyo mu ye yekka; bwe kiba nga eno y’embeera y’ebitonde byonna, eby’omu Ggulu nga bwe biri eby’oku nsi; bwe biba nga si kintu, tebiyinza kukola kintu, tebiyinza kubonaabona bulumi, wadde okuwulira essanyu lyonna, okuggyako nga, era mu madaala ng’ago, obuyinza bwa Katonda bwe bukola bino byonna; bwe kiba nga eno y’embeera y’ebintu, kale tuyinza tutya okuba n’akatono akatono ak’essanyu oba okubudaabudibwa, tuyinza tutya okwesiima mu mirembe, okuggyako nga tubeera abalamu eri Katonda oyo yekka, nga tukozesa era nga tukola buli kintu nga kituukagana n’okwagala Kwe? Obulamu obwewaddeyo bwe butyo eri Katonda, obutunuulira Ye yekka mu bikolwa byaffe byonna, era obukola ebintu byonna nga bisaanira ekitiibwa Kye, buli wala nnyo okuba obuzitowa era obutaliimu kubudaabudibwa, ne kiba nti butonda okubudaabudibwa okuggya mu buli kye tukola.

Ku ludda olulala, bw’oba oyagala okulaba nga bwe bali ab’essanyu abo ababeera abalamu ng’okwagala kwabwe bwe kuli, abatasobola kugondera mulimu omuzitowa era ogw’ennaku ogw’obulamu obwewaddeyo eri Katonda; tunuulira omusajja mu lugero, mukama we gwe yali awadde ttalanta emu.

Teyasobola kugumiikiriza birowoozo bya kukozesa ttalanta ye nga bw’ayagala Oyo gwe yagifunako, n’olwekyo n’alonda okwefuula ow’essanyu okusingawo mu ngeri eyiye. "Ssebo," bw’agamba, "nakumanya nga bw’oli omuntu omuzibu, okungulira gy’otaasigira era okuŋŋaanyiza gy’otaasaasaanyiza: Olw’okutya bwe wagenda ne nkweka ttalanta yo mu ttaka! era yiino ttalanta yo."

Mukama we, bwe yamala okumusingisa omusango okuva mu kamwa ke ye, n’amusindika n’ekibonerezo kino, "N’omuddu oyo ataliiko ky’agasa mumusuule ebweru mu kizikiza eri okukaaba n’okuluma obujiji." [Matayo 25:24, 25, 30]

Wano olaba omusajja ono bwe yeefuula ow’essanyu, olw’obutakola nga mukama we bw’ayagala mu byonna. Lyali, ng’ebigambo bye bwe biri, ssanyu lya kwemulugunya n’obutamatira; nakumanya, bw’agamba, nga bw’oli omuntu omuzibu: lyali ssanyu lya kutya n’okweraliikirira; Olw’okutya, bw’agamba: lyali ssanyu lya mirimu egitaliimu n’ennyiriri ezitaliimu bibala; nagenda, bw’agamba, ne nkweka ttalanta yo; era oluvannyuma lw’okuba akaseera ekinyumu eky’okwegomba okw’obusirusiru, okutya okubonyaabonya, n’emirimu egitaliimu bibala, asasulwa n’ekizikiza, okukaaba okutaggwaawo, n’okuluma obujiji.

Kale lino lye ssanyu lya bonna abatwala okutya Katonda okukakali era okw’awaggulu, kwe kugamba, okukozesa obulungi ttalanta yaabwe, okuba embeera y’obulamu enzitowa era ey’ennaku.

Bayinza okubeera akaseera nga ba ddembe ku biziyiza n’obulagirizi bw’eddiini; naye, mu kifo ky’ekyo, bateekwa okubeera wansi w’obufuzi obw’obusirusiru obw’okwegomba kwabwe: bateekwa, ng’omusajja mu lugero, okubeera mu kwemulugunya n’obutamatira, mu kutya n’okweraliikirira. Bayinza okwewala omulimu gw’okukola ebirungi, ogw’okumalira obudde bwabwe mu kwewaayo eri Katonda, ogw’okutereka eby’obugagga mu Ggulu, ogw’okwambaza abali obwereere, ogw’okulambula abalwadde; naye kale bateekwa, ng’omusajja ono, okuba n’emirimu n’obulumi ebitaliimu, ebitaliiko mugaso oba ky’ebigasa, ebitakolera kirungi oba bo bennyini oba abalala; bateekwa okutambula, n’okukola, n’okufuba, n’okusima, okukweka ttalanta yaabwe mu ttaka. Bateekwa, nga ye, ku kujja kwa Mukama waabwe, okusingisibwa omusango okuva mu kamwa kaabwe, okuvunaanibwa emitima gyabwe, era buli kintu kye baayogera era kye baalowooza ku ddiini, kufuulibwe okulaga obwenkanya bw’okusalirwa omusango kwabwe okugenda mu kizikiza ekitaggwaawo, okukaaba, n’okuluma obujiji.

Kuno kwe kugula kwe bakola, abo abeewala obukakali n’okutuukirira kw’eddiini, balyoke babeere mu ssanyu.

Ku ludda olulala, bw’oba oyagala okulaba ennyinyonnyola ennyimpi ey’essanyu ly’obulamu obukozesebwa obulungi, obwewaddeyo ddala eri Katonda, oteekwa okutunuulira omusajja mu lugero mukama we gwe yali awadde ttalanta ttaano. "Mukama wange," bw’agamba, "wampa ttalanta ttaano, nviisizaamu ttalanta endala ttaano. Mukama we n’amugamba nti, Weebale, oli muddu mulungi era mwesigwa, obadde mwesigwa mu bintu ebitono, ndikusigira ebintu ebingi. Yingira sanyukira wamu ne mukama wo."

Wano olaba nti obulamu obwemalidde ddala ku kukulaakulanya ttalanta, obwewaddeyo ddala eri Katonda, mbeera ya ssanyu, emirimu egikulaakulana, n’obuwanguzi obw’ekitiibwa. Wano tewali, nga mu nsonga eyasooka, kwegomba kwonna okutaliimu mirembe, okwemulugunya, okutya okutaliimu, n’emirimu egitaliimu bibala. Omusajja takola nnyo era tasima mu ttaka awatali kigendererwa oba ky’agasa; wabula emirimu gye egy’okutya Katonda gikulaakulana mu mikono gye, essanyu lye limweyongerako; omukisa gwa ttaano gufuuka omukisa gwa ttalanta kkumi; era asembezebwa n’ekigambo nti "Weebale, oli muddu mulungi era mwesigwa: Yingira sanyukira wamu ne mukama wo."

Kale nga embeera y’abasajja bano mu lugero bwe yali tebalekera kya kulonda kirala, okuggyako okuba ab’essanyu mu kukozesa ebirabo byabwe olw’ekitiibwa kya Mukama, oba ab’ennaku nga babikozesa ng’endowooza zaabwe n’okwegomba kwabwe bwe biri; bw’etyo embeera y’Obukristaayo tetulekera kya kulonda kirala.

Byonna bye tulina, byonna bye tuli, byonna bye twesiimamu, ttalanta nnyingi bunnyingi okuva eri Katonda: bwe tuzikozesa olw’ebigendererwa by’obulamu obutya Katonda era obutukuvu, ttalanta zaffe ettaano zirifuuka kkumi, era emirimu gyaffe girituttwala mu ssanyu lya Mukama waffe; naye bwe tuzikozesa obubi okumatiza okwegomba kwaffe, nga tuwaayo ssaddaaka ebirabo bya Katonda eri amalala gaffe n’obutaliimu, tulibeera wano mu mirimu egitaliimu n’okweraliikirira okw’obusirusiru, nga twewala eddiini ng’ekintu eky’ennaku, nga tuvunaana Mukama waffe ng’omukama omukakanyavu, olwo ne tugwa mu nnaku etaggwaawo.

Tuyinza okumala akaseera nga twesanyusa n’amannya n’amaloboozi, n’ebisiikirize by’essanyu; tuyinza okwogera ku bukulu buno oba buli n’ekitiibwa; naye bwe tuba nga twegomba essanyu ery’amazima, tetulina ngeri ndala esoboka gye liyinza kufunibwamu wabula olw’okukulaakulanya ttalanta zaffe, olw’okukozesa bwe tutyo mu butukuvu era mu kutya Katonda obuyinza n’obusobozi bw’abantu mu mbeera eno eya kaakano, tulyoke tube ab’essanyu era ab’ekitiibwa mu buyinza n’obusobozi bwa Bamalayika mu nsi egenda okujja.

N’olwekyo nga tebamanyi nnyo butonde bw’eddiini, butonde bw’omuntu, n’obutonde bwa Katonda, abo abalowooza nti obulamu obw’okutya Katonda okukakali n’okwewaayo eri Katonda mbeera nzitowa etaliimu kubudaabudibwa; so nga kyeyoleka era kikakafu nti tewali kubudaabudibwa wadde essanyu ebiyinza okusangibwa mu kintu ekirala kyonna!

fields.title: Essanyu ly’obulamu obwewaddeyo ddala eri Katonda likakasibwa nate, okuva mu bwereere, okwegomba kw’omubiri, n’okwesanyusa okwavu okw’okusekererwa, abo ababeera nga bwe baagala bye bawalirizibwa okumatira nabyo. Kino kiragibwa mu bifaananyi by’abantu ab’enjawulo
fields.body_html:
TUYINZA okweyongera okulaba essanyu ery’obulamu obwewaddeyo eri Katonda, nga tufumiitiriza ku nkola ez’obwavu ze bakola okunoonya essanyu, n’engeri z’obulamu ez’okunyoomebwa ze bagwamu, abo abatali wansi w’obulagirizi bw’okutya Katonda okunywevu, naye abanoonya essanyu mu makubo amalala.

Bw’otunuulira obulamu bw’abo abatalina kiragiro kirala kye bagoberera wabula endowooza zaabwe n’okwegomba kwabwe; bw’olaba kye bayita essanyu, n’obukulu, n’okusanyuka; bw’olaba nga bwe basanyuka, ne beenenya, ne bakyuka, ne badduka okuva mu bulimba obumu okudda mu bulala; ojja kufuna ensonga nnene ey’okusanyuka nti Katonda yateekawo omulyango omufunda n’ekkubo eddiima eridda eri obulamu; era nti tetwalekebwa mu busirusiru bw’amagezi gaffe, oba okukakibwa okukwata ebisiikirize by’essanyu n’okusanyuka, ebyo obunafu n’obusirusiru bw’ensi bye byayiiya. Njogera nti byayiiya; kubanga ebyo ebikola essanyu n’okusanyuka kw’ensi biyiiye buyiiye, tebirina musingi mu butonde ne mu magezi, si birungi bya muntu ebituufu wadde essanyu lye, tebimutuukiriza mu mubiri gwe wadde mu mutima gwe, era tebimutwala eri ekigendererwa kye ekituufu.

Ng’ekyokulabirako; omuntu bw’ateesa okusanyuka mu makubo ag’okwagala obukulu, ng’ayagala okwesitula ku ntikko ez’ekirooto okusinga abantu abalala, kuno ddala kuba kuyiiya kwa ssanyu, okutalina musingi mu butonde, naye kubeera bulimba bwe twekolera ffekka, nga omuntu bwe yandigezezaako okwesanyusa ng’alinnya ku madaala.

Omukazi bw’anoonya essanyu mu langi ennungi oba obubala ku maaso ge, mu mayinja ag’omuwendo ne mu ngoye ez’ebbeeyi, eryo nalyo ssanyu liyiiye buyiiye, eriwakanya obutonde n’amagezi, nga bwe yandiyagadde okwesanyusa ng’asiiga langi ku kikondo, n’akiteekako eby’okwewunda ebyo bye bimu. Mu nsonga eno kwe nsinziira okuyita essanyu n’okusanyuka kw’ensi kuno okuyiiya obuyiiya okw’essanyu, kubanga Katonda, wadde obutonde, wadde amagezi, tebyabiteekawo ng’essanyu; naye kyonna ekirabika ng’ekisanyusa, oba ekikulu, oba eky’essanyu mu byo, kitondebwa oba kiyiiyibwa bwiyiiyibwa obuzibe n’obutaliimu bw’amagezi gaffe.

Era ku kuyiiya kuno okw’essanyu kwe njagala otunule, olyoke oyige okuva awo, eddiini bw’eri ekirungi ekinene, ekikununula mu busirusiru obungi bwe butyo, ne mu kunoonya okw’obwereere, ebibonyaabonya era ebiteganya emitima egibungeeta nga giva ku ssanyu lyagyo ettuufu mu Katonda.

Tunuulira Flatus, oyige abo abalekeddwa mu busirusiru bw’okwegomba kwabwe bwe bali ab’ennaku.

Flatus mugagga era mulamu, kyokka bulijjo talina mirembe, era bulijjo anoonya essanyu. Buli lw’omukyalira, osanga ng’alina enteekateeka empya mu mutwe gwe; agyagala nnyo ng’ekintu ekisinga omugaso, era ekinaamukolera ebisinga ku byonna eby’emabega. Buli kintu ekiggya kimukwata nnyo, nti singa wandikimuggyako, yandirowoozezza nti azikiridde ddala. Obuggya bwe obw’amaanyi n’okwegomba kwe okw’amaanyi bimusuubiza essanyu lingi nnyo mu buli kintu, n’abeera bulijjo ng’alimbiddwa, era tewali kimumala.

Bwe yali yaakatandika obulamu, engoye ennungi ze zaali essanyu lye, yabuuzanga bubuuza ku bakozi b’engoye abasinga obulungi n’abakola ebiwiiga, era teyalowoozanga kusinga mu kintu kyonna wabula mu kwambala. Teyasaasira ssente, naye buli kiwoomerevu yakituusa ku ntikko yaakyo. Naye essanyu lino bwe litaatuukiriza by’yali asuubira, yaleka engoye ze ez’ebbeeyi, n’ayambala ekkooti ennyangu, n’ayogera bubi ku bakyakala ab’emisono, ne yeewaayo nnyo eri okukuba zzaala.

Essanyu lino eriggya lyamumala okumala ekiseera: teyakwatirwa buggya ngeri ndala ya bulamu. Naye bwe yasikirizibwa, olw’omuzannyo, mu kulwanagana mu kitiibwa, mwe yawonera okufa n’ekyambika, yaleka empiki, era teyaddamu kunoonya ssanyu mu bakubi ba zzaala.

Ekyaddako ekyakwata endowooza ye ebungeeta, ge gaali amasanyu g’ekibuga: era okumala omwaka n’okusingawo wamuwulira ng’ayogera ku bakyala bokka, ku bisenge eby’okusisinkanirwamu, ku mbaga z’amazaalibwa, ku mizannyo, ku mazina, ne ku nkuŋŋaana. Naye bwe yabikoowa, yeewaayo eri okunywa ennyo. Wano yafuna ebiro bingi eby’essanyu, n’asanga essanyu ery’amaanyi okusinga lyonna lye yali awulidde. Wano yalowooza okusiba akasiisira, n’atanoonya nate; naye ku bw’ekibi bwe yalwala omusujja, yasunguwalira omwenge gwonna ogw’amaanyi, n’asiibula essanyu ery’okutamiira.

Okugezaako okwaddako okunoonya essanyu kwamutwala mu nnimiro; okumala emyaka ebiri oba esatu, tewaali kisanyusa nga kuyigga; yakuyingiramu n’omwoyo gwe gwonna, n’abuuka ebikomera n’ebinnya bingi okusinga ebyali bimanyiddwa mu kiseera ekimpi bwe kityo. Tewamulabanga wabula mu kkooti eya kiragala; bonna abaafuuwanga eŋŋombe baamukwatirwanga obuggya, era bulijjo yayogeranga n’embwa ze mu lulimi olutuufu ennyo. Bwe wamusanganga ewuwe, ku lunaku olubi, wandimuwulidde ng’afuuwa eŋŋombe ye, n’akusanyusa n’ebyewuunyisa eby’okuyigga okw’ekitiibwa okwasembayo. Flatus bwe yamala okusinga ensi yonna mu kuzaaza n’okuyigiriza embwa ze, n’azimba ebiyumba ebiggya, n’ebiraalo ebiggya, n’agula ekifo ekiggya eky’okuyigga, amangu ago n’alaba essanyu eddala, n’akyawa oluyoogaano n’okwanguyiriza okw’okuyigga okutaliimu magezi, n’agaba embwa, era okumala ekiseera oluvannyuma, n’abbira mu masanyu g’okuzimba.

Kaakano ayiiya engeri empya ez’ebiyumba by’enjiibwa, era alina enkola mu mawanika ge ne mu biraalo ebitalabikangako; yeewuunya obusirusiru bw’abazimbi ab’edda, yeewaddeyo ddala okulongoosa okuzimba, era kumpi tayinza kuwanika luggi mu ngeri eya bulijjo. Abuulira mikwano gye nti tasanyukangako bwe atyo mu kintu kyonna mu bulamu bwe; nti alina essanyu lingi mu matoffaali ge ne mu bbumba okusinga lye yali alina mu lubiri; era nti alowooza engeri gy’anaabeera n’ekintu ekitono eky’okukola mu ngeri eyo ebbanga lyonna ly’anaaba omulamu.

Omwaka ogwaddako aleka ennyumba ye nga tewedde, yeemulugunya eri buli muntu ku bazimbi n’ababazzi, era yeewaayo ddala eri essanyu ery’okutambula ng’avuga embalaasi. Oluvannyuma lw’ebyo, tewamulabanga wabula ng’ali ku mbalaasi, era ng’asanyukidde nnyo engeri eno empya ey’obulamu, nti yandikugambye nti, muwe mbalaasi ye n’ensi ennungi ey’okugitambuliramu, n’otwala ebirala byonna. Amatandiiko amaggya mangi n’enkoba, n’okukyusa embalaasi ennyingi, byayongera nnyo ku ssanyu ly’engeri eno empya ey’obulamu. Naye, oluvannyuma lw’ekiseera, bwe yamala okwekooya yennyini n’embalaasi ze, ekintu ekyasinga okusanyusa kye yali ayinza okulowoozaako ekyaddako, kwali kugenda bweru kukyalira nsi ez’ebweru; era eyo ddala essanyu lyasinga ku ky’yali alowooza, era yali talina mirembe olw’okuba teyatandika bulamu bulungi bwe butyo mangu. Omwezi ogwaddako yakomawo ewaabwe, nga takyasobola kugumiikiriza bujoozi bwa bannaggwanga.

Oluvannyuma lw’ebyo yafuuka omuyizi omunyiikivu okumala omwaka mulamba; yazuukukanga mu makya era n’asula kikeerezi ng’asoma ennimi z’Oluyitale, alyoke abeere n’essanyu ery’okutegeera opera, buli lw’anaagiwulira, aleme kubeera ng’abantu abo abatalina magezi, abasanyuka nga tebamanyi kibasanyusa.

Flatus musunguwavu nnyo, oba si bwe kiri, okusinziira ku mbeera y’ensonga ze bw’oba omukyalidde; bw’omusanga ng’enteekateeka emu kumpi eweddeyo, ojja kusanga omusajja omukambwe atalina mpisa; naye singa wamulaba nga yaakayingira mu nkola ye ey’okuvuga embalaasi, oba ng’atandise okusinga mu kufuuwa eŋŋombe, wandibadde oyanirizibwa n’ekisa kingi.

Flatus kaakano ayimiridde ddala, era akola ekyo ky’atakolangako mu bulamu bwe, alowooza era afumiitiriza yekka. Amala ennaku eziwerako ng’alowooza ku ngeri ki ku ze yasuula ez’obulamu gy’anaagezaako nate.

Naye wano enteekateeka empya ejja okumuyamba. Kaakano alya middo gyokka, era adduka mu nsi yonna afune omukka mungi nga omuweereza yenna adduka mu bwakabaka.

Nnyinnyonnyodde bwe nti ebintu bingi eby’obusirusiru eby’obulamu obw’engeri eno, kubanga nsuubira nti buli busirusiru bw’olaba wano bujja kwekyusa mu ngeri ey’obutonde ne bufuuka ensonga ey’amagezi n’essanyu ery’obulamu obw’eddiini.

Singa nnali nsobola okukuteekera mu maaso ebigambo byonna mu bujjuvu ebikwata ku ntiisa n’ennaku, ebigoberera buli lunaku obulamu ku nnyanja, gye nnandisinze okunnyonnyola mu bujjuvu, gye nnandisinze okukuwulizisa n’okukusanyusa olw’essanyu ery’okubeera ku lukalu.

Mu ngeri y’emu, gye nkoma okubala obusirusiru, okweraliikirira, obulimba, n’okwegomba okutaliiko mirembe, ebiyita mu buli kitundu ky’obulamu obwewaddeyo eri okwegomba kw’abantu, n’amasanyu ag’ensi, gy’ojja okukoma okukwatibwako emirembe egyo, n’okuwummula, n’okumatira okunywevu, eddiini bye wa emyoyo gy’abantu.

Bw’otunuulira bw’otunuulizi omulalu, oba omusirusiru, oboolyawo tekikutegeeza kintu kitono oba kyonna; naye singa wandibalabirira okumala ennaku eziwerako, n’olaba obulalu obw’ennaku n’obusirusiru bw’ebikolwa byabwe byonna, kino kyandibadde ekintu ekikwata ku mutima, era kyandikuleetedde emirundi mingi okwebaza olw’okuba n’amagezi go n’ebiwulizo byo.

Bwe kityo bwe kiri, bw’obuulirwa bubuulirwa mu bufunze, ku busirusiru n’obulalu bw’obulamu obwewaddeyo eri ensi, tekikukwatako nnyo oba n’akatono; naye bw’olagibwa abantu ng’abo bwe babeera buli lunaku; bw’olaba obusirusiru n’obulalu obutakoma obw’ebikolwa byabwe byonna n’enteekateeka zaabwe; kino kyandibadde ekintu ekikwata ku mutima, era kyandikuleetedde okwebaza Katonda olw’okukuwa essanyu erisinga obukulu ery’okunoonya.

N’olwekyo empisa ez’engeri eno, gye zikoma okubaamu obusirusiru n’eby’okusekererwa, kasita ziba nga za butonde, ze zisinga okuba ez’omugaso okulongoosa emitima gyaffe; era n’olwekyo tewali we zisinga kugwanira okusinga mu bitabo eby’okwewaayo eri Katonda n’okutya Katonda okw’ebikolwa. Era nga bwe kiri, mu nsonga eziwerako, nti tusinga okuyiga obutonde bw’ebintu nga tutunuulira ekyo ekibiwakanya; bwe kityo oboolyawo tusinga okutegeera obulungi bw’amagezi, nga tufumiitiriza ku bulalu obw’ensusso obw’obusirusiru.

N’olwekyo nja kweyongera mu nkola eno katono, era ngezeeko okukusemba essanyu ery’okutya Katonda, nga nkulaga, mu byokulabirako ebirala, abo ababeera nga tebalina kwo bwe babeera mu nnaku ne mu bwavu.

Naye oboolyawo oligamba nti, obulamu bwa Flatus obw’okusekererwa obutaliiko mirembe si y’embeera eya bulijjo ey’abo abeewaayo okubeera ng’endowooza zaabwe bwe ziri, ne balagajjalira amateeka g’eddiini amakakali; era nti n’olwekyo si nsonga nnene bwe etyo ey’essanyu ery’obulamu obw’eddiini, nga bwe njagala okugifuula.

Nziramu nti, ntya nti y’emu ku mpisa ezisinga okubeerawo mu bulamu; era nti abantu batono abayinza okugisoma, nga tebalabyemu kintu ekibakwatako bo bennyini. Kubanga omusajja oyo ow’amagezi era ow’essanyu tunaamusanga wa, atanoonyanga n’amaanyi ebifaananyi eby’enjawulo eby’essanyu, oluusi ng’alowooza nti liri wano, ate oluusi nti liri wali?

Era singa abantu baali bagabanya obulamu bwabwe mu bitundu eby’enjawulo, ne beebuuza kye baali banoonya, oba kye baali basinga okutunuulira, bwe baali ab’emyaka amakumi abiri, kiki ku myaka amakumi abiri mu etaano, kiki ku myaka amakumi asatu, kiki ku myaka amakumi ana, kiki ku myaka amakumi ataano, n’ebirala, okutuusa lwe baatuusibwa ku kitanda kyabwe ekisembayo; abantu bangi bandizudde nti baayagala, ne bakyawa, ne banoonya, ebifaananyi by’essanyu eby’enjawulo bingi nga ebyo ebirabika mu bulamu bwa Flatus.

Era bwe kityo bwe kiteekwa okubeera, okusingawo oba okukendeerako, eri abo bonna abateesa essanyu eddala lyonna, okuggyako eryo eriva mu kutya Katonda okunywevu era okw’enkola.

Naye, eky’okubiri, ka kikkirizibwe nti abantu abasinga obungi tebalina mpisa ezitaliiko mirembe era ezikyukakyuka nga Flatus: enjawulo olwo eri eno yokka, Flatus bulijjo akyuka era agezaako ekintu ekiggya, naye abalala bamatira n’embeera emu; tebaleka zzaala, ne bagwa mu kuyigga. Naye balina obunywevu bungi mu mpisa zaabwe, nti abamu tebanoonya ssanyu ddala wabula ery’okutuuma obugagga; abalala bakaddiwa mu mizannyo gy’omu nnimiro; abalala bamatira okunywa okutuusa lwe bafa, nga tebabuuza na katono ku ssanyu eddala lyonna.

Kaakano waliwo ekintu ekisinga essanyu oba amagezi mu bulamu ng’obwo, okusinga mu bulamu bwa Flatus? Si kikulu era si kyagalwa, si kya magezi era si kya ssanyu, okukyuka bulijjo okuva mu kintu ekimu okudda mu kirala, nga bwe kiri okubeera mukuŋŋaanya wa ssente yekka, omuyizzi, omukubi wa zzaala, oba omutamiivu, obulamu bwo bwonna?

Eddiini eneetunuulirwa ng’omugugu, ng’embeera ekooya era ey’ennaku, olw’okuyita abantu okuva mu ssanyu ng’eryo, okubeera ng’amateeka ga Katonda bwe gali, okufuba okutuukiriza obutonde bwabwe, n’okwetegekera embeera etaliiko nkomerero ey’essanyu n’ekitiibwa mu maaso ga Katonda?

Naye kaakano kyusa amaaso go ogatunuze ludda lulala, era leka amasanyu ag’obwereere, essanyu ery’eby’okuzannyisa erya Feliciana, likuyigirize abo bwe bali ab’amagezi, bulimba ki bwe bawona, abo emitima gyabwe n’essuubi lyabwe ebinywevu ku ssanyu mu Katonda.

Singa wandibeera ne Feliciana okumala ekitundu ky’omwaka kyokka, wandirabye essanyu lyonna ly’agenda okufuna ebbanga lyonna ly’anaaba omulamu. Talina kirala kijja, wabula okuddiŋŋana okw’obwavu okw’ekyo ekitandisobodde kusanyusa n’olumu, okuggyako olw’obutono bw’omutima, n’obutalowooza.

Agenda nate okwambazibwa obulungi, era akuume olunaku lwe olw’okukyaliza. Agenda nate okukyusa langi y’engoye ze, nate okufuna ekyokwewunda ku mutwe ekiggya, era nate okuteeka obubala ku maaso ge. Agenda nate okulaba ani asinga okuzannya obulungi mu kizimbe ky’emizannyo, n’ani asinga okuyimba obulungi mu opera. Agenda nate okukola okukyala kkumi mu lunaku lumu, n’okubeera emirundi kkumi mu lunaku ng’agezaako okwogera mu bukugu, mu bwangu, ne mu mpisa ennungi, ku kintu ekitali kintu.

Agenda nate okusanyukira omusono omuggya; era nate okunyiiga olw’okukyusibwa kw’omusono ogumu ogw’edda. Agenda nate okubeera ku bikuubo, n’okukuba zzaala mu ttumbi, era nate okubeera mu kitanda mu ttuntu. Agenda nate okusanyukira okutendereza okw’obunnanfuusi, era nate okutabulwa olw’okuvumibwa okw’ekirooto. Agenda nate okusanyukira omukisa gwe omulungi mu zzaala, era nate okubonyaabonyezebwa olw’okufiirwa ssente ze. Agenda nate okwetegekera embaga y’amazaalibwa, era nate okulaba ekibuga nga kijjudde abantu abalungi. Agenda nate okuwulira enkwe n’okwekobaana kw’ekibuga; nate okufuna amawulire ag’ekyama ku bwagalana obw’ekyama, n’okumanyisibwa amangu ku bufumbo, ku nnyombo, ne ku kwawukana.

Bw’omulaba ng’ava mu kigaali kye n’amaanyi okusinga bulijjo, ng’ayogera n’omwoyo omungi, era ng’alabika ng’ajjudde essanyu okusinga bwe yali wiiki ewedde, kiri bwe kityo kubanga waliwo ekyambalo ekiggya ekyewuunyisa oba eky’okwesanyusa ekiggya ekyakatuuka mu kibuga.

Bino byonna bye bitundu ebikulu era ebya bulijjo eby’essanyu lya Feliciana; era tamanyangako lunaku lulungi mu bulamu bwe, okuggyako nga kiva ku kimu, oba okusingawo, ku bintu bino.

Olw’essanyu lino bulijjo kye yava abeera omuggavu w’amatu eri okuwabula kw’eddiini, era omutima gwe kye guvudde gubeera omusanyufu ennyo okulowooza ku kituufu oba ekikyamu ku bikwata ku bulamu obutaggwaawo; oba okuwuliriza eddoboozi ly’ebigambo ebikooya ng’ebyo, ng’amagezi, okutya Katonda, n’okwewaayo eri Katonda.

Olw’okutya okufiirwa ekitundu ku ssanyu lino, kyava tayaŋŋanga kufumiitiriza ku butafa bwa mwoyo gwe, okulowooza ku nkolagana ye ne Katonda, oba okukyusa ebirowoozo bye eri amasanyu ago agafuula abatukuvu ne bamalayika okuba abasanyufu ennyo ddala mu maaso ne mu kitiibwa kya Katonda.

Naye kaakano kitegeerekeke wano nti, newankubadde enkulungo y’essanyu eno erabika nga ya bwavu bwe etyo, naye abakazi abasinga obungi abeewala obuzibu bw’eddiini olw’obulamu obw’amasanyu, bateekwa okumatira n’obutundu obutono ennyo obw’essanyu eryo. Nga bwe batalina bugagga n’ekifo kya Feliciana mu nsi, bwe batyo bateekwa okugaba essanyu ery’obulamu obw’okutya Katonda olw’ekitundu ekitono ennyo eky’essanyu lye.

Era bw’otunuulira ensi, n’olaba obulamu bw’abakazi abo abatasobola kumatizibwa nsonga yonna okubeera ddala ku lwa Katonda, nga beekozesa mu ngeri ey’amagezi era ey’okutya Katonda, ojja kusanga abasinga obungi nga bali abo abafiirwa essanyu lyonna ery’eddiini, nga tebafunye na kitundu kimu kya kkumi eky’essanyu lya Feliciana. Be bamala ebiseera byabwe n’obugagga bwabwe nga bakoppa bukoppi amasanyu g’abantu abagagga okubasinga; era basinga kutunuulira n’okwegomba, okusinga okunyumirwa obulimba obwo, obuyinza okugulibwa n’obugagga obungi bwokka.

Naye, singa omukazi ow’olulyo olwa waggulu era ow’obugagga obungi, bw’amala okusoma Enjiri, yandisinze okwagala okubeera omuweereza owa wansi mu maka agamu ag’okutya Katonda, amagezi, okutya Katonda, n’okwewaayo eri Katonda okunene mwe biragirira ebikolwa byonna ebya buli lunaku; singa yandisinze okwagala kino okusinga okubeera ku ntikko y’essanyu lya Feliciana; sandimulowoozezza nti mulalu, wadde nti ali mu nnaku; wabula nti yalamula bulungi omwoyo gw’Enjiri, nga bwe yandisinze okwagala okubeera Laazaalo omwavu ku mulyango, okusinga okubeera omusajja omugagga ayambala engoye ez’effulungu ne linena, era alya ebyassava buli lunaku. [Lukka 16:19, n’ebirala]

Naye ka tweyongereyo: bw’oba oyagala okumanya nga bwe kiri essanyu okufugibwa amagezi g’eddiini, n’okwewaayo eri amasanyu n’essuubi ery’obulamu obw’okutya Katonda, tunuulira embeera ey’obwavu eya Succus, essanyu lye erisinga obunene kwe kwebaka obulungi ekiro mu kitanda, n’emmere ennungi bw’azuukuka. Bw’ayogera ku ssanyu, bulijjo ayogera mu bigambo ebikulaga nti alowooza ku kitanda kye n’eky’emisana kye byokka.

Okufaayo kuno ku mmere ye n’okuwummula kwe kuleetera Succus okuteekateeka ebiseera bye ebirala byonna okusinziira ku byo. Tajja kukwata mulimu gwonna oguyinza okwanguyiriza omwoyo gwe, oba okuyingirira essaawa ze ez’okulya n’okuwummula. Bw’asoma, kijja kuba kya kitundu kya ssaawa kyokka, kubanga ekyo kimala okusanyusa omwoyo; era ajja kusoma ekintu ekiyinza okumusesa, kubanga kifuula omubiri okugwanira emmere yaagwo n’okuwummula. Oba bw’aba, mu kiseera kyonna, ng’ayagala okulowooza ekirowoozo eky’amaanyi, bulijjo adda eri ekitabo eky’omugaso ekikwata ku kufumba okw’edda. Succus mulabe w’ensonga zonna ez’ebibiina by’eby’obufuzi, kubanga yalaba nti waliwo emmere ennungi mu Ba-Whig nga bwe eri mu Ba-Tory.

Ayogera mu bukkakkamu era mu kigero ku nsonga zonna, era atya okusunguwala nga bw’atya okufuna ssennyiga; kubanga akakasa ddala nti byombi byonoona olubuto kyenkanyi. Bw’omulaba ng’abuguumiridde okusinga bulijjo, kiba ku mukolo ogumu ogunyiiza, okukaayana ku kufumba bwe kubuuka ennyo, oba ng’alwanirira emmere emu gy’ayagala, eyali emusanyusizza emirundi mingi. Naye amaze ebbanga ddene ku nsonga zino, amanyi bulungi byonna ebiyinza okwogerwa ku njuyi zombi, era emirundi mingi yaddamu okuwakana kwonna, nti emirundi mingi amalawo ensonga n’obuzito bungi.

Succus mwesigwa nnyo eri kabaka, era amangu ddala nga bw’ayagadde omwenge gwonna, anywa ku lw’obulamu bwa kabaka n’omutima gwe gwonna. Tewali kyandiyinzizza kuteeka birowoozo bya bujeemu mu mutwe gwe, okuggyako nga yandiwangadde okulaba ekirangiriro ekiziyiza okulya amagi g’ensenene ez’omu nsiko.

Essaawa zonna ezitaweereddwayo eri okuwummula oba eri okulya, Succus azitunuulira ng’ebiseera ebyonoonese oba ebisigadde. Olw’ensonga eno asula kumpi n’ennyumba y’emmwanyi n’ekirabo ky’omwenge, bw’azuukuka ku makya abeere kumpi n’amawulire, era bw’ayawukana ekiro, aleme kubeera n’olugendo luwanvu okugenda ku kitanda. Ku makya bulijjo omulaba mu kifo kye kimu mu kisenge ky’emmwanyi; era bw’alabika ng’afaayo nnyo okusinga bulijjo, kiri bwe kityo kubanga omumenyi w’amateeka omu adduse mu kkomera lya Newgate, oba omukyala omu yanyagiddwa ekiro ekyayise, naye tebamanyi wa. Bw’amala okuyiga byonna by’asobola, agenda ewuwe okumaliriza ensonga n’omulenzi w’omusazi w’enviiri ajja okumumwa ekirevu.

Ekiseera ekiddako ekyonoonese ekiba ku mikono gye, kiva ku ky’emisana okutuuka ku ky’eggulo. Era ebirowoozo eby’ennaku bwe bimujjira mu mutwe, biba mu kiseera kino, emirundi mingi bw’alekebwa yekka okumala essaawa emu oba okusingawo, era ekyo, oluvannyuma lw’essanyu erisinga obunene ly’amanyi nga lyakaggwa. Atya okwebaka, kubanga yawulira nti si kirungi eri obulamu mu kiseera ekyo, kale akakibwa okugaana omugenyi ono gw’ayagala ennyo.

Naye wano amangu ddala ayambibwa, olw’enkola enywevu ey’okuzannya ebikuubo, okutuusa ekiseera lwe kituuka okulowooza ku kintu ekitono ekiwoomu eky’eky’eggulo.

Oluvannyuma lw’ebyo Succus akwata ekikopo kye, ayogera ku bulungi bw’enfuga ya Bungereza, era atendereza nnyo minisita oyo asinga okuba n’emmere ennungi ku mmeeza ye.

Ku kiro kya Ssande oluusi oyinza okumuwulira ng’asalira omusango obutali butuukirivu bw’abakyakala abakaba ab’omu kibuga; era ekintu ekisinga obukaawu ky’aboogerako, kye kino, nti akkiriza ddala nti abamu ku bo baweddemu nnyo, nti tebafuna mmere ya bulijjo, wadde otulo otulungi ekiro, mu wiiki.

Ku ssaawa ttaano ez’ekiro, Succus asiibula bonna, era ayawukana nabo mu mukwano mungi. Amangu ago aba ku kitanda, era yeebaka okutuusa ekiseera lwe kituuka okugenda mu nnyumba y’emmwanyi enkeera ku makya.

Singa wandibeera ne Succus okumala omwaka mulamba, kino kyokka kye wandirabye mu bulamu bwe, okuggyako ebikolimo n’ebirayiro bitono by’akozesa ng’omukisa bwe gujja.

Era kaakano siyinza kwewala kufumiitiriza kuno:—

Nti nga bwe nzikiriza nti engeri esinga okusoboka mu nsi okusikiriza omuntu okutya Katonda okw’amazima, kwe kulaba ekyokulabirako ky’omuntu omu ow’ettutumu ayatula eddiini, bwe kityo ekiddako ekiyinza okujjuza omuntu obunyiikivu obwo bwe bumu, kwe kulaba obusirusiru, obubi, n’okumatira okw’obwavu, okw’obulamu obutaliimu ddiini. Ng’ekimu bwe kitukubiriza okwagala n’okwewuunya amagezi n’obukulu bw’eddiini, bwe kityo ekirala kiyinza okututiisa okubeera nga tetulina yo.

Kubanga ani ayinza okwewala okwebaza Katonda olw’engeri z’ekisa, n’olw’essuubi ery’ekitiibwa, bw’alaba obusirusiru obw’enjawulo bwe bugwamu abo ababeera nga tebalina byo? Ani ataandyewaddeyo n’omutima gwe gwonna mu mirimu gyonna n’okwegezaamu kw’obulamu obw’okutya Katonda, okubeera "banywevu era abatasagaasagana nga mweyongeranga bulijjo okukola omulimu gwa Mukama waffe," [1 Abakkolinso 15:58] bw’alaba okwegomba kw’omubiri okukooya, endowooza ez’obwavu, amasanyu amakkakkamu, abo abanoonya essanyu mu makubo amalala bwe balekebwamu?

N’olwekyo, ka tulowooze ku bukulu bw’eddiini, oba ku butono bw’ebintu ebirala byonna, n’obunafu bw’amasanyu amalala gonna, tewali kiyinza kusangibwa, mu butonde bwonna obw’ebintu, omutima ogulowooza kwe guyinza okuwummulira, wabula essanyu mu ssuubi ly’eddiini.

Kaakano lowooza ggwe wennyini, nga bwe kyefuula awatali nsonga nti obulamu obw’okutya Katonda okunywevu buteekwa okubeera embeera ekooya era ey’okweraliikirira. Kubanga kiyinza, n’ensonga yonna, okwogerwa nti emirimu n’obuziyiza bw’eddiini buteekwa okufuula obulamu bwaffe obuzito era obw’ennaku, ng’eddiini etuggyako bwokka essanyu ng’eryo eryakuteekeddwa mu maaso wano?

Kiteekwa okuba ekikooya era ekitawaanya okubeera mu kwegezaamu okutakoma okw’okusaasira, okw’okwewaayo eri Katonda, n’okwefuga, okukola mu magezi n’obulungi, okukola ebirungi okutuuka ku kkomo ly’amaanyi go, okukoppa obutuukirivu bwa Katonda, n’okwetegekera okunyumirwa Katonda? Kiteekwa okuba ekikooya era ekitawaanya okununulibwa mu buzibe n’obutaliimu, mu ssuubi ery’obulimba n’okutya okw’obwereere, okweyongera mu butukuvu, okuwulira okubudaabudibwa kw’omwoyo omulungi mu bikolwa byo byonna, okumanya nti Katonda ye Mukwano gwo, nti byonna biteekwa okukola olw’obulungi bwo, nti wadde obulamu wadde okufa, wadde abantu wadde emizimu emibi, tebiyinza kukukola kabi konna; naye nti okubonaabona kwo kwonna n’ebikolwa byo ebiweebwayo eri Katonda, okutunula kwo kwonna n’okusaba kwo, n’emirimu gy’okwagala n’okusaasira, okukulaakulana kwo kwonna, mu kiseera ekitono bigenda kusasulwa n’ekitiibwa ekitaggwaawo mu maaso ga Katonda; embeera ng’eno eteekwa okuba ekooya era etawaanya, olw’obutaba na ssanyu nga Flatus, oba Feliciana, lye banyumirwa?

Kaakano bw’oba kino tekiyinza kwogerwa, olwo tewali ssanyu wadde amasanyu agafiirwa, olw’okutya Katonda okunywevu; era omuntu eyeewaayo eri Katonda talina kintu kyonna kya kukwatirwa buggya mu mbeera endala yonna ey’obulamu. Kubanga obukugu bwonna n’enkola zonna mu nsi, awatali ddiini, tebiyinza kufuula bulamu bwa muntu kusingawo, oba okutwala essanyu lyabwo ku ntikko esingawo, okusinga Flatus ne Feliciana bwe bakoze.

Omugezi asinga obukugu, omuntu asinga obusobozi ku nsi, bw’aba tafugibwa ddiini, ateekwa okubeera omusirusiru, era owa wansi, era ow’obwereere mu makubo ge ag’essanyu, nga Succus omwavu.

Singa wandirabye omusajja ng’afuba mu bunafu obulamu bwe bwonna okumalawo ennyonta ye, ng’asitula ekikopo kye kimu ekyereere ku mumwa gwe, ddala wandinyoomye obutamanya bwe.

Naye singa wandirabye abalala abalina obusobozi obusingawo, n’okutegeera okusingawo, nga basekerera okumatira okukooya okw’ekikopo ekimu, era nga balowooza okumalawo ennyonta yaabwe n’ebikopo ebyereere eby’enjawulo ebisiigiddwako zaabu era ebya zaabu; wandirowoozezza nti bano baali ba magezi okusingawo, oba ba ssanyu okusingawo, oba nga bakozesebwa bulungi okusingawo, olw’obusobozi bwabwe obusingawo?

Kaakano eno y’enjawulo yokka gy’oyinza okulaba mu ssanyu ery’obulamu buno.

Omwoyo omunafu era omuzito guyinza okumatira n’ekifaananyi kimu ekyereere eky’essanyu, ne gubeera bulijjo nga gugezaako okusitula ekikopo kye kimu ekyereere ku mumwa gwagwo obulamu bwagwo bwonna. Naye olwo omugezi, omuyivu omukulu, omuntu ow’obusobozi obulungi, omukulembeze omukulu ow’eggwanga, omwami ow’empisa ennungi, ka bateeke emitwe gyabwe gyonna wamu, era basobola okukulaga bwokka ebifaananyi ebyereere eby’essanyu ebingi era eby’enjawulo; bawe ensi yonna mu mikono gyabwe, ka basale era bakole nga bwe baagala, basobola okukola bukozi ebikopo ebyereere eby’enjawulo ebingi okusingawo.

N’olwekyo bw’oba tolowooza nti kizibu okuggibwako amasanyu ag’obuluvu, ku lw’eddiini, tolina nsonga kulowooza nti kizibu okuziyizibwa okuva mu ssanyu eddala lyonna ery’ensi. Kubanga noonya nga bw’oyagala mu buziba, era tunula wala nga bw’oyagala, tewali kintu ekiyinza kusangibwa wano, ekisinga ekitiibwa, oba obukulu, okusinga okulya n’okunywa ennyo, okuggyako ng’okinoonya mu magezi ne mu mateeka g’eddiini.

Era bwe biba nga byonna ebiri mu nsi, bikopo ebyereere ebingi bwe bityo, kitegeeza ki ky’otwala, oba bimeka by’otwala, oba bimeka by’olina?

Singa wandimanyidde okufumiitiriza ng’okwo, okulowooza ku butaliimu bw’embeera zonna ez’obulamu awatali kutya Katonda, okulowooza nti amakubo gonna ag’ensi bwe gali bwokka amakubo ag’enjawulo amangi ag’ensobi, ag’obuzibe, n’ag’okukyama; amangu ddala wandizudde ng’omutima gwo gufuuliddwa ogw’amagezi era omulungi okusingawo olw’ekyo. Okufumiitiriza kuno kwandizuukusizza omwoyo gwo okwegomba n’obunyiikivu essanyu eryo erinywevu, erisangibwa bwokka mu kudda eri Katonda.

Ebyokulabirako eby’okutya Katonda okunene kaakano si bya bulijjo mu nsi; kiyinza obutaba ssanyu lyo okubeera awali ekimu ku byo, oba okufuna empisa zo ennungi okukoleezebwa ekitangaala n’obunyiikivu bwabyo. Naye ennaku n’obusirusiru bw’abantu ab’ensi kye kintu ekisisinkana amaaso go buli wantu, era tekikwetaagisa kutunula wala okulaba abantu bwe bamala obulamu bwabwe nga baloota mu bwavu ne mu bwereere, olw’obutaba na magezi ga ddiini.

Eno y’ensonga lwaki nkuteekedde mu maaso empisa nnyingi bwe zityo ez’obutaliimu bw’obulamu obw’ensi, okukuyigiriza okufuna omugaso mu bwonoonefu bw’omulembe guno, era olyoke ofuulibwe ow’amagezi, newankubadde si lwa kulaba okutya Katonda kye kuli, naye olw’okulaba ennaku n’obusirusiru ebifuga awatali kutya Katonda.

Singa wandikyusizza omutima gwo eri okufumiitiriza ng’okwo, okwetegereza kwo kwandituusizza okuyigiriza kuno wala nnyo, era okwogera kwo kwonna n’okumanyagana kwo n’ensi byandibadde buli lunaku kukakasa gy’oli obwetaavu bw’okunoonya essanyu erisinga obunene, okusinga amasanyu gonna ag’obwavu ag’ensi eno ge gayinza okuwa.

Okufumiitiriza ku butuukirivu bw’engeri za Katonda, okulowooza ku kitiibwa ky’Eggulu, okulowooza ku ssanyu ly’abatukuvu ne bamalayika, ababeera emirembe gyonna mu kumasamasa ne mu kitiibwa eky’Okubeerawo kwa Katonda; kuno kwe kufumiitiriza kw’emyoyo egyeyongedde mu kutya Katonda, era tekugwanira buli busobozi.

Naye okulaba n’okulowooza ku butaliimu n’ensobi y’essanyu lyonna ery’ensi; okulaba obukyafu bw’okwegomba kw’omubiri, obwavu bw’amalala, obusirusiru bw’omululu, obutaliimu bw’okwambala, obulimba bw’ekitiibwa, obuzibe bw’okwegomba kwaffe, obutali bukakafu bw’obulamu bwaffe, n’obumpi bw’enteekateeka zonna ez’ensi; kuno kwe kufumiitiriza okugwanira obusobozi bwonna, okutegekeddwa okukwata ku mitima gyonna; tekwetaaga kulowooza kwa buziba wadde okufumiitiriza okw’awaggulu, naye kutukakibwako ebiwulizo byaffe byonna, era tukuyigirizibwa kumpi buli kintu kye tulaba ne kye tuwulira.

Gano ge magezi ago "agakoowoolera era agayimusa eddoboozi lyago" [Engero 8:1] mu nguudo, agayimirira ku nzigi zaffe zonna, agasaba ebiwulizo byaffe byonna, nga gatuyigiriza mu buli kintu, ne buli wantu, mu byonna bye tulaba, ne byonna bye tuwulira, mu kuzaalibwa ne mu kuziika, mu bulwadde ne mu bulamu, mu bulamu ne mu kufa, mu bulumi ne mu bwavu, mu nnaku ne mu butaliimu, ne mu nkyukakyuka zonna n’ebigwawo eby’obulamu, nti tewali kirala muntu ky’alina kunoonya, tewali kigendererwa kirala mu butonde ky’alina kuluubirira, wabula essanyu erisangibwa bwokka mu ssuubi n’okusuubira kw’eddiini.

fields.title: Nti si bulamu bwa bwereere oba bwa kwegomba kwa mubiri bwokka, wabula n’obulamu obusinga okutegekebwa, obutafugibwa kwewaayo kunene eri Katonda, bulaga ennaku zaabwo, obwetaavu bwabwo n’obwereere bwabwo eri amaaso g’ensi yonna. Kino kiragibwa mu bifaananyi by’abantu ab’enjawulo
fields.body_html:
KIGAMBO ekyewuunyisa ennyo Mukama waffe era Omulokozi waffe kye yagamba abayigirizwa be, mu bigambo bino: "Amaaso gammwe galina omukisa, kubanga galaba, n’amatu gammwe kubanga gawulira." [Matayo 13:16] Bituyigiriza ebintu bibiri; ekisooka, nti obunafu n’obuzito bw’emitima gy’abantu, ku bikwata ku by’omwoyo, bunene nnyo, nti mu butuufu buyinza okugeraageranyizibwa n’obutaba na maaso n’amatu.

Eky’okubiri, Nti Katonda yajjuza buli kintu na buli kifo, ensonga n’obukakafu obw’obulamu obw’okutya Katonda, nti abo bonna abalina omukisa, abasanyufu bwe batyo okukozesa amaaso gaabwe n’amatu gaabwe, bateekwa okukwatibwako byo.

Kaakano newankubadde nga kino kyali, mu ngeri ey’enjawulo ennyo, embeera y’abo abaali ab’okuwa obujulizi n’ebiwulizo byabwe ku bulamu, n’ebyamagero, n’enjigiriza, bya Mukama waffe omutendereze, naye era ddala y’embeera y’Abakristaayo bonna mu kiseera kino. Kubanga ensonga z’eddiini, okuyitibwa eri okutya Katonda, biwandiikiddwa era byoleddwa ku buli kintu, era byeraga n’amaanyi bwe gatyo, era bulijjo bwe gatyo, eri ebiwulizo byaffe byonna mu buli kye tusisinkana, nti biyinza okubuusibwa amaaso gokka agatalaba, n’amatu gokka agatawulira.

Nsonga ki esinga obukulu ey’obulamu obw’eddiini, okusinga obutaliimu, obwavu bw’amasanyu gonna ag’ensi? Kyokka ani ayinza okwewala okulaba n’okuwulira kino buli lunaku olw’obulamu bwe?

Kuyita ki okusinga obukulu okutunula eri Katonda, okusinga obulumi, obulwadde, emisalaba n’okutawaanyizibwa kw’obulamu buno? Kyokka maaso ga ani n’amatu ga ani agatali bajulirwa baabyo buli lunaku?

Byamagero ki ebyandisinze okukwata ku biwulizo byaffe n’amaanyi, oba bubaka ki okuva mu Ggulu obwandisinze okutwogerera n’eddoboozi ery’omwanguka, okusinga okufa n’okugenda kwa bannaffe ebitonde buli lunaku? Kale ekintu ekimu ekyetaagibwa, oba ekigendererwa ekinene eky’obulamu, tekirekeddwa kuzuulibwa na kuwakana okw’amagezi n’okufumiitiriza okw’obuziba; naye kitukakibwako, mu ngeri esinga obwangu, olw’okumanya okuva mu biwulizo byaffe byonna, olw’ebintu byonna bye tusisinkana mu bulamu.

Ka tumale tuteese okulaba n’okuwulira, olwo ensi yonna efuuka gye tuli ekitabo eky’amagezi n’okuyigiriza; byonna ebiri mu nteekateeka ya bulijjo ey’obutonde, byonna ebigwawo obugwi mu ntambula y’ebintu, ensobi zonna n’okuggwamu essuubi ebitutuukako ffe bennyini, ennaku zonna n’ensobi ze tulaba mu bantu abalala, bifuuka gye tuli amasomo amangi ag’okubuulirirwa ageeyoleka obulungi; nga bituyigiriza, n’obukakafu bungi nga malayika okuva mu Ggulu, nti tetuyinza mu ngeri yonna kwesitula eri essanyu lyonna ery’amazima, wabula nga tukyusa ebirowoozo byaffe byonna, okwegomba kwaffe, n’okufuba kwaffe, eri essanyu ery’obulamu obulala.

Kuno kwe kukozesa okutuufu okw’ensi kwe njagala okukutwalamu, nga nkulagirira okukyusa amaaso go eri buli ngeri ey’obusirusiru bw’abantu, olyoke ofune okuva awo ensonga empya n’ebikukubiriza okubeera ku lw’ebigendererwa ebisinga obulungi n’obukulu eby’okutondebwa kwo.

Era singa wandimala otambula n’ekigendererwa kino, eky’okufuna omugaso mu busirusiru bw’ensi, n’eky’okuyiga obukulu bw’eddiini, okuva mu butono n’obutaliimu bw’engeri endala yonna ey’obulamu; singa, njogera, wandimala okutambuza ekigendererwa kino mu mutima gwo, wandizudde buli lunaku, buli kifo, na buli muntu, nga bukakafu obuggya obw’amagezi g’abo, abalonda okubeera ddala ku lwa Katonda. Olwo emirundi mingi wandikomyewo ewuwo ng’oli wa magezi okusingawo, mulungi okusingawo, era munywevu okusingawo mu ddiini, olw’ebintu byonna ebikugwiridde mu kkubo lyo.

Octavius musajja muyivu, ow’amagezi, amanyi bulungi ebitundu ebisinga eby’ebiwandiiko, era si mugenyi mu bwakabaka bwonna mu Bulaaya. Olunaku lumu, bwe yali yaakawona omusujja ogwali gumuludde, yeetwalira okwogera bw’ati eri mikwano gye:—

Essaawa yange ey’omusenyu, bw’agamba, kumpi eweddemu; era amaaso gammwe galaba obubonero bungi obw’obukadde n’okufa bwe ntambula nabwo: naye mpulira bulungi nga nzikirira mangu okusinga abali okumpi bwe balowooza. Nzikiriza ddala nti omwaka gumu omulala gujja kumaliriza okubala kwange.

Okufaayo kwa mikwano gye kwasitulibwa nnyo olw’okulangirira okw’engeri eyo, nga basuubira okuwulira ekintu ekirungi ennyo ddala okuva eri omusajja omuyivu bw’atyo, eyali asigazzaayo omwaka gumu gwokka okubeera omulamu. Octavius n’alyoka yeeyongerayo bw’ati: Olw’ensonga zino, bw’agamba, mikwano gyange, ndese ebirabo by’omwenge byonna; omwenge gw’ebifo ebyo si mulungi kimala gye ndi, mu kuggwaamu amaanyi kuno okw’obutonde. Kaakano nteekwa okwegendereza mu bye nnywa; siyinza kwefuula kukola nga bwe nnakolanga; era n’olwekyo mmaliridde okujjuza ekisenge kyange eky’omwenge n’omwenge mutono ogusinga obulungi ddala, newankubadde gunaamala ssente nnyingi bwe zityo.

Era nteekwa okubabuulira, mikwano gyange, nti obukadde bukaka omuntu okubeera ow’amagezi mu bintu ebirala bingi, era butukyusa endowooza zaffe nnyingi n’empisa zaffe.

Mumanyi nga bwe nnayagalanga okumanyagana n’abantu abangi; kaakano nkivumirira ng’ensobi. Abanywanyi basatu oba bana abasanyufu, abasanyusa, be bokka be njagala kaakano; kubanga nzudde nti, mu bunafu bwange obwa kaakano, bwe ndekebwa nzekka, oba n’abantu abazito, siba mu mirembe.

Ennaku ntono oluvannyuma lwa Octavius okulangirira kino eri mikwano gye, yaddamu n’alwala obulwadde bwe obw’olubereberye, n’akwasibwa omusawo omujjanjabi, eyamuziba amaaso ng’omwenge gwe omuggya tegunnatuuka.

Eugenius omuvubuka, eyaliwo mu kwogera kuno, yadda ewuwe ng’afuuse omuntu omuggya, n’okumalirira okujjuvu okw’okwewaayo ddala eri Katonda.

Sikwatibwangako nnyo bwe ntyo, bw’agamba Eugenius, olw’amagezi n’obukulu bw’eddiini, nga bwe nnakwatibwako bwe nnalaba Octavius omuyivu nga bw’agenda okuva mu nsi mu bwavu ne mu bunafu, olw’obutaba nayo.

Emirundi emeka gye nnakwatirwanga obuggya olw’obuyivu bwe obungi, obukugu bwe mu nnimi, okumanya kwe ku by’edda, empisa ze, n’engeri ye ennungi ey’okwoleka ebirowoozo bye ku nsonga zonna! Naye bwe nnalaba nga byonna bwe byakoma mu bwavu, omwaka ogusembayo ogw’obulamu ng’obwo bwe gwali ogw’okuba, era omukugu w’ebirungi bino byonna bwe yali awaliriziddwa okwogera mu busirusiru, olw’obutamanya masanyu n’essuubi eby’okutya Katonda, nnakakasizibwa ddala nti tewali kintu kya kukwatirwa buggya oba kwegomba, wabula obulamu obw’okutya Katonda okw’amazima; wadde ekintu ekirala eky’obwavu era ekitaliimu kubudaabuda nga okufa awatali kwo.
