Yesu Omutukuvu bw’agamba nti, "Ensi bw’ebakyawanga," tayongerako ng’abudaabuda, nti eyinza mu kiseera ekimu oba ekirala okulekera awo obukyayi bwayo, oba nti tejja kubakyawanga bulijjo; naye awa bwokka kino ng’ensonga ey’okukugumiikiriza, "mumanye nti yasooka kukyawa nze"; [Yokaana 15:18] ng’ategeeza, nti ye yali, kwe kugamba, Omwoyo we, olw’okuwakanya ensi, eyakyayibwa yo olwo, era bulijjo eyandikyayiddwa.

Oboolyawo oligamba nti, ensi kaakano efuuse ya Kikristaayo, waakiri ekitundu kyayo kye tubeeramu; era n’olwekyo ensi kaakano tesaanidde kutunuulirwa mu mbeera eyo ey’okuwakanya Obukristaayo, nga bwe yali bwe yali ey’abakaafiiri.

Kikkirizibwa, ensi kaakano eyatula Obukristaayo. Naye waliwo agamba nti ensi eno ey’Ekikristaayo eri wa Mwoyo wa Kristo? Empisa zaayo ez’awamu ze mpisa za Kristo? Okwegomba kw’omubiri, okwerowoozaako, amalala, omululu, okwagala obukulu, n’okwekulumbaza, biwakanya kitono omwoyo gw’Enjiri kaakano nga biri mu Bakristaayo, okusinga bwe byali mu bakaafiiri? Oba onoogamba nti empisa n’okwegomba kw’ensi ey’abakaafiiri byabula era byagenda?

Lowooza, eky’okubiri, ky’olina okutegeeza ku nsi. Kaakano kino kinnyonnyolwa mu bujjuvu gye tuli St. Yokaana. "Kubanga buli eky’ensi: okwegomba kw’omubiri, n’okwegomba kw’amaaso, n’okwekuluntaza okw’obulamu," [1 Yokaana 2:16] Eno y’ennyinnyonnyola entuufu era enzijuvu ey’ensi. Kaakano onoogamba nti ensi eno efuuse ya Kikristaayo? Naye singa bino byonna bikyaliwo, olwo ensi y’emu kaakano eriwo, era omulabe y’omu eri Obukristaayo, nga bwe yali mu nnaku za St. Yokaana.

Yali nsi eno St. Yokaana gye yavumirira, ng’etali ya Kitaffe: n’olwekyo oba eyatula Obukristaayo kungulu, oba ebuyigganya mu lwatu, ekyali mu mbeera y’emu ey’okuwakanya omwoyo ogw’amazima n’obutukuvu bw’Enjiri.

Era mazima ensi, olw’okwatula Obukristaayo, eri wala nnyo n’okuba omulabe ow’akabi akatono okusinga bwe yali edda, nti olw’ebirungi byayo ezikirizza Abakristaayo bangi okusinga bwe yakola n’okuyigganya okusinga obukambwe.

N’olwekyo, tuteekwa okuba wala nnyo n’okutunuulira ensi ng’eri mu mbeera ey’obulabe obutono n’okuwakanya Obukristaayo okusinga bwe yali mu biseera ebisooka eby’Enjiri, nti tuteekwa okugyekuuma ng’omulabe asinga obukulu n’akabi kaakano, okusinga bwe yali mu biseera ebyo.

Mulabe asinga obukulu, kubanga erina obuyinza bungi ku Bakristaayo olw’ebirungi byayo, obugagga, ebitiibwa, empeera, n’obukuumi, okusinga bwe yalina olw’omuliro n’obukambwe bw’okuyigganya kwayo.

Mulabe asinga akabi, olw’okufiirwa endabika yaayo ey’obulabe. Okwatula kwayo okw’ebweru okw’Obukristaayo kugifuula obutakyatunuulirwa ng’omulabe, era n’olwekyo abantu abasinga obungi basendebwasendebwa mangu okwewaayo okufugibwa n’okulagirirwa yo.

Emyoyo emingi egibalamula nga gikuumibwa mu mirembe, ku musingi omulala gwonna, wabula kubanga boonoona wansi w’obuyinza bw’ensi ey’Ekikristaayo!

Ebiragiro by’Enjiri ebingi nga bigalamidde awo nga tebifiibwako, era abantu ab’enjawulo nga babisoma awatali kufaayo, olw’ensonga endala yonna wabula kubanga birabika nga tebifiibwako nsi ey’Ekikristaayo!

Okugondera kungi abantu kwe bakola eri ensi ey’Ekikristaayo, awatali kulonzalonza wadde okwejjusa; okwandibadde kugaaniddwa, singa kwabasabibwa abakaafiiri bokka, ng’okuwakanya obutukuvu bw’Obukristaayo!

Ani yandimatidde okulaba obulamu bwe nga bwe buwakanya Enjiri, okuggyako kubanga alaba nti abeera ng’ensi ey’Ekikristaayo bw’ekola?

Ani, asoma Enjiri, eyandyetaaga okumatizibwa ku bwetaavu bw’okwefiiriza okunene, obwetoowaze, n’obwavu bw’omwoyo, okuggyako nti obuyinza bw’ensi bugobye enjigiriza eno ey’Omusalaba?

N’olwekyo tewali kintu, Omukristaayo omulungi ky’asaanidde okusinga okwekengera, oba okwekuumanga bulijjo, okusinga obuyinza bw’ensi ey’Ekikristaayo.

Era ebitundu byonna eby’Ebyawandiikibwa ebyogera ku nsi ng’ewakanya Obukristaayo, ebitwetaagisa okwawukana nayo, ng’okuva ku Mamona ow’obutali butuukirivu, ekisolo eky’obubi, byonna birina okutwalibwa mu makulu ge gamu amakakali, ku bikwata ku nsi eya kaakano.

Kubanga enkyukakyuka ensi gy’eyiseemu ekyusizza bwokka enkola zaayo, naye tekendeezezza ku buyinza bwayo, obw’okuzikiriza eddiini.

Abakristaayo tebaalina kye baatya okuva mu nsi ey’abakaafiiri okuggyako okufiirwa obulamu bwabwe; naye ensi efuuse mukwano, ekifuula ekizibu gye bali okulokola eddiini yaabwe.

Amalala, okwegomba kw’omubiri, omululu, n’okwagala obukulu, bwe byali nga birina bwokka obuyinza bw’ensi ey’abakaafiiri, Abakristaayo baafuulibwa olw’ekyo okussaayo ennyo omwoyo ku mpisa ennungi ezibiwakanya. Naye amalala, okwegomba kw’omubiri, omululu, n’okwagala obukulu, bwe bibeera n’obuyinza bw’ensi ey’Ekikristaayo, olwo Abakristaayo ab’omu kyama baba mu kabi akasingayo, si ka kukwatibwa nsonyi ne balekayo okwegezaamu kwokka, naye ak’okufiirwa n’endowooza yennyini, ey’okutya Katonda kw’Enjiri.

N’olwekyo, kumpi tewali ngeri yonna ey’okwerokola okuva mu nsi eya kaakano, okuggyako ng’ogitunuulira ng’omulabe y’omu omubi eri obutukuvu bwonna obw’amazima, nga bw’eyogerwako mu Byawandiikibwa; era ng’okakasa nti kya kabi okutuukagana n’empisa zaayo n’okwegomba kwayo kaakano nga ya Kikristaayo, nga bwe kyali nga ya bakaafiiri.

Kubanga weebuuze bwokka, Okutya Katonda, obwetoowaze, obwegendereza bw’ensi ey’Ekikristaayo, kwe kutya Katonda, obwetoowaze, n’obwegendereza bw’omwoyo ogw’Ekikristaayo? Bwe kiba nti nedda, oyinza otya okuzikirizibwa ensi yonna okusinga olw’okutuukagana n’eyo ey’Ekikristaayo?

Omuntu yeetaaga okukola ebisingawo okufuula omwoyo gwe obutasaanira kusaasirwa Katonda, okusinga olw’okubeera n’omululu n’okwegomba okw’ekitiibwa? Naye omuntu ayinza atya okulekayo empisa eno, nga talese mwoyo n’empisa y’ensi, mw’obeera kaakano?

Omuntu ayinza atya okufuulibwa okusingawo obutasobola Mwoyo wa Kristo, okusinga olw’okuwa ssente omuwendo omukyamu? era naye, ayinza atya okukyama okusingawo mu muwendo gw’azisaamu, okusinga olw’okugoberera obuyinza bw’ensi ey’Ekikristaayo?

Wabula, mu buli kibiina na buli kifo eky’obulamu, oba eky’obuyivu oba eky’emirimu, oba mu Kkanisa oba mu Gavumenti, toyinza kukola ng’omwoyo gw’eddiini bwe guli, nga tolese mpisa ey’awamu esinga n’enneeyisa y’abo abali mu kibiina kye kimu n’omulimu gwe gumu nga ggwe.

Era newankubadde amagezi g’abantu galabika ng’ayogera n’amagezi mangi ku bwetaavu bw’okwewala okweyawula ku balala, naye oyo atayaŋŋanga kubeera munafu bw’atyo okweyawula, emirundi mingi ajja kuwalirizibwa okwewala emirimu egisinga obukulu egy’okutya Katonda okw’Ekikristaayo.

Okufumiitiriza kuno, nsuubira, kujja kukuyamba okumenya obuzibu obwo, n’okuwakanya okukemebwa okwo, obuyinza n’emisono gy’ensi bye bisitudde okulwanyisa okwegezaamu obwetoowaze obw’Ekikristaayo.

fields.title: Okulaga okusomesebwa abasajja kwe batera okufuna mu buvubuka bwabwe bwe kufuula okuyigiriza okw’obwetoowaze okuzibu okukola. Omwoyo gw’okusomesebwa okusingako obulungi, nga guragibwa mu kifaananyi kya Paternus
fields.body_html:
OBUZIBU obulala mu kwegezaamu obwetoowaze buva mu ngeri gye twakuzibwamu n’okusomesebwa. Ffenna, okusinga obungi, twakuzibwa mu ngeri ey’obwonoonefu, n’oluvannyuma ne tukwasibwa okutambula mu nsi eyonoonese; kale si kya kwewuunya bwe kiba nti ebyokulabirako by’okutya Katonda okunene tebitera kulabika.

Ekitundu ekinene eky’ensi kizikirizibwa olw’okuzaalibwa n’okukuzibwa mu maka agatalina ddiini: gye bafuulirwa ababi era abatalina nkola, olw’okufaanana abo be baasooka okubeera nabo.

Naye kino si kye ntegeeza kaakano; okukuzibwa n’okusomesebwa kwe ntegeeza wano, kwe kwo abaana kwe batera okufuna okuva eri abazadde abalina empisa ennungi era abeegendereza, n’abasomesa abayivu n’abalabirizi.

Singa twasigala nga tutuukiridde, nga Katonda bwe yatonda omuntu eyasooka, oboolyawo obutuukirivu bw’obutonde bwaffe bwandibadde okwesomesa okumala eri buli muntu. Naye ng’obulwadde n’endwadde bwe byatonda obwetaavu bw’eddagala n’abasawo, bwe kityo enkyukakyuka n’obutabulatabule bw’obutonde bwaffe obw’amagezi byaleeta obwetaavu bw’okusomesebwa n’abasomesa.

Era ng’ekigendererwa kyokka eky’omusawo kwe kuzzaawo obutonde mu mbeera yaabwo, bwe kityo ekigendererwa kyokka eky’okusomesebwa kwe kuzzaawo obutonde bwaffe obw’amagezi mu mbeera yaabwo esaanidde. Okusomesebwa, n’olwekyo, kulina okutunuulirwa ng’amagezi ageewolebwa okuva mu muntu omulala, agalina, nga bwe gasobola, okujjuzaawo okufiirwa kw’obutuukirivu obw’olubereberye. Era ng’eby’eddagala bwe biyinza okuyitibwa mu butuufu obukugu bw’okuzzaawo obulamu, bwe kityo okusomesebwa kusaanidde okutunuulirwa mu kitangaala ekirala kyonna, wabula ng’obukugu bw’okuzzaawo eri omuntu okukozesa amagezi ge.

Kaakano ng’okuyigiriza kwa buli bukugu oba ssaayansi bwe kwesigamiziddwa ku bizuuliddwa, amagezi, okumanya, n’engero, z’abantu abakulu abawerako abaafuba mu kyo; bwe kityo amagezi g’omuntu, oba okukozesa obulungi amagezi gaffe, abavubuka gye basaanidde okuyitibwamu olw’okusomesebwa kwabwe, si kirala wabula okumanya okusinga obulungi, n’okuwakana okusinga obulungi, okw’abantu abeewaayo okusoma amagezi, n’okulongoosa obutonde bw’omuntu.

N’olwekyo byonna abatukuvu abakulu, n’abantu abafa, nga bajjudde nnyo ekitangaala n’okukakasibwa, era oluvannyuma lw’okulongoosebwa okusinga obukulu okw’amagezi gaabwe, byonna bye baayogera ku bwetaavu bw’okutya Katonda, ku bulungi bw’empisa ennungi, ku mulimu gwabwe eri Katonda, ku butaliimu bw’obugagga, ku butaliimu bw’ensi; ebigambo byonna, okusalawo, okuwakana, n’engero, z’abafirosoofo abasinga amagezi, nga bali mu mbeera yaabwe esinga obukulu ey’amagezi, bisaanidde okukola amasomo ag’awamu ag’okuyigiriza emitima gy’abavubuka.

Eno ye ngeri yokka ey’okufuula ekitundu ky’ensi ekito era ekitamanyi okubeera ekirungi okusingawo olw’amagezi n’okumanya kw’abagezi n’ab’edda.

Okusomesebwa okutali kwa kugenderera kino kwokka, kuli bweru wa nsonga, ng’obukugu bw’eby’eddagala obutalina kufaayo kutono oba kwonna ku kuzzaawo obulamu.

Abavubuka abaagobereranga Pythagoras, Socrates, Plato, ne Epictetus, baasomesebwa bwe batyo. Amasomo gaabwe aga buli lunaku n’okuyigirizibwa byali mboozi nnyingi ku butonde bw’omuntu, ekigendererwa kye ekituufu n’okukozesa obulungi obusobozi bwe; ku butafa bw’omwoyo, enkolagana yaagwo ne Katonda, obulungi bw’empisa ennungi, n’okutuukagana kwayo n’Obutonde bwa Katonda; ku kitiibwa ky’amagezi, obwetaavu bw’okwefuga, obuvumu, n’obugabi, n’ensonyi n’obusirusiru bw’okwesanyusa mu kwegomba kwaffe.

Kaakano ng’Obukristaayo bwe bwatonda obuggya, nga bwe kyandibadde, ensi ey’empisa n’eddiini, ne buteeka buli kintu eky’amagezi, eky’obugezi, ekitukuvu, era ekyagalwa, mu kitangaala kyakyo ekituufu; bwe kityo omuntu yandisuubidde, nti okusomesebwa kw’abavubuka kwandisinzeewo obulungi era kwandirongooseddwa Obukristaayo, ng’okukkiriza n’enjigiriza z’eddiini bwe birongooseddwa bwo.

Nga bwe bwaleeta embeera empya ey’ebintu ng’eyo, era ne butubuulira mu bujjuvu bwe butyo ku butonde bw’omuntu, ebigendererwa by’okutondebwa kwe, embeera y’obulamu bwe; nga bwe bwanyweza ebirungi byaffe byonna n’ebibi, ne butuyigiriza engeri ez’okulongoosa emyoyo gyaffe, okusanyusa Katonda, n’okufuuka abasanyufu emirembe gyonna; omuntu yandirowoozezza mu butonde, nti buli nsi ey’Ekikristaayo ejjudde amasomero ag’okuyigiriza, si bibuuzo bitono n’eby’okuddamu eby’Ekitabo ky’Enjigiriza byokka, naye ag’okukola, okutendeka, n’okwegezaamu abavubuka mu ngeri ey’obulamu ey’ebweru ng’eyo, ebiragiro ebisinga obukulu, amateeka amakakali ennyo, n’enjigiriza ez’awaggulu ennyo ez’Obukristaayo bye byetaaga.

Okusomesebwa wansi wa Pythagoras, oba Socrates, tekwalina kigendererwa kirala, wabula okukuyigiriza okulowooza, okusalawo, okukola, n’okugoberera amateeka g’obulamu ng’ago Pythagoras ne Socrates ge baakozesanga.

Era si kya magezi mu ngeri y’emu okulowooza, nti okusomesebwa okw’Ekikristaayo tekusaanidde kubeera na kigendererwa kirala, wabula okuyigiriza abavubuka engeri y’okulowooza, n’okusalawo, n’okukola, n’okubeera, ng’amateeka amakakali ennyo ag’Obukristaayo bwe gali?

Waakiri, omuntu yandirowoozezza, nti, mu masomero gonna ag’Ekikristaayo, okuyigiriza abavubuka okutandika obulamu bwabwe mu mwoyo gw’Obukristaayo, mu bukakali bw’enneeyisa ng’obwo, okwefuga ng’okwo, obwegendereza, obwetoowaze, n’okwewaayo eri Katonda, nga Obukristaayo bwe bwetaaga, tekwandibadde kwa kufiibwako nnyo kwokka, naye emirundi kikumi okusinga, ekintu ekirala kyonna, oba ebintu ebirala byonna.

Kubanga okusomesebwa kwaffe kusaanidde okukoppa bamalayika baffe abatukuuma; obutateeka mu birowoozo byaffe kintu kyonna wabula eky’amagezi era ekitukuvu; okutuyamba okuzuula n’okuwangula buli kwegomba okw’obwereere mu mitima gyaffe, na buli kusalawo okw’obulimba mu birowoozo byaffe.

Era kya bwegendereza era kya magezi okusuubira n’okwetaaga omugaso guno gwonna okuva mu kusomesebwa okw’Ekikristaayo, nga bwe kiri okwetaaga eddagala okunyweza byonna ebituufu mu butonde bwaffe, n’okuggyawo ebyo ebirwadde era ebirumbiddwa endwadde.

Naye, woowe, okusomesebwa kwaffe okw’omulembe guno si kwa ngeri eno.

Empisa esooka gye tugezaako okuzuukusa mu baana, ge malala; okwegomba okw’akabi nga okwegomba okubi okw’omubiri. Tubasitula okubeera n’ebirowoozo eby’obwereere ku bo bennyini, era tukola buli kye tusobola okuzimbya emitima gyabwe n’okutegeera obusobozi bwabwe.

Engeri yonna ey’obulamu gye tubateekerateekera, twolekera omuliro n’obutaliimu bw’emitima gyabwe, era tubakubiriza mu buli kintu okuva mu nsonga ez’obwonoonefu. Tubasitula okukola okuva mu misingi gy’okuvuganya n’okwagala obukulu, okuva mu kitiibwa, obuggya, n’okwegomba okwawukana ku balala, basobole okusinga abalala, n’okumasamasa mu maaso g’ensi.

Tuddiŋŋana era tubakuutira ensonga zino, okutuusa lwe balowooza nti kitundu ku mulimu gwabwe okubeera ab’amalala, ab’obuggya, era abeekulumbaza olw’ebirungi byabwe.

Era bwe tumala okubayigiriza okunyooma okusingibwa omuntu yenna, obutagumiikiriza muvuganya, okulumwa ennyonta ya buli kyokulabirako eky’okutenderezebwa, obutamatira na kintu kyonna wabula ebitiibwa ebisinga obukulu, olwo tutandika okubudaabudibwa mu bo, ne tusuubiza ensi ebintu ebinene okuva mu bavubuka ab’omwoyo ogw’ekitiibwa bwe gutyo.

Abaana bwe baba nga bateekerwateekerwa obuweereza obutukuvu, tubateekera mu maaso omwogezi omu ow’ettutumu, okubuulira kwe okulungi okwamufuula eky’okwewuunyisa eky’omulembe, ne kumuyisa mu bitiibwa byonna n’ebifo ebya waggulu eby’Ekkanisa.

Tubakubiriza okubeera n’ebitiibwa bino mu maaso gaabwe, n’okusuubira empeera y’okusoma kwabwe okuva mu byo.

Omuvubuka bw’aba ng’ateekerwateekerwa obusuubuzi, tumugamba okutunuulira abasajja bonna abagagga ab’obusuubuzi obwo bwe bumu, n’okulowooza bangi kaakano nga bwe batambuzibwa mu bigaali byabwe eby’ekitiibwa, abaatandikira ku ddaala lye limu erya wansi nga ye bw’atandika kaakano. Tuzuukusa okwagala kwe okw’obukulu, era tufuba okuwa omutima gwe entambula entuufu, nga tumubuulira emirundi mingi omusuubuzi gundi bwe yafa nga mugagga nnyo.

Bw’aba wa kufuuka munnamateeka, olwo tuteeka mu maaso ge abawabuzi b’amateeka abakulu, abaami, abalamuzi, n’abakulu b’ensonga z’amateeka. Tumubuulira ssente nnyingi ki, n’okutenderezebwa okunene ki, ebigoberera okuwoza obulungi. Tumukubiriza okukwatibwa omuliro olw’ebintu bino, okusitula omwoyo gw’okuvuganya mu ye yennyini, n’obutamatira na kintu kyonna ekitono okusinga ebitiibwa ebisinga obukulu eby’ekkanzu empanvu.

Nti eno y’engeri y’okusomesebwa kwaffe okusinga obulungi, kyeyoleka nnyo nti tekyetaaga bukakafu bwonna; era nzikiriza nti waliwo abazadde batono, abatandisanyuse okulaba okuyigirizibwa kuno nga kuweebwa abaana baabwe buli lunaku.

Era oluvannyuma lw’ebyo byonna, twemulugunya ku biva mu malala; twewuunya okulaba abasajja abakulu nga basikirizibwa era nga bafugibwa okwagala obukulu, obuggya, okunyooma, n’okwegomba ekitiibwa; nga tetulowooza nti ebiseera byonna eby’obuvubuka bwabwe baayitibwanga eri ebikolwa byabwe byonna n’obunyiikivu, ku misingi gye gimu.

Oyigiriza omwana okunyooma okusingibwa, okulumwa ennyonta y’okwawukana ku balala n’okutenderezebwa; era kya kwewuunya nti agenda mu maaso okukola obulamu bwe bwonna mu ngeri y’emu?

Kaakano omuvubuka bw’aba ow’okubeera Omukristaayo okutuuka wano, okufuga omutima gwe olw’enjigiriza z’obwetoowaze, nnandyagadde okumanya mu kiseera ki mw’alina okubutandikira: oba, bw’aba ow’okubutandika n’akatono, lwaki tumukuza mu mpisa ezibuwakanya ddala?

Enjigiriza y’obwetoowaze nga eteekwa okuwulikika ng’ekalu era ey’obwavu eri omuvubuka, eyakubirizibwa mu bunyiikivu bwe bwonna okwagala obukulu, obuggya, okuvuganya, n’okwegomba ekitiibwa n’okwawukana ku balala! Era bw’aba nga talina kukola lwa misingi gino ng’afuuse musajja, lwaki tumuyita okukola olw’ogyo mu buvubuka bwe?

Obuggya bukkirizibwa abantu bonna okubeera okwegomba okusinga obutaba na mutima mugabi, okwa wansi, era okubi okuyinza okuyingira mu mutima gw’omuntu.

Era eno y’empisa ey’okussibwa, okuliisibwa, n’okunywezebwa, mu mitima gy’abavubuka?

Mmanyi nti kyogerwa, nti si buggya, wabula okuvuganya, okugenderera okuzuukusibwa mu mitima gy’abavubuka.

Naye kino kyogerwa bwereere. Kubanga abaana bwe bayigirizibwa obutagumiikiriza muvuganya, n’okunyooma okusingibwa omuntu yenna ow’emyaka gyabwe, bayigirizibwa mu lwatu era butereevu okubeera ab’obuggya. Kubanga tekisoboka muntu yenna okubeera n’okunyooma kuno okw’okusingibwa, n’okuvuganya kuno n’abavuganya, nga tayokebwa buggya eri abo bonna abalabika okumusinga, oba abafuna okwawukana kwonna okuva gy’ali. Kale abaana kye bayigirizibwa buggya bwennyini, nga bubikkiddwa bwokka n’erinnya ery’eddoboozi eritali ly’omuzizo nnyo.

Eky’okubiri, Obuggya bwe buba nga bukkirizibwa bwe butyo nti bubi, era nga kuvuganya kwokka okufubibwa okuzuukusibwa mu baana, ddala kwandibaddewo okufaayo okunene, abaana basobole okumanya ekimu n’ekirala:— basobole okukyawa ennyo ekimu ng’omusango omunene, nga bwe bayingiza ekirala mu mitima gyabwe.

Naye singa kino kyandigezeseddwa, obusiru bw’enjawulo wakati w’obuggya n’okuvuganya bwandiraze nti kyali kyangu okubyawula mu bigambo, okusinga okubyawula mu bikolwa.

Kubanga okuvuganya, bwe kunnyonnyolwa mu ngeri yaakwo esinga obulungi, si kirala wabula obuggya obulongooseddwa, oba okusingako ekitundu ekisinga okulabika obulungi eky’okwegomba okwo okuddugavu era okw’obutwa.

Era newankubadde kyangu okubyawula mu ndowooza, naye omufirosoofo asinga obugezi, ategeera obukugu bw’okwawula obulungi nnyo, bw’aba yeewaayo eri okuvuganya, ddala ajja kwesanga ng’abbidde mu buggya.

Kubanga obuggya si mpisa ya lubereberye, naye kye kiva mu butonde, ekyetaagisa, era ekitayinza kwewalika mu kuvuganya, oba okwegomba ekitiibwa.

Kale oyo anyweza ekimu mu mitima gy’abantu, ateekwa okunyweza n’ekirala eyo. Era tewali ngeri ndala esoboka ey’okuzikiriza obuggya, wabula okuzikiriza okuvuganya, oba okwegomba ekitiibwa. Kubanga ekimu bulijjo kirinnya era kikka nga kigoberera ekirala.

Mmanyi nti kyogerwa ng’okulwanirira enkola eno ey’okusomesebwa, nti okwagala obukulu, n’okwegomba ekitiibwa, byetaagisa okusitula abavubuka eri obunyiikivu; era nti singa twandibakaka enjigiriza z’obwetoowaze, twandimazeemu emitima gyabwe amaanyi, ne tubasuula mu kukooya n’obugayaavu.

Naye abantu abo aboogera kino, tebalowooza nti, ensonga eno, bw’eba erina amaanyi gonna, erina amaanyi ge gamu okuwakanya okukaka enjigiriza z’obwetoowaze ku basajja abakulu, tuleme okumalamu emitima gyabwe amaanyi, ne tubasuula mu kukooya n’obugayaavu.

Kubanga ani atalaba, nti abasajja ab’emyaka egy’omu makkati beetaaga obuyambi bw’amalala, okwagala obukulu, n’okwekulumbaza, okubasitula eri ebikolwa n’obunyiikivu, nga abaana bwe babwetaaga? Era kikakafu nnyo, nti ebiragiro by’obwetoowaze biwakanya nnyo ebigendererwa by’abasajja ng’abo, era bibanyiiza nnyo emitima gyabwe bwe bibakakibwako, okusinga bwe biri eri emitima gy’abavubuka.

Ensonga eno, n’olwekyo, eweebwa, lwaki abaana tebasaanidde kukuzibwa mu misingi gy’obwetoowaze obw’amazima, nsonga nnungi mu ngeri y’emu lwaki obwetoowaze obwo bwe bumu tebusaanidde kwetaagibwa okuva mu basajja abakulu.

Eky’okusatu, Abantu abo abalowooza nti abaana bandyonoonese, singa tebaasomesebwa bwe batyo, ka balowooze ku kino:—

Bayinza okulowooza, nti, singa abaana bonna baasomesebwa Mukama waffe Omutendereze, oba Abatume be Abatukuvu, emitima gyabwe gyandisuuliddwa mu kukooya n’obugayaavu?

Oba bayinza okulowooza, nti abaana ng’abo tebandikuziddwa mu misingi egisinga obuziba egy’obwetoowaze obukakali era obw’amazima? Bayinza okugamba nti Mukama waffe Omutendereze, eyali Omuntu asinga obuwombeefu n’obwetoowaze eyali abaddewo ku nsi, yaziyizibwa obwetoowaze bwe okubeera ekyokulabirako ekisinga obukulu eky’ebikolwa ebisaanidde era eby’ekitiibwa, ebyali bikoleddwa omuntu?

Bayinza okugamba nti Abatume be, abaabeera mu mwoyo ogwetoowaze ogwa Mukama waabwe, olw’ekyo baalekera awo okubeera ebikozesebwa ebitegana era ebikola eby’okukola ebirungi eri ensi yonna?

Okufumiitiriza okutono ng’okwo kumala okwoleka ebyekwaso byonna eby’obwavu eby’okusomesebwa mu malala n’okwagala obukulu.

Paternus yabeerawo nga emyaka ebikumi bibiri egiyise; yalina omwana omu yekka ow’obulenzi, gwe yasomesa yennyini mu nnyumba ye. Bwe baali batudde wamu mu nnimiro, omwana bwe yali ow’emyaka kkumi, Paternus n’atandika okumugamba bw’ati:

Ekiseera ekitono ky’omaze mu nsi, mwana wange, okimaze ddala nange; era okwagala kwange n’ekisa gy’oli bikuleetedde okuntunuulira nga mukwano gwo yekka era omuyambi, era ensibuko y’okubudaabudibwa kwonna n’essanyu by’onyumirwa; omutima gwo, mmanyi, gwandibadde mwetegefu okumenyeka olw’ennaku, singa wandirowoozezza nti luno lwe lunaku olusembayo lwe nnaabeera naawe.

Naye, mwana wange, newankubadde kaakano weerowooza okubeera omusanyufu ennyo, kubanga okutte omukono gwange, kaakano oli mu mikono, era wansi w’okufaayo okw’ekisa, okwa Kitaawo era Mukwano gwo asinga ennyo obukulu okusinga nze, okwagala kwe gy’oli kusinga nnyo okwange, era gw’ofunako emikisa egyo omuntu yenna afa gy’atayinza kuwa.

Katonda oyo gw’olabye nga nsinza buli lunaku, gwe nkoowoola buli lunaku okukuwa omukisa ggwe nange, n’abantu bonna, ebikolwa bye eby’ekyewuunyo ebiwandiikiddwa mu Byawandiikibwa ebyo by’osoma bulijjo; Katonda oyo eyatonda eggulu n’ensi, eyaleeta amataba ku nsi yonna, eyalokola Nuuwa mu lyato, eyali Katonda wa Ibulayimu, Isaaka, ne Yakobo, Yobu gwe yeebaza era gwe yatendereza mu kubonaabona okusinga obunene, eyanunula Abayisirayiri mu mikono gy’Abamisiri, eyali Omukuumi wa Yusufu omutuukirivu, Musa, Yoswa, ne Danyeri omutukuvu, eyatuma Bannabbi bangi bwe batyo mu nsi, eyatuma Omwana we Yesu Kristo okununula abantu; Katonda ono, akoze ebintu bino byonna ebinene, eyatonda obukadde bungi nnyo obw’abantu abaabeera era ne bafa nga tonnazaalibwa, emyoyo gy’abantu abalungi abaava mu bulamu buno gye gibeera naye kaakano, bamalayika abatabalika gwe basinza kaakano mu Ggulu; Katonda ono omukulu, Omutonzi w’ensi, owa bamalayika, n’abantu, ye Kitaawo akwagala era Mukwano gwo, Omutonzi wo omulungi era Akuliisa, gwe wafunako, so si nze, obulamu bwo emyaka kkumi egiyise, mu kiseera ekyo bwe nnasimba omuti ogwo omuto omugonvu ogw’omuvule gw’olaba wali.

Nze kennyini sinnatuuka ku kitundu ky’emyaka gy’omuti guno omunene ogw’ekisiikirize, wansi waagwo we tutudde; bajjajjaffe bangi baatuula wansi w’amatabi gaagwo, ffenna twaguyita ogwaffe nga buli omu kiseera kye, newankubadde guyimirira, ne gusuula bannannyini gwo, nga bwe gusuula ebikoola byagwo.

Olaba, mwana wange, ebbanga lino eggazi era eddene waggulu w’emitwe gyaffe, enjuba n’omwezi, n’emmunyeenye zonna gye zirabikira nga buli kimu kiseera kyakyo. Singa wanditwaliddwa waggulu ku kimu ku bintu bino ku bbanga lino eddene ennyo okuva gye tuli, wandizudde nate ebirala ebiri waggulu wo ennyo, ng’emmunyeenye z’olaba wano bwe ziri waggulu w’ensi. Singa wandigenze waggulu oba wansi, ebuvanjuba oba ebugwanjuba, obukiikakkono oba obukiikaddyo, wandisanze obugulumivu bwe bumu obutalina ntikko, n’obuziba bwe bumu obutalina ntobo.

Kyokka, mwana wange, Katonda mukulu nnyo bw’atyo, nti ebintu bino byonna bwe bigattibwa wamu biri ng’akasirikitu k’omusenyu kamu mu maaso ge. Kyokka ggwe ofiibwako Katonda ono omukulu era Kitaawe w’ensi zonna n’emyoyo gyonna, nga gy’obeera talina mwana mulala okuggyako ggwe, oba nga tewali kitonde kirala ky’alina kwagala n’okukuuma okuggyako ggwe wekka. Abala enviiri ez’oku mutwe gwo, akutunuulira, ng’oli mu tulo era ng’otunula, era akuwonyezza obulabe lukumi, ggwe ne nze bwe tutamanyiiko kintu.

Amaanyi gange nga matono, era nga sisobola kukukolera bingi, ofuze okulaba emirundi mingi. Obulwadde bwo obw’emabegako bukulaze nga bwe nnali sisobola kukukolera bingi mu mbeera eyo; era obulumi obw’emirundi mingi obw’omutwe gwo bukakafu obweyoleka nti sirina maanyi kubuggyawo.

Nsobola okukuleetera emmere n’eddagala, naye sirina maanyi kubifuula kukuwummuza n’okukuliisa. Katonda yekka y’ayinza okukukolera kino.

N’olwekyo, mwana wange, tyanga, era sinzanga, era yagalanga Katonda. Mazima amaaso go tegannasobola kumulaba. Naye ebintu byonna by’olaba bubonero bungi obw’amaanyi ge n’okubeerawo kwe, era ali kumpi naawe okusinga ekintu kyonna ky’oyinza okulaba.

Mutwale nga Mukama wo, era Kitaawo, era Mukwano gwo, mutunuulire waggulu ng’ensulo n’ensibuko y’ebirungi byonna by’ofunye okuyita mu mikono gyange; era onzisengamu ekitiibwa ng’omutwazi yekka era omuweereza w’ebirungi bya Katonda gy’oli. Era Oyo eyawa kitange omukisa nga sinnazaalibwa, ajja kukuwa omukisa nga mmaze okufa.

Obuto bwo n’omutima gwo omutono bimanyi bwokka amaka gange, era n’olwekyo olowooza nti tewali ssanyu bweru wa go.

Naye, mwana wange, oli wa maka amakulu okusinga agange; oli mmemba muto ow’amaka ga Kitaffe ono Ayinzabyonna ow’amawanga gonna, eyatonda ebika bya bamalayika ebitabalika, n’emirembe gy’abantu egitabalika, okubeera bammemba abeegatta ab’ekibiina kimu kye kimu mu Ggulu.

Okola bulungi okussa ekitiibwa n’okugondera obuyinza bwange kubanga Katonda ampadde obuyinza ku ggwe, okukukuza mu kumutya, n’okukukolera nga bajjajja abatukuvu abawandiikiddwako mu Byawandiikibwa bwe baakolera abaana baabwe, abali kaakano mu kuwummula n’emirembe ne Katonda.

Mu kiseera kitono nja kufa, nkuleke eri Katonda n’eri ggwe wennyini; era, Katonda bw’anaasonyiwa ebibi byange, nja kugenda eri Omwana we Yesu Kristo, mbeere mu bajjajja n’abannabbi, abatukuvu n’abajulizi, gye nnaakusabira, era nsuubire okutuuka kwo okw’emirembe mu kifo kye kimu.

N’olwekyo, mwana wange, fumiitirizanga ku bintu bino ebinene; era omwoyo gwo gujja kukula mangu ne gufuuka omukulu era ogw’ekitiibwa olw’okufumiitiriza bwe gutyo ku byo.

Ebirowoozo byo ka bitera okuleka ennimiro zino, n’ebibangirizi bino n’amalundiro, okulowooza ku Katonda n’Eggulu, okufumiitiriza ku bamalayika, n’emyoyo gy’abantu abalungi egibeera mu kitangaala ne mu kitiibwa.

Nga bwe wamanyiira okuntunuulira mu bikolwa byo byonna, era nga watyanga okukola ekintu kyonna, okuggyako nga wasooka okumanya kye njagala, bwe kityo ka kibeere kaakano etteeka ery’obulamu bwo, okutunuulira Katonda mu bikolwa byo byonna, okukola buli kintu mu kumutya, n’okwewala buli kintu ekitali ng’okwagala kwe bwe kuli.

Mumanyanga bulijjo mu mutima gwo, yigiriza ebirowoozo byo okumussaamu ekitiibwa mu buli kifo, kubanga tewali kifo w’atali.

Katonda akuuma ekitabo eky’obulamu, mwe biwandiikiddwa ebikolwa byonna eby’abantu bonna; erinnya lyo liri omwo, mwana wange; era bw’olifa, ekitabo kino kiribikkulwa mu maaso g’abantu ne bamalayika, era, ng’ebikolwa byo bwe binaasangibwa omwo, oba olikkirizibwa mu ssanyu ly’abantu abo abatukuvu abaafa nga ggwe tonnafa, oba oligobebwa mu myoyo emibi, egitaliddayo kulaba Katonda nate.

Tewerabiranga kitabo kino, mwana wange, kubanga kyawandiikibwa, kiteekwa okubikkulwa, oteekwa okukiraba, era oteekwa okusalirwa omusango okusinziira ku kyo. N’olwekyo, fuba okukijjuza ebikolwa byo ebirungi, omukono gwa Katonda ogwawandiika guleme kulabika nga gukuwakanya.

Katonda, mwana wange, kwagala kwokka, n’amagezi, n’obulungi; era buli kintu kye yakola, na buli kikolwa ky’akola, kye kiva mu byonna ebyo. N’olwekyo toyinza kusanyusa Katonda, okuggyako nga bw’ofuba okutambulira mu kwagala, amagezi, n’obulungi. Ng’amagezi gonna, okwagala, n’obulungi, bwe biva eri Katonda, bwe kityo tewali kirala wabula okwagala, amagezi, n’obulungi, ekiyinza okutwala eri Katonda.

Bw’oyagala ekyo Katonda ky’ayagala, okola wamu naye, weegatta naye; era bw’oyagala ky’atayagala, olwo omuwakanya, era weeyawula ku ye. Lino lye kkubo ery’amazima era ettuufu: lowooza Katonda ky’ayagala, naawe okyagale n’omutima gwo gwonna.

Okusooka byonna, mwana wange, sinza era tendereza Katonda, mulowoozeeko mu ngeri ey’obukulu, mwogereko n’ekitiibwa, gulumiza obulabirizi bwe, sinza amaanyi ge, genda emirundi mingi mu kusinza kwe, era omusabenga emirundi mingi era bulijjo.

Oluvannyuma lw’ekyo, yagalanga muliraanwa wo, be bantu bonna, n’ekisa n’okwagala ng’okwo nga bwe weeyagala. Lowooza Katonda bw’ayagala abantu bonna, bw’abasaasira, bw’abalumirirwa, bw’abakuuma n’obwegendereza; olwo ofube okwagala ensi, nga Katonda bw’agyagala.

Katonda ayagala abantu bonna babeere basanyufu; n’olwekyo naawe yagala era weegombe kye kimu. Abantu bonna byokulabirako binene eby’Okwagala kwa Katonda; n’olwekyo abantu bonna ka babeere byokulabirako by’okwagala kwo.

Naye okusinga byonna, mwana wange, tegeera kino; tokolanga kintu kyonna olw’okuyomba, oba obuggya, oba okuvuganya, oba okwekulumbaza. Tokolanga kintu kyonna olw’okusinga abantu abalala, wabula olw’okusanyusa Katonda, era kubanga kwe kwagala kwe okole buli kintu mu ngeri esinga obulungi gy’osobola.

Kubanga bwe kiba nti omulundi gumu essanyu gy’oli okusinga abantu abalala, mpolampola kijja kufuuka essanyu gy’oli okulaba abantu abalala nga si balungi nga ggwe.

N’olwekyo goba buli kirowoozo eky’amalala n’okwagala okwawukana ku balala, era omanyiire okusanyukira obulungi bwonna n’obutuukirivu bwa bannaffe ebitonde, era osanyuke okulaba ebikolwa byabwe ebirungi nga bw’osanyukira ebibyo.

Kubanga nga Katonda bw’asanyukira ebikolwa byabwe ebirungi, nga bw’asanyukira ebibyo; bwe kityo osaanidde okwegomba, nti buli kintu eky’amagezi, era ekitukuvu, era ekirungi, kikolebwe mu ngeri ey’awaggulu abantu abalala, nga bw’okikola ggwe wennyini.

N’olwekyo kino kibeere kyokka ekikukubiriza era ekikusitula eri ebikolwa byonna ebirungi, obunyiikivu obw’obwesigwa, n’emirimu, okukola buli kintu mu ngeri etuukiridde era ennungi ennyo nga bw’osobola, olw’ensonga eno yokka, kubanga kisanyusa Katonda, ayagala obutuukirivu bwo, era awandiika ebikolwa byo byonna mu kitabo. Bwe ndimala okufa, mwana wange, olibeera nnannyini bugagga bwange bwonna, obunaasinga ennyo ebyetaago by’amaka gamu. N’olwekyo, nga bw’olina okusaasira emyoyo gy’abantu, n’okubeegombera essanyu lye limu naawe mu Ggulu, bwe kityo saasira emibiri gyabwe, era ofube okubafuula abasanyufu nga ggwe ku nsi.

Nga Katonda bwe yatonda ebintu byonna olw’obulungi obw’awamu obw’abantu bonna, bwe kityo ekitundu ekyo eky’ebyo ekikugweddeko ka kikozesebwe, nga Katonda bw’ayagala byonna bikozesebwe, olw’obulungi obw’awamu obwa bonna.

Kola ebirungi, mwana wange, okusooka byonna eri abo abasinga okubisaanira; naye jjukira okukola ebirungi eri bonna. Aboonoonyi abasinga obubi bafuna buli lunaku ebyokulabirako by’obulungi bwa Katonda gye bali; abaliisa era abakuuma, basobole okwenenya, n’okudda gy’ali: naawe n’olwekyo koppa Katonda, era tolowooza nti waliwo muntu mubi nnyo okufuna obuyambi bwo n’ekisa kyo, bw’olaba nti abyetaaga.

Nkuyigiriza Olulattini n’Oluyonaani, si lwa kwegomba okubeera omukebezi omukulu w’ebiwandiiko, omuwandiisi w’ebitontome omulungi, oba omwogezi omukugu; saagala mutima gwo kuwulira kwegomba kwonna ku kuno; kubanga okwegomba ebirungi bino butaliimu bwa mutima, era abakugu mu byo emirundi mingi basajja abeekulumbaza. Kubanga okwegomba ekintu kyonna ekitali kirungi kya mazima, kukendeeza okwewaayo kw’omutima eri ekyo ekiri ekirungi eky’amazima.

Naye nkuyigiriza ennimi zino, mu biseera ebisaanidde olyoke otunuulire ebyafaayo by’emirembe egyayita, n’oyiga enkola z’obulabirizi bwa Katonda ku nsi: nti, ng’osoma ebiwandiiko by’Abagezi ab’edda, olyoke olabe amagezi n’empisa ennungi nga bwe byabanga ettendo ly’abantu abakulu ab’emirembe gyonna, era onyweze omutima gwo olw’ebigambo byabwe eby’amagezi.

N’olwekyo amazima n’obwangu bibeere kyokka eky’okwewunda eky’olulimi lwo, era tosoma kirala wabula engeri y’okulowooza ku bintu byonna nga bwe bisaanidde, okulonda buli kintu ekisinga obulungi, okubeera ng’amagezi n’entegeka bwe biri, n’okukola mu buli kitundu ky’obulamu bwo ng’otuukagana n’okwagala kwa Katonda.

Soma engeri y’okujjuza omutima gwo ddala okwagala Katonda, n’okwagala muliraanwa wo, olwo omatire obutabeera muyivu wa buziba okusingawo, wadde omwami ow’empisa ennungi okusingawo, okusinga empisa zino bwe zinaakufuula. Ng’eddiini ey’amazima bw’etali kirala wabula obutonde obwangu obufugibwa amagezi amatuufu, bwe kityo eyagala era yeetaaga obwangu obunene n’obutaba na kyemulugunyo mu bulamu. N’olwekyo weewale okwolesa kwonna okutali kwetaagisa okw’eby’okwewunda n’abaweereza, era ennyumba yo ka eteekebwemu bulungi ebyetaago eby’ekigero. Tolowooza obugagga bwo kye busobola okukuwa, wabula amagezi amatuufu kye geetaaga.

Okwambala kwo kubeere kwa bwegendereza, okuyonjo, era okw’ekitiibwa, si kwa kwolesa bulungi bw’omubiri gwo, wabula okulangirira obwegendereza bw’omutima gwo, ekyambalo kyo eky’ebweru kifaanane obwangu obw’omunda n’obutaba na kyemulugunyo obw’omutima gwo. Kubanga kya magezi nnyo okubeera omuntu omu, ow’ekitundu kimu kyonna, n’olabika kungulu nga bw’oli munda.

Ku bikwata ku mmere yo n’ebyokunywa, mu byo kuuma amateeka agasinga obukulu ag’okwefuga n’obwegendereza obw’Ekikristaayo; tunuulira omubiri gwo bwokka ng’omuweereza era omukozi w’omwoyo gwo; era oguliise bwokka mu ngeri, esobola okusinga okuguweereza n’obwetoowaze era n’obuwulize.

Naye, mwana wange, kuuma kino ng’ekintu ekikulu ennyo, kye nnaakujjukizanga ebbanga lyonna lye nnaabeera naawe:—

Kyawa era onyoome ekitiibwa kyonna eky’abantu, kubanga si kirala wabula obusirusiru bw’abantu. Kye kyambika ekisinga obunene, era omulyamu asinga obunene, gw’oyinza okuyingiza mu mutima gwo.

Yagala obwetoowaze mu ngeri zaabwo zonna; bukole mu bitundu byabwo byonna, kubanga y’embeera esinga ekitiibwa ey’omwoyo gw’omuntu; bujja kutereeza omutima gwo n’okwagala kwo eri Katonda, era bukujjuze buli mpisa ey’ekisa era ey’okwagala eri abantu.

N’olwekyo buli lunaku lubeere lunaku lwa bwetoowaze; kkiriza okukka eri obunafu bwonna n’obutasobola bwa bannaffe ebitonde, bikka ku bunafu bwabwe, yagala obulungi bwabwe, kubiriza empisa zaabwe ennungi, yamba mu bwetaavu bwabwe, sanyukira obugagga bwabwe, saasira ennaku yaabwe, kkiriza omukwano gwabwe, buusa amaaso obutaba na kisa bwabwe, sonyiwa ettima lyabwe, beera muddu wa baddu, era kkiriza okukola emirimu egisinga obwavu eri abantu abasinga obwavu.

Toluubirira kirala wabula obulongoofu bwo n’obutuukirivu bwo, era tobeera na kwegomba bukulu, wabula okukola buli kintu mu ngeri ey’amagezi era ey’eddiini bwe etyo, nti osobola okusanyuka nti Katonda ali buli wantu, era alaba era yeetegereza ebikolwa byo byonna. Okugezesebwa okusinga obunene okw’obwetoowaze ye nneeyisa ey’obwetoowaze eri abo b’oyenkanya nabo mu myaka, mu bugagga, ne mu mbeera y’obulamu. N’olwekyo weegendereze entambula zonna ez’omutima gwo eri abantu bano. Enneeyisa yo yonna gye bali ka efugibwe okwagala okutaliimu bunnanfuusi. Tobeera na kwegomba kuteeka n’omu ku b’oyenkanya nabo wansi wo, wadde obusungu eri abo abandyagadde okwessa waggulu wo. Bwe baba ab’amalala, balwadde obulwadde obubi ennyo; n’olwekyo, ka bafune okusaasira kwo okw’ekisa; era oboolyawo obuwombeefu bwo buyinza okufuuka ensonga ey’okuwona kwabwe. Naye singa obwetoowaze bwo tebubagasa, kyokka bujja kuba kirungi ekisinga obunene ky’oyinza okwekolera ggwe wennyini.

Jjukira nti waliwo omusajja omu yekka mu nsi, gw’olina okuvuganya naye bulijjo, n’ofuba bulijjo okumusinga, era oyo ye ggwe wennyini.

Ekiseera eky’okukola ebiragiro bino, mwana wange, kijja kuggwa mangu gy’oli, ensi ejja kuseerera mangu okuva mu mikono gyo, oba okusingako ggwe ojja kuseerera mangu okugiyitamu; kirabika ng’olunaku lwa jjo bwe nnafuna okuyigirizibwa kuno kwe kumu okuva eri kitange omwagalwa, kwe nkulekera kaakano. Era Katonda eyampa amatu okuwulira, n’omutima okufuna, kitange bye yaŋŋamba, nsuubira, ajja kukuwa ekisa okwagala n’okugoberera okuyigirizibwa kwe kumu.

Bw’atyo Paternus bwe yasomesa omwana we.

Waliwo kaakano ayinza okulowooza nti okusomesebwa ng’okwo kwandinafuyizza era ne kumalamu emitima gy’abavubuka amaanyi, ne kunyaga ensi emirimu gyonna egisaanidde era egy’amagezi?

Kuli wala nnyo n’ekyo, nti tewali kintu ekisinga okuyinza okugulumiza n’okusitula omutima, n’okugutegekera okwegezaamu okusinga obuzira okw’empisa ennungi zonna.

Kubanga ani anaagamba, nti okwagala Katonda, okwegomba okumusanyusa, okwagala muliraanwa waffe, okwagala amazima ag’amagezi, n’empisa ennungi, okufumiitiriza ku butaggwaawo, n’empeera z’okutya Katonda, si nsonga za maanyi okusingawo ez’ebikolwa ebinene era ebirungi, okusinga okutenderezebwa abantu okutono okutali kukakafu?

Ku ludda olulala, tewali kintu mu mazima ekisinga okunafuya omutima, n’okugussa mu bwavu n’obuddu, tewali kintu ekiguleetera obutabeera mukama nnyo w’ebikolwa byagwo, oba obutasobola nnyo kugoberera magezi, okusinga okwagala okutenderezebwa n’ekitiibwa.

Kubanga, ng’okutenderezebwa n’ekitiibwa bwe biweebwa emirundi mingi ebintu n’abantu, gye bitasaanidde, ng’ekyo ekisinga okutenderezebwa n’okuweebwa ekitiibwa, kye kyo ekisinga okusanyusa okwegomba, emisono, n’empisa embi ez’ensi; bwe kityo oyo akola olw’okwegomba okutenderezebwa n’okukubirwa mu ngalo, ateekwa okuleka buli musingi omulala; ateekwa okugamba nti ekiddugavu kyeru, okufuula ekikaawa okuba ekiwoomerera, n’ekiwoomerera okuba ekikaawa, n’okukola ebintu ebisinga obwavu, ebisinga obubi, alyoke akubirwe mu ngalo.

Kubanga mu nsi eyonoonese, ng’eno bw’eri, ebikolwa ebisaanidde biyinza okuwanirirwa obulungi bwabyo bwokka, gye bitenderezebwa n’okuweebwa ekitiibwa, emirundi mingi bivumibwa era biyigganyizibwa.

Kale okusomesa abaana ku nsonga y’okuvuganya, oba okwegomba ekitiibwa, mu nsi ekitiibwa kyennyini gye kiri eky’obulimba, era gye kisinga okuweebwa obubi, kwe kuzikiriza obwesimbu obw’obutonde n’obuvumu bw’emitima gyabwe, n’okubawa okukyamira, okunaasinga okubatwala eri ebikolwa ebibi era ebya wansi, okusinga eri ebikolwa ebinene era ebisaanidde.

fields.title: Okulaga engeri y’okusomesa abawala bw’efuula ekizibu gye bali okuyingira mu mwoyo gw’obwetoowaze obw’Ekikristaayo. Nga bwe bayisibwa obubi era ne bonoonebwa olw’okusomesebwa okw’engeri eyo. Omwoyo gw’okusomesebwa okusingako obulungi, nga guragibwa mu kifaananyi kya Eusebia
fields.body_html:
ENGERI eyo ey’omutima eyigirizibwa era ekubirizibwa mu kusomesa abawala, ebaleetera obuzibu bungi nnyo okuyingira mu kutegeera n’okwegezaamu obwetoowaze ng’okwo, omwoyo gw’Obukristaayo nga bwe gwetaaga.

Okusomesa obulungi ekikula kino kikulu nnyo ddala eri obulamu bw’abantu. Tewali kintu ekisinga okwagalibwa olw’obulungi obw’awamu obw’ensi yonna. Kubanga newankubadde abakazi tebaddukanya busuubuzi n’emirimu gy’ensi, naye nga bwe bali bamaama, era abakyala ab’amaka, abalina okumala ekiseera nga balabirira okusomesebwa kw’abaana baabwe ab’ebika byombi, bakwasibwa ekyo ekisinga obukulu eri obulamu bw’abantu. Olw’ensonga eno, abakazi abalungi oba ababi bayinza okukola ebirungi oba ebibi bingi mu nsi, nga abasajja abalungi oba ababi bwe bakola mu mirimu egisinga obukulu egy’obulamu.

Kubanga, ng’obulamu n’amaanyi, oba obunafu bw’emibiri gyaffe, bwe biva ennyo mu ngeri gye baatuyisangamu nga tukyali bato; bwe kityo obulamu oba obusirusiru bw’emitima gyaffe tebiva kitono mu mpisa ezo ezaasooka n’engeri ez’okulowooza, ze twafuna n’obunyiikivu okuva mu kwagala, ekisa, obuyinza, n’okunyumya okutakoma okwa bamaama baffe.

Nga bwe tuyita olulimi lwaffe olusooka olulimi lw’omu nda, bwe kityo tuyinza okuyita mu butuufu empisa zaffe ezaasooka empisa ez’omu nda; era oboolyawo kiyinza okulabika nga kyangu okwerabira olulimi, okusinga okuleka ddala empisa ezo, ze twayigira mu kisenge ky’abaana.

N’olwekyo, kya kukungubagira nnyo, nti ekikula kino, ebintu bingi bwe bityo kwe byesigamye, abasooka okukola emibiri gyaffe n’emitima gyaffe byombi, tebasomesebwa mu malala gokka, naye mu kitundu kyago ekisinga obusirusiru era ekisinga okunyoomebwa.

Mazima tebakkirizibwa kuvuganya naffe ku mpeera ez’amalala ez’obukugu ne ssaayansi, ez’obuyivu n’okwogera obulungi, mwe nneekengera nnyo nti emirundi mingi bandituusinze; naye tubakyusiza okusoma obulungi bw’endabika n’okwambala, era ensi yonna eyekobaana okubaleetera obutalowooza ku kirala. Bakitaabwe ne bannyaabwe, mikwano gyabwe n’ab’ekika kyabwe, balabika nga tebalina kwegomba kulala eri omuwala omuto, wabula abeere n’olususu olulungi, endabika ennungi, ayambale bulungi, era azine mu ngeri eyewuunyisa.

Kaakano singa okwagala ennyo emibiri gyaffe, okwegomba obulungi bw’endabika, okwagala okwambala, bwe biba ekitundu ky’amalala (nga ddala kye kitundu kyago ekisinga okunyoomebwa), eddaala erisooka eridda eri obwetoowaze bw’omukazi, lirabika ng’eryetaaga okwenenya olw’okusomesebwa kwe.

Kubanga kiteekwa okukkirizibwa nti, okwogera mu ngeri ey’awamu, abazadde abalungi tebasinga kwagala nnyo bawala baabwe, okusinga bwe babalaba nga beeyagala nnyo bo bennyini, era nga bambadde mu ngeri, eri ensonyi ennene eri obuzito n’obwegendereza bw’obulamu obw’Ekikristaayo.

Era ekifuula ensonga eno okusingawo okukungubagirwa kye kino, nti abakazi tebonoonebwa bokka olw’okusomesebwa kuno, naye twonoona ekitundu ekyo eky’ensi, ekyandibadde kituwa ebyokulabirako ebisinga eby’okutya Katonda okw’ettutumu era okw’awaggulu.

Kubanga nzikiriza nti kiyinza okukakasibwa, nti okusinga obungi waliwo okutegeera okusinga obulungi, omutima ogusinga obutangaavu, okutegeera okusinga obwangu, n’empisa ezisinga obukkakkamu mu kikula ekyo okusinga mu kirala.

Empisa zino zonna, singa zaalongoosebwa ddala olw’okusoma okusaanidde n’enkola ez’okusomesa ez’obwegendereza, oboolyawo zandibatutte ku ntikko ez’okutya Katonda ezisingawo, okusinga ezo ezisangibwa mu basajja abasinga obungi.

Olw’ensonga eno, njogera ku nsonga eno mu lwatu n’obwangu bungi bwe ntyo, kubanga kya kukungubagira nnyo, nti abantu abalina mu butonde ebisaanyizo okubeera ebyokulabirako ebinene eby’okutya Katonda, bafuulibwa, olw’okusomesebwa okukyamu, eby’okulaba eby’obwavu era ebyeyolesa eby’obutaliimu obusinga obunene.

Ekkanisa edda yalina abatukuvu ab’ettutumu mu kikula ekyo, era kiyinza okulowoozebwa mu magezi, nti kiva ku kusomesebwa kwabwe okw’obwavu era okw’obutaliimu kwokka, ekitiibwa kino eky’ekikula kyabwe okusinga obungi kyakoma ku mirembe egyayita.

Obwonoonefu bw’ensi bubasanyusa mu butaliimu bungi, era abantu balabika nga tebabatunuulira mu ngeri ndala yonna wabula nga bifaananyi bingi ebisiigiddwa langi, ebirina okusikiriza n’okusanyusa okwegomba kwabwe; kale singa abakazi bangi beekulumbaza, baba bawewufu, bitonde bya kwewunda, balina kino eky’okwewolereza, nti si bokka nga bwe baafuulibwa okusomesebwa kwabwe, naye nga bwe bakkirizibwa okubeera ensi esinga obungi.

Naye olwo basaanidde okulowooza, nti mikwano gy’obutaliimu bwabwe si mikwano gyabwe; basaanidde okulowooza nti balina okubeera ku lwabwe bennyini; nti balina omugabo munene mu butonde obw’amagezi nga abasajja; nti balina ensonga nnene ey’okwefuula, n’obwetaavu bungi obw’okwegomba, ebirungi ebisinga obukulu eby’empisa ennungi ez’Ekikristaayo era enywevu, nga abafirosoofo Abakristaayo abasinga obuzito n’amagezi.

Basaanidde okulowooza nti bakozesebwa bubi, era bakolebwako ebibi, era balyamibwa okuva ku butuukirivu bwabwe bwokka, buli lwe bayigirizibwa nti ekintu kyonna kya kwewunda gye bali, ekitali kya kwewunda mu basinga amagezi mu bantu.

Kitera okwogerwa, nti abakazi mu butonde balina emitima emitono era egy’obutaliimu; naye kino nkitunuulira ng’eky’obulimba era ekitaliimu magezi, nga okugamba nti abasala ennyama mu butonde bakambwe; kubanga, ng’obukambwe bwabwe bwe butava mu butonde bwabwe, naye mu ngeri yaabwe ey’obulamu, ekyusizza obutonde bwabwe; bwe kityo obutono bwonna n’obutaliimu obulabibwa mu mitima gy’abakazi, buli ng’obukambwe bw’abasala ennyama, empisa eteekebwa mu bo olw’obulamu obwo bwe bayigirizibwa era bwe bamanyiira okubeeramu.

Waakiri kino kiteekwa okwogerwa, nti tetuyinza kuvunaana butonde bwabwe kintu kyonna, okutuusa nga tufaayo nti tebwonoonebwa kusomesebwa kwabwe.

Era, ku ludda olulala, singa kyali kituufu nti mu butonde baali beekulumbaza era bawewufu bwe batyo, olwo nga kusinga nnyo okunenyezebwa okusomesebwa okwo, okulabika ng’okwateekebwateekebwa okunyweza n’okwongera obusirusiru buno n’obunafu bw’emitima gyabwe!

Kubanga singa kyali kya mpisa nnungi mu mukazi okubeera ow’amalala era eyeekulumbaza ye yennyini, kumpi tetwandisobodde kukozesa ngeri esinga obulungi okusitula okwegomba kuno mu ye, okusinga ezo ezikozesebwa kaakano mu kusomesebwa kwe.

Matilda mukazi mulungi, ayigiriziddwa bulungi empisa, ow’amagezi mangi, era ow’eddiini nnyo. Alina abawala basatu b’asomesa yennyini. Tajja kubakwasa muntu mulala yenna, wadde mu ssomero lyonna, olw’okutya nti bayinza okuyiga ekintu kyonna ekibi. Abeerawo n’omusomesa w’amazina ebiseera byonna by’amala nabo, kubanga ayagala okuwulira buli kigambo kye bagambibwa. Abawulidde nga basoma Ebyawandiikibwa emirundi mingi bwe gityo, nti basobola okuddiŋŋana ekitundu ekinene ekyabyo awatali kitabo: era kumpi tewali kitabo kirungi eky’okwewaayo eri Katonda, ky’otayinza kusanga mu bisenge byabwe.

Singa Matilda yabeerawo mu mirembe egyasooka egy’Obukristaayo, bwe bwakolebwanga mu bujjuvu n’obwangu bw’enjigiriza zaabwo, oboolyawo yandibadde omu ku batukuvu baabwo abasinga obukulu. Naye nga bwe yazaalibwa mu biseera eby’obwonoonefu, gy’abulwa ebyokulabirako by’obutuukirivu obw’Ekikristaayo, era kumpi teyalabangako kutya Katonda okusinga okukwe; bwe kityo alina ebibi bingi, era abiyisa byonna mu bawala be.

Matilda teyayambalanga mu ngeri ya bwavu mu bulamu bwe; era tewali kimusanyusa mu kwambala, wabula ekyo ekiri eky’ebbeeyi ennyo era ekirungi mu maaso.

Abawala be balaba obunyiikivu bwe obunene ku ddiini, naye olwo balaba obunyiikivu obwenkanankana ku bika byonna eby’okwewunda. Balaba nti tagayaalira kwewaayo kwe eri Katonda, naye olwo balaba ng’asinga okufaayo okukuuma langi y’olususu lwe, n’okuziyiza enkyukakyuka ezo ebiseera n’obukadde ze bimutiisa nazo.

Batya okumusisinkana, bwe baba nga basubiddwa ekkanisa; naye olwo basinga okutya okumulaba, bwe baba nga tebasibiddwa nnyo mu ngoye zaabwe nga bwe kisoboka.

Emirundi mingi abalaga ekifaananyi kye, ekyakubibwa kitaabwe bwe yamwagala. Ababuulira nga bwe yatabukatabuka olw’okwegomba bwe yamulaba omulundi ogusooka, era nti teyandibadde na langi ya lususu nnungi bw’etyo, okuggyako olw’obunyiikivu bwa nnyina omulungi, eyafaayo ennyo ku yo.

Matilda yeemalidde nnyo ku bukugu bwonna obw’okulongoosa okwambala kwabwe, nti alina endowooza empya kumpi buli lunaku, era taleka kya kwewunda kyonna nga tategezezza, okuva ku jjinja ery’omuwendo erisinga obwebbeeyi okutuuka ku kimuli ekisinga obwavu. Mukakali nnyo era mukebezi mu kusalawo kwe, awulira nnyo ensobi esinga obutono, nti omuweereza omukazi emirundi mingi akakibwa okwambaza n’okwambula abawala be emirundi esatu oba ena mu lunaku, nga tannamatira.

Ku bikwata ku kuteeka obubala ku maaso, ekyo akyekuumira yekka, kubanga, bw’agamba, bwe bitateekebwako n’amagezi, bisinga kwonoona okusinga okulongoosa amaaso.

Abaana balaba bulungi nnyo empisa ya nnyaabwe, nti beefuula n’okusanyukira ennyo okwambala, n’okwagala ennyo buli kya kwewunda ekitono okusinga bwe bakyagala ddala, olw’okufuna obusiimi bwe bwokka.

Baalaba mukulu waabwe omulundi gumu ng’atuusibwa ku maziga, era obujeemu bwe ne bunenyezebwa nnyo olw’okwaŋŋanga okugamba, nti alowooza kisinga obulungi okubikka ensingo, okusinga okutambula nga yeeyambudde nnyo nga okwambala okw’omulembe guno bwe kwetaaga.

Abakomako ku mmere yaabwe, era yeegendereza nnyo ku bye balya n’ebye banywa, era ababuulira endabika ennungi nnyingi ze yalaba nga zoonooneka mu biseera bye, olw’obutafaayo ng’okwo. Akabumbe bwe kavaayo ku maaso gaabwe, atya nnyo, era bo bennyini batya okumulaba nako, nga gy’obeera bakoze ekibi ekinene.

Buli lwe batandika okulabika nga balamu nnyo era nga bamyufu nnyo, ayita omusawo okuyamba; era singa eddagala, oba ebiwundu ebiggulwa, binaakuuma langi y’olususu obutakyuka kufuuka mbi oba emmyufu, alowooza nti bikozeseddwa bulungi.

Mu ngeri eno bafuuka bitonde bya bwavu, ebisiiwuuse, ebirwalalwala, ebinafu, ebizirika olw’obutaba na maanyi, ebikaaba olw’ebigwawo ebisinga obutono, ebizirika olw’ekintu kyonna ekibitiisa, era nga kumpi tebisobola kugumiikiriza buzito bw’engoye zaabyo ezisinga obulungi.

Omuwala omukulu yabeerawo ebbanga lyonna lye yasobola wansi w’enkola eno, n’afa mu mwaka gwe ogw’amakumi abiri.

Omubiri gwe bwe gwasalibwa ne kirabika nti embiriizi ze zaali zikulidde mu kibumba kye, era nti ebyenda bye ebirala byali byonoonese nnyo olw’okunyigibwa wamu n’ekyambalo kye ekisiba, nnyina kye yalagira okusibibwa ennyo, nti emirundi mingi kyamuleeteranga amaziga mu maaso ng’omuweereza amwambaza.

Omuwala we omuto yaddukira n’omukubi wa zzaala, omusajja ow’endabika ennungi ennyo, atalina amusinga mu kwambala ne mu kuzina.

Matilda agamba nti, yandifudde olw’ennaku olw’ekigwawo kino, okuggyako nti omwoyo gwe ogumulamula gumugamba, nti tewali kye yakyongerako ye yennyini. Ajuliza ebisenge byabwe, n’ebitabo byabwe eby’okwewaayo eri Katonda, okuwa obujulizi ku kufaayo kw’akoze okunyweza abaana be mu bulamu obw’okutya Katonda okunywevu n’okwewaayo eri Katonda.

Kaakano, newankubadde sigenderera kugamba, nti tewali bawala bakuzibwa mu ngeri esinga eno obulungi, kubanga nsuubira nti waliwo bangi abakuzibwa bwe batyo; naye kino nzikiriza nti kiyinza okwogerwa, nti ekitundu ekisinga ennyo obunene ku bo tebakuzibwa bulungi bwe batyo, oba okumanyiizibwa eddiini nnyingi bwe etyo, nga mu kyokulabirako kino.

Emitima gyabwe gikyusibwa nnyo eri okufaayo ku bulungi bw’endabika yaabwe n’okwambala, n’okwesanyusa mu kwegomba okw’obwereere, nga mu nsonga eno, awatali kubeera na mateeka ga kwewaayo eri Katonda ng’ago okugiwakanya. Kale singa okutya Katonda okunywevu, obwetoowaze, n’okwetegeera okw’obwegendereza, byetaagibwa nnyo mu kikula ekyo, kye kiva mu lwatu era mu butonde mu kusomesebwa okw’obutaliimu era okw’obwonoonefu.

Era bwe baba nga emirundi mingi beetegefu nnyo okukkiriza abakyakala abasooka, abeeraga, n’abazinyi abalungi, okubeera abaami baabwe, si kya kwewuunya nti bandyagadde ekyo mu basajja, kye bayigirizibwa okwewuunya mu bo bennyini.

Era bwe balabibwa emirundi mingi nga bafiirwa eddiini eyo entono gye baayigirizibwa mu buvubuka bwabwe, si kya kwewuunya okusinga okulaba ekimuli ekitono nga kinyigibwa era nga kittibwa mu muddo omubi omunene.

Kubanga amalala ag’omubiri n’okwefuula, okusanyukira obulungi bw’endabika n’okwagala ennyo eby’okwewunda, mpisa ziteekwa oba okutta eddiini yonna mu mwoyo, oba bo bennyini okuttibwa yo; tebiyinza kukulaakulanira wamu okusinga obulamu n’obulwadde.

Abantu abamu abasalawo mu bwangu oboolyawo wano bajja kugamba, nti nkozesa obukakali bungi nnyo okuwakanya ekikula kino.

Naye abantu abasinga amagezi bajja kulaba mangu, nti ekikula nkirekera ddala, era nnumiriza okusomesebwa kwabwe kwokka; nti si kubalekera kwokka, naye mpolereza omugaso gwabwe, nnyweza ekitiibwa kyabwe, nnyonnyola obutuukirivu bwabwe, ntendereza empisa zaabwe ez’obutonde, era nvumirira kwokka okusomesebwa okwo okukola ebibi bwe kutyo eri omugaso gwabwe, okutoowaza bwe kutyo ekitiibwa kyabwe, era okubanyagako omugaso gw’obutonde bwabwe n’empisa zaabwe ennungi ennyo.

Okusomesebwa kwabwe, njatula, siyinza kukulekera; naye ensonga yokka eri nti, kubanga kwe mulabe waabwe asinga obunene; kubanga kunyagako ensi emikisa mingi bwe gityo, n’Ekkanisa abatukuvu bangi bwe batyo, nga bwe kyandisuubiddwa mu magezi okuva mu bantu abaakolebwa bwe batyo empisa zaabwe ez’obutonde eri obulungi bwonna n’ekisa, era abasaanyizibwa bwe batyo obutangaavu n’okumasamasa kw’emitima gyabwe okufumiitiriza, okwagala, n’okwewuunya buli kintu ekitukuvu, eky’empisa ennungi, era eky’obwakatonda.

Singa wano kyandyogeddwa, nti mpitiriza okuvunaana okusomesebwa kwabwe, era nti tekubakola kabi kangi nga bwe ndowooza:

Kiyinza okuddibwamu, nti newankubadde seefuula kulaga kigero kituufu eky’akabi akakolebwa kwo, naye okukyamira kwakwo okweyoleka era okw’obutonde okukola akabi kumala okuwa obutuufu okuvumirira kwakwo okusinga okubeera okujjuvu.

Naye singa omuntu yenna yandyagadde okumanya abakazi nga bwe bakolebwako akabi okusomesebwa kuno okutwalira awamu; bw’alowooza nti wayinza obutabaawo malala ga mubiri oba okweyagala okw’obwereere, mu abo abateekebwako obubala era abambazibwa n’okumasamasa kungi bwe kutyo okw’obukugu n’eby’okwewunda; ka akole bwokka okugezesa kuno okuddako buli w’ayagala.

Ka amanyise bwokka omukazi yenna ow’engeri eyo endowooza ye ku ye: sitegeeza nti amugamba mu maaso ge, oba nti akikola mu ngeri yonna ey’obujoozi mu lwatu; naye ka ateekateeke engeri esinga empisa ennungi, ey’ekyama, ey’omukwano gy’ayinza okulowoozaako, okumumanyisa bwokka endowooza ye, nti alowooza nti si mulungi mu ndabika, wadde ayambala bulungi, wadde eby’okwewunda bimusaanira; era nkakasa nti ajja kuzuula nti waliwo abakazi batono nnyo abambadde obulungi abatalimuyisa bubi olw’endowooza ye obwereere, newankubadde etamanyiddwa wabula bo bokka; era nti tajja kumala bbanga ddene nga tannalaba bivaamu mu busungu bwabwe.

Naye singa okugezesa ng’okwo kwandimulaze nti waliwo abakazi batono ng’abo abayinza okugumiikiriza omukwano gwe, nga bamaze okumanya nti alina endowooza ng’eyo ku bo, ddala kye kiseera eky’okwemulugunya ku, n’okuvunaana okusomesebwa okwo, okwonoona emitima gyabwe bwe kutyo okutwalira awamu.

Kubanga, newankubadde kizibu okusalira emitima gy’abantu, naye we balangirira obusungu bwabwe n’obutaba na mirembe olw’ekintu kyonna, awo we beesalira bo bennyini omusango. Omukazi bw’aba tasobola kusonyiwa musajja alowooza nti talina bulungi bwa ndabika, wadde eky’okwewunda kyonna okuva mu kwambala kwe, awo alaga awatali kukyama embeera y’omutima gwe, era asalirwa omusango okusalawo kwe yennyini, so si kwa mulala.

Kubanga tetusunguwalira balala, okuggyako endowooza zaabwe ku ffe bwe ziwakanya eyo gye tulina ku ffe bennyini.

Omusajja atefuula kubeera muyivu, tasunguwalira abo abatamutwala nga muyivu: bwe kityo omukazi bw’aba nga talina ndowooza ku ndabika ye n’okwambala kwe, tasaanidde kusunguwalira abo abalina endowooza y’emu naye.

Kale ebivaamu ebibi eby’awamu eby’okusomesebwa kuno bimanyiddwa nnyo okusukka okukkiriza okubuusabuusa kwonna okw’amagezi.

Naye nga bwe kisoboka okukuza abawala mu ngeri esinga obulungi, ka empisa eno eddako ekirangirire.

Eusebia nnamwandu atya Katonda, ow’olulyo olulungi, ayigiriziddwa bulungi empisa, era alina obugagga obulungi obw’abawala bataano, b’akuza ng’omuntu eyakwasibwa Katonda okusaanya abawala embeerera bataano olw’obwakabaka obw’Eggulu. Amaka ge galina enteekateeka y’emu ng’ennyumba ey’eddiini, era ebiragiro byago byonna bigenderera okuwanirira okwewaayo eri Katonda okutakoma era okw’enkola.

Ye, abawala be, n’abaweereza be abakazi, bakuŋŋaana wamu mu ssaawa zonna ez’okusaba emisana, ne bayimba zabbuli n’okwewaayo okulala eri Katonda, era ne bamala ebiseera byabwe ebisigaddeyo mu bikolwa ebirungi n’eby’okwesanyusa ebitaliiko kabi ebibafuula abasaanira okudda ku zabbuli zaabwe n’essaala.

Abaagala ng’abaana be ab’omwoyo, era nabo bamussaamu ekitiibwa nga nnyaabwe ow’omwoyo, n’okwagala okusinga ennyo okw’emikwano egisinga okwagalana.

Agabye ekitundu ku bugagga bwe mu bo, buli omu asobole okusaasira okuva mu bibye, era buli omu ku bo akyuka mu kiseera kye okulabirira abaavu n’abalwadde ab’ekitundu ky’ekkanisa.

Eusebia abakuza mu bika byonna eby’emirimu egisaanira abakazi, ng’okutunga, okuluka, okuwuzza ewuzzi, n’ebitundu ebirala byonna eby’okulabirira amaka; si lwa kwesanyusa kwabwe, wabula balyoke babeere ab’omugaso eri bo bennyini n’abalala, era balokolebwe okuva mu kukemebwa okwo okugoberera obulamu obw’obugayaavu.

Ababuulira nti, yandisinze okubalaba nga bassiddwa mu bwetaavu bw’okweyimirizaawo olw’emirimu gyabwe, okusinga okubeera n’obugagga okwesonyiwa emirimu. Kubanga newankubadde, bw’agamba, muyinza okusobola okuyamba abaavu awatali mirimu gyammwe, naye olw’emirimu gyammwe mujja kusobola okubayamba okusingawo.

Singa Eusebia abadde wa ddembe okuva mu kibi nga bwe kisoboka eri obutonde bw’omuntu, kiri bwe kityo kubanga bulijjo atunula era yeekuuma okulwanyisa ebyokulabirako byonna eby’amalala. Era singa empisa ze ennungi za maanyi era za waggulu okusinga ez’abantu abalala, kiri bwe kityo kubanga zonna zisimbiddwa mu bwetoowaze obw’obuziba.

Baana bange, bw’agamba, kitammwe bwe yafa nnasaasirwa nnyo mikwano gyange olw’okubeera n’okufaayo kwonna okw’amaka, n’okuddukanya obugagga nga binzigwiddeko.

Naye ennaku yange yennyini yali nsimbe ku musingi mulala; nnanakuwala okulaba nga nziggiddwako mukwano omwesigwa bw’atyo, era nti ekyokulabirako eky’ettutumu bwe kityo eky’empisa ennungi ez’Ekikristaayo kyandiggiddwa mu maaso g’abaana be, nga tebannatuuka ku myaka egy’okukyagala n’okukigoberera.

Naye ku bikwata ku kweraliikirira kw’ensi, mikwano gyange kwe baalowooza nti kunzitoowerera nnyo, okusinga obungi kwe tweereetera ffe bennyini, era kuggwaawo amangu ddala nga bwe tumanya ffe bennyini.

Omuntu mu kirooto bw’atawaanyizibwa ebifaananyi ebyewuunyisa, obuzibu bwe buggwaawo amangu ddala nga bw’azuukuka, n’alaba nti bwali busirusiru bwa kirooto.

Kaakano, okwetegeera okutuufu bwe kuyingira mu mitima gyaffe, kuleeta enkyukakyuka nnene mu birowoozo byaffe byonna n’okutegeera, nga bwe tuzuukuka okuva mu kubungeeta okw’ekirooto.

Tukkiriza nti omuntu mulalu oba ali mu nnaku ennyingi alowooza nti ye ndabirwamu, era n’atya okusagaasagana; oba, ng’alowooza nti ye mubaka, n’atayaŋŋanga kuleka njuba kumwakako.

Naye, baana bange, waliwo ebintu mu nsi ebitwalibwa ng’amagezi, empisa ennungi, obukulu, essanyu, n’okukuzibwa obulungi, ebiraga obutamanya bunene obw’okwetegeera, era ebyandiyinzizza mu butuufu okutwalibwa ng’obulalu obujjuvu, nga omuntu bw’alowooza nti ye ndabirwamu oba ye muzira.

Omukazi atayaŋŋanga kulabika mu nsi awatali ngoye nnungi, alowooza nti ssanyu okubeera n’amaaso agasiigiddwa obulungi langi, okubeera n’olususu olweru obulungi, eyandisinze okufa okusinga okussibwa mu bwavu n’awalirizibwa okukola olw’okweyimirizaawo okw’obwavu, tamanyi ddala ye yennyini, nga oyo alowooza nti ye ndabirwamu.

Olw’ensonga eno, okwogera kwange kwonna nammwe, kubadde kwa kubamanyisa mmwe bennyini, n’okubamanyiiza ebitabo ng’ebyo n’okwewaayo eri Katonda, ebiyinza okusinga okubayigiriza okumanya kuno okusinga okumanya kwonna.

Mwandirowoozezza nti kizibu obutamanya maka ge mwazaalibwamu, bajjajja ki be mwava, n’obugagga ki obwali bubajjira. Naye, baana bange, muyinza okumanya bino byonna mu butuufu, kyokka ne mutamanya mmwe bennyini, nga oyo eyeetwala nti ye mubaka.

Kubanga newankubadde mwenna mwazaalibwa mu mubiri gwange, era mutwala erinnya lya kitammwe, naye mwenna muli myoyo mirongoofu. Sitegeeza nti temulina mibiri egyetaaga emmere n’ebyokunywa, n’otulo n’engoye, wabula nti byonna ebisaanidde okuyitibwa mmwe, si kirala wabula omwoyo; ekitonde eky’omwoyo era eky’amagezi mu butonde bwakyo, ekiwakanya ebitonde byonna eby’omubiri nga obulamu bwe buwakanya okufa; ekyakolebwa mu kifaananyi kya Katonda, okubeera omulamu emirembe gyonna, obutaggwaawo nate, wabula okunyumirwa obulamu, n’amagezi, n’okumanya, n’essanyu mu maaso ga Katonda, ne mu kibiina kya bamalayika, n’emyoyo egy’ekitiibwa emirembe n’emirembe.

Buli kintu kye muyita ekyammwe, ng’oggyeeko omwoyo guno, kiri ng’engoye zammwe zokka; ekintu eky’okukozesebwa okumala akaseera kokka, n’oluvannyuma ne kiggwaawo, ne kifa, ne kikaddiwa, era nga tekibategeeza kusinga ngoye n’emibiri gy’abantu abalala.

Naye, baana bange, temuli myoyo mu ngeri eno yokka, naye muli myoyo egyagwa, egyatandika obulamu bwagyo mu mbeera ey’obwonoonefu n’obutabulatabule, nga gijjudde empisa n’okwegomba ebiziba era ebiddugaza amagezi g’omutima gwammwe, era ebibakyamiza eri ekyo ekirumya.

Emibiri gyammwe si gya bwavu gyokka era egizikirira ng’engoye zammwe, naye giri ng’engoye ezirimu obulwadde, ezibajjuza endwadde embi n’obutali bulungi, ebinyigiriza omwoyo n’okwegomba okulwadde, n’okwetaaga okw’obwereere.

Kale ffenna tuli ng’ebitonde bibiri, ebirina, nga bwe kyandibadde, emitima ebiri munda mu ffe; n’omu tulaba, era tuwooma, era twewuunya amagezi, obulongoofu, n’obutukuvu: n’omulala tukyamira eri amalala, n’obutaliimu, n’amasanyu ag’omubiri.

Olutalo luno olw’omunda bulijjo tuluwulira munda mu ffe okusingawo oba okukendeerako: era bwe mwandyagadde okumanya ekintu kimu ekyetaagibwa eri ensi yonna, kye kino; okukuuma n’okutuukiriza byonna eby’amagezi, ebitukuvu, n’eby’obwakatonda mu butonde bwaffe, n’okufuga, okuggyawo, n’okuzikiriza obutaliimu bwonna obwo, amalala, n’okwegomba kw’omubiri, ebiva mu bwonoonefu bw’embeera yaffe.

Mwandirowoozezza, baana bange, bwe mutunuulira ensi, ne mulaba obulombolombo ki, n’emisono, n’amasanyu, n’ebizibu, n’enteekateeka, n’empisa, ebikozesa emitima n’ebiseera by’abantu, nti ebintu byali bwe bityo, nga bwe mbabuulidde?

Naye mmwe temukwatibwako bintu bino; ensi eri mu kirooto kinene, era abantu batono bokka abatunula mu yo.

Tulowooza nti tugwa mu kizikiza bwe tufa; naye, woowe, ffe abasinga obungi tuli mu kizikiza okutuusa olwo; era amaaso g’emyoyo gyaffe galyoka gatandika okulaba, amaaso gaffe ag’omubiri bwe gaba nga gaggalawo.

Kale mulaba embeera yammwe, baana bange; mulina okussa ekitiibwa, okulongoosa, n’okutuukiriza omwoyo oguli munda mu mmwe; mulina okugutegekera obwakabaka obw’Eggulu, okuguliisa n’okwagala Katonda n’empisa ennungi, okugwewunda n’ebikolwa ebirungi, n’okugufuula omutukuvu era ow’omu ggulu nga bwe musobola. Mulina okugukuuma okuva mu nsobi n’obutaliimu bw’ensi; okugulokola okuva mu bwonoonefu bw’omubiri, okuva mu masanyu ago ag’obulimba n’empisa ez’omubiri omubiri bye gugukema nabyo.

Mulina okuliisa emyoyo gyammwe n’okusoma okw’okutya Katonda n’okufumiitiriza okutukuvu, n’okutunula, okusiiba, n’okusaba, mulyoke muwoome, era munyumirwe, era mwegombe embeera eyo etaggwaawo, egenda okutandika obulamu buno bwe buliggwaawo.

Ku bikwata ku mibiri gyammwe, mulina okugitunuulira ng’ebintu eby’obwavu, ebizikirira, ebirwalalwala era ebyonoonese kaakano, era ebinaatera okugwa mu nfuufu eya bulijjo. Mulina okugitunuulira ng’abalabe abagezaako bulijjo okubakema n’okubalyamu, era n’olwekyo temugobereranga kubuulirira kwagyo n’amagezi gaagyo; mulina okugitunuulira ng’ekifo n’ennyumba y’emyoyo gyammwe, era n’olwekyo mugikuume nga mirongoofu, era nga miyonjo, era nga gisaanidde; mulina okugitunuulira ng’abaweereza n’ebikozesebwa eby’okukola, era n’olwekyo mugiwe emmere, n’okuwummula, n’engoye, gibeere n’amaanyi era nga miramu okukola emirimu gy’obulamu obw’okusaasira, obw’omugaso, obw’okutya Katonda.

Bwe mubeera bwe mutyo, mubeera nga bwe muli; era buli lwe mufaayo ekitono ku myoyo gyammwe, oba ekisingawo ku mibiri gyammwe, okusinga kino; buli lwe mwemalira okwewunda emibiri gyammwe, okusinga okutuukiriza emyoyo gyammwe, muba mubuze ddala okusinga oyo eyandisinze okubeera n’ekkooti erukiddwako obulungi okusinga omubiri omulamu.

Olw’ensonga eno, baana bange, sibayigirizanga kintu kyonna kya kabi gye muli okuyiga; mbakuumye okuva mu buli kintu ekyandibalyamu ne mugwa mu bunafu, n’obusirusiru; oba ekyandibaleetedde okulowooza nti ekintu kyonna kirungi, wabula omutima omulungi; ekintu kyonna kya ssanyu, wabula okusiimibwa Katonda; oba ekintu kyonna kyagalwa, wabula okukola ebirungi byonna bye musobola.

Mu kifo ky’eby’okwesanyusa eby’obwereere, ebitali bya mpisa nnungi eby’emizannyo n’opera, mbayigirizza okusanyukira okukyalira abalwadde n’abaavu. Ennyimba, n’amazina, n’eby’okwesanyusa bye biri eri bangi mu nsi, ekyo essaala n’okwewaayo eri Katonda, ne zabbuli, bye biri gye muli. Emikono gyammwe tegikozesebwanga mu kuluka enviiri, n’okwewunda emibiri gyammwe; wabula mu kutunga engoye ez’abali obwereere. Temwonoonanga bugagga bwammwe ku mmwe bennyini, naye mubwongeddeko emirimu gyammwe, okukola ebirungi ebisingawo eri abantu abalala.

Mu kifo ky’endabika ezikakiddwa, amaaso agateekeddwako obubala, empisa ez’obukungu ez’okwefuula, n’entambula ez’okwefuula, mbayigirizza okubikka emibiri gyammwe n’engoye ez’ekitiibwa, era muleke ensi obutaba na kintu kya kulaba ku mmwe, wabula obwangu, obwesimbu, n’obwetoowaze obw’enneeyisa yammwe yonna.

Mumanyi, baana bange, obutuukirivu obw’awaggulu n’empeera ennene ez’obubeerera; mumanyi nga bwe bununula okuva mu kweraliikirira kw’ensi n’ebizibu, era nga bwe buwa engeri n’emikisa egy’okukulaakulana okusingawo mu bulamu bwa Katonda; n’olwekyo, mwagale, era mussemu ekitiibwa, era muwe ekitiibwa obubeerera: mwebaze Katonda olw’ekibiina ekyo kyonna eky’ekitiibwa eky’abawala embeerera abatukuvu, okuva ku ntandikwa y’Obukristaayo, mu mirembe egy’enjawulo egy’Ekkanisa, abaaleka okweraliikirira n’amasanyu g’obufumbo, okubeera ebyokulabirako eby’olubeerera eby’okubeera obwomu, okufumiitiriza, n’okusaba.

Naye nga buli muntu bw’alina ekirabo kye ekimusaanira okuva eri Katonda, nga bwe mbatunuulira mwenna ng’emikisa mingi eminene egy’embeera y’obufumbo; bwe ntyo mbalekera okulonda, oba okukola nga nze bwe nnakola, oba okwegomba ebigero by’obutuukirivu ebisingawo mu mbeera y’obulamu obw’obubeerera.

Sirina kye njagala, sirina kye mbakaka, wabula okufuna ebisinga mu bulamu bw’abantu, n’okwegomba obutuukirivu; embeera yonna ey’obulamu gye munaalonda.

N’olwekyo temwetunuuliranga ng’abantu abalina okulabibwa, okwewuunyibwa, n’okwogerezebwa abasajja; wabula ng’aboonoonyi abaavu, abalina okwerokola okuva mu butaliimu n’obusirusiru bw’ensi ey’ennaku, olw’obwetoowaze, okwewaayo eri Katonda, n’okwefiiriza. Muyige okubeera ku lwammwe ne ku lw’okuweereza Katonda; era tewabanga kintu kyonna mu nsi ekirina omuwendo gye muli, wabula ekyo kye musobola okufuula obuweereza eri Katonda, n’engeri ey’essanyu lyammwe eriddako.

Mulowoozenga emirundi mingi nga bwe muyitibwa n’amaanyi eri obulamu obw’empisa ennungi, n’ebintu ebinene era eby’ekitiibwa Katonda by’abakoledde, okubaleetera okwagala buli kintu ekiyinza okutumbula ekitiibwa kye.

Mulowooze ku butaliimu n’obumpi bw’obulamu bw’abantu, era okufa n’obutaggwaawo bibeerenga emirundi mingi mu mitima gyammwe; kubanga ebirowoozo bino bijja kunyweza n’okugulumiza emitima gyammwe, bibafuule ab’amagezi era abeegendereza, era abategeera ddala obutono bw’ebintu byonna eby’abantu.

Mulowooze ku ssanyu ly’Abannabbi n’Abatume, abatukuvu n’abajulizi, abasanyuka kaakano mu maaso ga Katonda, era abeerabako nga bannannyini kitiibwa ekitaggwaawo. Olwo mulowooze nga kintu kyagalwa nnyo okutunula, n’okusaba, n’okukola ebirungi, nga bo bwe baakola, mulyoke bwe mulifa mufune omugabo gwammwe mu bo.

N’olwekyo oba mufumbiddwa, oba temufumbiddwa, mwetunuulire nga bamaama ne bannyinaabwe, nga mikwano n’ab’oluganda, eri bonna abeetaaga obuyambi bwammwe; era temwekkirizanga kubeera bagayaavu, ng’abalala beetaaga ekintu kyonna emikono gyammwe kye giyinza okubakolera.

Okwekozesa kuno okw’omugaso, okw’okusaasira, okw’obwetoowaze, kye mbasemba n’obunyiikivu bungi, ng’ekitundu ekikulu eky’obulamu obw’amagezi era obw’okutya Katonda. Era ng’oggyeeko ebirungi bye munaakolera abantu abalala olw’ekyo, buli mpisa ennungi ey’omutima gwammwe ejja kulongoosebwa nnyo kyo.

Kubanga oluvannyuma lw’okusoma, okufumiitiriza, n’okusaba, tewali kintu ekikuuma bwe kityo emitima gyaffe okuva mu kwegomba okw’obusirusiru, tewali kintu ekikuuma bwe kityo embeera y’omutima entukuvu era ey’amagezi, ng’okwekozesa okumu okw’omugaso, okw’obwetoowaze.

N’olwekyo temutunuuliranga mirimu gyammwe ng’eky’okwesanyusa ekirina okumalawo ebiseera byammwe, era ekiyinza okubeera eky’obwereere nga bwe mwagala; wabula mugitunuulire ng’ekintu ekirina okubeera eky’omugaso eri mmwe n’abalala, ekirina okuweereza ebigendererwa ebimu eby’obwegendereza eby’obulamu, okulokola n’okununula ebiseera byammwe, n’okubifuula okubagasa ng’emirimu gy’abantu bonna bwe girigezesebwa omuliro.

Bwe mwali abato, nnabaleka mu by’okwesanyusa ebitono, okwesanyusa mu bintu byonna ebitaliiko kabi; naye nga bwe mukuze kaakano ne mutuuka ku kumanya Katonda n’okwetegeera; nga emitima gyammwe bwe gimanyi kaakano omugaso n’omuwendo gw’empisa ennungi, era nga gigulumiziddwa n’enjigiriza ennene ez’eddiini, kaakano temulina kukola kintu kyonna ng’abaana, wabula okunyooma buli kintu eky’obwavu, oba eky’obwereere, oba ekitaliiko mugaso; kaakano mulina okufuula emirimu gy’emikono gyammwe okusaanira okutya Katonda kw’emitima gyammwe, n’okugikozesa olw’ebigendererwa bye bimu, era n’omwoyo gwe gumu, nga bwe mutunula era nga bwe musaba.

Kubanga bwe wabaawo ekirungi kyonna eky’okukolebwa olw’emirimu gyammwe, bwe muba nga musobola okwekozesa mu ngeri ey’omugaso eri abantu abalala; nga busirusiru, nga kiwakanya amagezi g’eddiini, okufuula ekyo eky’okwesanyusa obwereere, ekyandifuuliddwa mu bwangu bwe bumu okwegezaamu okusaasira okusinga obunene!

Mwandirowoozezza ki ku magezi g’oyo eyandikozesezza ebiseera bye mu kusogola amazzi, n’okukola ebyokunywa omuntu yenna by’atayinza kukozesa, olw’okwesanyusa bwokka n’enjawulo ya langi zaabyo n’obutangaavu, ng’ayinza, n’okutegana okutono n’okusaasaanya okutono, okumalawo ebyetaago by’abo abatalina kya kunywa?

Kyokka yandibadde akozeseddwa mu magezi nga abo abeesanyusa n’emirimu egikooya ng’egyo gye batetaaga, era nga kumpi tebamanyi ngeri ya kugikozesa nga giwedde; nga bayinza, n’okutegana okutono n’okusaasaanya okutono, okukola ebirungi bingi nga oyo ayambaza abali obwereere, oba akyalira abalwadde.

N’olwekyo musanyuke okumanya ebyetaago by’abantu abasinga obwavu, era emikono gyammwe ka gikozesebwe okubakolera ebintu eby’obwavu era ebya bulijjo, ng’obwetaavu bwabwe bwe bwetaaga. Bwe mufuula bwe mutyo emirimu gyammwe ekirabo n’obuweereza eri abaavu, emirimu gyammwe egya bulijjo gijja kukyusibwa gifuuke obuweereza obutukuvu, era gifuulibwe okusiimibwa Katonda ng’okwewaayo kwammwe eri Katonda.

Era ng’okusaasira bwe kuli empisa ennungi esinga obukulu mu zonna, nga bwe kwali bulijjo empisa enkulu ey’abatukuvu abasinga obukulu; bwe kityo tewali kiyinza kufuula kusaasira kwammwe kusinga kwagalibwa mu maaso ga Katonda, okusinga enkola eno ey’okukwongerako emirimu gyammwe.

Obwetoowaze bw’omulimu guno nabwo bujja kubagasa nga okusaasira kwagwo. Bujja kubakuuma okuva mu birowoozo byonna eby’obwereere n’eby’amalala ku mbeera yammwe n’okwawukana kwammwe mu bulamu, n’okuva mu kuyisa abaavu ng’ebitonde eby’ekika ekirala. Bwe mumanyiira emirimu gino n’obuweereza eri abaavu, ng’abakiise ba Yesu Kristo, mujja kuzuula mangu emitima gyammwe nga gigonze ne gifuuka obuwombeefu n’obwetoowaze obusinga obunene gye bali. Mujja kussa ekitiibwa mu mbeera yaabwe, mulowooze nti kitiibwa okubaweereza, era temusanyukanga nnyo mmwe bennyini nga bwe muba mukozesebwa n’obwetoowaze obusinga mu buweereza bwabwe.

Kino kijja kubafuula abayigirizwa ab’amazima aba Mukama wammwe omuwombeefu era Mukama, eyajja mu nsi teyajja kuweerezebwa, wabula okuweereza; era newankubadde yali Mukama wa byonna, era mu bitonde bye yakola yennyini, naye yali mu bo ng’omu aweereza.

Obukristaayo olwo bubeera n’ebivaamu byabwo ebisinga ekitiibwa ku mitima gyammwe, bwe bukyusizza bwe butyo omwoyo gwammwe, ne bubaggyako amalala gonna ag’obulamu, ne bubafuula abasanyukira okwetoowaza wansi w’abasinga obwavu mu bannammwe ebitonde bonna.

N’olwekyo mubeere, baana bange, nga bwe mwatandika obulamu bwammwe, mu mirimu egy’obwetoowaze olw’obulungi bw’abalala; era okukyala okw’emikolo n’okumanyagana okw’obwereere ka bifune ebiseera byammwe bitono nga bwe kisoboka. Temukolanga mikwano gya busirusiru, oba okwagala okw’obwereere eri abantu ab’enjawulo; wabula mwagale nnyo abo abasinga okukyusa okwagala kwammwe eri Katonda, n’okusaasira kwammwe eri ensi yonna.

Naye, okusinga byonna, mwewalenga okunyumya n’abakyakala abeeraga ab’empisa ez’obukungu, era temukyawa kirala okusinga okwogera okw’obwereere, okuwaanawaana n’okutendereza okw’abasajja ab’engeri eyo; kubanga be nsonyi z’ekikula kyabwe, era basaanidde okubeera omuzizo eri ekyaffe.

Bwe mugenda ebweru, obwetoowaze, obwegendereza, n’enneeyisa esaanidde, bibeere ekitiibwa kyokka kye mwetwalira; era ekisa, okusaasira, n’empisa ennungi, bibeere okukuzibwa obulungi kwokka kwe mulaga mu kifo kyonna.

Okwogera obubi, okuwaayiriza, oba okwogera ku balala nga tebaliiwo, bwe biba nga kwe kunyumya awo we mubeera, mukuume emitima gyammwe n’ennimi zammwe: munakuwale nnyo nga gy’obeera muli mu bakolima n’abalayira, era muveewo amangu ddala nga bwe musobola.

Newankubadde mugenderera okufumbirwa, naye ekiseera ekyo kireme kutuuka, okutuusa lwe mulifuna omusajja alina obutuukirivu obwo bwe mubadde mufubira mmwe bennyini; ayinza okubeera mukwano gw’empisa zammwe zonna ennungi, era gwe kisinga obulungi okubeera naye, okusinga okubulwa omugaso gw’ekyokulabirako kye.

Mwagale obwavu, era mussemu ekitiibwa abantu abaavu; olw’ensonga nnyingi, naye naddala olw’eno, kubanga Omulokozi waffe Omutendereze yali omu ku bo, era kubanga muyinza okubafuula bonna mikwano mingi era abawolereza eri Katonda ku lwammwe.

Mubakyalirenga era munyumyenga nabo emirundi mingi; emirundi mingi mujja kusanga obwangu, obutaliiko musango, obugumiikiriza, obuvumu, n’okutya Katonda okunene mu bo; era we batali bwe batyo, ekyokulabirako kyammwe ekirungi kiyinza okubalongoosa.

Musanyukirenga buli mukisa ogw’okukola ekikolwa eky’obwetoowaze, n’okwegezaamu obuwombeefu bw’emitima gyammwe, oba kibeere, ng’Ebyawandiikibwa bwe biyogera, mu kunaaza abatukuvu ebigere, kwe kugamba, mu kulabirira, n’okuweereza abo abali wansi wammwe; oba mu kugumiikiriza amalala n’empisa embi ez’abo be mwenkanya nabo, oba abali waggulu wammwe. Kubanga tewali kisinga bwetoowaze; bwe ttaka eggimu ery’empisa ennungi zonna; era buli kintu eky’ekisa era ekirungi kikula mu butonde okuva mu bwo.

N’olwekyo, baana bange, musabe obwetoowaze, era mubukole, era mugaane buli kintu mu kwambala, oba mu nneeyisa, oba mu kunyumya, ekirina endabika yonna ey’amalala.

Mufube okukola buli kintu ekisaanira okutenderezebwa, naye temukolanga kintu kyonna olw’okutenderezebwa; wadde okulowooza ku mpeera yonna olw’emirimu gyammwe gyonna egy’okwagala n’empisa ennungi, okutuusa Kristo lw’alijja ne bamalayika be bonna Abatukuvu.

Era okusinga byonna, baana bange, mwegendereze ebirowoozo eby’obwereere n’eby’amalala ku mpisa zammwe ennungi. Kubanga amangu ddala nga abantu bwe babeera mu ngeri eyawukana ku ngeri ey’ensi eya bulijjo, ne banyooma obutaliimu bwayo, Setaani ateeka mu mitima gyabwe obugulumivu bw’obutuukirivu bwabwe; era amatira basinge mu bikolwa ebirungi, kasita asobola okubafuula ab’amalala olw’ebyo.

N’olwekyo mukuume empisa zammwe ennungi n’eriiso ery’obuggya, era mugaane buli kirowoozo eky’obwereere, nga bwe mwandigaanye endowooza esinga obubi; era mulowooze nga kyandibadde kufiirwa kunene gye muli okulaba ebibala by’ebikolwa byammwe byonna ebirungi nga biriibwa obutaliimu bw’emitima gyammwe.

N’olwekyo temwekkirizanga kunyooma abo abatagoberera mateeka gammwe ag’obulamu: naye mukake emitima gyammwe okubaagala, era musabe Katonda ku lwabwe; era obwetoowaze ka bubeere bulijjo nga bubawuubaala mu matu, nti mmwe bennyini mwandigudde okuva mu mateeka ago enkya, singa Katonda yandibalese mu maanyi gammwe n’amagezi gammwe.

N’olwekyo, bwe mumala okumala obulungi ennaku n’ewiiki, temuganya mitima gyammwe kulowooza ku kintu kyonna ng’ekyammwe, wabula muwe ekitiibwa kyonna eri obulungi bwa Katonda, abayisizza mu mateeka ag’obulamu obutukuvu ng’ago, ge mwali temusobola kukuuma lwa maanyi gammwe; era mwegendereze okutandika olunaku oluddako, si ng’abakugu mu mpisa ennungi, abasobola okukola ebintu ebinene, wabula ng’abatandisi abaavu, abeetaaga obuyambi bwa Katonda obwa buli lunaku okubalokola okuva mu bibi ebisinga obukyafu.

Kitammwe omwagalwa yali musajja mwetoowaze, atunula, atya Katonda, era ow’amagezi. Obulwadde bwe bwe bwamukkirizanga okwogera nange, okwogera kwe okusinga kwali ku kusomesebwa kwammwe. Yali amanyi emigaso gy’obwetoowaze, yalaba okuzikirira amalala kwe gaaleeta mu kikula kyaffe; era n’olwekyo yanneegayirira, n’ebigambo ebisinga ekisa, okulekayo engeri ez’emisono ez’okusomesa abawala mu malala ne mu bugonvu, mu kufaayo ku bulungi bw’endabika yaabwe, n’okwambala; n’okubakuza mwenna mu byokulabirako ebisinga obwangu n’obutaba na kyemulugunyo eby’obulamu obw’obwetoowaze, obutukuvu, era obw’obunyiikivu.

Yanjigiriza etteeka ery’ekyewuunyo ery’obwetoowaze, lye yakuumanga ennaku zonna ez’obulamu bwe, lye lino: obutaleka makya gonna kuyita nga tetulowoozezza ku bunafu obumu n’obutasobola bwaffe, obuyinza okutuswaza, okutuleetera okukwatibwa ensonyi munda, n’okubeera n’endowooza ya wansi ku ffe bennyini.

N’olwekyo, mulowooze, baana bange, nti omwoyo gwa kitammwe omulungi, ali kaakano ne Katonda, gubogera nammwe okuyita mu kamwa kange; era okwegomba okw’emirundi ebiri okwa kitammwe, eyagenda, n’okwange, ali nammwe, ka kubawangule okwagala Katonda, okusoma obutuukirivu bwammwe, okukola obwetoowaze, n’okukola n’emirimu egitaliiko musango n’okusaasira ebirungi byonna bye musobola eri bannammwe ebitonde bonna, okutuusa Katonda lw’alibayita eri obulamu obulala.

Bw’atyo nnamwandu oyo atya Katonda bwe yasomesa abawala be.

Omwoyo gw’okusomesebwa kuno gwogera mu lwatu nnyo ku lwagwo, nti nsuubira nti teneetaaga kwogera kintu kyonna okukuwolereza. Singa twali tusobola okukulaba mu bulamu, nga bwe tukusoma mu bitabo, ensi yandizudde mangu ebivaamu eby’essanyu mu kwo.

Omuwala asomeseddwa bw’atyo, yandibadde mukisa eri amaka gonna g’ayingiramu; munno asaanidde eri omusajja ow’amagezi, era yandimufudde omusanyufu mu kufuga amaka ge, ne mu kusomesa abaana be.

Era oyo eyali oba atayagala, oba atayinza kwewaayo bulungi mu bufumbo, yandimanyi engeri y’okubeera olw’ebigendererwa ebinene era ebirungi ennyo mu mbeera ey’obubeerera.

Okumanya okwa bulijjo ennyo okw’omwoyo gw’Obukristaayo kulabika nga kumala okutumatiza, nti tewali kusomesebwa kuyinza kubeera kwa mugaso gwa mazima eri abakazi abavubuka, okuggyako okwo okubakuza mu bunyiikivu obw’obwetoowaze, mu bwangu bunene obw’obulamu, mu bwegendereza obutuufu obw’okwambala, empisa, n’enneeyisa, ne mu kwewaayo eri Katonda okukakali. Kubanga omukazi Omukristaayo yandibadde ki, wabula ekitonde ekyangu, ekitefuula, ekyegendereza, ekyetoowaze, ekikyawa buli kintu mu kwambala kwakyo n’enneeyisa ekiyinza okusikiriza amaaso g’abalabi, oba okusanyusa okwegomba kw’abantu abagwagwa era ab’obukaba?

Nga ateekwa okubeera omugwira ennyo eri Enjiri oyo atamanyi, nti yeetaaga kino okubeera omwoyo gw’omukazi atya Katonda!

Omulokozi waffe omutendereze agamba nti, "Buli muntu atunuulira omukazi n’amwegomba aba amaze okumwendako mu mutima gwe." [Matayo 5:28]

Okusomesebwa, okukyusa emitima gy’abakazi eri obukugu n’eby’okwewunda eby’okwambala n’obulungi bw’endabika, kwetaaga okuvumirirwa n’amaanyi okusinga olw’ebigambo bino? Kubanga ddala, singa eriiso liyinza okulyamibwa mu bwangu bwe butyo era mu ngeri ey’akabi bwe etyo, buli bukugu na buli kya kwewunda kivumiriddwa ekimala, ekigenderera mu butonde okulirimba.

Era omukazi atya Katonda ayinza atya okukyawa n’okwewala mu butuufu ekintu kyonna, okusinga ekyo ekifuula omubiri gwe okusingawo ekyambika n’okukemebwa eri abantu abalala? Singa okwegomba okubi n’amaaso ag’obukaba bwe kufa kw’omwoyo, waliwo abakazi abayinza okwerowooza nti tebaliiko musango, abasikiriza eriiso okwonoona n’ebifuba ebyeyambudde, amaaso agateekeddwako obubala, na buli kya kwewunda eky’okwambala?

Era nga bwe watali kwekwasa kwa butaliiko musango mu nneeyisa ng’eyo, bwe kityo tebayinza kumanya ngeri ya kuteeka kkomo ku musango gwabwe. Kubanga nga bwe batayinza kumanya bungi oba emirundi emeka gye baleetedde abantu abalala okwonoona, bwe kityo tebayinza kumanya musango gwenkana wa oguliteekebwa ku bo bennyini.

Kino, omuntu yandirowoozezza, kyandimaze okutiisa buli mukazi atya Katonda okuva ku buli kintu ekiyinza okumufuula ensonga ey’okwegomba okubi mu bantu abalala.
